column1: A  good performance, to be sure. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And, even now,  communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.  Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
column2: 确实是不错的表现。布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围希望。而且，即便此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通已被切断。列宁格勒如今应可轻易拿下；莫斯科会更棘手些。

column1: A chain of unfortunate incidents with the Soviets along the Chinese - Soviet border has opened the way for the outbreak of full scale military operations.  As you know, the relationship with our former Soviet allies has badly deteriorated.  Moscow doesn't like our own interpretation of Marxism and wants to take us back to the ''correct'' communist system.  To punish us, they have launched an invasion across the Amur River, the natural border between the PRC and the USSR.  They have captured a many square kilometers of Chinese territory, including some villages.
column2: 中苏边境沿线一连串不幸事件，为全面军事行动的爆发打开了道路。如你所知，我们与从前的苏联盟友的关系已严重恶化。莫斯科不喜欢我们对马克思主义自己的解释，想让我们回到"正确"的共产主义制度。为了惩罚我们，他们越过黑龙江——中华人民共和国与苏联之间的天然边界——发动了入侵。他们已夺取了许多平方公里的中国领土，包括一些村庄。

column1: A coded radio transmission was intercepted from the Greek submarine facility before you captured it. Radio traces now indicate a secret Soviet sub base in Sweden was the reciever of the transmission. Air recons confirm that more of the advanced submarines are being produced there. Your job is to lead the attack on this facility Commander.If you can neutralize these subs, not only will Allied shipping be safe but we will be able to set up an invasion force to retake Soviet-held Scandanavia from this beachhead...
column2: 在你夺取那座希腊潜艇设施之前，我们截获了一段加密无线电传输。无线电追踪现在表明，瑞典(Sweden)境内一处秘密苏联潜艇基地是这段传输的接收方。空中侦察证实那里正在生产更多这种先进潜艇。你的任务就是指挥对这座设施的进攻，指挥官。如果你能解除这些潜艇的威胁，不仅盟军航运将安全，我们还能从此滩头组建一支入侵部队，夺回苏占斯堪的纳维亚……

column1: A complete failure! To our south, US divisions moving north have relieved the surrounded 101Abn at Bastogne and continue moving north, threatening to cut us of from the main lines.
column2: 彻底失败！在我们南面，北上的美军师已为巴斯托涅(Bastogne)被围的第101空降师解围，并继续北进，威胁要切断我们与主防线的联系。

column1: A complete failure. You lost Kharkov and Russian advances North and South of the city force us to retreat to the Dniepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
column2: 彻底失败。你丢掉了哈尔科夫，俄军在该城南北的推进迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整与整补。只有一支战斗群会留在东线，直到 1944 年春天。

column1: A costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.

column1: A fourth year plebe could have done better than that General.
column2: 四年级军校生都能比你做得更好，将军。

column1: A German-Romanian army tries to capture Grozny in the Caucasus Mountains.
column2: 一支德罗联军试图夺取高加索山脉(Caucasus Mountains)中的格罗兹尼(Grozny)。

column1: A good performance, commander, but the brass seems to think you could have moved a lot faster than you did. Don't worry, we'll get them next time.
column2: 表现不错，指挥官，但上面那些人似乎认为你本可以推进得快得多。别担心，下次我们收拾他们。

column1: A good performance, to be sure. Kyiv has fallen; the Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And now, Moscow is threatened.
column2: 确实是一场出色的表现。基辅(Kyiv)已经陷落；布尔什维克各集团军已被切断，救援无望。而现在，莫斯科也受到威胁。

column1: A horrible massacre... this time the high command has decided to avoid your sepukku, since your services have been requested from Tokyo...
column2: 一场惨烈的屠杀……这一次高层决定免您切腹，因为东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

column1: A huge battle against the last Soviet units is about to begin, the Red army will fight to the finish and has countless forces. Unfortunately bad weather conditions are on its side like in 1941...
column2: 一场对付苏军最后部队的大战即将开始，红军将战至最后，且兵力不计其数。不幸的是，与 1941 年一样，恶劣天气站在他们一边……

column1: A Kamfgruppe of your division will stay on the Eastern front until June 1st, but you are ordered to move to France to prepare the reorganization of Das Reich into a Panzer-Grenadier division.
column2: 你师的一个战斗群将留在东线直到6月1日，但你奉命调往法国，为「帝国」师改编为装甲掷弹兵师做准备。

column1: A large British army has been spotted in Israel, proceed there at once.
column2: 已在以色列(Israel)发现一支庞大的英军，立即前往该地。

column1: A lot of armoured units has been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the Tommies are trying to stop our assault over Tobruk, which is completely besieged now. Unfortunately, we should stop the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. In the other hand, beware with the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they would be able to attack us from behind.
column2: 在我们的前沿阵地已发现大量装甲部队。英国佬肯定是在设法阻止我们对托布鲁克(Tobruk)的突击，而该地现在已被彻底围困。遗憾的是，我们应当停止对托布鲁克的进攻，以挡住英国人的进攻！另一方面，要当心从托布鲁克出来的敌军部队，如果你不加小心，他们就能从背后攻击我们。

column1: A lot of armoured units have been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the enemy is trying to stop our assault on Tobruk, which is completely besiged now. Unfortunately we must halt the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. On the other hand, beware the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they will be able to attack us from behind.
column2: 我军前沿阵地发现大量装甲部队。敌人肯定是在设法阻止我们对托布鲁克的进攻，而托布鲁克现在已被彻底包围。遗憾的是，我们必须停止对托布鲁克的攻击，以阻止英军的进攻！另一方面，要提防托布鲁克的敌军部队，一不留神，他们就会从背后袭击我们。

column1: A magnificent but costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.
column2: 一场辉煌但代价高昂的胜利，将军阁下。继续向莫斯科推进。
国之危难（第1部分） - 1941 年 3 月 16 日
国之危难（第2部分） - 1941 年 4 月 21 日

column1: A new attack, begun on 25th January by Konev's 2nd Ukrainian Front, in four days linked up with Vatunin's 1st Ukrainian Front and encircled 6 German divisions at Korsun-Shevchenkovsky, north-west of Cherkassy.  Hitler refused to countenance any breakout attempt, insisting that von Manstein instead link up with the trapped forces and thus re-eastablish the Dniepr Line.
column2: 1 月 25 日，科涅夫(Konev)的乌克兰第2方面军(2nd Ukrainian Front)发起新的进攻，四天后与瓦图京(Vatunin)的乌克兰第1方面军会合，在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)西北的科尔孙-舍甫琴柯夫斯基(Korsun-Shevchenkovsky)合围了 6 个德军师。希特勒拒不同意任何突围尝试，坚持要冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)改为与被围部队会合，从而重建第聂伯河(Dniepr)防线。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook "Hennepot".
column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一锅“鸡肉砂锅”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Carbonnade flamande".
column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“弗拉芒啤酒炖牛肉”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Filet américain".
column2: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Filet américain”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Gegratineerd witloof".
column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“焗菊苣”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Lapin à la gueuze".
column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“啤酒炖兔肉”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Moules frites".
column2: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Moules frites”。

column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“土豆泥”。

column1: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Waterzooi".
column2: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“瓦特佐伊炖菜”。

column1: A new Troika has formed and is asking for terms.
column2: 新的三巨头已经组成，并正在请求和谈条件。

column1: A nice but costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.
column2: 一场漂亮但代价高昂的胜利，将军阁下。继续向莫斯科推进。

column1: A number of Trigger Hexes on map (see listed below)
column2: 地图上设有若干触发格（详见下文）

column1: A properly planned amphibious assault, supported by massive naval
column2: 一场计划周密的登陆突击，若有强大的海军

column1: A properly planned amphibious assault, supported by massive naval gunfire, was difficult if not impossible to repel. At Salerno, the Germans, who didn't know this, almost crushed the beachhead and might have done so with just slightly better luck.
column2: 一次计划周密的登陆作战，在强大舰炮火力支援下，即使并非不可能，也很难被击退。在萨莱诺(Salerno)，不知道这一点的德军几乎碾碎了滩头阵地，若是运气稍好一点，他们或许就能成功。

column1: A Soviet scientist wishes to defect to our cause, bringing with him intimate knowledge of Stalin's nuclear weapon program. However, there is a limited gap of time for us to rescue him from the Soviet base in Riga before Soviet units arrive to reinforce the base. Our forces have begun an amphibious landing in the area. Secure the area as quickly and efficently as possible, to retrieve the scientist's crucial information and also to begin the liberation of the Baltic states.
column2: 一名苏联科学家希望投奔我们的事业，他会带来关于斯大林(Stalin)核武器计划的详尽内情。不过，我们要在苏军部队赶来增援里加(Riga)基地之前把他从那里救出来，时间窗口很有限。我军已在该地区开始登陆。尽快、尽可能高效地控制该地区，取回那名科学家的关键情报，同时开始解放波罗的海诸国。

column1: A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys!  Good job, good job, son.
column2: 一场壮观的胜利，而且是在极其不利的条件下！看来这一仗可能让你再添一颗星。我听说你一直和你的小伙子们一起在最前线！干得好，干得好，孩子。

column1: A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys! Good job, good job, son.
column2: 一场壮观的胜利，而且是在极其不利的条件下！看来这一仗可能让你再添一颗星。我听说你一直和你的小伙子们一起在最前线！干得好，干得好，孩子。

column1: A summary of the conflict from 1940-1942
A victory here will allow crossing over the Vistula River to the Oder.
column2: 在此取胜将可以渡过维斯瓦河(Vistula)直抵奥得河(Oder)。

column1: A victory here will put Finland out of the war.
column2: 在此取胜将使芬兰退出战争。

column1: A) At first, you must destroy the allied fleet on the Channel, our fleet will arrive from the Baltic to accomplish this task. Soviet submarines recently developed may strongly help you. Be aware that if you try to drive your troops without sunking the enemy fleet, they will destroy your troops.
column2: A) 首先，你必须摧毁海峡上的盟军舰队，我们的舰队将从波罗的海(Baltic)前来完成这项任务。苏联最近研制的潜艇可能会给你很大帮助。要注意，如果你不击沉敌方舰队就驱兵前进，他们会摧毁你的部队。

column1: A) Defend Ortona, Orsogna, Guardiagrele and Pennapiedimonte
column2: A) 防守奥尔托纳、奥尔索尼亚、瓜尔迪亚格雷莱(Guardiagrele)与彭纳皮耶迪蒙特(Pennapiedimonte)

column1: A) Soviet troops have disembarked towards the South-West of the island, pursueing the remaining north American troops from Vladivostok. You must destroy those troops.
column2: A) 苏军部队已在岛屿西南部登陆，从符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)追击剩余的北美部队。你必须消灭那些部队。

column1: able to transmit the schematics...let's hope they never got that chance.
column2: 把图纸传出去了……但愿他们从未得到那个机会。

column1: According to Intelligence a sharp attack of German infantry around the locality of Halen is expected. The 4th Panzerdivision has moved further south towards Gembloux (Gembloers) where it would meet the French Cavalry units of Prioux. So luckily it seems you will not have to fight the German tanks again.
column2: 据情报判断，德军步兵将在哈伦附近发起猛烈进攻。第4装甲师已南调至让布卢（Gembloers），将在那里迎战普里乌指挥的法军骑兵部队。因此幸运的是，您这次似乎不必再与德军坦克交手。

column1: According to the intelligence service, you will have to fight against several panzerdivisions from the XIX Panzerkorps of Guderain, so be prepared!  We have also been informed that paratroopers may land behind our lines, probably close to Neufchâteau (20,25).
column2: 据情报部门称，你将面对古德里安第19装甲军的数个装甲师，做好准备！我们还获悉，伞兵可能会降落在我们战线后方，很可能在讷沙托(20,25)附近。
王牌在手(Ace in the Hole) - 1942 年 4 月 19 日

column1: Act as quick as possible, the Japanese are going to use all available means to defeat any try to stop their penetration into China.
column2: 行动要尽可能迅速，日军将动用一切可用手段来挫败任何阻止其深入中国的企图。

column1: Adolf Hitler sent troops, aircraft, tanks, and other weapons to support Franco.
column2: 阿道夫·希特勒派出军队、飞机、坦克及其他武器支援佛朗哥。
肾上腺素飙升(Adrenaline Rush) - 1942 年 5 月 10 日

column1: Advance Fallschirmjager scouts report just a small French detachment.  It appears our deception of landing in Tunisia has succeeded and the British have left Algiers unguarded.
column2: 先遣伞兵侦察部队报告，只有一支小规模法军分遣队。看来我们登陆突尼斯(Tunisia)的欺骗行动已经奏效，英军已弃守阿尔及尔。

column1: Advance On St. Lo PeG: WW2
Advance On St. Lo PeG: WW2
column2: 西线-02 向圣洛推进 PeG: WW2
西线-03 向圣洛推进：重制版

column1: Advance to the city of Winchester in order to cut the enemy grouping which is currently being slowly restored from our surprise attack, you won't find a strong resistance, but anyway you have to be really fast.
column2: 向温切斯特(Winchester)城推进，以割裂敌军集团——他们目前正从我们的突袭中缓慢恢复；你不会遇到顽强抵抗，但无论如何你必须非常快。
先头部队(Advanced Elements) - 1940 年 10 月 11 日

column1: After 19 days of indecisiveness - known as the 19 day interregnum, Hitler has decided you and the rest of Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe need turn South to assist Von Rundstedt's less successful Armee Gruppe Sud in the encirclement of Kiev - Ukraine - 350 km South of here. You are to make contact with von Kleist's 1 Pz Gruppe South of Konotop to complete the encirclement. The capture of Moscow will have to wait. Opposing your forces is the newly created Russian 40th Army assisted by the 2nd Air-landing Corps and the 10th Tank Division.
column2: 经过 19 天的犹豫不决——史称 19 天权力空窗期——希特勒决定让你和古德里安(Guderian)第2装甲集群的其余部队转向南面，协助冯·伦德施泰特(Von Rundstedt)不太顺利的南方集团军群(Armee Gruppe Sud)合围基辅(Kiev)——乌克兰(Ukraine)——在此地以南 350 公里。你要在科诺托普(Konotop)以南与冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)的第1装甲集群会合，完成合围。攻取莫斯科(Moscow)只能往后推了。与你对抗的是新组建的俄国第40集团军，配属有第2空降军与第10坦克师。

column1: After 4 days of fighting, Goering decided to force the Dutch in Rotterdam to surrender by bombing the city. When Generalleutnant Schmidt (9th PzDiv) reached an agreement on the terms of surrender of Rotterdam with it's Dutch commander, it was too late to recall all bombers and Rotterdam city center got hit very hard. The same day, Dutch General Winkelman decided to have all equipment destroyed in preparation for the overall Dutch surrender.
column2: 经过4天战斗，戈林决定以轰炸城市的方式迫使鹿特丹的荷兰人投降。当施密特中将（第9装甲师）与鹿特丹的荷军指挥官就投降条款达成一致时，已来不及召回所有轰炸机，鹿特丹市中心遭到重创。同一天，荷兰温克尔曼将军决定销毁所有装备，为荷兰全军投降做准备。

column1: After a day of heavy fighting the Leibstandarte seized the Klidi Pass.  The British immediately began to withdraw to a defensive line west of Mount Olympus and the Greek 1st Army began to pull out of Albania.
column2: 经过一天激战，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)夺取了克利迪山口(Klidi Pass)。英军随即开始向奥林匹斯山(Mount Olympus)以西的一道防御线撤退，希腊第1集团军也开始撤出阿尔巴尼亚(Albania)。

column1: After a hard winter in Russia, your division is rested and re-equipped. The division is re-designated as SS Panzer-Grenadier Division Das Reich. As a reaction to the Allied landings in North-Africa, Hitler ordered Operation Anton - the occupation of Vichy France to protect it against the Allies. The French were allowed to hold the port of Toulon, to defend it against an Allied invasion. Now Hitler has changed his mind and wants Operation Lila executed. We are to move into Toulon and capture the Vichy French fleet that Hitler has promised to Mussolini. You will have to move fast because the French are expected to scuttle their fleet, rather than hand it over to us. French GMR and SOL forces are thought to be more favorable to our cause than the rest of the Vichy French troops.
column2: 在俄国经历一个严酷的冬天后，你的师得到休整和重新装备，并改称党卫军装甲掷弹兵「帝国」师。为回应盟军在北非登陆，希特勒下令执行「安东」行动——占领维希法国，以防其落入盟军之手。法国人获准保留土伦港，以抵御盟军入侵。如今希特勒改变了主意，要执行「百合」行动。我们要开进土伦，夺取希特勒许诺给墨索里尼的维希法国舰队。你必须行动迅速，因为预计法国人会凿沉舰队，而不是交给我们。据信，法国的 GMR 和 SOL 部队比维希法国其他部队更倾向于我方。

column1: After a night marked by continuous infantry battles in puring rain, by dawn the Leibstandarte assaulted bunkers and fortified positions in the second line of defensive works.  In a day of heavy fighting, the panzers of the Leibstandarte engaged the 1st Guards Armoured Brigade and destroyed a large part of it.  The advanced carried the front line to Pokrovka, south-west of Prokhorovka.
column2: 在倾盆大雨中经历了一整夜接连不断的步兵战斗之后，拂晓时警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)向第二道防御工事线的地堡与坚固阵地发起突击。在一天的激烈战斗中，警卫旗队的装甲部队与近卫第1装甲旅交战，并歼灭了其大部。这次推进把前线推到了普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)西南的波克罗夫卡(Pokrovka)。

column1: After Angloamerican's disembarks in the Afrikan coasts they'd surround us. Due to our lack of forces we failed to resist in battle.
column2: 英美军队在非洲海岸登陆后，就将我们合围。由于兵力不足，我们未能抵挡住。

column1: After containing the Allied beachhead, but failing to capture Anzio, the Germans established defensive positions. This is your chance to change history. Be aware that your units are the only ones that can attack, so analyse if you main forces will attack Anzio or not. This battle will be harder than the last one.
column2: 在遏制住盟军登陆场、但未能夺取安齐奥之后，德军建立了防御阵地。这是你改变历史的机会。注意，你的部队是唯一能进攻的部队，所以要分析你的主力是否会进攻安齐奥。这一战将比上一战更难。

column1: After crossing the Ardenne Forest, your task is to strike the enemy at Sedan, where the Frenchs don't expect an attack. Drive your Panzer divisions to cross the Meuse River, and clear this sector, from Sedan to Rethel. Although we surely will surprise the Frenchs, they will sent at least one Army Corps as reinforcements. Exploit at the maximun the Blitzkrieg here, and show what we are capable of.
column2: 穿过阿登森林(Ardenne Forest)之后，你的任务是在色当(Sedan)打击敌人，法国人没料到那里会遭到进攻。率领你的装甲师渡过默兹河(Meuse)，并肃清从色当到勒泰勒(Rethel)的这段地区。虽然我们肯定能打法国人一个措手不及，但他们至少会派一个军作为增援。在这里把闪击战发挥到极致，让他们看看我们的本事。

column1: After defeat in Tobruk, Rommel had pressured the High Command to take Malta in order to have a secured route of supplies for the forthcoming invasion of Egypt. A seaborne and airborne invasion of Malta has been planned by the OKW.
column2: 托布鲁克(Tobruk)战败之后，隆美尔(Rommel)曾向最高统帅部施压，要求夺取马耳他(Malta)，以便为即将到来的入侵埃及确保一条补给路线。国防军最高统帅部(OKW)已策划了一场对马耳他的海上与空降入侵。

column1: After departure from Cherbourg in the past hours, we have reached this nearby point to Plymouth, the little port of Lyme Regis, where you should make the third beach-head, and start to advance following the plan. Two LuftWaffe's Squadrons are above us, and they will show the British what the LuftWaffe is capable of with valuable support, as well as some little Kriegsmarine support ships, wich will destroy the sea mines deployed in all the Lyme Bay by the British. In the other hand, you could test our new amphibious Panzers!, we have just dropped them into the water, and now they are rumbling under the sea!. Be aware, in spite of the defense of Lyme consist of Home Guard militias only, it's possible they will receive some reinforcements from the North.
column2: 在几小时前从瑟堡(Cherbourg)出发之后，我们已抵达靠近普利茅斯(Plymouth)的这一点——莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)小港，你应在此建立第三个滩头阵地，并按计划开始推进。我们上空有两个德国空军中队，他们将用宝贵的支援让英国人见识德国空军的本事；此外还有几艘小小的德国海军支援舰，它们将摧毁英国人在整个莱姆湾(Lyme Bay)布设的水雷。另一方面，你可以检验我们新型两栖装甲车！我们刚把它们放下水，现在它们正在海底下轰隆隆地前进！要注意，尽管莱姆(Lyme)的防御只有本土防卫队民兵，他们仍可能从北面得到一些增援。

column1: After fall of Rumania and Bulgaria, Germans are on the run.
column2: 罗马尼亚(Rumania)与保加利亚(Bulgaria)陷落之后，德军正在溃逃。

column1: After five days of bitter fighting, the SS-Panzer Corps reached the city of Kharkov.  Three more days of viscious fighting throughout the city followed, and the city was secured on the 14th March.  On the 18th, Byelgorod was retaken, thus regaining the defensive line of the Donets to Byelgorod, and correcting the tactical situation brought about by the Stalingrad disaster.
column2: 经过五天苦战，党卫军装甲军(SS-Panzer Corps)抵达哈尔科夫(Kharkov)城。随后全城又进行了三天激战，该城于 3 月 14 日被确保。18 日，别尔哥罗德(Byelgorod)被夺回，从而恢复了顿涅茨河(Donets)至别尔哥罗德的防线，纠正了斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)灾难所造成的战术态势。

column1: After many days of hard fighting in the northern part of Sicily elements of the Italian division "Aosta" and the 15th Panzergrenadier managed to briefly stop the overwhelming advance of Pattons forces. Patton was forced to replace the 3rd Infantry Division with the 45th because very high losses amongst his men. Meanwhile Patton was also concentring a large amount of artillery to try to break the Axis lines at Etna. Your mission is to stop the American advance and give the Axis time to evacuate the stationed troops on Sicily.
column2: 在西西里(Sicily)北部苦战多日之后，意大利「奥斯塔」(Aosta)师与第15装甲掷弹兵师的部分部队设法短暂挡住了巴顿(Patton)部队的压倒性推进。由于人员损失极为惨重，巴顿不得不把第3步兵师换成第45步兵师。与此同时，巴顿还在集中大量炮兵，试图突破埃特纳(Etna)的轴心国防线。你的任务是挡住美军的推进，给轴心国争取时间撤走驻西西里的部队。

column1: After negotiations between Germany and Poland broke down, Pz Division Kempf units crossed the border into Poland on August 26th 06h00. At the last minute the order to attack was postponed and it wasn't until 09h00 that all the units had been recalled to their assembly points.
column2: 德波谈判破裂后，肯普夫装甲师的部队于8月26日6时越过边境进入波兰。最后一刻进攻命令被推迟，直到9时所有部队才被召回集结点。

column1: After our assault on the Philippines in December of the past year, the enemy forces have been defeated, and these islands are clearly into our hands, however, there are still some pockets of enemy resistance. The most of the enemy troops are entretched on the Bataan peninsula, where they are desperately trying to resist our assaults...
column2: 在去年12月我们对菲律宾发起进攻之后，敌军已被击败，这些岛屿显然已落入我们手中，不过仍有若干敌军抵抗的孤立据点。敌军大部分部队据守巴丹半岛，拼命抵抗我们的进攻……

column1: After our Blitz advance over Duenkirchen, the remnants of the Allied forces are enclosed arond the Ypres Channel and the city of Lille. Your mission is to end with the enemy resistance as soon as possible, by attacking from the South, taking Lille, and the another mission objective.
column2: 在我军闪击推进越过迪恩基兴之后，盟军残部被围困在伊普尔(Ypres)海峡与里尔(Lille)城一带。你的任务是尽快终结敌人的抵抗：从南面进攻，夺取里尔，以及另一个任务目标。

column1: After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. That units are surely the remnants of the 1st Armored division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate that is deployed around Bengazhi.
column2: 在我们成功夺回布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)与阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)之后，反攻必须继续。英国人现在正试图在贝达富姆(Beda Fomm) - 班加西(Bengazhi) - 梅基利(Mechilli)地区重整一些部队。那些部队肯定是第1装甲师与第4印度师的残部，情报报告指出第4印度师部署在班加西周边。

column1: After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. These units are surely the remnants of the enemy 1st Armored Division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate is deployed around Bengazhi.
column2: 在成功夺回布赖加港和阿杰达比亚之后，反攻必须继续下去。英军目前正试图在贝达富姆——班加西——梅基利一带重整部分部队。这些部队肯定是敌军第1装甲师和第4印度师的残部，情报显示后者部署在班加西周边。

column1: After partial success in capturing Caen, the British attempt to push the
column2: 在夺取卡昂(Caen)取得部分成功后，英军试图把

column1: After partial success in capturing Caen, the British attempt to push the Germans out of Caen and breakout of Normandy.
column2: 在夺取卡昂(Caen)取得部分成功后，英军试图把德军逐出卡昂，并冲出诺曼底(Normandy)。

column1: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
column2: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消「堡垒」行动。

column1: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle. Unfortunately, we will not be able to completely finish of the Russian armor with the 3 Panzer divisions we kept in reserve.
column2: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消「堡垒」行动。遗憾的是，我们无法用留在预备队的3个装甲师将俄军装甲部队彻底歼灭。

column1: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
column2: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消「堡垒」行动。

column1: After success in North Africa and Sicily, The Americans, along with their British allies, decide to invade the soft underbelly of Europe.  You are to lead your troops in the struggle to free Europe from Axis control.  Anything less than an Axis unconditional surrender is unacceptable.
column2: 在北非与西西里(Sicily)取胜之后，美国人同他们的英国盟友决定入侵欧洲柔软的下腹部。你将率你的部队投入把欧洲从轴心国控制下解放出来的斗争。任何不及轴心国无条件投降的结果都不可接受。

column1: After taking Skopje, the Leibstandarte turned soouth, and headed for the strategically important Monastir Gap - the gateway to Greece.  The reconnaissance battalion of the Leibstandarte that had been sent ahead did not encounter any strong opposition until it reached the area east of Florina. Against all expectations, the enemy had left open the Monastir Gap. The Germans did not hesitate to exploit their advantage and continued the advance in the direction of Kozani.
column2: 夺取斯科普里(Skopje)后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)转向南面，直趋具有战略意义的莫纳斯提尔山口(Monastir Gap)——通往希腊的门户。先前派出的警卫旗队侦察营直到抵达弗洛里纳(Florina)以东地区才遇到顽强抵抗。出乎一切预料，敌人让莫纳斯提尔山口敞开着。德军毫不犹豫地利用这一优势，继续向科扎尼(Kozani)方向推进。

column1: After the Allies's retreat towards the beach and due to impossibility of the Germans to get there quickly, the Allies have fortified. Now is your chance to eliminate the beachhead at Anzio once and for all.
column2: 在盟军撤向滩头、而德军无法迅速赶到之后，盟军已筑垒固守。现在是你一劳永逸地清除安齐奥(Anzio)滩头的机会。

column1: After the Anglo-American's disembark on the African coasts they'll surround us. Due to our lack of forces we be unable to resist in battle.
column2: 英美在非洲海岸登陆后将包围我们。由于兵力不足，我们将无力在战斗中抵抗。

column1: After the Balkans campaign, the Leibstandarte was given divisional status and reinforced with a new motorised infantry battalion.  Manpower shortages - thanks to restrictions placed on the number of SS personnel allowed by the Army - meant the division couldnt be fully fleshed out with reinforcements, and the situation was not helped any by Himmler's insistance that the Leibstandarte remain 'racially pure'.  While Volksdeutsche could serve in the SS, they were not accepted into the LSSAH.
column2: 巴尔干战役之后，警卫旗队获得了师级建制，并以一个新的摩托化步兵营得到加强。兵员短缺——由于陆军对党卫军人员数量所设的限制——意味着该师无法用补充兵员充实到满编，而希姆莱(Himmler)坚持警卫旗队必须保持「种族纯洁」，更使情况雪上加霜。虽然德意志裔人(Volksdeutsche)可以在党卫军服役，却不被警卫旗队接纳。

column1: After the battle of Stalingrad our units were broken.
column2: 斯大林格勒之战后，我部已元气大伤。

column1: After the British surrender, the OKH have selected you to defeat the remaining British troops which have not surrendered yet. While the Japanese will make the same in the Indian Ocean, we are going to destroy the British forces in the Mediterranean, starting with Gibraltar. General Franco finally have allowed us to cross Spain with three divisions wich are supported by a Spanish Infantry division, and by some Spanish navy and Kriegsmarine units. With those forces at your disposal you should take the Rock. The LuftWaffe will arrive to help you, as well as our special commandos 'Brandenburgers', in sea men suits. Good Luck!
column2: 英国投降之后，陆军总司令部(OKH)选定你去击败尚未投降的英军残部。日本人将在印度洋(Indian Ocean)做同样的事，而我们将摧毁地中海的英国军队，首先从直布罗陀(Gibraltar)开始。佛朗哥(Franco)将军终于允许我们带三个师穿越西班牙(Spain)，这三个师还得到一支西班牙步兵师以及若干西班牙海军与德国海军部队的支援。有这些兵力供你调遣，你应当夺取巨岩(the Rock)。德国空军将前来协助你，还有我们穿着水兵服的特种突击队「勃兰登堡」(Brandenburgers)。祝你好运！

column1: After the capture of Bristol, the last important point in our plans on the West coast of England is the city of Gloucester, if we destroy the British resistance here, we will take the control of all this area. Intelligence and our recon flights report us that the British have built here a good defensive line, using the rivers and the city. You will receive reinforcements from two Panzer Divisions, also you the 22nd FJ Division will help us again. Good Luck.
column2: 夺取布里斯托尔(Bristol)之后，我们计划中英格兰西海岸最后一个重要据点就是格洛斯特(Gloucester)城。如果我们在这里摧毁英国的抵抗，就能控制整个这一地区。情报与我们侦察机的报告都告诉我们，英国人利用河流与该城在这里构筑了一道良好的防线。你将得到两个装甲师的增援，另外你的第22伞兵师将再次协助我们。祝好运。

column1: After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will capture a military base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
column2: 攻占阿图岛(Attu)之后，我们可以说美国海军几乎已被摧毁。现在我们将夺取阿拉斯加(Alaska)的一处军事基地，以便取得一个开始入侵大陆的桥头堡。

column1: After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will take a militar base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
column2: 攻占阿图岛(Attu)之后，我们可以说美国海军几乎已被摧毁。现在我们将在阿拉斯加(Alaska)夺取一处军事基地，以便取得一个开始入侵大陆的桥头堡。

column1: After the crossing of the Canal Albert by German troops, the Belgian army has received the order to retreat to the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position). In order to protect the retreat and give time to take the new positions, you will support the "2e Division de Cavalerie" (2 DC) to establish a temporary defensive line in the Gete river, between Diest and Tienen (Tirlemont).
column2: 德军渡过阿尔贝特运河后，比利时军队已奉命撤往“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）。为掩护撤退并争取时间进入新阵地，您将支援“第2骑兵师”（2 DC），在迪斯特与蒂嫩（蒂尔勒蒙）之间的盖特河建立一道临时防线。

column1: After the defeat at Tobruk, Rommel had pressured the High Command to plan to take Malta, because for the intended advance to Egypt, they needed to have a secured route of supplies.
column2: 托布鲁克战败之后，隆美尔向最高统帅部施压，要求策划夺取马耳他，因为要按计划向埃及推进，就必须拥有一条安全的补给路线。

column1: After the defeat of the Africa Korps the next step for the Allies was the invasion of Sicily and the Italian mainland, hoping to force the surrender of this German allied and open a second front in Europe. They were expecting a quick victory and the retreat of the German army towards the Alps, but situation turned into a bloody conflict that lasted until the end of war.
column2: 非洲军(Africa Korps)被击败后，盟军的下一步是入侵西西里(Sicily)与意大利本土，希望迫使这个德国盟友投降，并在欧洲开辟第二战场。他们本指望速胜、指望德军向阿尔卑斯山(Alps)撤退，但局势却变成了一场持续到战争结束的血腥冲突。

column1: After the fall of Baghdad, we will never again suffer from the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with the most petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please give me a moment to explain to you the Persian situation:-
column2: 在巴格达陷落之后，我们再也不会饱受燃料匮乏之苦。只有波斯——世界上石油储量最多的地方之一——仍不在我们控制之下。请给我一点时间向您说明波斯的局势：

column1: After the fall of Baghdad, we won't suffer anymore the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with more petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please, let me a moment to explain you the Persian situation:
column2: 巴格达(Baghdad)陷落之后，我们再也不必忍受燃料短缺了。只有波斯(Persia)——世界上石油储量最多的地方之一——仍不在我们控制之下。请给我一点时间，向你说明波斯的局势：

column1: After the fall of Burma, the British will be busy for a long time! hahaha.  The Burma Road will no longer be the life line for our old Chinese enemies.  The Chinese supplies are running out quickly and now it's time to begin the end for the Chinese campaign at once.  We should take advantage of this opportunity!  Your mission is to capture Kunming, one of the latest supply depots the Chinese still hold.  This won't be easy because the mountain terrain will allow the dirty Chinese to ambush us every step of the way, but we count on you once again to complete this mission.
column2: 缅甸陷落之后，英国人将有很长时间忙不过来！哈哈哈。滇缅公路将不再是我们这些中国老对手的生命线。中国的补给正迅速耗尽，现在是立刻着手结束中国战役的时候了。我们应当利用这个机会！您的任务是夺取昆明，那是中国仍然掌握的最后几个补给基地之一。这不会容易，因为山地地形会让卑鄙的中国人一路伏击我们，但我们再次指望您来完成这项任务。

column1: After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports say that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible meeting with the Americans in the coming months.
column2: 在开罗和塞得港陷落之后，英国在埃及抵抗的最后一个据点是苏伊士运河。敌人已在苏伊士周边重整了一些部队，作为阻止我们的最后机会。情报报告称美国人正筹备不久后入侵北非，所以您必须尽快解决英国人，控制苏伊士运河，以便在今后几个月可能与美国人会师。

column1: After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez, as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports says that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon, so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible future meeting with the Americans in the next months.
column2: 在开罗(El Cairo)与塞得港(Port Said)陷落之后，英国在埃及最后的抵抗据点就是苏伊士运河(Suez Canal)。敌人已在苏伊士(Suez)周边重整了一些部队，作为阻止我们的最后机会。情报报告说，美国人很快就要准备入侵北非，所以你必须尽快解决英国人，控制苏伊士运河，以备未来几个月可能与美国人交手。

column1: After the fall of France, the Axis powers look for an avenue to Gibraltar.  They ask their one time partner, the Spanish Nationalists, but they deny land passage to the Straits.  With backing from the British, the Spanish await the Axis onslaught.
column2: 法国陷落之后，轴心国在寻找通往直布罗陀的途径。他们去问昔日的伙伴西班牙民族主义者，但对方拒绝给予穿越海峡的陆上通行权。在英国的撑腰下，西班牙人静候轴心国的猛攻。

column1: After the fighting in Holland, the Leibstandarte was offered a brief rest, during which it remained under the command of the 18th Army.  Shortly after it was transported south, and crossed into France on the 20th of May.  The regiment soon found itself under the new command of the XXXXIV Corps, 6th Army, Army Group B.  The Leibstandarte was then moved to positions along the Aa canal, which formed part of the defensive perimeter of the trapped BEF.
column2: 荷兰的战斗之后，警卫旗队得到短暂的休整，其间仍归第18集团军指挥。不久之后它被南运，并于 5 月 20 日进入法国。该团很快便归 B 集团军群第6集团军第44军指挥。随后警卫旗队被调往阿河(Aa)运河沿线的阵地，那里是被围英国远征军防御周界的一部分。

column1: After the first success against the British (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The British are withdrawing thier troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive on towards Benghazi, then later to Mechilli. In this way, Cyrenaica will be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.
column2: 在对英军取得首次胜利之后（此举也违背了希特勒的命令），形势正朝着有利于我们的方向转变。英军正在撤走其部队，梅尔萨布赖加已落入我们手中，现在我们必须继续向班加西、随后向梅基利进攻。这样，昔兰尼加就能得到确保，战线也可暂时恢复。

column1: After the first success agaisnt the Brits (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The Brits are withdrawing their troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive onwards to Benghazi, and later to Mechilli. This way, Cyrenaica would be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.
column2: 在对英国人取得首次胜利之后（而且是违背希特勒的命令取得的），局势正变得对我们有利。英国人正在撤走他们的部队，布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)已落入我们手中，现在我们必须继续攻势，向班加西(Benghazi)推进，随后再向梅基利(Mechilli)推进。这样一来，昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)就能得到确保，战线也能暂时恢复。

column1: After the Polish attacks, the Leibstandarte was withdrawn to the west, where it was attached to the forces attempting to encircle the Polish forces on the Bzura.  Under XVI Corps, the Leibstandarte played a major part in this operation, which was the largest battle of the Polish campaign.  Some of the heaviest fighting took place in the streets of Sochaczev, where strong resistance was encoutered.
column2: 在波兰的进攻之后，警卫旗队被撤往西面，配属给试图在布祖拉河(Bzura)合围波兰军队的部队。在第16军指挥下，警卫旗队在这场波兰战役中规模最大的战斗中发挥了重要作用。一些最激烈的战斗发生在索哈切夫(Sochaczev)的街巷中，在那里遭遇了顽强的抵抗。

column1: After the Russian 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps, now also some troops of the 33rd Army are encircled. Altough we expected more from you in this battle, you have stopped the Russian Winter offensive. Congratulations.
column2: 继俄军第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军之后，如今第33集团军的一些部队也被合围。虽然我们本以为你在这场战斗里能有更好的表现，但你毕竟遏止了俄军的冬季攻势。恭喜。

column1: After the Russian 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps, now also the 33rd Army is encircled. You have stopped the Russian Winter offensive. Congratulations.
column2: 继俄军第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军之后，如今第33集团军也被合围。你遏止了俄军的冬季攻势。恭喜。

column1: After the seizure of the Wattenberg heights, the Leibstandarte doggedly pursued the retreating enemy.  The 2nd Battalion tasked with capturing the town of Wormhoudt, encoutered stiff resistance from men of the British 48th Infantry Division, and on 28th May the town was still held by British forces.  As the fighting continued, a number of the 4th Chesire Regiment were taken prisoner and led to a barn, which was then raked with machine gun fire.  Grenades were then tossed inside, and by the time an officer had halted the slaughter, 65 of the 80 POW's were dead.  Those who survived this incident have since implicated Wilhelm Mohnke as the officer who gave the execution order.
column2: 夺取瓦滕贝格(Wattenberg)高地之后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)顽强追击退却之敌。受命夺取沃尔穆特(Wormhoudt)镇的第2营遭到英国第48步兵师(48th Infantry Division)士兵的顽强抵抗，到 5 月 28 日该镇仍由英军据守。战斗继续进行时，柴郡团第4营(4th Chesire Regiment)的一些人被俘并被带进一座谷仓，随后谷仓遭到机枪扫射。接着手榴弹被扔了进去，等到一名军官制止这场屠杀时，80 名战俘中已有 65 人死亡。此事的幸存者后来指认威廉·蒙克(Wilhelm Mohnke)就是下达处决命令的军官。

column1: After the successes in Foggia, Termoli and Vinchiaturo the 8th army commanded by Montgomery decided to initiate an offensive. The Germans on the other hand used a break given by the Americans to reorganize their forces. The Germans retreated to the Tringo River and fortified themselves along the Sangro River.
column2: 在福贾(Foggia)、泰尔莫利(Termoli)与温基亚图罗(Vinchiaturo)取得胜利之后，由蒙哥马利(Montgomery)指挥的第8集团军决定发起攻势。而德军则利用美军给予的间歇重整部队。德军退到特里尼奥河(Tringo)一线，并沿桑格罗河(Sangro)构筑工事。

column1: After the victory in Amiens, our Panzer forces are taking positions to attack Arras, where some units from the 1st French Army are deployed, as well as some BEF forces. The 7th Panzer division of the General Rommel is available to support the attack (in fact we didn't know where really was this division), and also the SS Division "Totenkopf", and other Wehrmacht units which will arrive later. We expect a complete victory here.
column2: 亚眠告捷之后，我们的装甲部队正在占领阵地，准备进攻阿拉斯；那里部署着法国第1集团军的一些部队，以及部分英国远征军。隆美尔将军的第7装甲师可用来支援这次进攻（其实我们并不知道这个师究竟在哪里），此外还有党卫军「骷髅」师，以及其他稍后抵达的国防军部队。我们期待在此取得全胜。

column1: After the Western front destruction, you are facing your most difficult duty:- in battle once more against Monty's 8th Army. This is a very difficult mission, but if you are successful you will have stopped the threat of our expulsion from Africa.
column2: 在西线被摧毁之后，您面临最艰难的任务：再次与蒙蒂的第8集团军交战。这是一项非常艰难的任务，但如果您成功，就能阻止我们被逐出非洲的威胁。

column1: After their defeat, the allies will not surrender.
column2: 盟军在被击败后仍不会投降。

column1: After these 7 long years of war, our long awaited objective is now near; the complete conquest of China, and the unconditional surrender of all the Chinese forces.  Although we eliminated their supply lines some time ago, their new capital, Chongqing is still resisting our assaults.  Your mission is simply to take the enemy capital, without taking into account the losses; we must defeat the Chinese at all costs!
column2: 经过这漫长的七年战争，我们期盼已久的目标如今近在眼前：彻底征服中国，迫使中国所有军队无条件投降。虽然我们此前已切断了他们的补给线，但其新首都重庆仍在抵抗我们的进攻。您的任务很简单，就是拿下敌军首都，不必计较损失；我们必须不惜一切代价打败中国人！

column1: After this the Frenchs surely are completely scared!, we have destroyed their defenses in Sedan, and now we can launch our Panzer Divisions on to the heart of  France. The enemy forces were waiting for us in the Low Countries, and now we will be able to trap them.
column2: 此后法国人肯定被彻底吓住了！我们摧毁了他们在色当(Sedan)的防御，现在可以把我们的装甲师投向法国的心脏地带了。敌军主力一直在低地国家(Low Countries)等着我们，现在我们可以把他们困住。

column1: After this the Frenchs surely are completely scared!, we have destroyed their defenses in Sedan, and now we can launch our Panzer Divisions on to the heart of France. The enemy forces were waiting for us in the Low Countries, and now we will be able to trap them.
column2: 此后法国人肯定被彻底吓住了！我们摧毁了他们在色当(Sedan)的防御，现在可以把我们的装甲师投向法国的心脏地带了。敌军主力一直在低地国家(Low Countries)等着我们，现在我们可以把他们困住。

column1: After West front destruction, you are facing your most difficult duty, once more battle against the Monty's 8th, this is a very difficult mission, but if you are successful you will have stopped the menace of our expulsion from Afrika.
column2: 西线覆灭之后，你面临最艰难的任务——再次与蒙蒂的第8集团军交战，这是极为困难的一战，但你若成功，就能挡住我们被逐出非洲的威胁。

column1: After you have destroyed the Angloamerican forces in Bone and stopped the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers in order to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
column2: 在你消灭博讷(Bone)的英美联军并挡住第8集团军的推进之后，我们将把博讷的幸存者追向阿尔及尔(Algiers)，以摧毁第二战场，并向法国叛徒报仇。

column1: After you've destroyed the Anglo-American forces in Bone and stop the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
column2: 在您摧毁博讷的英美军队并阻止第8集团军推进之后，我们将把博讷的残部追向阿尔及尔，以摧毁第二战场，并向法国叛徒复仇。

column1: After your great success at Hong Kong and Macao, the high command wants you to assault the Malayan peninsula.  The last British stronghold in Asia is just at the end of the Malayan peninsula, Singapore!  That city-fortress is still an important base for the Royal Navy, and a menace to our shipping along Asia.  The British have deployed Malayan, Indian and Australian troops to defend their positions; however, thanks to the ''collaboration'' of the king of Thailand... we will attack from our Thai bases striking the peninsula from the North.  We will then expect the surrender from the British Commander hahaha!
column2: 在您于香港和澳门取得重大胜利之后，高层希望您进攻马来半岛。英国在亚洲的最后据点就在马来半岛的尽头——新加坡！那座城塞至今仍是皇家海军的重要基地，也是我们亚洲航线的一大威胁。英国人已部署马来亚、印度与澳大利亚部队守卫阵地；不过，多亏了泰国国王的“合作”……我们将从我们的泰国基地出击，自北面打击该半岛。之后我们就等着英国指挥官投降吧，哈哈哈！

column1: After your success at Iwo Jima we hope you can also stop the enemies here, in Okinawa. The High Command have planned the defence of the island in this way; our most important facilities are positioned in the South corner of the island, including some airstrips and the important Naha naval base. The main objective is to protect that part, focusing your efforts in holding the lines agaisnt the enemy strikes and landings using the hills and cities present there.
column2: 在硫磺岛取得成功之后，我们希望您也能在此地，在冲绳，挡住敌人。高层对岛屿防御作了如下部署：我们最重要的设施都位于该岛南部，包括几条简易机场跑道以及重要的那霸海军基地。主要目标是保护该地区，集中力量守住防线，抵御敌军的突击与登陆，利用当地的山丘与城镇。

column1: After your success in the Xingkai lake, the Kwantung army wants you to manage the retreat from the Karafuto island, the bolsheviks have invaded that island with strong units, and for the moment we can't mantain our positions there while our fleets are fighting the americans on the Pacific.
column2: 在兴凯湖取得成功之后，关东军希望您来负责库页岛的撤退事宜，布尔什维克已派出强大部队入侵该岛，而眼下我们的舰队正在太平洋上与美国人对峙，我们无法在那里维持阵地。

column1: Again, paratrooper groups will be assist you eliminating defensive posts and delay the enemy counterattacks.
column2: 伞兵部队同样将协助你消灭防御据点，并迟滞敌人的反击。

column1: Again, the central committee of the ChCP has agreed to launch another guerrilla assault on the Japanese rearguard in co-operation with our Kuomingtan ''allies''.  Comrade Mao dislikes this attack, but China is calling for Chinese action against the invaders, and that's what we are going to carry out.  The main objectives must be the capture of enemy resources present in your area: the coal mines and factories.  Your battle plan includes some cities and don't forget to cut all enemy lines of communication.
column2: 中共中央再次同意与我们的国民党"盟友"配合，对日军后方发动一次游击突击。毛泽东同志不喜欢这次进攻，但中国在呼吁中国人对侵略者采取行动，我们要做的就是这个。主要目标必须是夺取你所在区域内的敌方资源：煤矿和工厂。你的作战计划包括一些城市，别忘了切断敌人所有的交通线。

column1: Again, your smashing attack has left the enemy forces on the ground isolated.  This is the situation at Hungnam.  The UN forces are surrounded from the North and South by us while the North Korean units will attack from the East.  However, the Hungnam port continues to be their main lifeline, supported by their overwhelming naval power.
column2: 又一次，你的猛烈进攻使敌军地面部队陷入孤立。兴南的局势就是这样。联合国军被我们从北面和南面包围，而朝鲜人民军部队将从东面发起进攻。不过，兴南港仍是他们的主要生命线，并得到其压倒性海军力量的支持。
阿杰达比亚(Agedabia) - 1945 年 12 月 23 日

column1: agreements and are rushing on Berlin under the pretext of helping us.
column2: 各项协定，正以援助我们为借口抢攻柏林。

column1: AH!  You dirty rebel and traitor!.  You, the former hero of the People's Republic of China are now a coward capitalist traitor.  Your execution will be soon be celebrated in Tiananmen Square.
column2: 啊！你这个肮脏的叛贼和卖国贼！你，前中华人民共和国的英雄，如今是个懦弱的资本主义叛徒。你的处决不久将在天安门广场上被庆祝。

column1: Ah! Welcome, Commander! Let me brief you on the tactical situation: Russia is pushing Allied troops into western Germany. As our troops are bottled up in this region, you will lead advance elements of a covert invasion force into Poland.Take the surrounding area and eliminate Soviet resistance. Some bombers are on the way for support. Good luck!
column2: 啊！欢迎，指挥官！我来向你简报战术态势：俄国人正把盟军压向德国西部。由于我军被困在这一地区，你将率一支秘密入侵部队的先头部队进入波兰(Poland)。夺取周边地区，消灭苏军抵抗。一些轰炸机正在赶来支援。祝好运！

column1: Ah, Commander! Welcome. Let us get down to the matter at hand. One of our spies was recently captured deep in Soviet territory. He has vital information which is crucial to the war effort. One of our commando teams was able to rescue him, but is now encircled by Soviet troops. Lead your men in and rescue them before the Soviets can recapture them. On a more pleasant note, the Germans have joined us in the fight against communism after the success of the Polish operation.
column2: 啊，指挥官！欢迎。我们谈正事吧。我们的一名间谍最近在苏联腹地被捕。他掌握着对战事至关重要的情报。我们的一支突击队成功把他救了出来，但现在被苏军包围了。率你的人进去，在苏军重新抓住他们之前把他们救出来。说件更令人愉快的事：波兰行动成功之后，德国人也加入了我们对抗共产主义的战斗。

column1: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.  Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective:  the return of Germany to its proper place,  the leader of Europe.
column2: 啊，你好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国出手，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨炼自己的战争技艺。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、集中兵力和合成兵种作战的新构想。此后，你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国恢复其应有的地位，成为欧洲的领袖。

column1: Ah, Herr General, excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall! As you know, our campaign in the north continues to go well.  You have been chosen to lead our invasion in the south.  After your beachhead is secure,  it is imperative for you to seize the port city of Savannah. Once this is accomplished, our drive inland will cut the United States in half.  It is believed that the Americans are ignorant of our plans.  But be aware that the people of this region will fight us to their last breath.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，恕我失礼，元帅阁下！如你所知，我们在北方的战役进展顺利。你被选中指挥我方在南方的入侵。滩头堡巩固之后，你必须夺取港口城市萨凡纳。一旦达成，我们向内陆的推进将把美国一分为二。据信美国人对我们的计划毫不知情。但要注意，该地区的人民会与我们战斗到最后一息。

column1: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，希望你享受了休假。如你所知，英国和英联邦部队已占领历史性的温泉关。你必须夺取这个隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。地形崎岖，难以机动。你必须果断行动。

column1: Ahh, comrade Commander!  Do you like Khabarovsk?  It's a pretty city, isn't it?   I know you are the greatest hero of the PRC and the KRC and I have a mission for you from the Kremlin.  I have to give you a letter from Moscow but... well anyway this is a good situation to do it.  Err... yes, but first, let's negotiate the surrender of my forces in this sector.
column2: 啊，指挥员同志！你喜欢哈巴罗夫斯克吗？这是座漂亮的城市，不是吗？我知道你是中华人民共和国和朝鲜人民共和国最伟大的英雄，克里姆林宫交给你一项任务。我得转交给你一封莫斯科的来信，不过...好吧，反正现在正是转交的好时机。呃...对，不过首先，让我们商谈一下我这个地段部队的投降事宜。

column1: Air movement range changes (for example Fighters least range upto LB's most range)
column2: 空中单位移动航程有变化（例如战斗机航程最短，水平轰炸机航程最长）
阿留申群岛(Aleutian Islands) - 1946 年 8 月 6 日
阿尔及尔(Algiers) - 1945 年 10 月 10 日

column1: All German attacks have been repelled and you have retreated the forces under your command in an ordered manner. Your defence has enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
column2: 德军的进攻全部被击退，您以有序的方式撤出了麾下部队。您的防御使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

column1: All of Europe is watching you, Herr General.
column2: 全欧洲都在注视着你，将军阁下。

column1: All of Haguenau and several other villages are now in our hands and many prisoners were taken.
column2: 整个阿格诺(Haguenau)以及其他几个村庄现在都在我们手中，还抓了很多俘虏。

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  By the way, rumor has it that Ike speaks highly of you.
column2: 好吧，指挥官，干得漂亮！德国佬根本没弄清是什么击中了他们。嗯，多亏了你，我们的形势看起来真不错。顺便说一句，有传言说艾克(Ike)对你评价很高。

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  Hey, rumor has it the president may want to pin a medal on you himself.
column2: 好了，指挥官，干得漂亮！那些德国佬到死都不知道是什么打中了他们。是啊，多亏了你，我们的处境真不错。嘿，有传言说总统可能想亲自给你别上一枚勋章。

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  Hey, rumor has it the president may want to pin a medal on you himself.
column2: 亚眠(Amiens) - 1946 年 1 月 5 日

column1: All right, commander, a job well done! Now prepare to take hold of what remains of Morocco!
column2: 好，指挥官，干得漂亮！现在准备好拿下摩洛哥(Morocco)剩下的地方！

column1: All right, this is the way it is.  You and your boys must capture the city of Nancy and it's gonna be a tough nut to crack.  And, what's more, the Krauts have armor here to the east of the city ready and waiting to counter-attack.  Good luck.
column2: 好吧，情况就是这样。你和你的小伙子们必须夺取南锡(Nancy)城，这可是一块难啃的硬骨头。而且，德国佬在该城以东已备好装甲部队，严阵以待准备反击。祝你好运。

column1: All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control!, only the Suez Kanal remains under British domination... We shall see how long they can use the Kanal!
column2: 地中海的所有主要港口现在都在我们控制之下！只有苏伊士运河(Suez Kanal)仍在英国控制之下……我们倒要看看他们还能用这条运河多久！

column1: All the town is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
column2: 全城现在已在我们手中，我们已准备好进入本土。

column1: Allied forces begin their drive to Berlin
Allied Forces continue their drive west at Ulan Ude
column2: 盟军继续在乌兰乌德向西推进

column1: Allied Forces fight a mobile defensive battle against advancing Russian
column2: 盟军对推进中的俄军进行机动作战防御

column1: Allied Forces try to hold the strategic Fulda Gap against strong Soviet pressure.
column2: 盟军力图顶住苏军的强大压力，守住战略要地富尔达缺口。

column1: Allies had pushed the Soviets back from the borders of Germany all the way
column2: 盟军还是把苏军从德国边境一路逼退，

Allies On The March - US Side
already reached!. Prestige has been set to 500 at the beginning of the
column2: 已经达到！场景开始时的威望被设定为 500，

column1: Also we got our peace-offer: the 1937 borders, public in the US press, and announced that, as a sign of good will, we will immediately retreat from Belgium and France. We might still have a chance to split the coalition apart....
column2: 而且我们的和平提议：1937年的边界，已刊登在美国报端，我们还宣布，作为善意的表示，我们将立即从比利时和法国撤退。我们或许仍有机会拆散这个联盟……

column1: Also while you were busy, a revolt has broken out in Warschau. Clearly the goal is to establish an independent state before the Soviets enter Warschau. We will see what the English think of it.
column2: 另外，就在您忙于作战之时，华沙爆发了起义。其目标显然是在苏军进入华沙之前建立一个独立国家。我们就看英国人对此作何想法。

column1: Although Antwerpen/Anvers fell on the 18/19 May, the Belgian Army is now taking position in the Gent/Gand bridgehead, behind the Dender/Dendre and Escaut/Scheldt rivers.
column2: 虽然安特卫普已于5月18日至19日陷落，比利时军队现在正进入根特桥头堡，位于登德尔河和斯海尔德河后方。

column1: Although not all our objectives were taken and/or held we are confident that with more of the 2nd Armies tanks and heavy weapons moving north that the operation can still be successful.
column2: 尽管我们并非所有目标都被夺取和／或守住，但我们相信，随着第2集团军更多的坦克与重武器北调，这次行动仍能成功。

column1: Although not without problems, you have beaten off the Russian relieve attempt. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 虽然并非毫无波折，你毕竟击退了俄国人的解围企图。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: Although some Belgian soldiers were indeed evacuated it was not the result of an organized operation but of casual or individual circumstances.
column2: 虽然确实有一些比利时士兵被撤离，但这并非有组织行动的结果，而是偶然或个别情况所致。

column1: Although the area is secure, the research has been set back by damages
column2: 虽然该地区已安全，但研究因这场持久交火中

column1: Although the battle was a loss, the Italians have surrendered and we have completed the Italian Campaign.  Italy is once again a part of the German empire.
column2: 尽管这一战失利，意大利人已经投降，我们也完成了意大利战役。意大利再次成为德意志帝国的一部分。

column1: Although the Belgians succeeded in containing the bridgehead no sufficient reserves were available for a large-scale counterattack. On the contrary the Germans were constantly dropping new paratroopers at the bridges and the fortress of Eben-Emael.
column2: 尽管比利时人成功遏制了桥头堡，却没有足够的预备队发动大规模反击。相反，德军不断向桥头和埃本-埃马尔要塞空投新的伞兵。

column1: As the war in the east entered its fourth year, Zhukov's 1st Ukrainian Front moved across the Dnieper against Kirovgrad, taking advantage of the now severely weakened Army Group South right flank.  Two days later Kirovgrad was in Soviet hands, despite spirited defence by 11 German divisions.  Fighting a continuing series of defensive engagements in the area around Zhitomir, Korosten and Beredichev, the Leibstandarte at Beredichev was able to temporarily check the Soviet advance.  By mid-January the Soviet 1st Tank Army, spearheading 1st Ukrainian Front's southern advance, had gained 65 miles and was approaching Uman.  In knee-deep mud, sleet and blizzards, Army Group South fought desperately to prevent it's front from collapsing.
column2: 随着东线战争进入第四个年头，朱可夫(Zhukov)的乌克兰第1方面军(1st Ukrainian Front)趁南方集团军群(Army Group South)右翼此时已严重削弱之机，越过第聂伯河(Dnieper)进攻基洛夫格勒(Kirovgrad)。两天后，尽管 11 个德军师顽强防御，基洛夫格勒仍落入苏军之手。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在日托米尔(Zhitomir)、科罗斯坚(Korosten)与别列季切夫(Beredichev)一带进行一连串防御作战，在别列季切夫暂时遏止了苏军的推进。到 1 月中旬，作为乌克兰第1方面军南进矛头的苏军第1坦克集团军已前进 65 英里，逼近乌曼(Uman)。在没膝的泥泞、雨夹雪与暴风雪中，南方集团军群拼命阻止其战线崩溃。

column1: As the year drew to a close, the 4th Panzer Army was pushed back west and south of the city by a fresh offensive launched on Christmas Eve by the combined forces of four Soviet armies plus two independent corps against the southern rim of Kiev.  The next day it developed a second thrust west, which threatened to destroy the entire left flank of Army Group South, and succeeded in recapturing Zhitomir and the road linking it to Kiev.  While recognising that this thrust could be employed to drive the two army groups back against the Black Sea and Carpathian Mountains, Hitler saw that the southern attack posed the danger of an envelopment of Army Group South and A between the Dniepr and Dniestr Rivers, and considered it the greatest danger.
column2: 随着这一年接近尾声，12 月 24 日平安夜，4 个苏军集团军加上 2 个独立军的联合兵力对基辅(Kiev)南缘发起新攻势，把第4装甲集团军逐出该城以西与以南。第二天，苏军又向西发起第二次突击，有可能摧毁南方集团军群(Army Group South)的整个左翼，并成功夺回了日托米尔(Zhitomir)及其连接基辅的道路。希特勒虽然认识到这次突击可以用来把两个集团军群压向黑海(Black Sea)与喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains)，但他看出南面的进攻有在第聂伯河(Dniepr)与德涅斯特河(Dniestr)之间合围南方集团军群与A集团军群的危险，因而认为这是最大的危险。

column1: At Dubno, the Leibstandarte was able to defeat the Soviet counter-attack and prevent them from cutting the lengthening line of communications.  Victory came at a cost however, as the division lost 683 killed and wounded.  Following the battle, von Kleist and his armoured group were able to breakthrough the Stalin Line east of Zhitomir, driving a wedge between two Soviet armies.  Moving in behind this breakthrough, the division quickly sped along the road to Kiev, where it soon found itself thrown onto the backfoot thanks to a wide-ranging Soviet attack on the Southwest front.
column2: 在杜布诺(Dubno)，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)得以击败苏军的反击，阻止他们切断不断延长的交通线。但胜利是有代价的，该师有 683 人阵亡与负伤。此战之后，冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)及其装甲集群突破了日托米尔(Zhitomir)以东的斯大林防线(Stalin Line)，在两个苏军集团军之间打进一个楔子。该师紧随这次突破之后，沿通往基辅(Kiev)的道路快速推进，但很快因苏军对西南方面军(Southwest front)发起的大范围进攻而陷入被动。

The situation for Germany was critical - Budapest had fallen after a 51 day seige; Warsaw, Lodz and Krakow had fallen; a Soviet Army was in East Prussia; the Red Army was now a mere 200km from Prague, and worst of all, it had crossed the river Oder, and was only 70km from Berlin.  The I SS Panzer Corps was to be used to rectify this critical situation.
column2: 到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、利茨曼施塔特(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。

column1: By midday LSSAH was 50 miles inside Dutch territory, but found its progress halted by blown bridges at Boernbrock and Zwolle.  To the south however, the 3rd Battalion found another crossing near Zutphen, and before it halted to rest that night the regiment had covered 130 miles.
column2: 到正午，警卫旗队已深入荷兰领土 50 英里，但发现其推进被伯恩布罗克(Boernbrock)与兹沃勒(Zwolle)被炸毁的桥梁所阻。不过在南面，第3营在聚特芬(Zutphen)附近找到了另一处渡口；当晚停下休息之前，该团已推进 130 英里。

column1: By the first day, the Leibstandarte and the attached 46th Infantry Division had broken through the Soviet defences, advancing 10km.  On both the right and left flanks however, the 44th and 211th Infantry Divisions ran into strong resistance.  By the 21st, the I SS Panzer Corps had cleared the Gran bridgehead, sending the Soviets into a retreat across the Gran river.  Hitler quickly ordered that the Leibstandarte be freed as soon as possible for his next offensive, in the Lake Balaton area.
column2: 到第一天，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)与配属的第46步兵师已突破苏军防御，推进 10 公里。然而在左右两翼，第44与第211步兵师都遭遇了顽强抵抗。到 21 日，党卫军第1装甲军已肃清格兰河(Gran river)桥头堡，迫使苏军渡河撤退。希特勒随即下令尽快腾出警卫旗队，供他在巴拉顿湖(Lake Balaton)地区的下一次攻势使用。

column1: Caen had been lost, and the Leibstandarte had fallen back to the Bourgebus ridge, where they held the line and inflicted heavy casaulties upon the British 7th and 11th Armoured Divisions.  However, the weakened German defences began to lose the battle of attrition, with few reinforcements arriving, and roaming Allied bombers destroying supplies before the could reach the lines.  The division now helped to hold the Caen-Falaise highway until the end of July against repeated British attacks.
column2: 卡昂(Caen)已经失守，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)退到布尔格布斯岭(Bourgebus ridge)，在那里守住了战线，并给英国第7与第11装甲师造成重大伤亡。然而被削弱的德军防御开始输掉这场消耗战：增援寥寥无几，游弋的盟军轰炸机在补给送达前线之前就将其摧毁。该师现在协助守住卡昂-法莱斯(Caen-Falaise)公路，直到 7 月底，抵御英军的反复进攻。

column1: Caen proved to be a sticky wicket, indeed, but you brought us off the pitch with no trouble at all.  It was a difficult area for our brave men to break through, but you did it!  By jove, you did it. Good work!  Now, our lads are on their way to liberate all of France.
column2: 卡昂(Caen)确实是个难打的场地，但你毫无困难地把我们带下了场。那对我们勇敢的士兵来说是一块难以突破的地域，但你做到了！老天，你做到了。干得好！现在，我们的小伙子们正在去解放整个法国(France)的路上。

column1: Combined British and German forces have managed to penetrate the ring of Soviet defense surrounding Volgorad. This city is crucial to our overall plan, which is to flank Moscow and attack it from the north where the Soviet defenses are the least ready for a large-scale attack. The formidable and determined Soviet forces will give you a tough fight, Commander. Use the experienced German forces as you will, and keep in mind we've sent one of our own naval flotillas to help you. Take the city, and liberate the oppressed Soviet people.
column2: 英德联军已成功突入环绕伏尔加格勒(Volgorad)的苏军防御圈。这座城市对我们的总体计划至关重要——我们要包抄莫斯科(Moscow)，从北面进攻它，因为那里的苏军防御对大规模进攻准备最不充分。指挥官，强大而坚定的苏军会给你一场硬仗。你可以随意使用那些经验丰富的德军部队，并且记住，我们已派出一支自己的海军分舰队来协助你。拿下这座城市，解放受压迫的苏联人民。
