column1: Commander, after securing our positions around Salerno, it's time to breakout the German defence line and advance fast towards the city of Naples. Pay attention because recognition reports that the enemy positions in front of you are still very strong, supported by heavy armour and artillery. It will be quite tough for your infantry, who anyway is expected to act a key role in this battle. Good luck, son!
column2: 指挥官，在确保我们在萨莱诺(Salerno)周边的阵地之后，该突破德军防线，迅速向那不勒斯(Naples)城推进了。注意，侦察报告说，你前方的敌军阵地仍然非常坚固，并有重型装甲与炮兵支援。对你的步兵来说这会相当艰难，而他们在这场战斗中仍将扮演关键角色。祝好运，孩子！

column1: Commander, after your success at Orel the Russians have broken. They have formed a line just west of Novograd. You must pierce the line here and prepare our way to take the city of Novograd. Winter is getting closer Commander, You must hurry!
column2: 指挥官，你在奥廖尔取胜之后，俄国人已经崩溃。他们在诺沃格拉德(Novograd)以西刚组成一道防线。你必须在此地打穿这道防线，为我们夺取诺沃格拉德城铺路。冬天越来越近了，指挥官，你必须抓紧！

column1: Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the German counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，意大利刚刚投降。配合停战公告的宣布，我们已经发起了「雪崩」行动(Operation Avalanche)——在萨莱诺(Salerno)城附近、离那不勒斯(Naples)不远的海岸实施登陆突击。不管怎样，德国佬对意大利投降和我们在萨莱诺的登陆看起来一点也不意外。他们已在我们的滩头周围集结了一支强大的反击部队，所以你需要用上全部本领，挺过德军的反击，加固你的阵地，然后向那不勒斯推进。祝好运！

column1: Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not so far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the german counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，意大利刚刚投降。配合停战公告的宣布，我们已经发起了「雪崩」行动(Operation Avalanche)——在萨莱诺(Salerno)城附近、离那不勒斯(Naples)不远的海岸实施登陆突击。不管怎样，德国佬对意大利投降和我们在萨莱诺的登陆看起来一点也不意外。他们已在我们的滩头周围集结了一支强大的反击部队，所以你需要用上全部本领，挺过德军的反击，加固你的阵地，然后向那不勒斯推进。祝好运！

column1: Commander, as you know, operation Market Garden has been given the approval of SHAEF headquarters. Our objective is to use airborne forces to capture bridges leading up the the Rhine crossing at Arnhem. You will lead the armored forces that will link up with the Airborne units. You first objective will be the bridges over the Zuid Willems Canal.
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，市场花园行动已获得盟军远征军最高司令部(SHAEF)的批准。我们的目标是使用空降部队夺取通往阿纳姆(Arnhem)莱茵河渡口的各座桥梁。你将率领将与空降部队会合的装甲部队。你的第一个目标是南威廉运河(Zuid Willems Canal)上的桥梁。

column1: Commander, congratulations and accolades on a mission well done!  Your troops certainly gave the Germans everything that they deserved and more!  A field marshal's baton, engraved with your name awaits your arrival at Number 10.  I shall personally be there with the PM for the ceremony.  A spot of tea, Commander?
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你，任务完成得很出色，谨致赞誉！你的部队无疑给了德国人他们应得的一切，还远不止此！一根刻着你名字的元帅权杖正在唐宁街10号(Number 10)等候你到来。我会亲自与首相一同出席仪式。来杯茶吗，指挥官？

column1: Commander, congratulations and accolades on a mission well done! Your troops certainly gave the Germans everything that they deserved and more!
column2: 指挥官，祝贺你，并为你出色完成任务而致敬！你的部队确实给了德国人他们应得的一切，甚至更多！

column1: Commander, Congratulations for the capture of Minsk. I do not have time pin to any medal however.
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你夺取明斯克(Minsk)。不过我没时间给你别上什么勋章。

column1: Commander, Congratulations for the capture of Minsk. I do not have time to pin any medal however.
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你夺取明斯克。不过我没时间给你别上什么勋章。

column1: Commander, continue with your unstoppable attack in Italy, now we are getting close to the dream of a united Europe by Comunism and ruled by Comrade Stalin, "the little father of all peoples".
column2: 指挥官，继续你在意大利势不可挡的进攻，现在我们正接近那个梦想：由共产主义统一欧洲，由斯大林同志——「所有民族的小父亲」——来统治。

column1: Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allied Powers and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 指挥官，就在我们说话的此刻，盟国与德国的外交代表正在会晤……你在这里以及在整个欧洲一连串的胜利，是无可比拟的……你该回到心怀感激的祖国了。

column1: Commander, excuse me, General!  You are to lead our drive into Austria. The enemy will likely protect his homeland to the last man. There are most likely powerful panzer units in the region which is close to the Yugoslavian border. Expect intervention of Tito's communist partisans in their home country.
column2: 指挥官，恕我失言，将军！你要率领我们向奥地利推进。敌人很可能会为保卫他的本土而战至最后一人。在靠近南斯拉夫(Yugoslavia)边界的地区极可能有强大的装甲部队。要防备铁托(Tito)的共产主义游击队员在他们的本土介入。

column1: Commander, fruitcake? Just got it from the wife. Well, as you know, we've got a critical situation on our hands.  Our troops, along with the Brits, have blasted into Normandy.  Now, we've got to drive inland.  You and your men have got to smash through the Kraut lines and take St. Lo as fast as you can.  If you don't get things moving, the Krauts'll keep us pinned down here forever.
column2: 指挥官，来点水果蛋糕？刚从妻子那里收到的。嗯，如你所知，我们手上有个危急的局面。我们的部队连同英国人已突入诺曼底(Normandy)。现在，我们必须向内陆推进。你和你的部下必须打穿德国佬的防线，以最快速度夺取圣洛(St. Lo)。如果你不把事情推动起来，德国佬就会把我们永远钉死在这里。

column1: Commander, good to see you.  Smoke? Here you are.  Well, let's get down to business.  American and British troops are to land at Salerno and begin a Second Front against the Germans and knock Italy out of the war.  Once you're ashore, you'll need to get your men off those beaches  pronto.  By the way, you should be aware that the Krauts have got a panzer division somewhere in the area.  Good luck, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，很高兴见到你。抽烟吗？给你。好，我们谈正事。美英军队将在萨莱诺(Salerno)登陆，开辟对德军的第二战场，并使意大利(Italy)退出战争。一旦上岸，你就得让你的部下赶快离开那些海滩。顺便说一句，你应当知道德国佬在该地区某处有一个装甲师。祝你好运，指挥官。

column1: Commander, Here is the prize, Moscow!
column2: 指挥官，大奖就在这里——莫斯科(Moscow)！

column1: Commander, High Command has asked me to personaly thank you and your brave men for crushing that nasty Soviet attack earlier this month.
column2: 指挥官，最高统帅部要我个人感谢你和你勇敢的部下粉碎了本月早些时候那场凶险的苏军进攻。

column1: Commander, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. We must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to London to face a firing squad.
column2: 指挥官，我很遗憾，你那支优秀部队的牺牲都白费了。我们必须迅速后撤，否则就会面临全军覆没。你已奉命前往伦敦(London)面对行刑队。

column1: Commander, I must congratulate you on this resounding success. French forces have surrendered and resistance has collapsed. You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence. You will be, no doubt, honoured when you return to England.
column2: 指挥官，我必须为这次巨大的成功向你道贺。法国部队已经投降，抵抗已经崩溃。你以高超的技巧与智慧处理了这项艰难的任务。你回到英格兰时，无疑会获得殊荣。

column1: Commander, if we are to encircle Soviet troops successfully, we will need to cut their lines of supply. You will lead an attack from the west to capture important supply bridges. Deployment areas are limited, however several Combat Engineers have escaped from a Soviet camp to the south. A quick victory here will allow both our western and eastern forces to converge and eliminate the Soviet threat.
column2: 指挥官，若要成功合围苏军，我们就得切断他们的补给线。你将率部从西面发起进攻，夺取重要的补给桥梁。可部署的区域有限，不过有几名战斗工兵已从南面的苏军战俘营逃出。在这里迅速取胜，就能让我军东西两路会合，消除苏联的威胁。

column1: Commander, it appears that once again High Command has grossly underestimated the ability of the Soviet forces to bounce back.
column2: 指挥官，看来最高统帅部又一次严重低估了苏军恢复元气的本事。

column1: Commander, it appears we have grossly underestimated the current situation with the Soviets. We thought they were stricktly on the defensive but now we know that was to be untrue. It seems that a very large force of Russian troops and armor has infiltrated our forward positions and is now bearing down on a critical road juncture. Commander, if a Russian force of this size gets into our rear we could be in big trouble.
column2: 指挥官，看来我们严重低估了当前对苏军的形势。我们以为他们完全处于防御，但现在我们知道那并非事实。似乎有一支非常庞大的俄国部队与装甲力量已渗透进我们的前沿阵地，此刻正压向一处关键的公路枢纽。指挥官，如果这么大规模的俄军进入我们后方，我们就会有大麻烦。

column1: Commander, it may have been to your advantage to have remained in captivity. This failure was completely unexpected from an officer of your caliber and experience. Your transfer to mine removal duty will be forthcoming.
column2: 指挥官，你当初留在战俘营里也许对你更有利。以你这样的才干和经验，这次失败完全出乎意料。你即将被调去执行排雷任务。

column1: Commander, it seems that the Krauts really do not like to be cornered in Tunisia. Both Von Arnim and Rommel armies have just started an offensive aimed at our positions in south-west Tunisia. It will be tough for our boys who still lack a decent battle experience. Try your best to stop the Rommel forces that are to attack El Guettar and then Gafsa, my young leader, but pay attention for the powerful armoured units on the way.
column2: 指挥官，看来那些德国佬真的不喜欢在突尼斯(Tunisia)被逼到墙角。冯·阿尼姆(von Arnim)与隆美尔两支部队刚刚发起攻势，目标是我们位于突尼斯西南的阵地。我们的小伙子们还缺乏像样的战斗经验，这会很艰难。我的年轻指挥官，尽力挡住将要进攻盖塔尔(El Guettar)、随后进攻加夫萨(Gafsa)的隆美尔部队，但要留意沿途那些强大的装甲单位。

column1: Commander, jolly good performance!  I think something stronger than tea is appropriate after your capture of Nancy.  Now, the door is open for our invasion of Germany.  Do you know, there's been talk, merely rumor at this stage, of honours, possibly a knighthood?  Coffee?
column2: 指挥官，干得真是漂亮！我看在你拿下南锡(Nancy)之后，该来点比茶更带劲的东西。现在，入侵德国的大门已经敞开。你知道吗，有些议论——眼下还只是传言——说要给你授勋，可能是骑士爵位？来杯咖啡吗？

column1: Commander, now that you have helped our allies off the beach, our own troops can use your aid. Powerful German panzer units have fought our forces to a standstill at Caen. You and your crack troops will lead the breakthrough.
column2: 指挥官，既然你已帮我们的盟友离开海滩，我们自己的部队也需要你的援助。德军强大的装甲部队在卡昂(Caen)把我军打得陷入停滞。你和你的精锐部队将带头突破。

column1: Commander, once again the Americans need our help. The Germans have launched a major counterattack in the Ardennes region. The Americans have been forced to retreat. You will take command of all allied forces in the region and drive the Germans back.
column2: 指挥官，美国人又一次需要我们的帮助。德军已在阿登(Ardennes)地区发起大规模反击。美军被迫撤退。你将指挥该地区所有盟军部队，把德军打回去。

column1: Commander, our American allies are once again in a jam. For two days they have been pinned down on the beaches at Normandy. As our most experienced field commander, you have been chosen to lead your armored group into battle at Normandy to save our allies. We know you wil not let us down.
column2: 指挥官，我们的美国盟友又一次陷入困境。两天来他们一直被压制在诺曼底(Normandy)的海滩上。作为我们最有经验的战地指挥官，你被选中率领你的装甲集群在诺曼底投入战斗，去拯救我们的盟友。我们知道你不会让我们失望。

column1: Commander, our American allies are planning an invasion of French North Africa. Because they lack experience, the Americans have asked for our help.  You will lead a joint assault on Casablanca to demonstrate our amphibious tactics. Good Luck!
column2: 指挥官，我们的美国盟友正计划入侵法属北非。由于缺乏经验，美国人已请求我们帮助。你将率领对卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)的联合突击，以展示我们的两栖战术。祝好运！

column1: Commander, our beachhead is secure.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at SHAEF headquarters.
column2: 指挥官，我们的滩头阵地已稳固。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，盟军远征军最高司令部(SHAEF)就会需要你。

column1: Commander, our expeditionary force in Belgium has encountered heavy formations of German armor. Our commanders seem incapable of coping with the new German "Blitzkrieg" tactics. Hopefully you will have better luck.
column2: 指挥官，我们在比利时的远征军遭遇了德军重装装甲部队。我们的指挥官似乎无力应对德军新的「闪击战」战术。希望你的运气会更好。

column1: Commander, our invasion of Italy is proceeding ahead of schedule. Your troops will now be returned to England for some well-deserved rest. You will be recieving plenty of leave time yourself!
column2: 指挥官，我们对意大利的入侵正提前进行。你的部队现在将返回英格兰，享受他们应得的休整。你自己也会得到充裕的休假时间！

column1: Commander, our spring offensive has begun. We need you and your men to crack the line just west of Minsk. A small German battle group will be guarding your northern flank.
column2: 指挥官，我们的春季攻势已经开始了。我们需要你和你的部下打穿明斯克(Minsk)以西的防线。一支德军小战斗群将掩护你的北翼。

column1: Commander, Port Lyautey is the final objective for you here in Morocco. With this port in our hands, we'll be able to race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia. Once again you will be supported by our powerful ships and a small contingent of marines. You have to expect poor resistance from the French garrisons, by the way we are in a hurry. Do not waste your time!
column2: 指挥官，利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)是你在摩洛哥这里的最终目标。这个港口到手，我们就能向东疾进，直扑突尼斯(Tunisia)的德国佬。你这次仍将得到我们强大舰艇和一支小型陆战队分遣队的支援。法国守军的抵抗预料不会强，顺便说一句，我们时间紧迫。别浪费时间！

column1: Commander, Stalin has turned the city of Minsk into a fortress. We need your skills to take the city. This is not going to be easy commander, the Russians are heavily entrenched and abundently supplied. You will have a little less than three weeks to complete this mission.
column2: 指挥官，斯大林已把明斯克城变成一座堡垒。我们需要你的本领来拿下该城。这不会容易，指挥官，俄军构筑了坚固工事，补给充足。你完成这项任务的时间略少于三周。

column1: Commander, that was outstanding! You have managed to hold the russians back and even push them back past their jump off point. Now we need you to continue to hold the line. The Reds have us pinned in an area south of here and we could be in big trouble if they manage to push through. You must stop them!
column2: 指挥官，干得漂亮！你成功挡住了俄国人，甚至把他们逼退到出发线之后。现在我们需要你继续守住防线。赤色分子把我们压制在此地以南一片区域，一旦他们突破，我们就会有大麻烦。你必须挡住他们！

column1: Commander, the American forces that you defeated in Sicily have occupied Egypt.  You must liberate Egypt.
column2: 指挥官，你在西西里(Sicily)击败的美军已占领埃及。你必须解放埃及。

column1: Commander, the attack on Orel has been rescheduled for September 12th. Prepare your men for the assault.
column2: 指挥官，对奥廖尔的进攻已改期至 9 月 12 日。让你的人为突击做好准备。

column1: Commander, the attack on Orel has been rescheduled for September 8th. Prepare your men for the assault.
column2: 指挥官，对奥廖尔的进攻已改期至 9 月 8 日。让你的人为突击做好准备。

column1: Commander, the British have been demoralized but their erroneous belief that they are masters in desert warfare keeps their spirit alive.  You must crush them!
column2: 指挥官，英军士气已受挫，但他们自认是沙漠战行家的错误信念仍支撑着他们的精神。你必须粉碎他们！

column1: Commander, the British Navy is fast approaching to aid the already entrenched defenses.  You must find and destroy the British Navy or the planned landing will not succeed.
column2: 指挥官，英国海军正快速逼近，前来支援已构筑工事的防御。你必须找到并摧毁英国海军，否则计划的登陆不会成功。

column1: Commander, The city of Smolensk is your next objective. You will have some help from the 10th Mountain and 2nd Rangers. You must take the city by the end of the month.
column2: 指挥官，斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)城是你的下一个目标。你将得到第10山地师与第2游骑兵的一些协助。你必须在月底之前夺取该城。

column1: Commander, the Groundhog saw his shadow so we've got a long winter ahead. Now that Finland is free we need to consolidate our front and relieve Lithuania. The Russians have been knocked off balance so I don't expect this to be too much of a problem. General Patton is cleaning out the Balkans as we speak.
column2: 指挥官，土拨鼠看到了自己的影子，所以我们前面还有个漫长的冬天。既然芬兰已获自由，我们需要巩固我们的战线并为立陶宛(Lithuania)解围。俄国人已失去平衡，所以我不认为这会是什么大问题。巴顿(Patton)将军正在清剿巴尔干(Balkans)。

column1: Commander, the initial amphibious landing has stalled.  You must get on the beach and find a way to break through the enemy defenses.
column2: 指挥官，最初的登陆已经停滞。你必须登上滩头，找到突破敌军防御的办法。

column1: Commander, the Red Army has torn a gap in our line along the Moselle and is pouring armor toward Arracourt. You will seal the breach and destroy their spearheads before the whole front unravels. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，红军已在摩泽尔河(Moselle)一线撕开一道缺口，装甲集群正向阿拉库尔(Arracourt)涌来。你必须封住缺口、歼灭其矛头，否则整条战线都将瓦解。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Commander, the Red Army is massing for a decisive assault on the Pommernstellung position. You will hold the wall at all costs and bleed their tank armies white. One last thing: expect their air force to contest every mile of this battle.
column2: 指挥官，红军正在集结兵力，准备对「波美拉尼亚阵地」发动决定性突击。你必须不惜一切代价守住壁垒，让他们的坦克集团军在此流尽鲜血。最后一件事：预计敌空军将在这场战斗中争夺每一英里的天空。

column1: Commander, the Russians have been slowed down and now it is our turn to take the initiative. Throw the red menace off German soil. You have strong armored and air support.
column2: 指挥官，俄国人已被迟滞，现在轮到我们夺取主动权了。把红色威胁赶出德国土地。你有强大的装甲与空中支援。

column1: Commander, the stubborn defence put up by the Nazi has been a sort of nightmare for your assaulting troops, but at last you did it. Now please rest and refit for a while.
column2: 指挥官，纳粹的顽固防御对你突击的部队来说简直是场噩梦，但你终究做到了。现在请休整与整补一段时间。

column1: Commander, the time has come to take the city of Orel. If you can accomplish your mission before the end of the month we still may have a chance to take Moscow by Christmas.
column2: 指挥官，夺取奥廖尔城的时候到了。如果你能在月底前完成任务，我们也许还有机会在圣诞节前拿下莫斯科。

column1: Commander, the time has finally come.  The Soviets have launched a fierce counterattack on the German field marshal Erwin Rommel's forces, and crushed them into the snow.  French forces have withdrawn from the area, citing "a lack of proper supplies" as the reason for their withdrawal.  After reviewing your past performances, it has been decided you will lead the final attack on the Soviet capital of Moscow.  End Stalin's Iron Curtain over Eastern Europe and take the entire city, including the Kremlin. Communism dies here, Commander.  Show no pity, no remorse!
column2: 指挥官，时候终于到了。苏军已对德国元帅埃尔温·隆美尔(Erwin Rommel)的部队发起猛烈反击，把他们碾入雪中。法军已撤出该地区，理由是「缺乏适当的补给」。在审阅了你以往的表现之后，已决定由你指挥对苏联首都莫斯科的最后攻击。终结斯大林笼罩东欧的铁幕，夺取整座城市，包括克里姆林宫。共产主义将在此终结，指挥官。不要怜悯，不要悔意！

column1: Commander, this is going to be a tough one.  Just capture all the objectives and get us back on track.
column2: 指挥官，这一仗会很艰难。只要拿下所有目标，让我们重回正轨。

column1: Commander, this is going to be a tough one.  Our British friends are having a hard time in Caen. We're gonna have to bail them out and you're the man to do it.  Try not to step on their toes, the Brits think they're the only ones fighting this war.  Just capture Caen and get us back on track.
column2: 指挥官，这一仗会很艰难。我们的英国朋友在卡昂(Caen)处境艰难。我们得去解救他们，而你是做这件事的不二人选。尽量别冒犯他们，英国人自以为只有他们在打这场战争。拿下卡昂，让我们回到正轨。

column1: Commander, this is your finest hour, make us all proud!
column2: 指挥官，这是你最辉煌的时刻，让我们大家都为你骄傲！

column1: Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad.
column2: 指挥官，这次失败也许已让我们输掉了战争。你须返回英格兰面对行刑队。

column1: Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad. It's a disaster, whole Austria might fall under Soviet hands!
column2: 指挥官，这次失败也许已让我们输掉了战争。你须返回英格兰面对行刑队。这是场灾难，整个奥地利都可能落入苏军之手！

column1: Commander, this will be your last assignment before our spring offensive. There is a small pocket of Russian units just north of your current position. We need you to clean them out before they become a more serious problem.
column2: 指挥官，这将是我们春季攻势之前你的最后一项任务。就在你当前位置以北有一个俄军小包围圈。我们需要你在他们变成更严重的问题之前把他们清剿掉。

column1: Commander, this will certainly earn you another medal! The capture of Port Lyautey has been really an amazing job. Now we must race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia.
column2: 指挥官，这肯定会为你再赢得一枚勋章！夺取利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)真是件了不起的功绩。现在我们得向东疾进，直扑突尼斯(Tunisia)的德国佬。

column1: Commander, though able to achieve some limited success, most of the German troops escaped to fight on. We expected more from you.
column2: 指挥官，尽管你取得了有限的战果，大部分德军还是逃脱，得以继续作战。我们对你的期望更高。

column1: Commander, though you shamed the British Army with your miserable performance in France, the successful evacuation at Dunkirk has put Churchill in a forgiving mood.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of British Somaliland.  The Italians have occupied our colony sinc the beginning of the war. You must drive them out!
column2: 指挥官，尽管你在法国的糟糕表现让英国陆军蒙羞，但敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)的成功撤退让丘吉尔有了宽恕的心情。你得到最后一次机会——在我们入侵英属索马里兰(British Somaliland)时发挥重要作用。意大利人自战争开始就占领了我们的殖民地。你必须把他们赶出去！

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling.  I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough. In spite of your forgettable performance, we have won the war. I bid you farewell.
column2: 指挥官，付出如此代价走到这一步，却最终失败，实在令人恼火。我毫不怀疑你已尽力，但遗憾的是，尽力还不够。尽管你的表现不值一提，我们还是赢得了这场战争。我向你道别。

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling. I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough.
column2: 指挥官，付出如此代价走到这一步，却功败垂成，实在令人恼恨。我不怀疑你已经尽了全力，但遗憾的是，尽力还不够。

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling. I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough.

Commander, unfortunately you did not take the city in time and Stalin has managed to relocate his Command to the Urals and refuses to surrender. The war will continue for some time now, but not for you.
column2: 指挥官，遗憾的是你未能及时夺取该城，斯大林已成功把他的统帅部迁往乌拉尔(Urals)，并拒绝投降。战争还要再打上一段时间，但对你来说已经结束了。

column1: Commander, we are almost there... You must clear out this blocking force and pave the way to the Moscow suburbs.
column2: 指挥官，我们就快到了……你必须肃清这支阻援部队，为通往莫斯科郊区铺平道路。

column1: Commander, We are quite dissapointed. I will give you just one more chance to prove yourself. Do not dissapoint us again.
column2: 指挥官，我们相当失望。我只再给你一次证明自己的机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: Commander, We have a chance to trap many German troops between us and Patton's Third Army to the south. You must move quickly to accomplish this task.
column2: 指挥官，我们有机会把大量德军困在我们与南面巴顿(Patton)第3集团军之间。你必须迅速行动，完成这项任务。

column1: Commander, we may be in a bit of trouble here. G2 reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on our border positions as we speak. Bad weather has prevented air support from interdicting them. We need you back in that sector as a mobile reserve. The attack could come at any day now. Good luck.
column2: 指挥官，我们这里可能有点麻烦。G2 报告，就在我们说话的当口，整整一个俄国装甲军和几个独立坦克旅正朝我们的边境阵地压来。恶劣天气使空中支援无法拦阻他们。我们需要你回到那个地段充当机动预备队。进攻随时可能到来。祝好运。

column1: Commander, we may be in a bit of trouble here. G2 reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on our border positions as we speak. Bad weather has prevented the Air Corp from interdicting them. We need you back in that sector as a mobile reserve. The attack could come at any day now. Good luck.
column2: 指挥官，我们这里可能有点麻烦。G2 报告，就在我们说话的当口，整整一个俄国装甲军和几个独立坦克旅正朝我们的边境阵地压来。恶劣天气使航空军(Air Corp)无法拦阻他们。我们需要你回到那个地段充当机动预备队。进攻随时可能到来。祝好运。

column1: Commander, we must break in to the suburbs of Moscow. Once we clear out these Russian blocking troops we will be able to assault the mighty Russian city itself.
column2: 指挥官，我们必须突入莫斯科郊区。一旦肃清这些俄军阻援部队，我们就能进攻这座强大的俄国城市本身。

column1: Commander, we need you to open the door to  Orel by cracking a Russian defensive line just 40 miles west of the city. G2 reports some lesser Russian units in the area and does not feel this will be too much of a problem.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你打穿该城以西仅 40 英里处的一道俄军防线，从而打开通往奥廖尔(Orel)的大门。G2 报告该地区只有一些次要的俄军部队，认为这不会有多大问题。

column1: Commander, Welcome to Phase II of the operation to free Tunisia.
column2: 指挥官，欢迎进入解放突尼斯行动的第二阶段。

column1: Commander, Welcome to Phase II of this operation. We must quickly finish the task at hand because the foul winter weather is really starting to set in our air cover will soon be limited.
column2: 指挥官，欢迎进入本次作战的第二阶段。我们必须赶快完成手头的任务，因为恶劣的冬季天气真的开始到来了，我们的空中掩护很快就将受限。

column1: Commander, Winston Churchill has decided that we must confront the Germans.  You have been chosen to lead an amphibious attack on the Norwegian port of Narvik.  German forces are already occupying the town and are supported by naval units.  A victory here will prove the Germans are not invincible. Good Luck!
column2: 指挥官，温斯顿·丘吉尔(Winston Churchill)已决定我们必须与德国人正面交锋。你已被选中领导一次对挪威(Norwegian)港口纳尔维克(Narvik)的两栖进攻。德军已占领该镇，并有海军部队支援。在此取胜将证明德国人并非不可战胜。祝你好运！

column1: Commander, you are chosen to lead our forces in North Africa. The Italians have been stopped in the vicinity of Sidi Barrani, where they have established strong defensive positions. You will attack and overwhelm these defenses.
column2: 指挥官，你被选中率领我们在北非的部队。意大利人已在西迪拜拉尼附近被挡住，并在那里建立了坚固的防御阵地。你将进攻并击溃这些防御。

column1: Commander, you are losing our prestige to the world, the situation is so critical that we have no choice and we have to defend Moscow.
column2: 指挥官，你正让我国在世界面前失去威望，局势如此危急，我们别无选择，只能保卫莫斯科(Moscow)。

column1: Commander, you barely escaped disaster. We need commanders who can win decisively. You will be reassigned to our infantry training center as permanent latrine orderly!
column2: 指挥官，你险些遭遇灾难。我们需要能决定性取胜的指挥官。你将被重新分配到我们的步兵训练中心，担任永久性厕所勤务兵！

column1: Commander, you did a fine job. However, our forces are losing ground everywhere. You must withdraw you men to Dunkirk to be evacuated. We cannot afford to lose you or your men!
column2: 指挥官，你干得很出色。然而，我们的部队正在各处失守。你必须把部下撤往敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)以便撤离。我们承受不起失去你和你的部下的代价！

column1: Commander, you did a good job.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  More defeats like this will finish the Germans!
column2: 指挥官，你干得好。敌人打得很英勇，但这并未挡住你。再来几场这样的败仗，就能了结德国人！

column1: Commander, you did a good job. However, our forces are losing ground everywhere. You must withdraw you men to Dunkirk to be evacuated.
column2: 指挥官，你干得不错。然而，我们的部队正在各处失守。你必须把部下撤往敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)以便撤离。

column1: Commander, you did a good job. We can continue our offensive towards the German border.
column2: 指挥官，你干得不错。我们可以继续向德国边界推进攻势。

column1: Commander, you did a wonderful job in a tough situation. Your leadership was a key element in demolishing the Axis defences.
column2: 指挥官，你在艰难的处境中干得非常出色。你的领导是摧毁轴心国防线的关键因素。

column1: Commander, you got the job done at Caen.  Unfortunately, we lost a lot of GIs in the process.  Well, you did your best, I know, son, and you'll be given another chance to prove yourself.
column2: 指挥官，你在卡昂(Caen)把差事办成了。遗憾的是，我们在这个过程中损失了许多美国兵。唉，我知道，孩子，你已经尽了力，你会得到另一个证明自己的机会。

column1: Commander, you got the job done.  Unfortunately, we lost a lot of GIs to accompplish this mission. Anyway you did your best, so you'll be given another chance to prove yourself.
column2: 指挥官，你把事情办成了。遗憾的是，为完成这次任务我们损失了许多美国兵。不管怎样，你已尽了全力，所以你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。

column1: Commander, you have been a disappointment to King and country.  It was necessary to drive through Metz and move on, but instead, we find ourselves sandbagged in the trenches!  Our brave lads will capture Metz, I assure you, but it will be done with a different commander.  Good day.
column2: 指挥官，你让国王与国家失望了。本来必须穿过梅斯(Metz)继续推进，可我们却发现自己被沙袋堵在战壕里动弹不得！我向你保证，我们勇敢的小伙子们会拿下梅斯(Metz)，但那将由另一位指挥官来完成。日安。

column1: Commander, you have been chosen to lead our forces back onto European soil. You will lead our invasion of the Italian mainland at Salerno. You must succeed. The whole free world is watching!
column2: 指挥官，你已被选中率领我军重返欧洲大陆。你将指挥我们在萨莱诺(Salerno)对意大利本土的登陆。你必须成功。整个自由世界都在看着！

column1: Commander, You have broken through the enemy lines, but you took too long and Rommel retreated relatively unharmmed.
column2: 指挥官，你突破了敌军防线，但你花的时间太长，隆美尔(Rommel)相对无损地撤退了。

column1: Commander, you have cleared away the last of Russian forces between our current position and the Moscow suburbs. Congratulations! Now you must prepare your troops for the coming assault.
column2: 指挥官，你已肃清我们当前位置与莫斯科郊区之间最后的俄军部队。恭喜！现在你必须让部队为即将到来的突击做好准备。

column1: Commander, you have completed the first part of your mission. You must continue the thrust to Arnhem.
column2: 指挥官，你已完成任务的第一部分。你必须继续向阿纳姆突击。

column1: Commander, you have delayed the enemy long enough to allow our evacuation at Dunkirk. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
column2: 指挥官，你拖延敌人的时间已足以让我们在敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)完成撤离。我们承受不起继续遭受这样的损失。我们对你的期望要高得多。

column1: Commander, you have delayed the enemy long enough to allow our evacuation at Dunkirk. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
Commander, you have disgraced the British Army with pitiful efforts!  Many here demand your return to England to face a court-martial.  May I suggest suicide?
column2: 指挥官，你以可悲的表现让英国陆军蒙羞！这里许多人要求你回英格兰接受军事法庭审判。我能否建议你自杀？

column1: Commander, you have done it! Stalin has sued for peace and the world is now safe from the perils of Russian communism.
column2: 指挥官，你办到了！斯大林已求和，世界现在不再受俄国共产主义之害了。

column1: Commander, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  More defeats like this will finish the Germans!
column2: 指挥官，你超出了我们的期望。敌人打得很英勇，但这并未挡住你。再来几场这样的败仗，就能了结德国人！

column1: Commander, you have failed.  The French have successfully beaten back the Americans throughout North Africa.  We expected more from you.  You are being transferred as liaison officer to the US Army in the Aleutians.
column2: 指挥官，你失败了。法国人在整个北非成功地击退了美国人。我们对你期望更高。你将被调往阿留申群岛(Aleutians)任美军联络官。

column1: Commander, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, German forces have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of weather stations in Greenland.  Dismissed.
column2: 指挥官，你勉强达成了目标。遗憾的是，德军得以秩序井然地撤走，并在新的防线后方重新集结。你显然患上了战斗应激，将被调去监督格陵兰(Greenland)气象站的建设。解散。

column1: Commander, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, German forces have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of weather stations in Greenland.  Dismissed.
Commander, you have successfully broken through the German lines. Now we must move on the Ruhr to destroy German industrial capacity.
column2: 指挥官，你成功地突破了德军战线。现在我们必须向鲁尔(Ruhr)进军，摧毁德国的工业能力。

column1: Commander, you have successfully driven back the German offensive. Once again our American allies are in your debt.
column2: 指挥官，你成功地击退了德军的攻势。我们的美国盟友又一次欠你的人情。

column1: Commander, you have taken too long to succeed. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
column2: 指挥官，你成功所花的时间太长了。我们承受不起这样不断的损失。我们对你的期望远不止于此。

column1: Commander, you must lead our attack into the Ruhr. This is Germany's major industrial zone. If it falls, Germany will be forced to surrender!
column2: 指挥官，你必须率领我们进攻鲁尔。这是德国主要的工业区。如果它陷落，德国将被迫投降！

column1: Commander, You must take Novograd no later than the end of the month. Once again you have a small battle group of German Nationalist troops to assist you. The German Luftwaffe is even testing out a new fighter in this battle.
column2: 指挥官，你必须在月底前夺取诺沃格拉德。你又一次得到一支德国民族主义部队小战斗群的协助。德国空军(Luftwaffe)甚至将在这场战斗中试飞一种新型战斗机。

column1: Commander, you must take your forces and converge with nearby Allied troops in the area to take the weapons facility and destroy that tank. If we aren't quick enough, the blueprints will almost certainly be transmitted to another Soviet base. Take it out quickly and efficently, Commander. Good luck!
column2: 指挥官，你必须率部与该地区附近盟军部队会合，夺取兵工厂并摧毁那辆坦克。如果我们不够快，图纸几乎肯定会传到另一个苏军基地。迅速而高效地把它干掉，指挥官。祝好运！

column1: Commander, you struck out here, and good men died because of it.  We're lucky the Krauts didn't kick us back into the sea.  You've earned yourself a ticket home, but we both know there's nothing to be proud of.  Good luck as a civilian.
column2: 指挥官，你在这里失手了，好士兵因此丧命。我们运气好，德国佬没把我们踢回海里去。你为自己挣到了一张回家的车票，但我们俩都知道这没什么可骄傲的。祝你当平民好运。

column1: Commander, you struck out here, and good men died because of it.  We're lucky the Krauts didn't kick us back to Morocco! I guess you need some time for rest and refit before coming back into service...
column2: 指挥官，你在这里彻底失败了，好男儿因此丧命。我们还算走运，德国佬没把我们踢回摩洛哥去！我想在重新服役之前，你需要一段时间休整与整补……

column1: Commander, you were lucky to escape that one. A very disappointing performance indeed!
column2: 指挥官，你能从那一仗脱身算是走运。真是一场令人非常失望的表现！

column1: Commander, you will lead our assault on Sicily.  If Sicily falls into our hands, the Italians will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them out of the War.
column2: 指挥官，你将率领我们对西西里的突击。如果西西里落入我们手中，意大利人就再也恢复不过来。现在是我们把他们赶出战争的机会。

column1: Commander, your last defeat had a terrible impact over the Members,
column2: 指挥官，你上一次失败对委员们造成了可怕的影响，

column1: Commander, your leadership is now needed to free Libya.
column2: 指挥官，现在需要你的领导来解放利比亚。

column1: Commander, your narrow victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 指挥官，你的险胜表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: Commander, your next task is to break through German lines North of Dusseldorf. This will open the way into the heart of the Ruhr.
column2: 指挥官，你的下一个任务是突破杜塞尔多夫(Dusseldorf)以北的德军战线。这将打开通往鲁尔腹地之路。

column1: Commander, your victory at Bardia allows us an opportunity to evict Italy from our colony in British Somaliland, which they have occupied since the beginning of the war.  Your experience in amphibious warfare should prove useful here.
column2: 指挥官，你在拜尔迪耶的胜利给了我们一个机会，把意大利人从他们自战争开始就占领的英属索马里兰殖民地赶出去。你的两栖作战经验在这里应当有用。

column1: Commander, your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 指挥官，你的胜利表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: Commander, your work needs improvement!  You are not meeting our expectations.
column2: 指挥官，你的表现有待改进！你没有达到我们的期望。

column1: Commander. Even now, the Hermann Goering Division is advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.
column2: 指挥官。此刻赫尔曼·戈林师(Hermann Goering Division)正向我们的阵地推进。拿起步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。

column1: Commander. That was atrocious. The Russians have blasted an enormous hole in our lines and now our entire southern front is in jeapordy. Consider yourself relieved.
column2: 指挥官。那实在太糟糕了。俄国人在我们防线上轰出一个巨大的缺口，现在我们整个南线都岌岌可危。你被撤职了。

column1: communication between Ukraine and the Crimean peninsula.
column2: 乌克兰(Ukraine)与克里米亚(Crimea)半岛之间的陆上交通。

column1: Communism is no longer a threat for Western Europe thanks to you Commander.
column2: 多亏了你，指挥官，共产主义对西欧(Western Europe)不再是威胁。

column1: Communism is no longer a threat for Western Europe thanks to you Commander.
Complete failure! Tens of thousands of our troops are trapped in the Falaise pocket. Nothing is gonna stop the Allies now from reaching the fatherland.
column2: 彻底失败！我们数万部队被困在法莱斯包围圈中。如今再没什么能阻止盟军打到本土了。

column1: Comrade Commander, we want to resume our offensive in the north of Italy.
column2: 指挥官同志，我们要恢复在北意大利的攻势。

column1: Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force our forces trying to reach the Dnieper crossings! Karkhov recently liberated is threatened again! You shoul take command and stop the German counterattack!
column2: 将军同志，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)元帅正以强大兵力进攻我军，试图抵达第聂伯河(Dnieper)各渡口！刚刚解放的哈尔科夫(Karkhov)再次受到威胁！你应当接管指挥，挡住德军的反击！

column1: Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force to release the surrounding forces at Stalingrad! We need to stop them before is too late! You should take command of the Fifty First Army the only force in their path. The Second Guard Army will join you as soon as possible!
column2: 将军同志，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)元帅正以强大兵力进攻，以解救斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)被围的部队！我们必须在为时已晚之前挡住他们！你应当接管第51集团军(Fifty First Army)——他们路上唯一的部队。第2近卫集团军(Second Guard Army)将尽快与你会合！

column1: Comrade General Marshall Zhukov is preparing an offensive to push the Germans from the northern Ukraine. You should coordinate the operations of the Second Ukrainian Front.
column2: 将军同志，朱可夫元帅正在准备一次攻势，把德军逐出乌克兰北部。你应协调乌克兰第2方面军的作战。

column1: Comrade General STAVKA has prepared plans to encircle and destroy the new German Sixth Army  around the Ukranian city of Cherkassy. You should coordinate the operation!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部已制定计划，要在乌克兰城市切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)周围合围并消灭新的德国第6集团军。你应当协调这次作战！

column1: Comrade General STAVKA needs you to straighten the operations leading to the surrender of Odessa. You will get reinforcements, shore landings will be organized near Usatavo town. You will have also support from the Black Sea Fleet. Do not fail us Comrade!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部需要你整顿旨在迫降敖德萨(Odessa)的作战。你将得到增援，并将在乌萨托沃(Usatavo)镇附近组织登陆。你还会得到黑海舰队的支援。不要让我们失望，同志！

column1: Comrade General STAVKA needs you to straighten the operations leading to the surrender of Sevastopol. The local commanders have botched the attack. You can deploy only six of your units plus your Air Force. You will have also support from the Black Sea Fleet. Do not fail us Comrade!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部需要你整顿旨在迫降塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的作战。当地指挥员把这次进攻搞砸了。你只能投入你的六个单位外加你的空军。你还会得到黑海舰队的支援。不要让我们失望，同志！

column1: Comrade General STAVKA needs you to take command of the operations against Army Group South Ukraine. A victory here will weaken Romania and open the way toward the Hungarian plains.
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部需要你接管对南乌克兰集团军群的作战指挥。在此取胜将削弱罗马尼亚(Romania)，并打开通往匈牙利平原的道路。

column1: Comrade General STAVKA wants you to take command in Finland! The fall of Viipuri will knock Finland out of the war! Do not fail us Comrade!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部要你去芬兰指挥！维堡(Viipuri)的陷落将使芬兰退出战争！不要让我们失望，同志！

column1: Comrade General the enemy is attacking the city of Stalin! You have
column2: 将军同志，敌人正在进攻斯大林之城！你已被

column1: Comrade General the Germans are trying to break through our positions in the Kursk salient! Marshall Zhukov has put you in charge of the northern flank of our defenses! You should stop the enemy short of Ponyri Station!
column2: 将军同志，德军正试图突破我们在库尔斯克(Kursk)突出部的阵地！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅已任命你负责我们防线的北翼！你应当在波内里(Ponyri)车站之前挡住敌人！

column1: Comrade General the Germans are trying to establish an stable front on the right bank of the Dnepr river. We should penetrate this "Eastern wall" and gain a sure foothold on the other bank.
column2: 将军同志，德军正试图在第聂伯河(Dnepr)右岸建立一道稳定的防线。我们应当打穿这道「东方壁垒」，在对岸取得可靠的立足点。

column1: Comrade General the hour of our revenge has come. We have secretely gathered powerful forces on the flanks of the German forces. Only Romanian and other weak Axis forces face us. General Zhukov has ordered you to direct the operations of the northern pincer!
column2: 将军同志，我们复仇的时刻到了。我们已在德军两翼秘密集结强大兵力。面对我们的只有罗马尼亚部队及其他弱小的轴心国部队。朱可夫(Zhukov)将军已命令你指挥北钳的作战！

column1: Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.
column2: 将军同志，「堡垒」(Zitadelle)攻势已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。

column1: Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.
column2: 将军同志，「库尔斯克会战」(Zitadelle)已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。

column1: Comrade General Vassiliev has asked for you to direct the operations of
column2: 将军同志，瓦西里耶夫已要求你指挥

column1: Comrade General Vassiliev has asked for you to direct the operations of the Volkov and Leningrad Fronts that will try to take Schulenburg and break the siege of Leningrad. We expect much of you! Do not dissapoint us Comrade!
column2: 瓦西里耶夫(Vassiliev)将军同志已要求你指挥沃尔霍夫(Volkov)方面军与列宁格勒方面军的作战，夺取舒伦堡(Schulenburg)，打破列宁格勒之围。我们对你期望很高！同志，不要让我们失望！

column1: Comrade General we have to surprise the Germans by crossing the middle Dnepr at Mogilev. A beachhead there will threatened the flanks of both Army Groups Center and South. You have to cross to the right bank and penetrate the socalled "Eastern wall".
column2: 将军同志，我们必须出奇不意，在莫吉廖夫(Mogilev)渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)中游。在那里建立一个滩头阵地，将威胁中央与南方两个集团军群的侧翼。你必须渡到右岸，并突入所谓的「东方壁垒」。

column1: Comrade General you crossed the Vistula river but after that your indecision has allowed the Germans to rebuild their positions!!! This compromises our future operations. Vassiliev is very displeased!
column2: 将军同志，你渡过了维斯瓦河(Vistula)，但此后你的犹疑让德军得以重建阵地！！！这危及我们未来的作战。瓦西里耶夫极为不满！

column1: Comrade General you failed to achieve a great success! You were able to secure a big beachhead on the right bank of the Dnepr river, but your slow attack allowed them to contain your position. You have to do better than that!
column2: 将军同志，你未能取得重大胜利！你得以在第聂伯河(Dnepr)右岸建立了一个大滩头阵地，但你进攻迟缓，使他们得以遏制住你的阵地。你必须做得更好！

column1: Comrade General you failed to stop the Germans at the Myshkova! Marshall Zhukov have decided to flank them by adestrying the Eigth Italian Army covering the Don river. Do not fail us again or you will feel Vassiliev's wrath! Kotelnikovo is your objective!
column2: 将军同志，你未能在梅什科瓦河(Myshkova)挡住德军！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅已决定通过歼灭掩护顿河的意大利第8集团军(Eigth Italian Army)来迂回他们。不要再让我们失望，否则你会尝到瓦西里耶夫(Vassiliev)的怒火！科捷利尼科沃(Kotelnikovo)是你的目标！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and finally Crimea is free from invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，克里米亚(Crimea)终于摆脱了侵略者！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and Finland has asked for an armistice! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，芬兰(Finland)已请求停战！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and the gate for Moldavia is open! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，通往摩尔达维亚(Moldavia)的门户已经打开！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The German position is in disarray by the big beachhead you established on the right bank of the Dnepr river in the junction of both Army Groups.
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！由于你在两个集团军群接合部、第聂伯河(Dnepr)右岸建立的大滩头阵地，德军阵地已陷入混乱。

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! As we speak our pincers are joinning East of Kalach. The German Sixth Army is surrounded!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！就在我们说话的当口，我们的两把钳子正在卡拉奇(Kalach)以东合拢。德国第6集团军已被包围！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! The Romanian and German troops are on the run! Vassiliev is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！罗马尼亚与德国部队正在溃逃！瓦西里耶夫对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! You stopped the German counterattacks and took Budapest! Hungary has surrendered!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了伟大的胜利！你挡住了德军的反击并夺取了布达佩斯(Budapest)！匈牙利(Hungary)已经投降！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the German Central front. The Germans are on the run and most of Poland is in our hands, our borders are secured for a long time! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了巨大的胜利！你打破了德军的中央防线。德军正在溃逃，波兰大部已在我们手中，我们的边界将长期安全！瓦西里耶夫极为满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the siege of Leningrad and the Germans are on the run! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了巨大的胜利！你打破了列宁格勒(Leningrad)之围，德军正在溃逃！瓦西里耶夫极为满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the siege of Leningrad, but your indecision allowed the Germans to withdraw in good order! Vassiliev is very displeased with your failure in following up your success!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了巨大的胜利！你打破了列宁格勒(Leningrad)之围，但你的犹疑让德军得以井然有序地撤走！瓦西里耶夫对你未能扩大战果极为不满！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous victory! You have broken the German Ninth and Third Panzer Armies! Berlin is in front of us! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了巨大的胜利！你打垮了德军第9和第3装甲集团军！柏林就在我们眼前！瓦西里耶夫极为满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved complete success! The German are leaving Orel at full speed! We have them on the run!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了全胜！德军正全速撤离奥廖尔(Orel)！他们已被我们打得溃逃！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved complete victory! The German are retreating towards the Dnepr river at full speed! We have them on the run!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了完全的胜利！德国人正全速向第聂伯河(Dnepr)撤退！我们把他们打跑了！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved complete victory! The German are retreating towards the Dnepr river at full speed! We have them on the run!
column2: 阿杰达比亚(Agedabia) - 1945 年 12 月 23 日

column1: Comrade General you have achieved only a small victory! You stopped the German counterattacks, but failed to take Budapest and allowed the Germans to estabilize the front! Hungary is still defying us!
column2: 将军同志，你只取得了一场小胜！你挡住了德军的反击，却未能夺取布达佩斯(Budapest)，还让德军稳住了战线！匈牙利(Hungary)仍在顽抗！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved some success! Once again your
column2: 将军同志，你取得了一些战果！你的

column1: Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your dilatory tactics have failed to clear this part of the Ukraine from Germans invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了一些成功，但你拖沓的战术未能把德国入侵者从乌克兰的这一部分清除出去！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your ineptitude has allowed the enemy to evacuate the city by sea! Vassiliev is displeased even though you captured the city!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了一些战果，但你的无能致使敌人从海上撤走了！尽管你夺取了该城，瓦西里耶夫仍不满意！

column1: Comrade General you have an opportunity to rehabilitate yourself! Marshall Zhukov wants you to reduce Budapest and hold off the German attacks in the Hungarian plains!
column2: 将军同志，你有一个洗刷自己的机会！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅要你攻下布达佩斯(Budapest)，并挡住德军在匈牙利平原的进攻！

column1: Comrade General you have completely destroyed the Italian Eighth Army! Our tanks are rolling on the rear of the German force at the Myshkova! Kotelnikovo is threatened! Vassiliev is very satisfied!
column2: 将军同志，你已彻底消灭意大利第8集团军！我们的坦克正碾过梅什科瓦河(Myshkova)一带德军的后方！科捷利尼科沃(Kotelnikovo)已受威胁！瓦西里耶夫非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have crossed the Dniestr, but most Axis troops have been evacuated and Romania still opposes us! Vassiliev is not pleased!
column2: 将军同志，你已渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)，但大部分轴心国部队已经撤离，罗马尼亚(Romania)仍在对抗我们！瓦西里耶夫很不满意！

column1: Comrade General you have disrupted completely the German plans by forcing the river and establishing a big beachhead on the right bank of the Dnepr river.
column2: 将军同志，你强渡大河并在第聂伯河(Dnepr river)右岸建立了一个大桥头堡，彻底打乱了德军的计划。

column1: Comrade General you have failed completely to destroy the Italian Eighth Army! The Germans are in condition to release Sixth Army! Vassiliev is very disatisfied!
column2: 将军同志，你完全未能消灭意大利第8集团军！德国人已经有条件为第6集团军解围！瓦西里耶夫极为不满！

column1: Comrade General You have failed miserably! You have shown no conditions whatsoever to command a big group of troops! You should come back to your basics! You should report to the 10 NKVD Infantry division to command an infantry platoon!
column2: 将军同志，你败得很惨！你完全没有表现出指挥大兵团的条件！你该回去补补基本功！你应当向内务人民委员部第10步兵师报到，去指挥一个步兵排！

column1: Comrade General You have failed miserably! You have shown no conditions whatsoever to command a big group of troops! You should come back to your basics! You should report to the 10 NKVD Infantry division to command an infantry platoon!
Comrade General you have failed to achieve complete success! The German are evacuating Orel at in good order! Marshall Zhukov is displeased with your luckluster performance!
column2: 将军同志，你未能取得全胜！德军正井然有序地撤出奥廖尔(Orel)！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅对你的平庸表现很不满意！

column1: Comrade General you have failed to break the lines on the flanks of Sixth Army! We cannot expelled the Germans now! Vassiliev is very upset with your incompetence!
column2: 将军同志，你未能突破第6集团军两翼的防线！我们现在无法把德军逐出了！瓦西里耶夫对你的无能极为不满！

column1: Comrade General you have failed to break the lines on the flanks of Sixth Army! We cannot expelled the Germans now! Vassiliev is very upset with your incompetence!
Comrade General you have failed to destroy the Italian Eighth Army! The Germans still threaten to release Sixth Army! Vassiliev is very disatisfied!
column2: 将军同志，你未能消灭意大利第8集团军！德国人仍威胁着为第6集团军解围！瓦西里耶夫极为不满！

column1: Comrade General you have failed to destroy the Italian Eighth Army! The Germans still threaten to release Sixth Army! Vassiliev is very disatisfied!

Comrade General you have failed to disrupt the German plans! You undecided attack just established some beachheads here and there, but you failed to breach the Eastern wall! Vassiliev is very displeased! You have to do better!
column2: 将军同志，你未能打乱德军的计划！你犹疑不决的进攻只零零星星地建立了几个滩头阵地，却未能突破东方壁垒！瓦西里耶夫极为不满！你必须做得更好！

column1: Comrade General you have failed to stop the German offensive. The German Sixth Army has escaped! Our southern front is wrecked! The Rodina is in great danger!
column2: 将军同志，你未能挡住德军的攻势。德国第6集团军已经逃脱！我们的南线已被打垮！祖国(Rodina)危在旦夕！

column1: Comrade General you have failed to stop the Germans completely! Ponyri Station is still threatened! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你未能彻底挡住德军！波内里(Ponyri)车站仍受威胁！瓦西里耶夫对你的表现很不满意！

column1: Comrade General you have fought bravely throughout all German attacks! Unfortunately the city is mostly in German hands. Our situation is very precarious!
column2: 将军同志，你在德军的历次进攻中一直英勇作战！不幸的是，城市大部分已落入德军之手。我们的处境十分危险！

column1: Comrade General you have not achieved complete victory! The German are retreating towards the Dnepr river in order and at their own pace! You have failed to disrupt their plans!
column2: 将军同志，你未能取得全胜！德国人正井然有序、按自己的步调退向第聂伯河！你未能打乱他们的计划！

column1: Comrade General you have only partially stopped the German counteroffensive. The enemy still threatens Karkhov! Vassiliev is dissapointed!
column2: 将军同志，你只部分挡住了德军的反攻。敌人仍在威胁哈尔科夫(Karkhov)！瓦西里耶夫很失望！

column1: Comrade General you have resisted all German attacks! The city is solidly in our hands. We can look with confidence into the future!
column2: 将军同志，你顶住了德军的一切进攻！城市已牢牢掌握在我们手中。我们满怀信心地展望未来！

column1: Comrade General you have stopped the German counteroffensive. The enemy has lost the initiative and Karkhov is safe!
column2: 将军同志，你已挡住德军的反攻。敌人已失去主动权，哈尔科夫(Karkhov)安全了！

column1: Comrade General you have stopped the German offensive, but the enemy still threatens to release the Sixth Army! Your performance is disappointing! The Rodina is in great danger!
column2: 将军同志，你已挡住德军的攻势，但敌人仍威胁着为第6集团军解围！你的表现令人失望！祖国危在旦夕！

column1: Comrade General you have stopped the German offensive. The enemy cannot release the Sixth Army! The Sixth Army is now doomed! The Rodina is safe!
column2: 将军同志，你已挡住德军的攻势。敌人无法为第6集团军解围！第6集团军现在注定覆灭！祖国安全了！

column1: Comrade General you have stopped the German offensive. The enemy cannot release the Sixth Army! The Sixth Army is now doomed! The Rodina is safe!
Comrade General you have stopped the Germans completely! Ponyri Station is safe! Vassiliev is very pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你已彻底挡住德国人！波内里(Ponyri)车站安全了！瓦西里耶夫对你的表现非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have taken the town, but most Axis troops have been evacuated and Finland still opposes us! Vassiliev is not pleased!
column2: 将军同志，你夺取了该镇，但大部分轴心国部队已被撤走，芬兰仍在抵抗我们！瓦西里耶夫不满意！

column1: Comrade General you were able to push the Germans across the Narva river, but Army Group North is still intact opposing us! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你成功把德军逐过纳尔瓦河(Narva)，但北方集团军群仍然完整地与我们对抗！瓦西里耶夫对你的表现很不满意！

column1: Comrade General you were able to push the Germans from most Latvia, but Army Group North is still intact in the Curland area! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你成功把德军逐出了拉脱维亚(Latvia)大部，但北方集团军群仍在库尔兰(Curland)地区保持完整！瓦西里耶夫对你的表现很不满意！

column1: Comrade General you were able to push the Germans from Perekop, but the German-Romanian forces are still resisting us! STAVKA is not pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你成功把德军逐出了佩列科普(Perekop)，但德罗联军仍在抵抗我们！最高统帅部对你的表现很不满意！

column1: Comrade General your failure to break the lines on the flanks of Sixth Army has meant that the enemy still threatens Stalingad! Vassiliev is very upset with your incompetence!
column2: 将军同志，你未能突破第6集团军两翼的防线，这意味着敌人仍在威胁斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)！瓦西里耶夫对你的无能极为不满！

column1: Comrade General your initial success has trapped important German troops at the city of Cherkassy! Your failure to follow through has allowed most Germans to escape! Stavka is very displeased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你最初的成功把重要的德军部队困在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)城！但你未能贯彻到底，让大部分德国人逃脱了！最高统帅部对你的指挥极为不满！

column1: Comrade General your success has cleared this part of the Rodina from Germans invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你的胜利已把德国入侵者从祖国(Rodina)的这一部分清除出去！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General Your success has isolated the German Seventeenth Army in Crimea and many Romanian divisions. They are doomed!
column2: 将军同志，你的胜利已把德国第17集团军以及许多罗马尼亚师孤立在克里米亚(Crimea)。他们注定覆灭！

column1: Comrade General Your success has liberated the city of Riga and most of Latvia! Marshall Zhukov has proposed a promotion for you to Colonel General!
column2: 将军同志，你的胜利解放了里加(Riga)城和拉脱维亚(Latvia)大部！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅已提议把你晋升为大将！

column1: Comrade General your success has trapped and destroyed important German troops at the city of Cherkassy! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你的成功已在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)城围歼了德军重要部队！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General your wonderful victory has dealt a tremendous blow to Army Group North! Vassiliev is very pleased with your performance!
column2: 将军同志，你的辉煌胜利给了北方集团军群沉重一击！瓦西里耶夫对你的表现非常满意！

column1: Comrade General! Comrade Stalin, on Zhukov's proposal, has charged you with a task of leading an operation to destroy 2nd Hungarian and remnants of 8th Italian armies. Your aim is to cut off the 2nd German Army on the Voronezh Bridgehead and going to the back of Army Group South. Nothing can stop us!
column2: 将军同志！斯大林同志根据朱可夫的提议，交给你一项任务：指挥一次行动，歼灭匈牙利第2集团军和意大利第8集团军残部。你的目标是切断沃罗涅日桥头堡上的德国第2集团军，并插向南方集团军群的后方。没有什么能阻挡我们！

column1: Comrade General, according to Comrade Stalin, today the Germans will attack our positions at Kursk and Belgorod. We are well prepared so the Nazis shall get what they deserve!
column2: 将军同志，据斯大林(Stalin)同志说，今天德军将进攻我们在库尔斯克(Kursk)与别尔哥罗德(Belgorod)的阵地。我们准备充分，纳粹会得到他们应得的下场！

column1: Comrade General, after ferocious fighting during autumn and winter now we have the chance to strike the decisive blow and liberate the whole Ukraine from German occupation. You attack on German flank with task of encirclementing and destruction 4th Panzer Armee.
column2: 将军同志，经过秋冬两季的恶战，现在我们有机会打出决定性的一击，把整个乌克兰(Ukraine)从德国占领下解放出来。你将从德军侧翼进攻，任务是合围并歼灭第4装甲集团军(4th Panzer Armee)。

column1: Comrade General, Berlin aheads! Kill the Nazi Beast in its lair!!!
column2: 将军同志，前面就是柏林！把这头纳粹野兽消灭在它的巢穴里！！！

column1: Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created.
column2: 将军同志，斯大林同志正认真考虑让你出任波兰人民军司令——多亏你部队的刺刀，卢布林(Lublin)的波兰政府终于建立起来了。

column1: Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created.
column2: 破门而入(Kicking in the door) - 1946 年 4 月 17 日

column1: Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created. Afterwards, for your combat achievements, you were promoted to Army General and decorated with Order of the Kutuzov.
column2: 将军同志，斯大林同志正认真考虑让你做波兰人民军的司令候选人——毕竟多亏你部队的刺刀，卢布林(Lublin)的波兰政府才得以成立。之后，为表彰你的战功，你被晋升为大将并授予库图佐夫勋章。

column1: Comrade General, for over 900 days, Leningrad has been entrapped by the fascist invaders.  The Party has decreed that you must break their stranglehold on the city.  Comrade, the people must be freed at all costs. Their sacrifices must not have been in vain.
column2: 将军同志，900多天来，列宁格勒(Leningrad)一直被法西斯入侵者围困。党已下令，你必须打破他们对这座城市的扼制。同志，必须不惜一切代价解放人民。他们的牺牲绝不能白费。

column1: Comrade General, here we have the Gauleiter's daughter, if you would like to do it first... The Gauleiter is hanging on the apple-tree in his orchard - boys from NKVD regret they couldn't interrogate him...
column2: 将军同志，我们这里有大区领袖(Gauleiter)的女儿，如果你愿意先来的话……那位大区领袖正挂在他果园的苹果树上——内务人民委员部(NKVD)的人遗憾没能审讯他……

column1: Comrade General, here we have the Gauleiter's daughter, if you would like to do it first... The Gauleiter is hanging on the apple-tree in his orchard - boys from NKVD regret they couldn't interrogate him... Oh, there was a phone from Moscow that you were awarded with Order of Suvorov...
column2: 将军同志，地方长官(Gauleiter)的女儿就在这里，如果你想先来的话……那位地方长官正吊在他果园的苹果树上——内务人民委员部(NKVD)的小伙子们很遗憾没能审讯他……哦，莫斯科(Moscow)来了电话，你被授予苏沃洛夫勋章(Order of Suvorov)……

column1: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!!
column2: 将军同志，为奖赏你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的提议，把突击柏林(Berlin)的任务交给了你！！！

column1: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!! For your courage you've been again awarded with the Hero of the Soviet Union. Hurrah!!!
column2: 将军同志，为表彰你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的建议，把突击柏林的任务交给了你！！！由于你的英勇，你再次被授予苏联英雄称号。乌拉！！！

column1: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!! For your courage you've been again awarded with the Hero of the Soviet Union. Hurrah!!!

Comrade General, in the 3rd anniversary of Nazi attack on our Rodina, we shall start the greatest offensive of this war. Comrade Stalin ordered us the loudly aim of liberating the whole Byelorussia and driving the Germans away from our land!
column2: 将军同志，在纳粹进攻我们祖国(Rodina)三周年之际，我们将发动这场战争中最伟大的攻势。斯大林同志给我们下达了响亮的目标：解放整个白俄罗斯(Byelorussia)，把德国人赶出我们的土地！

column1: Comrade General, Marshall Zhukov wants you to reduce Bucharest and force Rumania to fight on our side. Moldavia must be brought back to Soviet Union!
column2: 将军同志，朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅要你攻下布加勒斯特(Bucharest)，迫使罗马尼亚(Rumania)站在我们一边作战。摩尔达维亚(Moldavia)必须重归苏联！

column1: Comrade General, now, after there are no german troops on the Ukraine, you'll be commanded to Byelorussia. From there we shall make a decisive blow to drive the fascist invaders away from Rodina!
column2: 将军同志，如今乌克兰境内已无德军，你将被调往白俄罗斯(Byelorussia)。我们将从那里发起决定性一击，把法西斯入侵者逐出祖国(Rodina)！

column1: Comrade General, now, after there are no german troops on the Ukraine, you'll be commanded to Byelorussia. From there we shall make a decisive blow to drive the fascist invaders away from Rodina! For liberation of the Ukraine you've been decorated with the Order of the Red Banner.
column2: 将军同志，如今乌克兰(Ukraine)已无德军，你将被调往白俄罗斯。从那里我们将发起决定性打击，把法西斯侵略者赶出祖国！为表彰解放乌克兰，你已被授予红旗勋章。

column1: Comrade General, on our northern flank there is still danger of counterattack from the Western Pomerania. STAVKA has orderded you to support the offensive of 1st Polish Army and to establish the front line along the Oder. After then, we shall assault on Berlin!!!
column2: 将军同志，我们北翼仍有来自西波美拉尼亚(Western Pomerania)的反击危险。最高统帅部(STAVKA)已命令你支援波兰第1集团军的攻势，并沿奥得河建立战线。之后，我们就要突击柏林！！！

column1: Comrade General, our troops continue pursuit after Germans. Now you have to cross the Dnieper before they establish stronger positions. For Comrade Stalin liberation of Ukraine is crucial.
column2: 将军同志，我军正在继续追击德军。现在你必须在他们建立更坚固的阵地之前渡过第聂伯河(Dnieper)。对斯大林同志来说，解放乌克兰(Ukraine)至关重要。

column1: Comrade General, thanks to your previous merits and Comrade Zhukov's personal intercession you have saved your head. Now you have to rebuild your corps.
column2: 将军同志，由于你以往的功绩以及朱可夫(Zhukov)同志本人的说情，你保住了脑袋。现在你必须重建你的军。

column1: Comrade General, the Wehrmacht has been crushed. Now towards Berlin; it's about 2000 km from our current positions...
column2: 将军同志，国防军已被击溃。现在向柏林进军；距我们当前位置约 2000 公里……

column1: Comrade General, this is the final assault. Our fronts cross the Oder along the whole line: break through the Seelow Heights, crush the remnants of the Wehrmacht and raise the red banner over Berlin! For the Motherland!
column2: 将军同志，这是最后的突击。我各方面军正沿全线强渡奥得河(Oder)：突破塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)，碾碎国防军残部，把红旗插上柏林(Berlin)城头！为了祖国！

column1: Comrade General, we congratulate you!  You are a true Hero of the Soviet Union.  Your forces have freed the world from the scourge of fascism, and the people of the world celebrate this victory with you.  The party, in order to show its gratitude, has secured for you an apartment in Moskva, and looks forward to your continued loyal service.  And now, let us drink tea.  The samovar is full!
column2: 将军同志，我们祝贺你！你是真正的苏联英雄。你的部队把世界从法西斯的祸害中解放出来，全世界的人民都在与你一同庆祝这场胜利。为表示感激，党已在莫斯科(Moskva)为你安排了一套公寓，并期待你继续忠诚服务。现在，我们来喝茶吧。茶炊是满的！

column1: Comrade General, you have arrived early.  We can begin our meeting now.  The samovar has just been refilled if you would like a drink.  Very good.  Let us begin.  The historical dialectic propounded by Marx and Lenin and refined by the Great Stalin has proven its inevitable truth.  The fascist invaders of our homeland have over-extended themselves in a futile attempt to seize the city of Stalingrad.  Here along the Chir River, you and your forces will surge through their defenses and drive southward with maximum speed.  The Red Army of workers and peasants will surround the enemy and force his surrender.
column2: 将军同志，你来得早。我们现在可以开会了。茶炊刚续满，如果你想喝一杯的话。很好。我们开始吧。马克思(Marx)与列宁(Lenin)提出、并由伟大的斯大林加以完善的历史辩证法，已证明了它必然的真理。我们祖国的法西斯入侵者为了夺取斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)城而过度伸展，徒劳无功。就在这里，沿奇尔河(Chir)一线，你和你的部队将冲垮他们的防御，以最快速度向南推进。工农红军将包围敌人，迫其投降。

column1: Comrade General, you have cleared the way to liberate Ukraine!
column2: 将军同志，你已为解放乌克兰清除了道路！

column1: Comrade General, you have completed your mission.  The fascists have been crushed. The western capitalists now understand that a state of free workers and peasants under the enlightened guidance of the Party can never be defeated.  You will be granted a medal to be worn proudly as evidence of your sacrifice and heroism.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军同志，你已完成了任务。法西斯已被粉碎。西方的资本家现在明白，一个在党英明指引下的自由工农国家是永远无法被击败的。你将获授一枚勋章，可自豪地佩戴，作为你牺牲与英勇的见证。恭喜。

column1: Comrade General, your pursuit has led us to the Middle Oder! Now there's only 60 km to the Berlin!!! The intelligence claims that these fortifications you've crossed nearly away, were said to be the strongest defence positions in the East. We would have never think about it in that way...
column2: 将军同志，你的追击把我们带到了中奥得河！现在距柏林只有 60 公里了！！！情报称，你几乎一冲而过的那片工事，据说是东方最坚固的防御阵地。我们绝不会那样想……

column1: Comrade General, your Tank Army is temporarily commanded to the Baltic Front. With a sudden strike we should capture East Prussia and thus leave the Germans with no possibility of counterattacking our troops on the Vistula's western bank. Tell your soldiers they have the honour of bringing the war into the German territory - you have to rape, burn, murder and plunder. Let these fascist scums feel the war!!!
column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军暂归波罗的海沿岸方面军(Baltic Front)指挥。我们应以突袭击夺取东普鲁士，从而使德军再无法反击维斯瓦河(Vistula)西岸的我军。告诉你的士兵，他们有幸把战争带入德国领土——你们必须强奸、烧杀、劫掠。让这些法西斯渣滓尝尝战争的滋味！！！

column1: Comrade General, Your Tank Army must as soon as possible cross the Vistula river and establish a bridgehead on its western bank. We expect very strong German resistance.
column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军必须尽快渡过维斯瓦河(Vistula)，并在其西岸建立桥头堡。我们预计德军会有非常顽强的抵抗。

column1: Comrade General, your Tank Army will strike from the Baranow Bridgehead towards Central Poland and then towards Berlin! You have to destroy Heeresgruppe "Weichsel", they can't stop us now!!!
column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军将从巴拉努夫桥头堡(Baranow Bridgehead)向波兰中部出击，然后直指柏林！你必须消灭「维斯瓦」集团军群(Heeresgruppe "Weichsel")，他们现在挡不住我们了！！！

column1: Comrade General, Your troops did excellent job! You have taken a bridgehead on the Vistula's western bank. This will be the basis for our offensive that should liberate Poland from Fascist-capitalist oppression!
column2: 将军同志，你的部队干得非常出色！你已在维斯瓦河(Vistula)西岸夺取了一个桥头堡。这将是我们把波兰从法西斯资本主义压迫下解放出来的攻势的基础！

column1: Comrade General, your troops have successfully crossed the Dnepr and driven back the fascist invaders.  Your performance, though adequate, does not entirely reflect what we expect of the New Soviet Man.  And now, Comrade, I have work to do.
column2: 将军同志，你的部队已成功渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)，并把法西斯入侵者击退。你的表现虽然合格，却并未完全体现出我们对苏维埃新人的期望。好了，同志，我还有工作要做。

column1: Comrade General.  Please, come in.  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed. Good work.
column2: 将军同志。请进。占领维堡(Vyborg)已打垮法西斯分子的意志。芬兰人已被他们的德国盟友抛弃，已请求和平。终于建立了一个像样的社会主义政府。干得好。

column1: Comrade General.  Please, come in. Some caviar?  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed.  Excellent, excellent work.
column2: 将军同志。请进。来点鱼子酱？占领维堡(Vyborg)已打垮法西斯分子的意志。芬兰人已被他们的德国盟友抛弃，已请求和平。终于建立了一个像样的社会主义政府。出色，干得非常出色。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is displeased with your performance! Anglo-Americans took Berlin, we must now share victory with them as bright second class partner!!! Furthermore we do not know about Hitler's fate!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现很不满意！英美军队夺取了柏林，我们现在只能作为出色的二流伙伴与他们分享胜利！！！此外，我们还不知道希特勒的下场！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is extremely pleased with your performance!!! Nazi Germany is no more and Anglo-americans are far from Berlin!!! You are one of the heroes of the hour and a new Marshall of the Soviet Union!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现极为满意！！！纳粹德国已不复存在，英美军队还远在柏林之外！！！你是当今的英雄之一，也是苏联的新元帅！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is extremely pleased with your performance!!! Nazi Germany is no more!!! You are one of the heroes of the hour and a new Marshall of the Soviet Union!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现极为满意！！！纳粹德国已不复存在！！！你是当今的英雄之一，也是苏联的新元帅！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not please with your lackluster performance. Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的平庸表现很不满意。你的下一个任务是前往满洲边境。你对我们的学说不理解得还不够透彻！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not pleased with your lackluster performance.
column2: 将军同志：斯大林(Stalin)同志对你的平庸表现很不满意。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not pleased with your lackluster performance. Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的平庸表现很不满意。你的下一个任务是前往满洲边境。你对我们的学说不理解得还不够透彻！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not pleased with your performance!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现很不满意！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is pleased with your performance! Despite some indecisions you were able to destroy Nazi Germany!!! Unfortunately we do not know about Hitler's fate!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现很满意！尽管有一些犹疑，你终究消灭了纳粹德国！！！遗憾的是我们不知道希特勒的下场！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Communist doctrine has gained a precious ally in the Balkans!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！共产主义学说在巴尔干(Balkans)赢得了一个宝贵的盟友！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Koenigsberg and Danzig have lived, Kaliningrad and Gdansk are born, our borders are now secured for a long time!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！柯尼斯堡(Koenigsberg)与但泽(Danzig)已经消亡，加里宁格勒(Kaliningrad)与格但斯克(Gdansk)就此诞生，我们的边界将长期安全！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Rocket science is no longer a secret for us!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！火箭科学对我们已不再是秘密！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! The Romanian troops have surrendered and Romania has asked for an armistice! Soviet Republic of Moldavia is born, our borders are now secured for a long time!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！罗马尼亚(Romania)军队已经投降，罗马尼亚已请求停战！摩尔达维亚(Moldavia)苏维埃共和国诞生了，我们的边界将长期安全！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! The world will remember that the Red Army liberated people from the most terrific Nazi extermination camp. This capture is an operation which will greatly benefit to the spread of our doctrine.
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！全世界都会记住，是红军把人们从纳粹最恐怖的灭绝营中解放出来。这次夺取行动将大大有利于我们学说的传播。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Warsaw belongs to us, now we can move to the Oder river!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！华沙(Warsaw)属于我们了，现在我们可以向奥得河(Oder)推进了！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered Belorussia for us!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！你为我们收复了白俄罗斯(Belorussia)！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered most of Lithuania and crossed the German border!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！你收复了立陶宛(Lithuania)的大部分，并越过了德国边境！！！

column1: Comrade General: Fall of Katowice allows us to liberate Auschwitz concentration camp. Anglo-Americans urge us to deliver deportees. Small forces have been allocated for this operation, Stavka cannot divert its core forces from other fronts. Use a small detachment and capture the camp, this should be a piece of cake while Germans are on the run. Stalin count especially on you, his prestige is at stake, failure is not an option.
column2: 将军同志：卡托维兹(Katowice)的陷落使我们得以解放奥斯维辛(Auschwitz)集中营。英美催促我们交送被驱逐者。此次作战只拨给了少量兵力，最高统帅部无法从其他战线抽调核心部队。派一支小分队夺取该营，德军正在溃逃，这应当轻而易举。斯大林尤其指望你，这关系他的威望，失败不是选项。

column1: Comrade General: Fall of Rumania and Bulgaria gave us the opportunity to free Yugoslav workers and peasants!!! You will join your forces with Malinovsky 3rd Ukrainian front and Tito's partisans!!!
column2: 将军同志：罗马尼亚(Rumania)与保加利亚(Bulgaria)的陷落给了我们解放南斯拉夫工人和农民的机会！！！你将与马利诺夫斯基(Malinovsky)的乌克兰第3方面军以及铁托(Tito)的游击队会合！！！

column1: Comrade General: Kiev the Ukrainian capital is in front of you. This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from the second most important Soviet Republic!!! Comrade Stalin wants to destroy Army Group South once and for all. You will attack from above and below the city.
column2: 将军同志：乌克兰首都基辅(Kiev)就在你眼前。这是你把德国法西斯逐出这第二个最重要的苏维埃共和国的机会！！！斯大林同志要一劳永逸地消灭南方集团军群。你将从该城的上方与下方发起进攻。

column1: Comrade General: The time for revenge has arrived! The last German troops try desperately to defend Berlin. Stavka orders you to take the city at any cost! In no way decadent anglo-americans may reach the city before us, the Great Patriotic War has been the suffering of the whole Soviet people, those "allies" cannot steal our deserved victory. Don't waste time! Hitler is supposed to remain in the City, he must be found dead or alive. His bunker has still not been located. Find it, this is your second objective.  Expect fanatic resistance. Unleash Hell! Failure is not an option Comrade General. The eyes of the Rodina are watching you!
column2: 将军同志：复仇的时刻到了！德军最后的部队正在拼死保卫柏林。最高统帅部命令你不惜一切代价拿下该城！绝不能让堕落的英美军队先于我们到达该城，伟大的卫国战争是全体苏联人民的苦难，那些「盟友」不能窃取我们应得的胜利。不要浪费时间！希特勒据说仍留在城里，无论死活都必须找到他。他的地堡仍未查明位置。找到它，这是你的第二目标。预料会遇到狂热的抵抗。放手大开杀戒！失败不是选项，将军同志。祖国在注视着你！
