column1: Comrade General: This is our opportunity to reach the lower Dnepr at Perekop  and isolate the German facists in the Crimea! You will command the operations of the Fourth Ukrainian Front!
column2: 将军同志：这是我们抵达佩列科普(Perekop)第聂伯河(Dnepr)下游、孤立克里米亚(Crimea)德国法西斯分子的机会！你将指挥乌克兰第4方面军的作战！

column1: Comrade General: This is the opportunity to liberate Polish peasants and
column2: 将军同志：这是把波兰农民和

column1: Comrade General: This is the opportunity to seize German technology!!!
column2: 将军同志：这是夺取德国技术的机会！！！

column1: Comrade General: This is the opportunity to seize German technology!!!
Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
column2: 将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯分子逐出立陶宛(Lithuania)、并在东普鲁士打开通往德国本土之路的机会！你将指挥波罗的海第1方面军(First Baltic Front)！

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
column2: 南乌克兰集团军群(Army Group Southern Ukraine) (#12) - 1944 年 8 月 7 日

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Russian territory!!! Comrade Stalin wants to destroy Army Group Center once and for all. You will attack in the direction of Minsk. Two tanks and four rifle armies will support you.
column2: 将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯逐出俄国领土的机会！！！斯大林同志要一劳永逸地消灭中央集团军群。你将向明斯克(Minsk)方向进攻。两个坦克集团军和四个步兵集团军将支援你。

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from the Leningrad area! You will command the Second Baltic Front and cross the Narva river destroying Army Group North!
column2: 将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯逐出列宁格勒(Leningrad)地区的机会！你将指挥波罗的海沿岸第2方面军，渡过纳尔瓦河(Narva)，消灭北方集团军群！

column1: Comrade General: Vassiliev has asked for you to direct the attack on the
column2: 将军同志：瓦西里耶夫已要求你指挥对

column1: Comrade General: You had the honour beeing the first Red Army
column2: 将军同志：你有幸成为第一位越过

column1: Comrade General: You have liberated Kiev the Ukrainian capital. We should complete the liberation of the Ukraine and push the Germans from Russian territory!
column2: 将军同志：你解放了乌克兰(Ukraine)首都基辅(Kiev)。我们应当完成乌克兰的解放，把德国人赶出俄国领土！

column1: Comrade General: You have taken Kiev the Ukrainian capital. Your indecision has allowed the Germans to withdraw most of their troops though. Yopu have to do better than that Comrade!
column2: 将军同志：你夺取了乌克兰(Ukraine)首都基辅(Kiev)。然而你的犹豫不决让德国人撤走了大部分部队。同志，你得做得更好才行！

column1: Comrade General: You will command the Second Baltic Front in charge of liberating the city of Riga and most of Latvia!
column2: 将军同志：你将指挥波罗的海沿岸第2方面军，负责解放里加(Riga)城与拉脱维亚(Latvia)大部！

column1: Comrade Kombrig, Comrade Stalin agreed to let you return to the army. You have been freed from the Labor Camp, but don't think the Party has forgotten your Trotzkist deviation. You have been given back your previous rank, but before you start any celebration you have to keep in mind you must vindicate your good name by your actions in the war. The Nazi scumbags stand at the gates of Moscow; however we're preparing counteroffensive to strike them back. You'll serve under Zhukov's command. If you fail, the Hand of our Communist Justice shall grab on you!!!
column2: 旅级指挥员同志，斯大林同志同意让你回到军中。你已从劳动营获释，但别以为党已忘记你的托洛茨基主义偏差。你已被恢复原先的军衔，但在你开始庆祝之前必须记住：你必须以战时的行动来证明你的清白之名。纳粹渣滓正站在莫斯科城下；不过我们正筹备反攻把他们打回去。你将在朱可夫的指挥下服役。如果你失败，我们共产主义正义之手就会抓住你！！！

column1: Comrade Komdiv, the Kharkov is taken, but the situation on our southern flank is critical... Comrade Stalin has ordered to hold the city at all costs, but German tanks can anytime get through our supply lines. Marshal Tiomoshenko has ordered retreat. Maybe you'll manage to get out of the cauldron...
column2: 师长同志，哈尔科夫(Kharkov)已经拿下了，但我们南翼的局势十分危急……斯大林(Stalin)同志命令不惜一切代价守住这座城市，可德军坦克随时可能切断我们的补给线。铁木辛哥(Tiomoshenko)元帅已下令撤退。也许你能设法突出包围圈……

column1: Comrade Komdiv, today at dawn our troops under the command of Zhukov, executing comrade Stalin's order, will attack 3rd Rumanian Army. You are to cut off the German 6th Army in Stalingrad. If you do it well, you'll be promoted.
column2: 师长同志(Komdiv)，今天拂晓，由朱可夫(Zhukov)指挥的我军将执行斯大林同志的命令，进攻罗马尼亚第3集团军(3rd Rumanian Army)。你要切断斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的德国第6集团军。如果你干得好，就会得到晋升。

column1: Comrade Komdiv, today at dawn the Southwestern Front under the command of Marshal Timoshenko, executing Stalin's order, are to start an offensive on the Ukraine. Your task is to liberate Kharkov. Remember, that the workers' class won't forgive you failure. For the support of your attack, you will be given some NKVD special battalions.
column2: 师长同志(Komdiv)，今日拂晓，由铁木辛哥(Timoshenko)元帅指挥的西南方面军将执行斯大林的命令，在乌克兰(Ukraine)发起攻势。你的任务是解放哈尔科夫(Kharkov)。记住，工人阶级不会宽恕你的失败。为支援你的进攻，将拨给你若干内务人民委员部(NKVD)特种营。

column1: Comrade Komdiv, you've been awarded the posthumous Hero of the Soviet Union.
column2: 师级指挥员同志，你已被追授苏联英雄称号。

column1: Comrade Mao has established a "Soviet Commune'' here in the Jinggangshan Mountains.  It is well protected and hidden from our enemies by a heavy wilderness and bamboo trees.  All the access points to our base are under continuous servalance and our Soviet GRU spies report that the Kuomingtan enemies and the Warlords are planning to eradicate us at once.  They are supported by German advisors who think the best way to eliminate us from here is the so-called strategy ''ferocious walls''.  They are blocking our exits by constructing blockhouses.  We will resist their attacks as long as possible.  Mao thinks we will leave here soon and go North which is much closer to the Soviet border.
column2: 毛泽东同志已在井冈山建立了一个"苏维埃公社"。这里被茂密的荒野和竹林掩护，很好地保护着我们，不被敌人发现。我们基地的所有通道都在持续监视之下，我们苏维埃的格鲁乌间谍报告说，国民党敌人和军阀正打算一举消灭我们。他们有德国顾问支持，这些顾问认为把我们赶出这里最好的办法就是所谓的"铁壁"战略。他们正修筑碉堡封锁我们的出路。我们将尽可能长久地抵抗他们的进攻。毛泽东认为我们很快就会离开这里北上，那里离苏联边境近得多。

column1: Comrade Marshal, the instruction from Moscow says: "In case of seeing nuclear mushroom, cover up with white sheet and go to the nearest graveyard"
column2: 元帅同志，莫斯科的指示说：「若见核蘑菇云，请用白床单盖住自己，并前往最近的墓地」

column1: Comrade Marshal, unfortunately you have to stop further attack. The Americans has threatened us with the use of nuclear weapons. Our socialist Motherland can't afford the next war now. Comrade Beria has been given an order to build the Soviet A-bomb in 4 years, or else... Then you'll be able to finish the started cause of liberation the working class of the Europe and the whole world...! For now we're establishing GDR and Warsaw Pact. And for you, for consolation, third Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union, comfortable residence, personal distillery and sturgeon fish-culture for caviar. Hurrrah! Long live the Peace!!! (not for long... ;-))
column2: 元帅同志，遗憾的是你必须停止继续进攻。美国人已威胁要使用核武器。我们社会主义的祖国现在打不起下一场战争。贝利亚(Beria)同志已接到命令，要在 4 年内造出苏联原子弹，否则……到那时你就能完成已开始的解放欧洲及全世界工人阶级的事业……！目前我们正在建立东德(GDR)与华沙条约组织(Warsaw Pact)。而对你，作为安慰，苏联英雄第三颗星、舒适的宅邸、私人酿酒坊，还有为鱼子酱而养的鲟鱼。乌拉！和平万岁！！！（不会太久…… ;-)）

column1: Comrade Marshal, we've beaten these Nazi pigs, but their capitalistic allies still endanger our Motherland and tyrannize the Europe's working class! We still must fight for their liberation!
column2: 元帅同志，我们打败了这些纳粹猪猡，但他们的资本主义盟友仍在威胁我们的祖国，仍在奴役欧洲的工人阶级！我们仍必须为解放他们而战！

column1: Comrade Marshal, you have to stop your attack! The Yanks has threatened us with use of nuclear bomb! We have to withdraw and wait for better time to complete the liberation of the Europe.
column2: 元帅同志，你必须停止进攻！美国佬威胁要使用核弹！我们必须撤退，等待更好的时机来完成解放欧洲的事业。

column1: Comrade Stalin has ordered you to destroy with sudden assault the forces of capitalist-fascist US' regime in middle Germany - then you'll liberate the Rühr and march towards Paris!
column2: 斯大林同志命令你以突袭歼灭德国中部资本主义法西斯美国政权的部队——之后你将解放鲁尔(Rühr)，并向巴黎(Paris)进军！

column1: Comrade Stalin wants to capture many scientists as possible. You will
column2: 斯大林同志想尽可能多地俘获科学家。你将

column1: Comrade Stalin wants to invade Great Britain.
column2: 斯大林同志想入侵大不列颠(Great Britain)。

column1: Comrade your job in the last battle was brillant, and Comrade Stalin has decided to begin a risked plan to invade America and he trusts you as his main leader to execute this operation.
column2: 同志，你在上一场战斗中的表现非常出色，斯大林同志已决定启动一项冒险的入侵美国计划，他信任你，要你作为主将执行这次作战。

column1: Comrade! The imperialists have landed at Gela on the southern coast of Sicily, trying to split our forces on the island in two. You are the nearest commander with available troops: seal off the beachhead and hurl them back into the sea before their armor comes ashore.
column2: 同志！帝国主义者在西西里岛(Sicily)南岸的杰拉(Gela)地域登陆，企图把我在岛集团切成两段。你是就近唯一握有可用部队的指挥员：封锁滩头阵地，趁敌装甲兵力尚未上岸，把他们赶回大海。

column1: Comrade! we have a critical situation! we've been removed a large amount of equipment from Italy without realizing that the allies were preparing a massive counter-attack.
column2: 同志！我们的处境十分危急！我们在没有意识到盟军正筹备大规模反击的情况下，从意大利撤走了大量装备。

column1: Comrade! Your task is to prevent Germans from stopping our offensive at the temporary positions at Mozhaisk.
column2: 同志！你的任务是阻止德军在莫扎伊斯克(Mozhaisk)的临时阵地上挡住我们的攻势。

column1: Comrade, a proper socialist goverment has been established in Finland after our victory. Our campaign over Scandinavia must continue just now in Norway, before the allies can put a foot on Scandinavia. We have reports that the remaining Germans on Norway are helping the allies to build up a defense line against us, it would be a pleasure to destroy them once more.
column2: 同志，我们胜利之后，芬兰已建立起一个合适的社会主义政府。我们在斯堪的纳维亚(Scandinavia)的战役必须马上在挪威(Norway)继续，趁盟军还没能在斯堪的纳维亚落脚。我们有报告说，挪威境内残余的德国人正在帮助盟军建立对抗我们的防线，能再消灭他们一次将是一件乐事。

column1: Comrade, after our first victory in the Aleoutians, we have received some informations from our spies on the Military base in Dutch Harbour (Alaska): the Yankees aided by some German scientists, are designing a horrible weapon, capable to reach our motherland on one shot. STAVKA has marked the possible zone where the weapon is hidden by the Yankees. Our spies are a group of guards, dissidents from the capitalist system. You can identify him by his grey mark. STAVKA will be pleased if you save him, because the enemies have discovered that they are sending us informations. We don't know if the weapon is ready for shot... be aware.
column2: 同志，在阿留申群岛(Aleoutians)取得首次胜利之后，我们从间谍那里收到一些关于荷兰港(Dutch Harbour)（阿拉斯加(Alaska)）军事基地的情报：美国佬在一些德国科学家的协助下，正在设计一种可怕的武器，能够一发打到我们的祖国。最高统帅部已标出美国佬藏匿这件武器的可能区域。我们的间谍是一群卫兵，是资本主义制度的异见者。你可以凭他的灰色标记认出他。如果你能救他，最高统帅部会很高兴，因为敌人已经发现他们在给我们送情报。我们不知道这件武器是否已能发射……要当心。

column1: Comrade, after the conquest of France, we couldn't forget Spain, which is an important strategical point, but is an very important political objective. The illegal goverment has been established after the criminal war started in 1936 by the fascists with "counselors" sent by Germany which aimed at destroying our motherland. Our mission here is to conquer this important way to the Mediterranean sea and to liberate Spain from the fascism. Good Luck, comrade.
column2: 同志，在征服法国之后，我们不能忘记西班牙，它是一个重要的战略据点，更是一个极为重要的政治目标。那个非法政府是在 1936 年法西斯分子在德国派来的「顾问」帮助下发动罪恶战争之后建立起来的，其目的就是摧毁我们的祖国。我们在这里的任务是征服这条通往地中海(Mediterranean sea)的重要通道，把西班牙从法西斯主义下解放出来。祝好运，同志。

column1: Comrade, due to your excellent job, you will be asked for your next assignment.
column2: 同志，由于你干得出色，将会有人来问你的下一个任务。

column1: Comrade, here there are the Americans, I know that wasn´t easy to escape from their hands, but beyond the river, we have a heavy defense line.
column2: 同志，美国人到这里了，我知道从他们手里逃出来不容易，但河对岸我们有一道坚固的防线。

column1: Comrade, it was an expected defeat, but I want to ask you that don't give up and get back with the large amount of equipment as possible to build a more solid defense.
column2: 同志，这场失败本在意料之中，但我要要求你不要放弃，尽可能带回大量装备，以建立更稳固的防御。

column1: Comrade, our victories have blinded us from the Allies plans of an invasion from the east.
column2: 同志，我们的胜利让我们看不见盟军从东面入侵的计划。

column1: Comrade, Stavka has made a campaign over the Scandinavian peninsula to destroy all possible threats that might arise by crossing Norway and Finland. After your success in Germany and Austria, you must cross the boundary with Finland to save Leningrad and Murmansk against any future allied attacks. Comrade, Stalin and the Party expect that one more time you'll get the victory.
column2: 同志，最高统帅部已发起一场跨越斯堪的纳维亚半岛(Scandinavian peninsula)的战役，以消除穿越挪威(Norway)与芬兰(Finland)可能产生的一切威胁。在德国与奥地利(Austria)取得成功之后，你必须越过与芬兰的边界，以保护列宁格勒(Leningrad)与摩尔曼斯克(Murmansk)免遭未来任何盟军进攻。同志，斯大林与党期望你再一次取得胜利。

column1: Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.
column2: 同志，多亏伟大的斯大林的领导，你的部队把德国陆军从莫斯科城下击退，但这只是开始。我们仍认为你该被送回古拉格，但朱可夫对你评价不错，所以你会再得到一次机会。应他的请求，你已被晋升为师级指挥员，但我们政治部会盯着你。

column1: Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinoion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.
column2: 同志，多亏伟大的斯大林的领导，你的部队把德国陆军从莫斯科(Moscow)城下击退，但这只是开始。我们仍认为你该被送回古拉格(Gulag)，但朱可夫对你评价不错，所以你会再得到一次机会。应他的请求，你已被晋升为师级指挥员，但我们政治部会盯着你。

column1: Comrade, the war continues to be well, we are showing the world that the socialist system is most advancend than the corrupted capitalist system. One more time, our spies from the NKVD are giving us important informations; the British are disembarking a big number of troops in the Low Countries and in some areas of France, they have the help from the remaining German troops in those zones, one more time. It's highly important that the allies do not establish a beachhead on the Low Countries. Good Luck, comrade.
column2: 同志，战争继续顺利进展，我们正向世界展示社会主义制度比腐败的资本主义制度更先进。我们的内务人民委员部(NKVD)间谍又一次给我们送来重要情报：英国人正在低地国家以及法国一些地区让大量部队登陆，而且他们又一次得到了那些地区残余德军的帮助。极为重要的是，不能让盟军在低地国家建立桥头堡。祝好运，同志。

column1: Comrade, things back to normal in Moscow, and the allies propose us a decent peace agreement if we give them Stalin... After all, Stalin isn´t the brillant leader that we´ve thought.
column2: 同志，莫斯科(Moscow)的局势恢复正常了，如果我们把斯大林交给他们，盟军就愿意给我们一份体面的和平协议……毕竟，斯大林并不像我们以为的那样是位英明领袖。

column1: Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe!
column2: 同志，这场辉煌的胜利之所以取得，是因为共产主义对纳粹主义的优越。现在我们要追击这些渣滓直到柏林(Berlin)，解放全欧洲的劳动人民！

column1: Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe! In appreciation to your merits you've been promoted to General of Tank Troops. Hail the Soviet Union!
column2: 同志，这一辉煌胜利的取得，是因为共产主义优于纳粹主义。现在我们要把这些渣滓追到柏林，解放整个欧洲的劳动人民！为表彰你的功绩，你已被晋升为坦克兵上将。苏联万岁！

column1: Comrade, this is the last stand in Tokyo. The enemy is regrouping his troops in the Japanese capital, Tokyo. The main Japanese island is enclosed by our submarines, the yankees only can receive reinforcements from the south. This will be the final blow for the Americans in Japan.
column2: 同志，这是东京(Tokyo)的最后抵抗。敌人正在日本首都东京重新集结部队。日本主岛已被我们的潜艇封锁，美国佬只能从南面获得增援。这将是给在日本的美国人的最后一击。

column1: Comrade, this is the last step to conquer Romans's Motherland. We've watched some allied ships approaching, so submarines and extra reinforcements are on the way.
column2: 同志，这是征服罗马人祖国的最后一步。我们已看到一些盟军船只正在接近，所以潜艇与额外增援正在途中。

column1: Comrade, we have a hard situation, the allies surround Moscow and Stalin won´t escape.
column2: 同志，我们的处境艰难，盟军包围了莫斯科(Moscow)，斯大林逃不掉了。

column1: Comrade, we have information that the "allies" are moving equipment in order to surround us in Germany.
column2: 同志，我们得到情报，「盟国」正在调动装备，以便在德国包围我们。

column1: Comrade, we have put the Allies in a corner against the coast, now we have to hurry up to avoid the mistake that the Nazis made.
column2: 同志，我们已把盟军逼到海岸边的一个角落里，现在我们得加快行动，以免犯下纳粹犯过的错误。

column1: Comrade, you have begun the invasion of France, your goal is to take the fortified city of Metz.
column2: 同志，你已开始入侵法国，你的目标是夺取设防城市梅斯(Metz)。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the British path.
column2: 同志，你选择了英国路线。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the French path.
column2: 同志，你选择了法国路线。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the Italian path.
column2: 同志，你选择了意大利的道路。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the Spanish path.
column2: 同志，你选择了西班牙路线。

column1: Comrade, your counterattack has sent the enemy reeling, but, at the same time your men have suffered severe losses.  Nevertheless, the Red Army now holds the initiative.  It is the beginning of the end of the fascists. Comrade, to the west!
column2: 同志，你的反击把敌人打得踉跄后退；但与此同时，你的部下也遭受了严重损失。尽管如此，红军现在掌握了主动权。这是法西斯覆灭的开端。同志，向西！

column1: Comrade, your counterattack has sent the enemy reeling, but, at the same time your men have suffered severe losses.  Nevertheless, the Red Army now holds the initiative.  It is the beginning of the end of the fascists. Comrade, to the west!
Comrade... all the socialist world is celebrating this victory... without any enemy in the Pacific, we'll use Los Angeles as a base for the invasion of the remaining US states...
column2: 同志……整个社会主义世界都在庆祝这场胜利……太平洋上再无敌人，我们将把洛杉矶(Los Angeles)作为入侵美国其余各州的基地……

column2: 苏联与西方盟国之间的冲突在
恭喜你，指挥官，那真是出色。

column1: Congratulations comrade!  Korea is now entirely unified under the communist flag, and Kim-Il-Sung has been proclaimed chairman of the People's Republic of Korea at Seoul. This is an enormous victory for the communist world, there have also been celebrations at other communist capitals like Moscow, East-Berlin, and of course Beijing.
column2: 祝贺你，同志！朝鲜现在已完全统一在共产主义旗帜之下，金日成已在汉城宣告就任朝鲜人民共和国主席。这是共产主义世界的巨大胜利，莫斯科、东柏林，当然还有北京等其他共产主义国家首都也举行了庆祝活动。

column1: Congratulations comrade!  You are the new Premier of the People's Republic of China. Mao has disappeared and we know he won't be back, hahaha!  I hope your understanding of the communist doctrine will be the correct one.  That would be the best for the communist world.
column2: 祝贺你，同志！你是中华人民共和国的新总理。毛已经消失，我们知道他不会再回来了，哈哈哈！我希望你对共产主义学说的理解会是正确的那一种。那对共产主义世界来说是最好的。

column1: Congratulations Comrade, Italy has surrendered to us and there's only
column2: 恭喜你，同志，意大利已向我们投降，只剩下

column1: Congratulations General, that was well done.
Congratulations General.  The enemy commander, Percival is now at the negotiation table but the only choice he has is "unconditional surrender!"
column2: 恭喜您，将军。敌军指挥官帕西瓦尔如今坐到了谈判桌前，但他唯一的选择就是“无条件投降！”

column1: Congratulations General. Our beach heads in the northern islands of the Philippines are secured, and the Rising Sun flag will rise in Manila soon. Those Philippinos and Americans are no match for our brave soldiers.
column2: 恭喜您，将军。我们在菲律宾北部诸岛的滩头阵地已稳固，旭日旗很快将升上马尼拉。那些菲律宾人和美国人根本不是我们勇敢士兵的对手。

column1: Congratulations General. The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
column2: 恭喜您，将军。藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

column1: Congratulations Herr Feldmarshal!!, High Command have prommoted you due to your good actions in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place. The reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. On the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objetive is to make a fast assault from the South, like at Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastest units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
column2: 祝贺您，元帅！鉴于您过去的出色表现，最高统帅部已提升您的军衔。现在，下一个目标应当是马特鲁港地区。敌人正试图在此地再建一道防线。报告显示，这次敌军防线比加扎拉要薄弱。另一方面，敌军兵力更多，肯定又会超过我军。任务目标是从南面发起快速突击，如同在加扎拉那样，用我们最快的部队打敌人一个措手不及，最后突击马特鲁港要塞。

column1: Congratulations Herr Feldsmarschall!!, the high command have promoted you due to your good results in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place, anyway the reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. In the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objective is to make a fast assault from the South, like in Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastests units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
column2: 恭喜，元帅阁下！！由于你过去的良好战果，最高统帅部已晋升你。现在，下一个目标应是马特鲁港(Mersa Matruh)地区。敌人正试图在这里建立又一道防线，不过报告表明这次敌人的防线比加扎拉(Gazala)薄弱。另一方面，敌军兵力更大，肯定会再次在数量上超过我们。任务目标是从南面发起快速突击，如同在加扎拉那样，以我们最快的部队让敌人措手不及，最后突击马特鲁港的设防要点。

column1: Congratulations Herr General your victory here has stopped the Americans. Our African Army can now be evacuated to defend Southern Europe.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下，你在这里的胜利挡住了美国人。我们的非洲集团军现在可以撤出，去保卫南欧了。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. The American beachhead has been annihilated. Unfortunately the British and Canadians have broken through our lines near Caen. This has forced us to retreat in order to escape from getting surrounded. Our retreat allowed US forces that remained in the Cherbourg area to outflank us in the Coutance area. Your mission is to push West to the shore in order to restore the front line and cut off the US divisions that have broken through.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。美军滩头阵地已被肃清。遗憾的是，英军和加军在卡昂附近突破了我军防线，迫使我们后撤以免被合围。我军的后撤又让留在瑟堡地区的美军得以在库唐斯一带迂回到我们侧后。你的任务是向西推进到海岸，以恢复战线并切断已突破的美军各师。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. With Yelnya captured, the next stop is Moscow!
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。叶利尼亚既已拿下，下一站就是莫斯科！

column1: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the first Russian defensive lines. This has however taken far more time than expected.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。你突破了俄军的第一道防线。但这花的时间远超预期。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the Russian defenses and have ran into and beaten the lead elements of the 5th Guards Tank Army. Next stop on the way to Kursk is the village of Prokhorovka.
column2: 恭喜你，将军阁下。你已突破俄军防线，并撞上并击退了近卫第5坦克集团军的先头部队。通往库尔斯克的下一站是普罗霍夫卡村。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the Russian defenses and have ran into and crushed the lead elements of the 5th Guards Tank Army. Next stop on the way to Kursk is the village of Prokhorovka.
column2: 恭喜你，将军阁下。你已突破俄军防线，并撞上并粉碎了近卫第5坦克集团军的先头部队。通往库尔斯克(Kursk)的下一站是普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)村。

column1: Congratulations on your capture of Vyborg. The Finns have sued for peace, but they have declared neutrality and will maintain their archaic capitalist system.  And now, if you will excuse me, I have work to do.
column2: 恭喜你夺取维堡(Vyborg)。芬兰人已求和，但他们宣布中立，并将维持其陈旧的资本主义制度。那么现在，恕我失陪，我还有工作要做。

column1: Congratulations on your promotion to commander of our reciently created People's Liberation Army!. Your actions were enough to support your upgrade decided in the ChCP council... Mao Zedong it's also pleased with you as PLA's general.
column2: 祝贺你晋升为我们新近组建的中国人民解放军指挥员！你的表现足以支撑中共中央委员会决定给你这次提拔...毛泽东对作为解放军将领的你也很满意。

column1: Congratulations on your Regiment's success!! We have protected the beach-head and also cleared up a significant pocket of resistance. Well done!
column2: 恭喜你的团取得成功！！我们守住了滩头阵地，还肃清了一个不小的抵抗包围圈。干得好！

column1: Congratulations on your successful escape from Finland, Herr General.  Rapid developments over the past few months have caused the General Staff to forget your failure there.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 恭喜你从芬兰成功脱身，将军阁下。过去数月形势的迅速发展，使总参谋部淡忘了你在那里的失败。你得到了最后一次机会——在我们入侵法国中扮演重要角色。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

column1: Congratulations on your victory.   Myself, together with Mao and our Komintern advisor Li-De (Otto Braun) are planning the evacuation of Jinggangshan.  We will do it quickly while the KMT troops are busy dealing with the Japanese in Manchuria.
column2: 祝贺你的胜利。我本人将同毛以及我们的共产国际顾问李德（奥托·布劳恩）一起筹划井冈山的撤离。我们会在国民党军队忙于在满洲对付日本人时迅速行动。

column1: Congratulations to you and your men Bob!! The northern front line has been held and we are in a good position to strike a blow to the heart of the Third Reich.
column2: 祝贺你和你的部下，鲍勃！！北面战线已守住，我们处于有利态势，可以向第三帝国的心脏挥出一击。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  All of Austria is now open to attack. The Third Reich is sure to fall soon.
column2: 祝贺你！出色的表现。现在整个奥地利(Austria)都已敞开可供进攻。第三帝国必定很快垮台。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  All of Austria is now open to attack. The Third Reich is sure to fall soon. Unfortunately Soviet troops will soon occupy Vienna, we have to meet Agreements decided in Yalta.
column2: 恭喜！出色的表现。整个奥地利(Austria)现在都对进攻敞开了。第三帝国必定很快覆灭。遗憾的是苏军很快将占领维也纳(Vienna)，我们必须遵守在雅尔塔(Yalta)达成的协议。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will be remembered as a great German victory.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
column2: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占将被铭记为德国的一场伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will rank with Tannenberg and Koniggratz as great German victories.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
column2: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占，将与坦能堡和克尼格雷茨并列为德国的伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

column1: Congratulations!  The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet. Herr General, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
column2: 恭喜！总参谋部对你的表现十分满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。将军阁下，你超出了所有的预期。你对战争艺术的掌握持续令我们的敌人沮丧。

column1: Congratulations!  Winston is pleased by your performance.  The capture of Sicily is almost assured. Commander, you have exceeded all expectations.
column2: 祝贺你！温斯顿对你的表现很满意。夺取西西里几乎已成定局。指挥官，你超出了所有人的期望。

column1: Congratulations!  Winston is pleased by your performance.  The capture of Sicily is almost assured. Commander, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
column2: 祝贺你！温斯顿(Winston)对你的表现很满意。夺取西西里(Sicily)几乎已成定局。指挥官，你超出了所有人的期望。你对战争艺术的精通不断令我们的敌人沮丧。

column1: Congratulations! It was the Waffen SS that captured Belgrade and not Heer troops. One of your SS patrols entered the city center and has hoisted the Nazi flag atop the German legation. About two hours later the mayor of Belgrade officially handed over the city to Obersturmfuehrer Klingenberg who was accompanied by a representative of the German Foreign Ministry, previously interned by the Yugoslavs.
column2: 恭喜！拿下贝尔格莱德的是武装党卫军，而非陆军部队。你的一个党卫军巡逻队进入市中心，在德国公使馆顶上升起了纳粹旗。约两小时后，贝尔格莱德市长把城市正式移交给了党卫军上级突击队领袖克林根贝格，陪同他的是一位此前被南斯拉夫人扣留的德国外交部代表。

column1: Congratulations! Now you return to a grateful nation a here!
column2: 恭喜！现在你回到一个心存感激的国家，成为一名英雄！

column1: Congratulations! One of your SS patrols entered the city center and has hoisted the Nazi flag atop the German legation. About two hours later the mayor of Belgrade officially handed over the city to Obersturmfuehrer Klingenberg who was accompanied by a representative of the German Foreign Ministry, previously interned by the Yugoslavs.
column2: 恭喜！你的一个党卫军巡逻队进入市中心，在德国公使馆顶上升起了纳粹旗。约两小时后，贝尔格莱德市长把城市正式移交给了党卫军上级突击队领袖克林根贝格，陪同他的是一位此前被南斯拉夫人扣留的德国外交部代表。

column1: Congratulations! Thanks to your defence and your counterattack the German attack has been stopped and most of the terrain previously lost has been regained.
column2: 祝贺！由于您的防御和反击，德军的进攻已被阻止，先前失去的大部分土地均已夺回。

column1: Congratulations! Thanks to your defence the German attack has been stopped and they have only be able to create some small bridgeheads not suitable for any further immediate action.
column2: 祝贺！由于您的防御，德军的进攻已被阻止，他们只建立了几个小桥头堡，不足以立即采取进一步行动。

column1: Congratulations! Thanks to your stubborn defence and your brave counterattack the German attack has been repelled and all terrain previously lost has been regained.
column2: 祝贺！由于您的顽强防御和英勇反击，德军的进攻已被击退，先前失去的全部土地均已夺回。

column1: Congratulations! The manoeuvres have been a complete success. You have proved the value of motorized forces.
column2: 祝贺！演习取得了圆满成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值。

column1: Congratulations! The manoeuvres have been a success. You have proved the value of motorized forces.
column2: 祝贺！演习取得了成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值。

column1: Congratulations! Your troops stormed the city in a charge that Henry V would admire!  Your victory at Metz shall stand alongside the great battles of Agincourt and Cressy.  I have heard your name mentioned several times in relation to some promotion or advancement.  Commander, your successful offensive has paved the way to our invasion of the "fatherland."
column2: 恭喜！你的部队以一场亨利五世(Henry V)都会钦佩的冲锋攻下了该城！你在梅斯(Metz)的胜利将与阿让库尔(Agincourt)和克雷西(Cressy)的伟大战役并列。我已多次听到你的名字与某些晋升或提拔联系在一起。指挥官，你成功的攻势为我们入侵「祖国」铺平了道路。

column1: Congratulations!, all the British Army units have been erased from the map on this area. Now, we can start the refurbishment of the port in order to install here our Field Head Quarters, and start to receiving reinforcements from the Continental soil. Good work.
column2: 恭喜！这一地区所有英国陆军部队都已从地图上被抹去。现在我们可以开始整修港口，以便在此设立我们的野战司令部，并开始接收来自欧洲大陆的增援。干得好。

column1: Congratulations!, Changchun, Jilin and Siping have been captured. This will be a big problem for the Nationalists, since their communications by train or by road from Manchuria to Beijing are now stopped.
column2: 祝贺！长春、吉林和四平已被攻占。这对国民政府将是个大麻烦，因为他们从满洲到北平的铁路和公路交通现在已被切断。

column1: Congratulations, 600,000 Bolsjeviks are trapped in the Kiev pocket!
column2: 祝贺你，60万布尔什维克被困在基辅包围圈里！

column1: Congratulations, commander!  You have saved our nation. I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.
column2: 恭喜你，指挥官！你拯救了我们的国家。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我国最伟大的英雄们一同被铭记。

column1: Congratulations, Commander.  Your capture of Pantelleria has opened the way to Sicily. Now we will attack the enemy in his homeland!
column2: 恭喜，指挥官。你夺取潘泰莱里亚(Pantelleria)打开了通往西西里(Sicily)的道路。现在我们要在敌人的本土进攻他们了！

column1: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.  I salute you, Herr General!
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。我向你致敬，将军阁下！

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your aggressive leadership has shattered the British forces. Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk, before the English can prepare an effective defense.
column2: 祝贺你，将军阁下。你果断的领导已经击溃了英军。现在，我们必须赶在英国人做好有效防御之前，攻占托布鲁克港。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is the pride of Germany!  Rather than waste your forces further, we are moving your army to the east for rest and refitting.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的装甲军是德国的骄傲！与其继续消耗你的部队，我们不如把你的集团军调往东线休整与整补。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is the pride of Germany!  Rather than waste your forces further, we are moving your army to the east for rest and refitting.
column2: 市场花园行动 第二阶段

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men.  Bravo.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的部队成功打通了通往第6集团军战友们的走廊。我们将能够继续向勇敢的士兵们输送增援和补给。干得漂亮。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General. Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men. Bravo.
column2: 祝贺你，将军阁下。你的部队已成功为第6集团军的同志们打开一条走廊。我们将能继续向这些勇士输送援军和补给。好样的。

column1: Congratulations, once more time you've demonstrated your skills.
column2: 恭喜，你又一次展示了你的本领。

column1: Congratulations, the great British empire is in ruins, the battles were hard but we are victorious.
column2: 恭喜，大英帝国已成废墟，战斗艰苦，但我们胜利了。

column1: Congratulations, the way to the South is open.  The North Americans have received a stinging lesson on the power of the People's War.
column2: 祝贺你，南下的大门已经打开。北美人在人民战争的力量面前受到了惨痛的教训。

column1: Congratulations, with your leadership, our troops have erased all British presence here!. The other side of the river is secured, and now we can continue with our journey to Bristol. Good Work again, General.
column2: 恭喜，在你的领导之下，我军已抹去了此地英军的一切存在！河对岸已经确保，现在我们可以继续向布里斯托尔(Bristol)进军了。再次干得好，将军。

column1: Congratulations, with your leadership, our troops have erased all British presence here!. The other side of the river is secured, and now we can continue with our journey to Bristol. Good Work again, General.
Congratulations, you have successfully crossed the Dniepr and have penetrated the Russian defenses. Gather your forces for the drive on Smolensk.
column2: 恭喜，你已成功渡过第聂伯河并突入俄军防线。集结你的部队，向斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)推进。

column1: Congratulations, you have successfully crossed the Dniepr. Gather your forces for the drive on Smolensk.
column2: 恭喜，你成功渡过了第聂伯河(Dniepr)。集结你的部队，向斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)推进。

column1: Congratulations. Most troops were able to get out of the Falaise pocket. Retreat east to form a new line of defense.
column2: 恭喜。大部分部队得以逃出法莱斯包围圈。向东撤退，建立新防线。

column1: Congratulations. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
column2: 恭喜。比利时国王已投降，英军正撤向敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)港。德国空军(Luftwaffe)可以继续负责消灭被围的部队。把你的部队东调，解决马奇诺防线(Maginot line)的守备部队。

column1: Congratuliatons General, advance into Burma with all speed!!
column2: 恭喜将军，请全速进军缅甸！！

column1: Congratuliatons General, the entire 17th Indian Division was practically destroyed.  The road to Rangoon is clear!.
column2: 恭喜将军，英印第17师几乎全军覆没。通往仰光的道路已畅通无阻！
康涅狄格州空军国民警卫队
康涅狄格州国民警卫队装甲部队

column1: Contains most of the East Front battles, from Moscow counteroffensive to the capture of Berlin.
column2: 包含东线大部分战役，从莫斯科反攻到攻克柏林。

column1: Contrary to our initial plans, Généralissime Gamelin has placed Leuven/Louvain in the area of the II British Corps and its 3 Infantry Division has already taken positions in this city, forcing to move northwards our 5th "Division d'Infanterie". Unfortunately also the German green devils have landed at Bona, and they will attack immediately to regain control of the airport. Your task is to reach at top gear Bona to support the British paratroops and seize all the remaining objectives while the Axis reinforcements are moving against you.

column1: First contact with British troops was made north of Vevi at 11:00 on 10 April. An intercepted radio message indicated that the British command was surprised by the swiftness of the Leibstandarte's thrust and gave orders for immediate withdrawal from the Vermion Position. The SS troops seized Vevi on 11 April, but were stopped a short distance south of that town, where strong Australian forces held the dominating heights overlooking the pass road. During the next day the Leibstandarte reconnoitered the enemy positions and at dusk launched a frontal attack against the pass. After heavy fighting the Leibstandarte overcame the enemy resistance and broke through the defile.
column2: 4 月 10 日 11:00，在韦维(Vevi)以北首次与英军接触。一份截获的无线电报文显示，英军统帅部对警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)突击之迅速感到意外，随即下令立即从韦尔米翁(Vermion)阵地撤退。党卫军部队于 4 月 11 日夺取韦维，但在该镇以南不远处被挡住——强大的澳军控制了俯瞰隘路的高地。次日，警卫旗队侦察了敌军阵地，并在黄昏对山口发起正面进攻。经过激战，警卫旗队压倒了敌军抵抗，突破隘口。

column1: Following the air raid, on the 13th of May, the Leibstandarte advanced through Rotterdam and was involved in an incident which drew heavy criticism from the army.  After spotting Dutch soldiers loitering outside a building, soldiers of the LSSAH opened fire.  Inside that building Dutch and German officers were negotiating a surrender.  One of the German officers inside was Airborne Commander Karl Student, who was severely wounded by the assault.
column2: 空袭之后，5 月 13 日，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)穿过鹿特丹(Rotterdam)推进，并卷入了一起招致陆军严厉批评的事件。在发现荷兰士兵在一栋建筑外闲荡之后，警卫旗队(LSSAH)的士兵开了火。当时那栋建筑里，荷兰与德国军官正在谈判投降事宜。楼内的德国军官之一、空降兵指挥官卡尔·施图登特(Karl Student)在这次突击中身负重伤。

You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure.

column1: For the rescue attempt von Manstein concentrated most of his tank strength in the 46th and 3rd Panzer Corps, and attached Leibstandarte to the latter.  On 11th February the breakout began, with Leibstandarte attacking on the northern flank with the 1st, 17th and 16th Panzer Divisions assaulting to the south.  Conditions could not have been worse with thick fog and hevaily bogged roads rendering rapid movement impossible.  Zhukov threw in the 5th Guards Tank Army to counter the German thrust and halted the Northern flank when it was barely eight miles from the trapped pocket.  Realising that the link-up he envisaged had failed, Hitler consented to a break-out attempt on 16th February, and that night a slow-moving column formed.  Leaving behind the wounded and most of their equipment, 35,000 men began moving toward 3rd Panzer Corps positions.  Men, of the Leibstandarte, covering the retreat, showed considerable bravery.  In one documentated incident, two NCO's of the 2nd Panzergrenadier Regiment held off two companies of Soviet troops before they could be relieved.  In all 32,000 troops had escaped, half of the forces that had been initially trapped.
column2: 为这次救援行动，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)把他大部分坦克兵力集中在第46与第3装甲军，并把警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)配属给后者。2 月 11 日突围开始，警卫旗队在北翼进攻，第1、第17与第16装甲师则向南突击。条件再糟不过：浓雾与严重泥泞的道路使快速运动成为不可能。朱可夫(Zhukov)投入近卫第5坦克集团军来对抗德军突击，在北翼距离被围包围圈仅 8 英里时将其阻止。希特勒意识到他所设想的会合已经失败，便于 2 月 16 日同意尝试突围，当晚一支缓慢行进的纵队编成。留下伤员与大部分装备后，35,000 人开始向第3装甲军阵地移动。负责掩护撤退的警卫旗队官兵表现出相当的勇气。在一份有记载的事例中，第2装甲掷弹兵团的两名军士在得到接应之前挡住了苏军两个连。总共 32,000 名官兵逃脱，是当初被围兵力的一半。

column1: For the very first time Russians cross the German border.
column2: 俄军第一次越过德国边界。

column1: For well over two years, the German High Command had known that the Allies would eventually try to land somewhere in France. The day is now.
column2: 两年多来，德军最高统帅部一直知道盟军终究会试图在法国某处登陆。这一天到了。

column1: For your outstanding achievment they are going to once again give you the opportunity to achieve greatness. You must take the city of Vitebsk no later than July 9th. Good luck Commander.
column2: 由于你的杰出成就，他们将再次给你建功立业的机会。你必须在 7 月 9 日前夺取维捷布斯克城。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Fortunately your failure here did not influence the outcome of this campaign. France surrenders! We accomplished in 6 weeks what could not be done in 4 years 25 years earlier. German troops will parade on the Champs Elysees.
column2: 所幸你在此处的失利没有影响本战役的结局。法国投降了！我们在6周内完成了25年前4年都没能做到的事。德军将在香榭丽舍大道上阅兵。

column1: Four long days has passed since the first wave. Our troops at Dover are constantly attacked by the British counterattacks. This is a very important moment, our troops in the north had more lucky and can advance more easily. The situation in the channel is the following: our ships came back, we are going to lauch the second attack with more heavy equipment so that we could disembark at Dover Port. Our miners had placed submarines mines in the channel, our bombers in Norway weren't successful.
column2: 自第一波登陆以来，漫长的四天已经过去。我们在多佛(Dover)的部队不断遭到英军反击。这是非常重要的时刻，我们在北面的部队运气更好，推进更为容易。海峡中的局势如下：我们的舰船已经返回，我们将以更多重型装备发起第二次进攻，以便能在多佛港登陆。我们的布雷部队已在海峡布设潜艇水雷，我们在挪威(Norway)的轰炸机却没有成功。

column1: France is falling in front of us. We have broken the country in two, and practically the victory couldn't resist us, however one more time the Allies are sending their troops in a stupid attempt to stop us... One more time, the socialism will give them a lesson leading to the conquest of France.
column2: 法国正在我们面前倒下。我们已把这个国家一分为二，胜利几乎不可能抗拒我们，然而盟军又一次把他们的部队派来，愚蠢地试图阻止我们……社会主义将再一次给他们一个教训，导向对法国的征服。
法国北部 - 1940 年 5 月 15 日

column1: France surrenders! We accomplished in 6 weeks what could not be done in 4 years 25 years earlier. German troops will parade on the Champs Elysees.
column2: 法国投降了！我们用6周完成了25年前4年都没做到的事。德军将在香榭丽舍大街上阅兵。
法国第7集团军向北推进 - 1940 年 5 月 15 日

column1: French forces are still active in the Netherlands. You will spend the coming weeks mopping up pockets of French resistance. It are other forces that will continue the drive into Belgium and France.
column2: 法军仍在荷兰活动。接下来几周你将用于清剿法军的抵抗据点。继续向比利时和法国推进的将是其他部队。

column1: French light troops are also expected to intervene to delay Germans and give time to their 9th and 2nd Armies to move to their positions in the Meuse River. Be open to cooperate with our French allies but your priority is to execute our retreat plans and remember ... you only receive orders from the Belgian command!
column2: 预计法国轻装部队也会介入，以迟滞德军，并为其第9和第2集团军争取时间进入默兹河一线的阵地。可以与本国的法国盟友合作，但你的首要任务是执行我们的撤退计划，记住……你只接受比利时司令部的命令！

column1: From now on, you will be in defensive position.
column2: 从现在起，你将处于防御态势。

column1: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
column2: 从现在起，您将转入防御。

column1: From the beginning their were a lot of doubts about operation Zitadelle. At first we delayed it for a few weeks in order to solve some of the mechanical problems our new tanks suffered. Then we heard of the great success of our forces in Sicily and decided to call the operation off, and decided to send some of the Panzer divisions against the offensive the Russians started in the south on July 17.
column2: 从一开始，人们对"堡垒"行动就疑虑重重。起初我们为排除新式坦克的某些机械故障而将其推迟了数周。随后我们得知我军在西西里大获成功，于是决定取消该行动，并决定抽调部分装甲师去对付俄军7月17日在南线发起的攻势。

column1: from the main lines. Give up your offensive and retreat back east to avoid being surrounded.
column2: 与主力的联系。放弃攻势，向东撤退，以免被合围。

column1: from your counter-attack behind their lines. Keep it coming Commander.
column2: 反击而踉跄后退。继续干，指挥官。

column1: G2 has a rumor that Stalin is so concerned with our efforts here that he's
column2: 情报部门(G2)有传言说，斯大林对我们的行动如此忧心，以致

column1: G2 has identified a weak spot on the Russian flank that I want you to
column2: 情报部门(G2)已在俄军侧翼发现一处弱点，我要你

column1: G2 reports two whole fronts on the move towards Khabarovsk.
column2: G2 报告，整整两个方面军正在向哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)开进。

column1: gained some experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new
column2: 在这场新型战争中获得了一些经验。此外，新的

column1: gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the
column2: 在这场新型战争中获得了宝贵的经验。此外，

column1: Gather whatever tanks you have and engage the Bolshevik hords.
column2: 集结你手头所有的坦克，迎击布尔什维克的坦克洪流。
杰拉(Gela) - 1945 年 10 月 25 日

column1: General Feld-Marschall Von Manstein is organizing a counterattack to relieve the German 6th Army. You have the strongest troops in the area. Report to Von Manstein and coordinate an immediate attack. It is imperative that Kalach is retaken and land communications are opened!!!\x00
column2: 将军，冯·曼施坦因(Von Manstein)元帅正在组织反击以解救德国第6集团军。你拥有该地区最强的部队。向冯·曼施坦因报到，并协调一次立即发起的进攻。必须夺回卡拉奇(Kalach)并打通陆上联系！！！\x00

column1: General here we stand on the banks of the Volga.
column2: 将军，我们此刻就站在伏尔加河(Volga)畔。

column1: General intelligence reports show that the Western Allies will try to destroy our oil installations in Ploesti.  They plan an attack with a massive air force plus paradrops and commando actions.  General an urgent message!!! The Americans have taken control of some local airfields under cover of a huge air fleet. You should intervene immediately!!!
column2: 将军，情报报告显示西方盟军将试图摧毁我们普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti)的石油设施。他们计划以庞大的空军加上空降与突击队行动发动进攻。将军，一份紧急消息！！！美国人在一支庞大机群的掩护下夺取了一些当地机场。你应当立即介入！！！

column1: General King Michael has deposed Marshal Antonescu!!! A transition cabinet has taken the goverment !!! They have requested an armistice from the Soviets.  They have refused. The II Ukrainian Front is invading the country through the Carpathian Mountains. They plan to occupy us and terminate our independence !!! You should close the mountain passes before is too late!!!\x00
column2: 将军，米哈伊国王(King Michael)已废黜安东内斯库(Antonescu)元帅！！！一个过渡内阁已接管政府！！！他们已向苏联人请求停战。苏联人拒绝了。乌克兰第2方面军(II Ukrainian Front)正通过喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains)入侵我国。他们打算占领我们，终结我们的独立！！！你应当在为时已晚之前封锁各山口！！！\x00

column1: General our troops situation in Sevastopol is desperate.  They are completly surrounded in the city of Sevastopol. You have to find an evacuation path. The Germans have cooperated with a small submarine fleet and some merchant ships. Good luck!!!
column2: 将军，我军在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的处境已无望。他们被完全包围在塞瓦斯托波尔城内。你必须找到一条撤退路线。德国人已配合派出了一支小型潜艇舰队和一些商船。祝好运！！！

column1: General Patton's army is approaching Karkov. High Command has a little bet going on which of you will be the first to motor down Red Square!
column2: 巴顿(Patton)将军的部队正在逼近哈尔科夫(Karkov)。最高统帅部打了个小赌：你们俩谁会第一个乘车驶过红场！

column1: General Student and his Fallschirmjäger must occupy the island.
column2: 施图登特将军和他的伞兵必须占领该岛。

column1: General that wasn't what I had hoped for.
column2: 将军，这可不是我所期望的。

column1: General the Conducator Antonescu has a lot of expectations about you. He has selected you to lead the forces that will invade the Soviet Union. It is time to get even with the Soviets!!!
column2: 将军，领袖(Conducator)安东内斯库(Antonescu)对你期望很高。他选中你率领将入侵苏联的部队。是时候跟苏联人算总账了！！！

column1: General the Conducator has asked that our push toward the oild fields in Grozny and the Caucasus mountains be led by you.  You should leave the 4th Army and take command of the expeditionary force in the Caucasus.  We expect great things from you !!!
column2: 将军，领袖要求由你率领我们向格罗兹尼(Grozny)与高加索山脉(Caucasus mountains)油田的推进。你应当离开第4集团军，去指挥高加索的远征部队。我们对你期望很大！！！

column1: General the Conducator has asked that our push toward the oild fields in Grozny and the Caucasus mountains be led by you.  You should leave the 4th Army and take command of the expeditionary force in the Caucasus.  We expect great things from you!!!
column2: 将军，领袖要求由你率领我们向格罗兹尼(Grozny)与高加索山脉(Caucasus mountains)油田的推进。你应当离开第4集团军，去指挥高加索的远征部队。我们对你期望很大！！！

column1: General the Germans have promised us all the territories up to the port of Odessa as a new province, Transnistria.  We need to go and occupy it. Let's show the Germans that we can be a helpful ally!!!\x00
column2: 将军，德国人已答应把直到敖德萨(Odessa)港的所有领土作为新省份——德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)——给我们。我们需要去占领它。让我们向德国人证明我们能当一个有用的盟友！！！\x00

column1: General the Soviets are attacking in great force our 3rd and 4th armies on the flanks of the German 6th Army at Stalingrad.  The situation is desperate. You should take command of the 3rd army  located by the Don river.   A great disaster awaits us if we do not stop the Russians!!!  \x00
column2: 将军，苏军正以强大兵力进攻我们在斯大林格勒德国第6集团军两翼的第3与第4集团军。局势危急。你应当接管顿河畔的第3集团军。如果我们不挡住俄国人，一场大灾难就在等着我们！！！\x00

column1: General the Soviets are attacking the city of Perekop on the isthmus joining Crimea to the mainland. If they succeed most of our best troops will be lost.  Hold the town at whatever cost!!!\x00
column2: 将军，苏军正在进攻连接克里米亚(Crimea)与大陆的地峡上的佩列科普(Perekop)城。如果他们成功，我们大部分最精锐的部队都将损失。不惜一切代价守住该镇！！！\x00

column1: General the Soviets are attacking with overwhelming superiority the Army Group Southern Ukraine. Our troops are demoralized and are escaping without a fight.  General Fiessner have asked that you take command of all our troops.  Many of the veterans of your victories during the Stalingrad and Crimea campaigns are there.  They will take heart if you are there to lead!!!\x00
column2: 将军，苏军正以压倒性优势进攻南乌克兰集团军群。我军士气低落，正不战而逃。菲斯纳(Fiessner)将军已请求由你指挥我们所有部队。你在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)与克里米亚(Crimea)战役中取胜时的许多老兵都在那里。有你前去指挥，他们就会重拾信心！！！\x00

column1: General the Soviets have made many concessions and an alliance has been established. You have been selected to lead our 4th Army in the invasion of Hungary. It is time to settle old scores with the Hungarians. Good luck!!!
column2: 将军，苏联人已作出许多让步，同盟已经建立。你被选中率领我们的第4集团军入侵匈牙利(Hungary)。是时候跟匈牙利人清算了结旧账了。祝好运！！！

column1: General the Soviets have taken the city of Rostov. The Army Group South has withdrawn to the line in the Mius river.  It is imperative we hold that line !!! You can buy some German equipment.  \x00
column2: 将军，苏军已夺取罗斯托夫(Rostov)城。南方集团军群(Army Group South)已撤至米乌斯河(Mius river)一线。我们必须守住这条防线！！！你可以购买一些德国装备。\x00

column1: General the Steppe Front has blundered into attacking us in the Kharkov area.  This is too good an opportunity to lose it !!! You should recover the initiative.  \x00
column2: 将军，草原方面军(Steppe Front)贸然在哈尔科夫(Kharkov)地区向我们发起进攻。这个机会太好了，不能放过！！！你应当夺回主动权。\x00

column1: General to cross the German border, now you have the privilege to force Prussian capital to surrender!!! The hour of revenge has come!!!
column2: 德国边界的红军将军，现在你有此殊荣，迫使普鲁士首府投降！！！复仇的时刻到了！！！

column1: General war is not for everybody. You will end up the war as a simple soldier. Pick up a rifle!!!
column2: 将军，战争不是谁都玩得起的。你将作为一名普通士兵打完这场战争。去拿起步枪吧！！！

column1: General You have achieved a complete victory !!! Now all the Crimea in in our hands !!!
column2: 将军，你取得了完全的胜利！！！现在整个克里米亚(Crimea)都在我们手中了！！！

column1: General you have achieved a great victory!!! We can recover our lost territory!!!
column2: 将军，你取得了重大胜利！！！我们可以收复我们失去的领土了！！！

column1: General you have saved our oil installations. You have inflicted great losses to the Allies air forces plus destroying a good number of their best commando units.
column2: 将军，你保住了我们的石油设施。你给盟军空军造成了重大损失，还消灭了他们不少最精锐的突击队。

column1: General you held the town and repulsed the Soviets!!!  Unfortunately a Soviet attack from Kerch has isolated our troops in Sevastopol.
column2: 将军，你守住了该镇，击退了苏军！！！遗憾的是，苏军从刻赤(Kerch)发起的进攻把我们塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的部队孤立了。

column1: General you narrowly achieved victory and closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!
column2: 将军，你勉强取得了胜利，并封闭了通往苏军的高山隘口！！！他们现在只能同意停战了！！！

column1: General you narrowly achieved victory and held the Soviets away from the border. A new goverment has taken charge in Bucharest!!! They have signed an armistice with the Soviets. Our country's destiny is unknown!!! Better do not return!!!
column2: 将军，你勉强取得胜利，把苏军挡在了边境之外。一个新政府已在布加勒斯特(Bucharest)掌权！！！他们已与苏联人签署停战协定。我们国家的命运未卜！！！你最好别回来！！！

column1: General you stopped the Soviets and rallied our men !!! You have saved the Army Group and stop the invasion of our motherland!!!
column2: 将军，你挡住了苏军，重振了我军士气！！！你拯救了集团军群，阻止了对我们祖国的入侵！！！

column1: General you succeeded in an impossible situation !!! You found a path and almost all our troops escaped.  They will live to fight another day !!!
column2: 将军，你在绝境中成功了！！！你找到了一条路径，我们几乎所有部队都逃脱了。他们会活下来，改日再战！！！

column1: General You will command our units cooperating with the Germans in the siege of Sevastopol. We have to take the city to free our troops for the southern offensive. \x00
column2: 将军，你将指挥我军与德国人合作围攻塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)。我们必须拿下该城，以便腾出部队用于南面的攻势。\x00

column1: General your not only stopped the Soviets at the Mius river, but also recovered Rostov !!!
column2: 将军，你不仅在米乌斯河(Mius river)挡住了苏军，还收复了罗斯托夫(Rostov)！！！

column1: General your victory is complete !!! You have taken Kharkov and expelled the Soviets from this part of Ukraine !!! The Donbass is open to us !!!
column2: 将军，你的胜利是彻底的！！！你夺取了哈尔科夫(Kharkov)，把苏军逐出了乌克兰(Ukraine)的这一部分！！！顿巴斯(Donbass)已向我们敞开！！！

column1: General your wonderful victory against heavy odds has secure the oil of Grozny for us !!! The door to the Caucasus is open !!!
column2: 将军，你在敌众我寡的情况下取得的辉煌胜利为我们确保了格罗兹尼(Grozny)的石油！！！通往高加索(Caucasus)的大门敞开了！！！

column1: General your wonderful victory has completed the liberation of our national territory!!! The conducator is very pleased with your performance !!!
column2: 将军，你的辉煌胜利完成了对我们国土的解放！！！领袖对你的表现非常满意！！！

column1: General your wonderful victory has completely closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!
column2: 将军，你的辉煌胜利已彻底封锁了通往苏军部队的山口！！！他们现在只能同意停战了！！！

column1: General, after so many fights, Comrade Stalin himself will ask you about your next assignment.
column2: 将军，经过这么多战斗之后，斯大林同志本人将亲自问你下一个任务。

column1: General, after stopping the enemy on the coast, we have a new plan; the objective is the Indian city of Imphal, where the allied HQ is deployed. A victory attacking Imphal is strongly desired to delay the enemy advance on Burma.
column2: 将军，在沿海挡住敌军之后，我们有了新计划：目标是印度城市英帕尔，盟军指挥部就设在那里。我们迫切希望通过进攻英帕尔取胜，以迟滞敌军向缅甸的推进。

column1: General, air recon discoverd that the bridge over Sittang River was blown prematurely, this is your chance to destroy the 17th Indian Division.
column2: 将军，空中侦察发现锡当河上的大桥已被过早炸毁，这是您歼灭英印第17师的机会。

column1: General, although you overran Hitler's headquarters, the Fuhrer managed to escape by U-Boat to South America. The world still lives in fear of the Nazi menace.
column2: 将军，尽管你攻占了希特勒的总部，元首还是乘 U 艇逃到了南美洲(South America)。世界仍生活在纳粹威胁的恐惧之中。

column1: General, come in, have a seat.

General, deploy your forces along the front lines we have reached in the past months. Be careful, the lines are not safe; althought we are near to Jilin, Changchun and Siping, the KMT forces still keep a strong attack axis near to our base at Linjiang. The mission will be a complete success if you can besiege Changchun and Jilin, and stop the KMT's assault on Linjiang, GRU spies reports our enemies will also try to recapture the section of the Beijing-Changchun railroad, which is also now our main supply line, protect it at any costs!
column2: 将军，把你的部队部署在我们过去几个月抵达的前线上。小心，这些战线并不安全；尽管我们已接近吉林、长春和四平，国民党军队仍在我们的临江基地附近保持着一条强大的进攻轴线。如果你能围困长春和吉林，并阻止国民党对临江的进攻，这次任务就会完全成功，格鲁乌间谍报告说，我们的敌人还会试图夺回北平-长春铁路的路段，那现在也是我们的主要补给线，不惜一切代价保住它！

column1: General, didn't you understand my orders?
column2: 将军，你没听懂我的命令吗？

column1: General, due to your unique successes in amphibious assault operations, our Italians allies have requested our help in the capture of the Malta Island. Have in mind that RAF is weakened, but even under those circumstances, it can overpass the Italians in experience.
column2: 将军，由于你在两栖突击作战中独一无二的成功，我们的意大利盟友已请求我们协助夺取马耳他(Malta)岛。要知道，皇家空军(RAF)虽已被削弱，但即便在这种情况下，其经验也胜过意大利人。

column1: General, I am losing my patience with you.
column2: 将军，我对你越来越没耐心了。

column1: General, I hope you've got enough transports for this operation because the distances are long and we're lacking of time. Your objectives are the cities of Sittingbourne, Sheerness and Gillingham, the capture of Maidstone will be the duty of the 8th panzer division that comes from the south.
column2: 将军，我希望你为这次作战备足了运输工具，因为距离很远，而我们时间不够。你的目标是锡廷伯恩(Sittingbourne)、希尔内斯(Sheerness)与吉灵厄姆(Gillingham)三座城市；夺取梅德斯通(Maidstone)将由从南面开来的第8装甲师负责。

column1: General, I've got a tough assignment for you.
column2: 将军，我有一项艰巨的任务给你。

column1: General, If it was up to me I would have you replaced!
column2: 将军，要是由我说了算，我早就把你换掉了！

column1: General, if we let Ivan get settled, this front will stalemate just like
column2: 将军，如果我们让伊万站稳脚跟，这条战线就会像

column1: General, in these frigid conditions, you must capture Gjovik.  Finish this battle so we may go south where it is warm!
column2: 将军，在这种严寒条件下，你必须夺取约维克(Gjovik)。打完这一仗，我们就能南下到暖和的地方去！

column1: General, maybe we've underestimated the Brits, but the troops in these sector have been lower than we had expected, Congratulations anyway.
column2: 将军，也许我们低估了英国人，但这一地段的部队比我们预期的要少，不管怎么说，恭喜你。

column1: General, no time for chit chat, weve got Ivan on the run.
column2: 将军，没时间闲聊了，我们已把伊万(Ivan)打得溃逃。

column1: General, our advance along the railroad is going nicely.
column2: 将军，我们沿铁路的推进进展顺利。

column1: General, our advance along the railroad is going nicely.
General, since we've stabilized the front in our sector, GHQ wants us to assist our British friends to the north.
column2: 将军，既然我们已稳定了本段的战线，总司令部(GHQ)要我们去支援北面的英国朋友。

column1: General, that was marginal at best.
column2: 将军，那至多只能算勉强合格。

column1: General, the Americans are trying their last revenge to defeat us.
column2: 将军，美国人正在为打败我们进行他们最后的报复。

column1: General, the British are almost defeated, the Japanese have taken all the British belongings in Asia along with its Mediterran strongpoints. London is under our control, the remaining Royal Navy pieces are scattered everywhere, and they won't be nomore any threat to us.
column2: 将军，英国人几乎已被击败，日本人已夺取英国在亚洲(Asia)的全部属地以及其在地中海的据点。伦敦(London)已在我们控制之下，皇家海军剩下的舰只四散各处，再也无法对我们构成威胁。

column1: General, the decisive attack aimed at breaking out the Gustav Line is about to begin. This will be for sure the toughest battle you have yet to participate in. Expect to fight a bloody infantry battle against a very strong enemy, deeply entrenched and dug in a number of die hard bunkers and strategic positions across the Apennines.
column2: 将军，旨在突破古斯塔夫防线的决定性进攻即将开始。这必定是你迄今参加过的最艰苦的一战。准备好打一场血腥的步兵战，对手非常强大，在亚平宁山脉(Apennines)各处顽固的碉堡和战略阵地里深沟高垒。

column1: General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. And now the last Bolshevist reserves await your attack. Defeat them! And end this war!
column2: 将军，敌人英勇作战，但这并未挡住你。现在布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你进攻。击败他们！结束这场战争！

column1: General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!
column2: 将军，战斗艰苦，但伦敦(London)已归我们所有！！丘吉尔(Churchill)已逃往北方，现在没人能否认第三帝国(Third Reich)的胜利了！！

column1: General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!!
column2: 将军，战斗很艰苦，但伦敦(London)是我们的了！！！丘吉尔(Churchill)已逃往北方，现在没有人能否认第三帝国的胜利了！！！

column1: General, the fighting was hard, but London is ours, Churchill has escaped to the north, now no one can deny the victory of the Third Reich!!
column2: 将军，战斗很艰苦，但伦敦(London)是我们的了，丘吉尔(Churchill)已逃往北方，现在没有人能否认第三帝国的胜利了！！

column1: General, the fighting was hard, but London is ours, Churchill has escaped to the north, now no one can deny the victory of the Third Reich!!
column2: 圣洛(St. Lo) - 向圣洛推进

column1: General, the hardest part of the operation is behind us, now is time to begin the stage two, for this you have our best weapon: the panzer divisions! This is the time to go as fast as you can through the path to London. With your tanks as spearhead, advance quickly to avoid the British defenses. The main obstacles are the 1st and 2nd Armored division that British have in the zone,
column2: 将军，作战最艰难的部分已经过去，现在是开始第二阶段的时候了，为此你有我们最好的武器：各装甲师！现在你要尽可能快地沿通往伦敦(London)的路线前进。以你的坦克为矛头，迅速推进，避开英国的防御。主要障碍是英国人在该地区部署的第1和第2装甲师，

column1: General, the red dream has come true, Stalin is delighted and proud of you, the Red flag floats over the Statue of Liberty and the world is ours thanks to your intervention. The Comunism will rule over the world to the benefit of peasants and workers.
column2: 将军，红色梦想已经成真，斯大林对你又欣喜又骄傲，红旗飘扬在自由女神像(Statue of Liberty)之上，多亏你的出手，世界已归我们所有。共产主义将统治世界，造福农民与工人。

column1: General, the red dream has come true, Stalin is delighted and proud of you, the Red flag floats over the Statue of Liberty and the world is ours thanks to your intervention. The Comunism will rule over the world to the benefit of peasants and workers.
General, the soviet scientists thank your care with the installations, the information harvested here will overpower the influence of communism throughout the world.
column2: 将军，苏联科学家们感谢你对那些设施的关照，在此收获的情报将压倒共产主义在世界各地的影响。

column1: General, the Soviets are still advancing in the British sector.
column2: 将军，苏军仍在英军防区内推进。

column1: General, the Soviets have finally recognized their danger.
column2: 将军，苏军终于意识到了他们的危险。

column1: General, the time has come to our last target, the attack to the capital city.
column2: 将军，时候到了，我们的最后目标是进攻首都。

column1: General, the White House and Pentagon is ours. The cradle of Capitalism has collapsed. Stalin is delighted and proud of you because you allowed him to be in a very strong position at the peace negotiation table. Remnants of US army must now surrender and the US communist party can rule the country according to Moscow's wills.
column2: 将军，白宫与五角大楼已归我们所有。资本主义的摇篮已经崩溃。斯大林对你又欣喜又骄傲，因为你让他在和谈桌上处于极为有利的地位。美军残部现在必须投降，美国共产党可以按莫斯科的意旨统治这个国家。

column1: General, this is the attack all of Germany has been waiting for.  You and your SS PanzerKorps have been chosen because of your brilliant victories for the last two years.
column2: 将军，这是全德国都在等待的进攻。你和你的党卫军装甲军之所以被选中，是因为你们过去两年辉煌的胜利。

column1: General, this loss is the last straw. Hitler has now consolidated his power in Norway and it will be years before we can launch an attack in the region. You have disgraced the British Army. A firing squad is in order!
column2: 将军，这次失利是最后一根稻草。希特勒现已巩固了他在挪威(Norway)的权力，我们要在该地区发动进攻将是多年之后的事了。你让英国陆军蒙羞。应当枪决！

column1: General, this situation right now is desperate.  The Finnish Army requires you to defeat this enemy horde and turn the tide against the Soviets.  Remember to wear only your Finnish uniforms!
column2: 将军，眼下的局势十分危急。芬兰军队需要你击败这股敌军，扭转对抗苏军的局势。记住，只穿你的芬兰军服！

column1: General, this triumph is a fitting end to the war. Hitler is destroyed and the world cheers your victory. Your name is mentioned everywhere. Some say you may become the next Prime Minister!
column2: 将军，这场胜利是这场战争恰如其分的结局。希特勒已被摧毁，世界为你的胜利欢呼。你的名字到处被提起。有人说你可能会成为下一任首相！

column1: General, though your performance has been competent, the decision has been made to give you a new command.  The General Staff feels it is best that if you assume command of one the weather stations in Greenland .  Bernard Montgomery will assume your duties.
column2: 将军，尽管你的表现还算称职，但已决定给你一个新的职务。总参谋部认为，你最好去接管格陵兰(Greenland)的一座气象站。伯纳德·蒙哥马利(Bernard Montgomery)将接替你的职务。

column1: General, we are in a complex situation. The Allies have launched a powerful offensive against our positions at Mandalay, which is our main base in this sector. Your mission is to hold the line at any cost!
column2: 将军，我们处境复杂。盟军已对我军在本地区的主要基地曼德勒的阵地发起强大攻势。您的任务是不惜一切代价守住防线！

column1: General, we are pressing the Axis all over the front but bad weather and rough terrain conditions represent a formidable ally for the Krauts. In the attempt to gain time and put up a strong defence line across central Italy, feldmarschall Kesselring has placed a strong and well entrenched contingent to guard the Volturno River and the nearby mountains, covering the retreat of his fascist comrades. Your task is to break the enemy positions over the Volturno, cross the river and capture the cities of Capua and Castel Volturno as fast as possible.
column2: 将军，我们正在全线上压迫轴心国军队，但恶劣天气与崎岖地形是那些德国佬的强大盟友。为了争取时间并在意大利中部建立坚固防线，凯塞林(Kesselring)元帅已部署了一支强大且工事坚固的部队，守卫沃尔图诺河(Volturno River)与附近山地，掩护他那帮法西斯同伙撤退。你的任务是突破沃尔图诺河一线的敌军阵地，渡过该河，并尽快夺取卡普阿(Capua)与沃尔图诺堡(Castel Volturno)两城。

column1: General, we continue with our powerful advance through the inner island.
column2: 将军，我们继续以强大的势头在岛内推进。

column1: General, we continue with our unstoppable advance in the inner island. Your objectives is the city of Gravesend, it is the key to take Tilbury and Grays, which would allow us to advance to the north.
column2: 将军，我们继续在岛内不可阻挡地推进。你的目标是格雷夫森德(Gravesend)城，它是夺取蒂尔伯里(Tilbury)与格雷斯(Grays)的关键，从而让我们能向北推进。

column1: General, we have a small situation here.
column2: 将军，我们这里出了点小状况。

column1: General, we have a small situation here.
General, we have appreciated your heroic efforts to stop that offensive.
column2: 将军，我们感谢你为阻止那次攻势所做的英勇努力。

column1: General, we have underestimated the opponent, not only the British has been denied our surrender offer but they have sent their best troops against us from London lauching a counterattack to Gravesend.
column2: 将军，我们低估了对手，英国人不仅拒绝了我们的投降提议，还从伦敦(London)派出他们最精锐的部队对我们发起反击，直扑格雷夫森德(Gravesend)。

column1: General, we've got to keep the pressure on Ivan.
column2: 将军，我们得继续对伊万施压。

column1: General, we've paid a high price, but we are close to finish the fist stage of our operations.
column2: 将军，我们付出了高昂的代价，但我们即将完成作战的第一阶段。

column1: General, welcome back.  We must move to defeat the last vestiges of Russian resistance.
column2: 将军，欢迎回来。我们必须行动，击败俄国抵抗的最后残余。

column1: General, western and southern Sicily are totally under our control, but the Krauts have put up a stubborn defence trying to avoid us to reach the Messina Strait. While the British are fighting to seize Catania, on the eastern side of the front, our task is to break the enemy positions along the western path of the island, forcing the Axis to evacuate Sicily. Expect a very well entrenched enemy and heavy air defence resistance. Let's jump to the Strait!
column2: 将军，西西里(Sicily)西部与南部已完全在我们控制之下，但那些德国佬顽抗不退，力图阻止我们抵达墨西拿海峡(Messina Strait)。英军正在战线东侧争夺卡塔尼亚(Catania)，而我们的任务是突破该岛西路的敌军阵地，迫使轴心国撤出西西里。要有准备：敌人构筑了坚固工事，防空抵抗也很强。让我们直扑海峡！

column1: General, you better pick up the pace.

General, you have achieved our highest goal; the unconditional surrender of Chiang-Kai-Shek!   Seven years of bloody battles have come at an enormous price.  All the resources and other supplies from China will be now included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere!  Omedetogozaimasu!
column2: 将军，您实现了我们的最高目标：蒋介石无条件投降！七年血战付出了极其惨重的代价。中国的全部资源与其他物资如今都将纳入共荣圈！恭喜！

column1: General, you have been assigned the ultimate objective: Your SS PanzerKorps must destroy the remaining Polish forces situated around Warszawa and secure the Polish Capital.  Be aware that if you go too far east you may encounter our new Allies.
column2: 将军，你已被赋予最终目标：你的党卫军装甲军必须消灭华沙(Warszawa)周边的残余波兰军队，并确保控制波兰首都。注意，如果你过于向东推进，可能会遇到我们的新盟友。

column1: General, you have been promoted to C-I-C of the defense of Tokyo, it's an enormous honor to protect the Imperial capital... isn't it?. Let me inform you about the reports we have about the enemy movements. We know they are going to disembark in two main fronts, one southwards from Tokyo, and another one in the East. According to our sources, the Americans have assembled a huge mass of Assault ships, supported by carriers and many warships.
column2: 将军，您已被晋升为东京防御总司令，保卫帝国首都是一项无上荣耀……不是吗？请允许我向您通报我们掌握的敌军动向情报。我们知道他们将主要在两条战线上登陆，一条在东京以南，另一条在东面。据我们的情报来源，美国人已集结了庞大的登陆舰群，并有航母与众多战舰支援。

column1: General, you have captured the Polish capital and their forces are in disarray.  We expect surrender at any moment.  Well done.
column2: 将军，你已夺取波兰首都，其部队一片混乱。我们预计他们随时会投降。干得好。

column1: General, you have made the impossible!, Stalin is glad with you and angry with the Americans, so he wants to invade America.
column2: 将军，你创造了不可能！斯大林对你很高兴，对美国很愤怒，所以他要入侵美国。

column1: General, you only achieved a marginal victory.  This is unsatisfactory!  Either you must improve or you will be transferred to U-Boat Commander School.
column2: 将军，你只取得了一场险胜。这不能令人满意！你要么有所改进，要么就被调到潜艇指挥官学校去。

column2: 库尔斯克(Kursk) (ZS#05)，1943 年 7 月 5 日

column1: General, your actions have been decisive!  A huge number of enemy units have been trapped, and the enemy resistance is being defeated in all sectors.  Our surprise and surgical strikes have given the Chinese what they deserved, Defeat!
column2: 将军，您的行动起到了决定性作用！大量敌军部队陷入重围，敌军在各处的抵抗正被逐一粉碎。我们的奇袭与精准打击让中国人得到了他们应得的东西——失败！

column1: General, your troops must quickly defeat our enemies!
column2: 将军，您的部队必须迅速击败我们的敌人！

column1: German attacks have been repelled and you have succeeded in retreating the forces under your command. Your defence has enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
column2: 德军的进攻已被击退，您也成功撤出了麾下部队。您的防御使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

column1: German field commanders are not allowed to fail.  I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 德军战地指挥官不允许失败。我对你无话可说了。

column1: Germans out of Caen and breakout of Normandy.
column2: 德军逐出卡昂，并冲出诺曼底(Normandy)。

Germany has defeated the Soviets soundly on all fronts, and soon we must turn our attention towards the west!

column1: Germany lies prostrate at the feet of the Allies!
column2: 德国已匍匐在盟军脚下！
赫罗纳(Gerona) - 1939 年 1 月 31 日

column2: 上车，你这渣滓，下一站——科雷马(Kolyma)！

column1: Get out of my sight until I can find something you're good for!
column2: 滚出我的视线，等我想出你还能干点什么！

column1: Getting past Cassino and beyond the Gustav Line was simply critical for this Italian campaign. Instead, we're still bogged down. There's no time for fooling around; we're going to have to go this thing all over again.
column2: 越过卡西诺(Cassino)并突破古斯塔夫防线，对这场意大利战役来说至关紧要。可我们却仍陷在原地。没时间瞎折腾了；我们只得把这件事从头再来一遍。
直布罗陀(Gibraltar) - 1946 年 9 月 30 日

column1: Give up your offensive and retreat back east to avoid being surrounded.
column2: 放弃攻势，向东撤退，以免被合围。

column1: Given that the 17 DI, which is defending the area, is withdrawing to their new positions, you have to help the "2 Division de Cavalerie" to re-establish the situation.
column2: 鉴于防守该地区的第17步兵师正在撤往新阵地，您必须协助“第2骑兵师”恢复局势。
格拉斯哥(Glasgow) - 1941 年 3 月 13 日

column1: Good day General, welcome back, now this time things are somewhat different.
column2: 你好，将军，欢迎回来，这一次情况有些不同。

column1: Good day, Commander.  British troops are to land at Salerno with the assistance of sundry American formations.   Be advised to press on from the beachhead as quickly as possible since recent reports indicate the presence of a panzer division hiding in the area.  Then, it is imperative, Commander, to drive on.  This will secure our line of supply as we continue our drive North.
column2: 你好，指挥官。英军将在若干美军部队协助下于萨莱诺(Salerno)登陆。建议你尽快从滩头阵地向前推进，因为最近报告显示该地区藏有一个装甲师。随后，指挥官，必须继续推进。这将保障我们继续北进时的补给线。

column1: Good day, Commander. It is your mission to capture the experimental Airbase at Dessau before the Soviets can get there.  Jerry's jet and rocket aircraft must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.  Good luck Commander, and God's speed.
column2: 你好，指挥官。你的任务是赶在苏军之前夺取德绍(Dessau)的试验机场。绝不能让杰里(Jerry)的喷气式与火箭飞机落到不该落到的人手里。祝好运，指挥官，一路顺风。

column1: Good Day, this is the situation: Patton has archieve his goals and now is marching on Berlin, you have two new divisions to stop the allies, you will receive heavy reinforcements from the north.
column2: 你好，情况是这样：巴顿(Patton)已达成他的目标，现在正向柏林(Berlin)进军，你有两个新师可以挡住盟军，你还将从北面获得大量增援。

column1: Good evening General, I don't have to tell you that the situation isn't going well.
column2: 晚上好，将军，不用我说你也知道，形势不妙。

column1: Good job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed and Allied shipping is safe.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。希腊虽已陷落，但那些潜艇已被摧毁，盟军航运安全了。

column1: Good job Commander. Now we need you to head south and plug a gap that is quickly becoming a very tricky situaion. The Russians are about to punch a huge hole in our lines. The 3rd Armored division will be joinging you in a few days. Good Luck!
column2: 干得好，指挥官。现在我们需要你南下，堵住一个正迅速变得十分棘手的缺口。俄国人即将在我们的防线上打出一个大洞。第3装甲师将在几天内与你会合。祝好运！

column1: Good job Commander. Those blasted subs are now at the bottom of the sea, where they belonged in the first place. And now we can begin the liberation of Scandinavia...
column2: 干得好，指挥官。那些该死的潜艇现在躺在海底，那本来就是它们该待的地方。现在我们可以开始解放斯堪的纳维亚了……

column1: Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你设法守住了防线，甚至把那些赤色分子打退了几英里。

column1: Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column2: 彼得库夫(Piotrkow) - 1939 年 9 月 7 日

column1: Good job General. We have proudly freed Poland. Take a few weeks off Commander. Rest up well because we have another tough job for you next month.
column2: 干得好，将军。我们骄傲地解放了波兰。休几周假吧，指挥官。好好休息，因为下个月我们还有一项艰巨任务给你。

column1: Good job, Commander! The gas has been neutralized. The men that served
column2: 干得好，指挥官！毒气已被解除。曾在你麾下

column1: Good job, commander! We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose. The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却全身而退、风光无限。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们硬是撑住了。

column1: Good job, Commander.  We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose.  The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却出淤泥而不染。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们咬牙顶住了。

column1: Good job, Commander. Now it's time to interrogate the scientist and find those missiles, before it's too late.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。现在是审讯那名科学家、找出那些导弹的时候了，别等到来不及。

column1: Good job, Commander. The attack into the Soviet homeland continues...
column2: 干得好，指挥官。向苏联本土的进攻仍在继续……

column1: Good job, Commander. The attack into the Soviet homeland continues...
Good job, Commander. You have given the Italians a taste of defeat. You must follow up this great victory with another!
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你让意大利人尝到了失败的滋味。你必须以又一场胜利来扩大这一伟大胜利！

column1: Good job, Commander. Your success has allowed British troops to pour into southern Italy.  And, as we surmised, Italy may be on the verge of surrendering.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你的胜利让英军得以涌入意大利(Italy)南部。而且正如我们所推测的，意大利可能即将投降。

column1: Good job, you dealt with Ivan's forces.
column2: 干得好，你解决了伊万的部队。

column1: Good job, you really pasted those Reds!. Now it's time for us to go over to the attack again. Get your men ready Commander.
column2: 干得好，你把那些赤色分子狠狠揍了一顿！现在该我们再次转入进攻了。让你的人做好准备，指挥官。

column1: Good job. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. The Bolsheviks made the mistake of committing all their troops to the first line of defense. Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Partisan activity makes it  increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target.
column2: 干得好。又有数十万俄军被困在我们后方的包围圈里。布尔什维克犯了把全部部队都投入第一道防线的错误。你一旦突破，他们便再无预备队可以阻挡你。游击队活动使从前线附近的机场出动越来越困难（这就是那些机场未能提供补给的原因）。现在是向东推进的时候了。目标是莫斯科。

column1: Good luck Commander, you will need it!!!
column2: 祝好运，指挥官，你会需要它的！！！

column1: Good luck Commander. You'll bloody well need it!!!
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官。你他妈的太需要好运了！！！

column1: Good Morning comrade. With all the French ports under our control, it's time to cross the English Channel and pursuit the British in their homeland. General Zhukov and his troops will join you in order to invade the South England area. Stavka have designed a special operation to incur a minimum number of casualities. You must follow these steps;
column2: 早上好，同志。所有法国港口都在我们控制之下，现在是时候渡过英吉利海峡，追击英国人直到他们的本土了。朱可夫(Zhukov)将军及其部队将与你一起入侵英格兰南部。最高统帅部(Stavka)设计了一次特殊行动，以把伤亡降到最低。你必须遵循以下步骤；

column1: Good morning General, what do you think of today's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor?  The Yankees were completely surprised and there fleet was severely damaged!   We will receive the war declaration from the USA in the next few hours...
column2: 早上好，将军，您对今天偷袭珍珠港有何看法？美国佬完全被打了个措手不及，他们的舰队遭受重创！接下来几小时内我们就会收到美国的宣战……

column1: Good morning general.  The enemy National Guard and those rookie soldiers weren't a problem for your elite warriors.  But now, we should take care, the Americans will send a lot of units to this sector with the aim of erasing us from US soil, we shall see.  Your mission is to capture San Francisco from the ground, and also seize San Jose.  We expect a direct attack on our beach head at Monterey and the arrival of the US navy, which will surely try to set a blockade... it, will be funny when the world biggest warship, our glorious battleship Yamato, arrives to deal with their vessels.
column2: 早上好，将军。 敌方的国民警卫队和那些新兵蛋子根本不是你们这些精锐武士的对手。 但现在我们得当心了，美国人会向这一地区投入大量部队，企图把我们彻底从美国本土上抹掉，走着瞧吧。 你的任务是从陆上夺取旧金山，同时占领圣何塞。 我们预计敌人会直接进攻我们在蒙特雷的滩头阵地，美国海军也会到来，他们肯定会试图实施封锁……等到世界上最大的战舰、我们光荣的大和号战列舰前来收拾他们的舰船时，那可就有意思了。

column1: Good morning Sir, I hope you want to stay in the U.S. for long?
column2: 早上好，长官，我希望你打算在美国长住？

column1: Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism.
column2: 早上好，将军。你倒向我们这一边，是相当明智的决定。帝国赞赏你的勇气。你和你的士兵现在可以与我们并肩对抗共产主义。

column1: Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism. Although it is a hard time, we believe the Führer will find the right solution.
column2: 早上好，将军，你投向我们这边是个相当明智的决定。帝国(Reich)赞赏你的勇气。你和你的士兵现在可以与我们并肩对抗共产主义。虽说时局艰难，但我们相信元首会找到正确的解决办法。

column1: Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism. Although it is a hard time, we believe the Führer will find the right solution.

Good news, Comrade General.  The fascist offensive has been halted.  Now is the time for our counter-offensive.  You have been selected to drive the fascists back.  The Red Army of workers and peasants will triumph!
column2: 好消息，将军同志。法西斯的攻势已被遏止。现在是我们反攻的时候了。你已被选中去把法西斯赶回去。工农红军必将胜利！

column1: Good work Bob, it seems your men are almost ready for the big one!!
column2: 干得好，鲍勃，看来你的部下已经差不多准备好打大仗了！！

column1: Good work Bob, it seems your men are ready for the big one!!
column2: 干得好，鲍勃，看来你的部下已经准备好打大仗了！！

column1: Good work by your elite division Bob.
column2: 你的精锐师干得好，鲍勃(Bob)。

column1: Good work Commander!  You have met our expectations.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！你达到了我们的期望。

column1: Good work comrade, we have defeated the allied armies in Belgium, however, the allied leaders have escaped from us.
column2: 干得好，同志。我们已在比利时击败盟军各集团军，但盟军首脑却从我们手中逃脱了。

column1: Good work in getting to Bastogne and digging-in.
column2: 干得好，你们到达了巴斯托涅(Bastogne)并构筑了工事。

column1: Good Work!, the British resistance into the streets of Bristol has been really hard, but finally you did it, now we have the control of the whole South East coast of England, the Allies can't sent supplies for the British anymore.
column2: 干得好！英军在布里斯托尔(Bristol)街巷中的抵抗确实顽强，但你终于拿下了，如今我们控制了英格兰整个东南海岸，盟军再也无法给英国人运送补给了。

column1: Good work!, the enemy has been defeated, we have captured a big number of prisoners and the enemy resistance will end soon.
column2: 干得好！敌人已被击败，我们俘获了大量战俘，敌人的抵抗很快就会结束。

column1: Good work!, we have captured the port of Lyme Regis according to the plan. Now, we should start the refurbishment of the docks in order to allow the arrival of more reinforcements. We will install here our Fields H.Q.
column2: 干得好！我们已按计划夺取莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)港。现在，我们应当开始整修码头，以便更多增援抵达。我们将在此设立野战司令部。

column1: Good work, commander! Now, we've got men and machines rolling into central Italy. Next stop maybe is Rome. Nice going.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！现在，我们的人马与车辆正滚滚开进意大利中部。下一站也许就是罗马。干得不错。

column1: Good work, Commander. The city has been liberated, and our forces continue to drive farther inland, into the heart of the U.S.S.R...
column2: 干得好，指挥官。城市已经解放，我军继续向更内陆推进，直插苏联(U.S.S.R)的心脏……

column1: Good work, Comrade, very good!  Thanks to your proper understanding of party doctrine, you have been able to accomplish your mission.  The fascist invaders are trapped without any hope of escape.  Now, prepare yourself and your men to drive them out of the Motherland.
column2: 干得好，同志，非常好！多亏你对党的学说有正确的理解，你才得以完成任务。法西斯入侵者已陷入重围，毫无逃脱的希望。现在，让你和你的部下做好准备，把他们赶出祖国。

column1: Good work, the allies are re-embarking their troops, in order to avoid their capture.
column2: 干得好，盟军正在重新登船撤离他们的部队，以免被俘。

column1: Good Work, the British have been withdrawn from the Portsmouth area!, and now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
column2: 干得好，英军已从朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)地区撤走！现在我们可以在这里建立司令部，并开始从大陆本土接收补给。

column1: Good work, the lines are secured, and now the British won't be able to make anything against us here. Now we must drive to Bristol.
column2: 干得好，防线已经稳固，现在英国人在这里对我们无可奈何了。现在我们必须向布里斯托尔(Bristol)推进。

column1: Good work.  You hit a  home run!  Now, we've got men and machines rolling into southern Italy, and rumor has it that Italy's on the verge of surrendering.  Nice going, Commander.
column2: 干得好。你打出了一记全垒打！现在，我们的人马正滚滚涌入意大利南部，还有传言说意大利即将投降。干得漂亮，指挥官。

column1: Good work. You have fulfilled Churchill's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, Italy will be forced to accept German help.
column2: 干得好。你实现了丘吉尔的期望！你的进攻削弱了敌人的抵抗。现在，意大利将被迫接受德国的援助。

column1: Good work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, the war with Norway will soon be over.
column2: 干得好。你实现了总参谋部的期望！你的进攻削弱了敌军抵抗。如今，对挪威的战争很快就要结束了。

column1: Good! the capture of Brighton took much time than expected, but we did it!
column2: 好！夺取布赖顿(Brighton)比预期花了更多时间，但我们还是做到了！
