column2: 干得非常非常漂亮，指挥官！我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却全身而退、风光无限。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们硬是撑住了。

column1: Great job Commander! Although the Soviets are still putting up some resistance, for the most part Germany is ours. And now the road is open for an offensive into Russia...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！虽然苏军仍在作些抵抗，但德国大体上已归我们所有。现在向俄国进攻的道路已经打通……

column1: Great job Commander! Not only are the last of those blasted subs gone, we now can easily liberate the rest of Scandinavia from this point. We really should promote you...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！不但那些该死的潜艇最后一艘也没了，我们现在还能从此地轻松解放斯堪的纳维亚(Scandinavia)其余地区。我们真该给你升官……

column1: Great Job Commander! Now on to Moscow!!!
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！现在向莫斯科进军！！！

column1: Great job Commander! The remaining Soviet forces in Germany have all surrendered, and the road is open for an offensive into Russia...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！德国境内残余的苏军已全部投降，向俄国进攻的道路已经打通……

column1: Great job commander. A lot of Vichy French ships fell into our hands. Hitler and Mussolini will be pleased.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。许多维希法国舰船落入我们手中。希特勒和墨索里尼会很高兴。

column1: Great job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed along with a substantial portion of the garrison force in Greece.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。虽然希腊已经陷落，但那些潜艇以及希腊驻军的一大部分都已被消灭。

column1: Great job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed along with a substantial portion of the garrison force in Greece.
Great Job commander. Now it's time for phase 2. We must finish up this operation before we're knee deep in snow!
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。现在进入第二阶段。我们必须在深陷雪中之前结束这次作战！

column1: Great job general. The French have retreated back to Belgium. Continue the pursuit and do not give them any rest.
column2: 干得好，将军。法国人已撤回比利时。继续追击，别给他们喘息之机。

column1: Great job, Commander!  You have done an absolutely fantastic job with the

column1: Great job, Commander! The missiles are neutralized, and we push towards Moscow! Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons...
column2: 塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol) (#5) - 1942 年 6 月 7 日

column1: Great Job, Moscow is now back to normal and Comrade Stalin is safe thanks to your intervention.
column2: 干得漂亮，莫斯科(Moscow)现已恢复正常，多亏你的出手，斯大林同志安然无恙。

column1: Great Job, Moscow is now back to normal and Comrade Stalin is safe thanks to your intervention.

Great stuff Bob!! Congratulations to you and your Regiment. The 101st Division has captured the strategically important town of Carentan and now we can link with the assault force coming inland from Omaha Beach.
column2: 干得好，鲍勃！！祝贺你和你的团。第101师已夺取战略要地卡朗唐(Carentan)，现在我们可以与从奥马哈海滩(Omaha Beach)向内陆推进的登陆部队会合了。

column1: Great work Bob!! Under difficult conditions your Regiment has secured the southern exits and allowed the passage of the Utah Beach assault force onto clear ground.
column2: 干得漂亮，鲍勃！！在艰难条件下，你的团守住了南面的出口，使犹他海滩(Utah Beach)登陆部队得以通过，进入开阔地。

column1: Great work Bob, you have rescued your men and now you can rejoin the lines at the town of Haguenau.
column2: 干得漂亮，鲍勃，你救出了你的部下，现在可以回到阿格诺(Haguenau)镇的阵地了。

column1: Great work by your elite division Bob.
column2: 你的精锐师干得漂亮，鲍勃。

column1: Great work to you and your regiment Bob!!! Under the most difficult of conditions we have gained a toehold on the continent.
column2: 你和你的团干得漂亮，鲍勃！！！在最艰难的条件下，我们在欧洲大陆上站住了脚。

column1: Great work!, we have eliminated the allied menace on the Mediterranean, greek partisans have established a proper socialist goverment in their country.

column1: Great work!, we have eliminated the allied menace on the Mediterranean, greek partisans have established a proper socialist goverment in their country.

Great work.  The Chinese will no longer be a threat to our shipping routes on the Yangtze and the Gan rivers.  They have suffered a major defeat by losing the industrial center of Nanchang.  We can now continue our advance on the Chinese mainland.
column2: 干得漂亮。中国军队将不再威胁我们在长江和赣江上的航运。他们失去了工业中心南昌，遭受了一场重大失败。我们现在可以继续在中国大陆推进了。

column1: Great!  Hong Kong and Macao are in our hands and the chinese armies deployed around our base of Canton have been defeated.  The chinese and their allies will no longer be a problem to our continued advance into Asia.
column2: 太好了！香港和澳门已落入我们手中，部署在我们广州基地周围的中国军队也已被击败。中国及其盟国将不再是我们继续向亚洲推进的障碍。

column1: Great! Once again you howed that our faith in you was justified. Headquarters is overjoyed by your success.
column2: 太好了！你再一次证明我们对你的信任没有错。司令部为你的成功欣喜若狂。

column1: Great!. The allies have been fully defeated at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
column2: 太好了！盟军在仰光城下被彻底击败。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。
希腊(Greece) - 1945 年 6 月 25 日

column1: Greetings Comrade, the Americans didn´t expected a fast advance of our armies, so their units are well covered, but poorly defended.
column2: 你好，同志，美国人没料到我们部队推进得这么快，所以他们的部队掩护良好，但防御薄弱。
土拨鼠日(Groundhog Day) - 1946 年 2 月 2 日

column1: Guderian has decided to not wait for the infantry divisions and to cross the Dniepr with only his mobile troops because General Hoth's 3rd Panzer Gruppe has already done the same to the north of us. Both Gruppen could meet at Smolensk thereby trapping more Russians in a new pocket. 10Pz Division will cross the Dniepr North of Mogilev with your division and the GrossDeutschland Infantry Regiment covering the flanks. The first goals are Kopyr and Gorki.
column2: 古德里安(Guderian)决定不等步兵师，只带他的机动部队渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)，因为霍特(Hoth)将军的第3装甲集群已在我们北面这样做了。两个集群可以在斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)会合，从而在新的包围圈中困住更多俄国人。第10装甲师(10Pz Division)将与你的师一起在莫吉廖夫(Mogilev)以北渡河，由大德意志步兵团(GrossDeutschland Infantry Regiment)掩护两翼。首要目标是科佩尔(Kopyr)与戈尔基(Gorki)。

column1: have erupted out of control. Stalin, apparently getting desperate at the outcome of the war, has begun building nuclear weapons.
column2: 已经失控爆发了。斯大林(Stalin)显然对战争结局越来越绝望，已开始建造核武器。

column1: having secured our facilities. Leave now, Commander. You have disgraced the Allies.
column2: 因为他们已夺取我们的设施。现在走吧，指挥官。你让盟军蒙羞。

column1: He got the job done but I wouldn't go visit our English friends for a while
column2: 他把事情办成了，但要是我，我短时间内不会去拜访我们的英国朋友

column1: He loves his defensive works so expect to see a lot of them.
column2: 他钟爱防御工事，所以要准备看到大量的工事。

column1: He's set up quite a nice welcome at Irkutsk.
column2: 他在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)设下了相当不错的欢迎仪式。

column1: Hell, this is the biggest counter-offensive against Armeegruppe Mitte so far!!!
column2: 见鬼，这是迄今对中央集团军群最大规模的反攻！！！
赫勒斯(Helles) - 1946 年 4 月 15 日

column1: Here we are, commander: we have the chance to write the final chapter of this African campaign and force the Axis to leave the continent. You are to act a key role in the capture of Tunis, but it won't be really easy since Berlin sent a lot of reinforcements to defend the last toehold of the Axis in Tunisia. You'll have to face a very experienced and entrenched enemy, able to destroy even the best units within your army. So be very cautious in managing your advance, or you will suffer heavy losses.
column2: 指挥官，我们到了：我们有机会写下这场非洲战役的最后一章，迫使轴心国离开这片大陆。你将在夺取突尼斯城(Tunis)的行动中扮演关键角色，但这绝不会轻松，因为柏林派来大量增援，保卫轴心国在突尼斯的最后一处立足点。你将面对一支经验丰富、工事坚固的敌军，他们甚至能摧毁你军中最精锐的部队。所以在指挥推进时要格外谨慎，否则你会遭受重大损失。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall Congratulations on your promotion!!! After a series of victories both East and West on American soil we are in a position to close conclusively the fight on the southern theater. We need to capture the city of Knoxville and destroy the atomic facilities at Oak Ridge. A victory here will put final victory at hand!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，恭喜你晋升！！！在美国土地上东西两线连番胜利之后，我们已有能力彻底终结南方战区的战斗。我们需要夺取诺克斯维尔(Knoxville)城，并摧毁橡树岭(Oak Ridge)的原子设施。在此取胜，最终胜利便唾手可得！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall the USA Capital is in front of you. The American resistance is extremely tough, but you should prevail!!! End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，美国首都就在你眼前。美国人的抵抗极其顽强，但你应该能取胜！！！结束这场战争，元帅阁下！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall your wonderful victory has closed the fight on the southern front and your troops can be used on the final assault on the Washington area!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，你的精彩胜利已终结南方战线的战斗，你的部队可以投入对华盛顿地区的最后突击！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall your wonderful victory has earned you the everlasting gratitude of your people.!!! You rank among the greatest heroes of our history !!!
column2: 元帅阁下，你的辉煌胜利为你赢得了人民永世的感激。！！！你跻身于我们历史上最伟大的英雄之列！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Russians threaten Berlin. Zhukov is about to break the Oder Front and Konev has already broken the 3rd Panzer army lines in the South. You are the only one who can stop them !!! You are in the direct path of Konev.  Feld Marschall Rommel came out of retirement to raise a Panzer Corps to slow down Zhukov.  He will try to buy some time for you. You should defeat Konev first and then Zhukov.
column2: 元帅阁下。俄国人威胁柏林。朱可夫(Zhukov)即将突破奥得河(Oder)防线，科涅夫(Konev)已突破南面的第3装甲集团军防线。只有你能挡住他们！！！你正处在科涅夫的正前方。隆美尔(Rommel)元帅已复出，组建了一个装甲军来迟滞朱可夫。他会尽力为你争取时间。你应当先击败科涅夫，再对付朱可夫。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  You have achieved a complete victory. The Reich's Capital is safe. !!! You have earned the gratittude of your people for all times !!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你取得了完全的胜利。帝国的首都安全了。！！！你赢得了人民永远的感激！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  You have achieved a complete victory. The Russians are in complete disarray. You have earned the gratitude of your people for all times !!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你取得了完全的胜利。俄国人已彻底溃乱。你永远赢得了你人民的感激！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  You have barely achieved a  victory. The Russians will agree to negotiations with a lot of conditions. You should stay outside the country for a while. People will not take this lightly.
column2: 元帅阁下。你勉强取得了一场胜利。俄国人会同意谈判，但会附带许多条件。你该在国外待一段时间。人们不会对此等闲视之。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall. You should complete the job by defeating the Americans in the Southern part of the front. Strasbourg should be retaken!!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你应当击败战线南段的美国人，把这件事做完。斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)应当被夺回！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall. Your victory has stopped the western allies advance on the Fatherland !!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你的胜利阻止了西方盟军向本土推进！！！

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, although you overran the Oak Ridge facility, the Americans had time to dismantle and move the most critical material. This Atomic Bomb may still a threat to us. We have no choice but to negotiate with the Americans.
column2: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你攻占了橡树岭设施，美国人却有时间拆走并转移了最关键的材料。这枚原子弹可能仍是我们的威胁。我们别无选择，只能与美国人谈判。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our Southern campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Knoxville, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....           Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance. Less than 20 kilometers north of us, here, is a large facility. Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power there. It is imperative that we act decisively and destroy this facility.
column2: 元帅阁下，由于你前所未有的推进，我们很快将看到南方战役的胜利收官。冯·曼施泰因元帅的北方集团军群已推进至距诺克斯维尔100公里处，而且……恕我打断一下，元帅阁下……元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份至关重要的情报。就在我们这里以北不到20公里处，有一处大型设施。情报报告显示，美国人正在那里建造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器。当务之急是我们必须果断行动，摧毁这处设施。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance.  Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power, which  will be finished by August 1!  It is imperative that we act decisively and conquer England before this weapon is ready.  With England in our hands we can negotiate a reasonable peace with the Americans.
column2: 元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份极其重要的情报。情报显示，美国人正在制造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器，它将在8月1日前完成！我们必须果断行动，在这一武器准备就绪之前征服英格兰。只要英格兰落入我们手中，我们就能与美国人体面地议和。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, the Americans have successfully evacuated their research site.  This is your failure.  This Atomic Bomb is still a threat to us, and now we are forced to make peace with the Americans on their terms.  You have disgraced the German nation.
column2: 元帅阁下，美国人已成功撤离了他们的研究场址。这是你的过失。这枚原子弹对我们仍是威胁，而现在我们被迫按美国人的条件与他们媾和。你让德意志民族蒙羞。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our Southern campaign.  Once again your skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb."  Their research facility is a gutted ruin.  It is most extraordinary that you were able to capture Knoxville despite this distraction.  We must hope that only one such facility exists.
column2: 元帅阁下，这场大捷为我们的南方战役画上了恰如其分的句号。你的才华再一次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人使用他们的「原子弹」。他们的研究设施已成一片焦土废墟。即便有这等牵制，你仍能攻占诺克斯维尔，实属非凡。我们只能寄望于这样的设施只有一处。

column1: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. You have left us no choice but to come to terms with the Americans. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
column2: 元帅阁下，我无言以对。你的失败是……不可理喻的。你让我们别无选择，只能与美国人达成协议。这场溃败将被铭记为我们民族最惨重的军事灾难之一。对你而言，永远不再回到祖国会更好。好得多。

column1: Herr Feldmarshall, though your performance has been.....competent, the decision has been made to ... relieve you of command.  The General Staff feels it is best that a more.... seasoned officer replace you.  The great Erich von Manstein will assume your duties.
column2: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你的表现……还算称职，但已作出决定……解除你的指挥权。总参谋部认为最好由一位更……老练的军官接替你。伟大的埃里希·冯·曼施泰因将接手你的职责。

column1: Herr General - very strong enemy position - inf. and aty fortresses - you must use the artillery and Flak 88 units and fight through  over hill and enemy bunkers.
column2: 将军阁下——敌军阵地极为坚固，步兵与炮兵要塞——您必须动用炮兵与88毫米高射炮部队，翻越山丘、突破敌军地堡。

column1: Herr General : Marshall Zhukov Belorussian Fronts have broken our defenses in Seelow Heights.  The Russians are about to take Berlin. You are the only one who can stop them !!!  Good luck !!!
column2: 将军阁下：朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的白俄罗斯方面军已突破我们在塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)的防线。俄国人即将攻取柏林。只有你能挡住他们！！！祝好运！！！

column1: Herr General : Pardon me ! Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Americans have created an opening in their advance toward the Reich border. You should cut their lines and reach Antwerp on the channel coast.
column2: 将军阁下：请原谅！元帅阁下。美国人向本土边境的推进中露出了一个缺口。你应当切断他们的交通线，直抵海峡海岸的安特卫普(Antwerp)。

column1: Herr General : The General Staff is displeased with your luckluster victory !!! Your will need to do better to restore your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：总参谋部对你这场平淡无奇的胜利不满！！！你需要做得更好，才能恢复总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a complete victory !!! The Western Allies are in disarray !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了彻底的胜利！！！西方盟军一片混乱！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a complete victory !!! The western allies are in disarray !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了完全的胜利！！！西方盟军一片混乱！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a wonderful victory !!! Your success has restored your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了辉煌的胜利！！！你的成功恢复了你总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a wonderful victory many of the 17th Army men will fight again !!! Your success has restored your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了辉煌的胜利，第17集团军的许多官兵还能再战！！！你的成功恢复了你总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Herr General bad news. The Russians have defeated the Finnish at Viipuri !!!. If we do not successfully counterattack Finland will sue for peace. We count on you Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，坏消息。俄国人在维堡(Viipuri)击败了芬兰人！！！。如果我们不能成功反击，芬兰将会求和。我们指望你了，将军阁下！！！

column1: Herr General congratulations in your victory. You have saved us valuable time. It will be years before Italy is invaded again.  Your services are needed in Russia.
column2: 将军阁下，祝贺你的胜利。你为我们赢得了宝贵的时间。意大利再次被入侵将是多年之后的事。俄国需要你的效力。

column1: Herr General in order to plan an invasion of the continental USA we need a base in the Caribbean. The island of St. George has been selected. You will lead the invasion force!!!
column2: 将军阁下，为了筹划对美国本土的入侵，我们需要在加勒比海(Caribbean)有一个基地。圣乔治(St. George)岛已被选定。你将率领入侵部队！！！

column1: Herr General St. George is ours!!! Your victory cements our control of the area.
column2: 将军阁下，圣乔治是我们的了！！！你的胜利巩固了我们对这一地区的控制。

column1: Herr General the 17th Army is in a completely desperate position inside Sevastopol. It is surrounded by overwhelmingly superior Russian forces. We organized an evacuation, but we need time desperately to be successful.
column2: 将军阁下，第17集团军在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)城内已陷入完全绝望的境地。它被占压倒性优势的俄国军队包围。我们组织了一次撤退，但要成功，我们迫切需要时间。

column1: Herr General the General Staff has orderred Mussolini to be release from prison at all costs. We are assemblying a especial team to do the job. I was thinking of that ex-SS officer that serves under you. Otto Skorzeny is his name I believe...
column2: 将军阁下，总参谋部已下令不惜一切代价把墨索里尼(Mussolini)从狱中救出。我们正在组建一支特别小队来完成这件事。我想到了在你手下服役的那个前党卫军军官。我记得他叫奥托·斯科尔兹内(Otto Skorzeny)……

column1: Herr General the I and II Ukrainian Fronts have broken our lines in the Ukraine. Kiev the Ukraine capital is threatened.  Several of our garrisons are isolated.  You have to stop them !!!
column2: 将军阁下，乌克兰第1与第2方面军已突破我们在乌克兰(Ukraine)的战线。乌克兰首都基辅(Kiev)受到威胁。我们有几处守备部队已被孤立。你必须挡住他们！！！

column1: Herr General the Italian Central front is about to be broken by the Western Allies.  It is imperative they do not pass !!!
column2: 将军阁下，意大利中部战线即将被西方盟军突破。绝不能让他们通过！！！

column1: Herr General the Russians are attacking Army Group Northen Ukraine. A reinforced infantry Corps is encircled in Cherkassy.  You have to break the circle and release these troops !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正在进攻北乌克兰集团军群。一个得到加强的步兵军在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)被合围。你必须打破包围圈，解救这些部队！！！

column1: Herr General the Russians are besieging Budapest. We need to relieve the city or the Hungarians will abandon the war.
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正在围困布达佩斯(Budapest)。我们得解该城之围，否则匈牙利人会放弃这场战争。

column1: Herr General the Russians are trying to break in the northern part of Army Group South. If they succeed the link between Army Groups Center and South will be broken. Gomel is threatened. Stop them before is too late !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图在南方集团军群北段实现突破。一旦得手，中央与南方两个集团军群之间的联系就会被切断。戈梅利(Gomel)受到威胁。在为时未晚之前挡住他们！！！

column1: Herr General the Russians have crossed the Bug river and entered into the Romanian province of  Transnistria. They try to cross the Dniestr and knock Romania out of the war. You have to stop them before they succeed. You can deploy only 16 units choose wisely !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄军已渡过布格河(Bug river)，进入罗马尼亚的德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)省。他们试图渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)，把罗马尼亚逐出战争。你必须在他们得手之前挡住他们。你只能部署 16 个单位，慎重选择！！！

column1: Herr General the Russians try to break into Crimea through the Kerch straits.  If they succeed it is going to be very difficult to stop them.  We count on you Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图通过刻赤海峡(Kerch straits)突入克里米亚(Crimea)。如果他们得手，要挡住他们就非常困难了。我们全靠你了，将军阁下！！！

column1: Herr General the western allies have invaded Sicily. You have to throw them into the sea before is too late. The loyalty of our Italian allies is at stake!!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已入侵西西里(Sicily)。你必须在为时未晚之前把他们赶下海去。我们意大利盟友的忠诚正处在危急关头！！！

column1: Herr General the Western Allies have landed on Salerno. You have to throw them into the sea before our Italian Allies will capitulate!!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已在萨莱诺(Salerno)登陆。你必须在我们的意大利盟友投降之前把他们赶下海！！！

column1: Herr General the Western Allies try to break our lines at St. Lo.  If they can break free from Normandy everything will be lost. We should counterattack before is too late !!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军正试图在圣洛(St. Lo)突破我们的防线。如果他们能冲出诺曼底，一切都完了。我们应当趁还来得及发起反击！！！

column1: Herr General this is our opportunity to break the western allies lines and reach Antwerp. Speed is crutial to reach Bastogne and St. Vith. If we fail the German border is open to them !!!
column2: 将军阁下，这是我们突破西方盟军防线、打到安特卫普(Antwerp)的机会。速度对于抵达巴斯托涅(Bastogne)与圣维特(St. Vith)至关重要。如果我们失败，德国边境就对他们敞开了！！！

column1: Herr General you achieved a magnificient victory against heavy odds. !!! The drive into Germany has been stopped !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你在极其不利的条件下取得了辉煌的胜利。！！！向德国境内的推进已被挡住！！！

column1: Herr General you achieved what Napoleon could not do !!! You have taken the city of London!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你做到了拿破仑(Napoleon)做不到的事！！！你已拿下伦敦城！！！

column1: Herr General you dealt a mighty blow to the Russians.  We will have a quiet Southern front for a long time.
column2: 将军阁下，你给了俄国人一记沉重的打击。南线将长久平静了。

column1: Herr General you dealt a mighty blow to the Russians.  We will have a quiet Southern front for a long time.
Herr General You have achieved a complete victory !!! The loyalty of our Italian allies is secured !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你取得了完全的胜利！！！我们意大利盟友的忠诚得到了确保！！！

column1: Herr General you have achieved what has not been done for thousand years the conquest of Britain!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你成就了千年来无人成就之事——征服不列颠！！！

column1: Herr General you have been selected to lead an invasion of the continental USA. This unprecedented effort will entail the capture of the port-city of Savannah by an invasion force leaving from the island of St. George.  The Americans will defend up to the last men and they have powerful sea, air and land units in the area.  Good luck!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你已被选中率军入侵美国本土。这项前所未有的行动，将由一支从圣乔治岛出发的入侵部队夺取港口城市萨凡纳(Savannah)。美国人会战至最后一人，而且他们在该地区拥有强大的海、空、陆部队。祝好运！！！

column1: Herr General you have the choice of continuing the historic line (in Tunisia) or moving into an alternative series of scenarios depicting an hypothetical German attack plan (through Egypt).
column2: 将军阁下，你可以选择继续历史路线（在突尼斯(Tunisia)），或者转入另一系列场景，描述一个假想的德军进攻计划（穿越埃及）。

column1: Herr General you rejected the Russian attack. Crimea is safe to the Reich !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你打退了俄军的进攻。克里米亚(Crimea)对帝国来说安全了！！！

column1: Herr General You rescued and flew Mussolini to safety against tremedous odds !!! Well done job !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你顶着极大困难把墨索里尼(Mussolini)救出并送到安全处！！！干得漂亮！！！

column1: Herr General your complete victory has restored the front and the confidence of our allies !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的完全胜利恢复了战线，也恢复了我们盟友的信心！！！

column1: Herr General your great victory has secured a beachhead on American territory!!! We can have real posibilities of victory if our Japanese Allies can do the same on the west coast
column2: 将军阁下，你的重大胜利已在美国领土上夺得一处桥头堡！！！如果我们的日本盟友能在西海岸做到同样的事，我们就真有获胜的可能

column1: Herr General your victory has contained the Allies. !!! Unfortunately they have broken our lines in the South.
column2: 将军阁下，你的胜利牵制住了盟军。！！！遗憾的是他们已在南面突破了我军防线。

column1: Herr General your victory is complete !!! The threat to our Italian front has been eliminated !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的胜利是彻底的！！！我们对意大利战线的威胁已被消除！！！

column1: Herr General your wonderful victory has released our troops and stabilized the front !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你出色的胜利解放了我们的部队，稳住了前线！！！

column1: Herr General your wonderful victory has steadied Romanian will to resist the red hordes !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的辉煌胜利稳固了罗马尼亚人抵抗红色蛮潮的意志！！！

column1: Herr General!  Good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军阁下！干得好！危机已经解除，波兰军队已经崩溃。你率我们渡河之后，就再没有什么能阻挡我们的装甲部队了。祝贺你。

column1: Herr General!  Very good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军阁下！干得非常好！危机已过，波兰军队已经崩溃。你一带我们渡河，就再没什么能挡住我们的装甲部队。恭喜。

column1: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.
column2: 将军阁下，能在俄国腹地的诺夫哥罗德以南率领此次进攻，是您的殊荣。此处攻势若成，将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并围困数个苏军集团军。当然，迅速夺取目标势在必行。我们挂念着您。

column1: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.

Herr General,  you narrowly accomplished what was expected of you.  Unfortunately, the Soviets held the Volokolamsk Highway long enough for more troops to arrive.  In addition, heavy snows are now falling.  Our offensive cannot continue under these conditions. Herr General, you are not suited to command at this level.  You will report to the officer training school at Metz. There is an opening for a panzer maintenance instructor.
column2: 将军阁下，你只是勉强完成了对你的期望。遗憾的是，苏军守住沃洛科拉姆斯克公路足够久，让更多部队得以抵达。此外，现在正下着大雪。在这种条件下，我们的攻势无法继续。将军阁下，你不适合这一层级的指挥。你将去梅斯的军官学校报到。那里有个装甲维护教官的空缺。
将军阁下，「Wir fahren gegen Engeland……」

column1: Herr General, after Gazala the remnants of the British Eighth Army have holed up inside the Tobruk perimeter. Panzerarmee Afrika attacks at dawn: breach the wire, seize the harbor and force the garrison to surrender before nightfall.
column2: 将军阁下，加扎拉(Gazala)之战后，英国第8集团军残部龟缩进托布鲁克(Tobruk)环形阵地。非洲装甲集团军将于拂晓发起强攻：突破外围防线、夺取港口，迫使守军在天黑之前投降。

column1: Herr General, after your incredible victory, the entire Russian line is in complete collapse.
column2: 将军阁下，在你令人难以置信的胜利之后，俄军整条战线已彻底崩溃。

column1: Herr General, Armeegruppe Sud is attacking Warsaw. You must occupy the roads and railroads south of Warsaw. This will allow you to use Karl railguns when needed.
column2: 将军阁下，南方集团军群正进攻华沙。你必须占领华沙以南的公路与铁路。这将使你能在需要时使用「卡尔」列车炮。

column1: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the northern thrust of our offensive. You must penetrate as far as the town of Prokhorovka. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，如你所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。为削平这个突出部、恢复我军战线的完整，我们将从南北两翼进攻，合围，然后歼灭被困之敌。你和你的指挥部将领导我军攻势的北翼。你必须推进到普罗霍夫卡镇。祝你好运。

column1: Herr General, as you know, Germany has declared war on the Soviet Union.  You have been chosen to play a key role in our drive into southern Russia. You will assist our Romanian Allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective.  Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical.  The world is watching, Herr General, do not disappoint.
column2: 将军阁下，如你所知，德国已对苏联宣战。你被选中在我们向俄国南部的进军中发挥关键作用。你将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友，设法收复他们失去的摩尔达维亚省。这个省的关键城市是基什尼奥夫，它也是你的首要目标。这项任务不仅在战略上重要，在政治上同样至关重要。全世界都在注视，将军阁下，不要让我们失望。
将军阁下，巴巴罗萨行动(Barbarossa)已经开始！

column1: Herr General, Bristol has fallen and the Severn crossings are ours. Your kampfgruppe now drives north-east on Gloucester: take the city and its docks before the British can improvise a new defensive line along the Severn. Every day of delay lets them dig in deeper.
column2: 将军阁下，布里斯托尔(Bristol)已经易手，塞文河(Severn)各渡口已在我们手中。你的战斗群现在向东北直取格洛斯特(Gloucester)：赶在英国人沿塞文河拼凑出新防线之前，夺取该城及其码头。每拖延一天，他们的工事就坚固一分。

column1: Herr General, defeat these remaining Soviet forces.  We must have Khar'kov.
column2: 将军阁下，击败这些残余的苏军。我们必须得到哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)。

column1: Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会谈……你在此地以及在西线取得的一连串胜利都是前所未有的......你将返回祖国，接受一个感恩的国家的欢迎。

column1: Herr General, fine performance.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective.
column2: 将军阁下，干得漂亮。占领维亚济马(V'Az'ma)对你达成下一个目标至关重要。

column1: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand?  I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。

column1: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand? I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。

column1: Herr General, How could you have lost?
Herr General, How could you let the Poles defeat your mighty PanzerKorps?
column2: 将军阁下，你怎么能让波兰人击败你强大的装甲军？

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain.  You have been ordered to Berlin.  I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain.  You have been ordered to Berlin.  I do not envy your reception there.
Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾你精锐部队的牺牲成了徒劳。你已被命令前往柏林。我可不羡慕你在那里会受到什么接待。

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain.  The Allies are advancing on all fronts.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你那些优秀部队的牺牲都白费了。盟军正在所有战线上推进。

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. Italy has  capitulated to the Allies, and we must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。意大利已向盟军投降，我们必须迅速后撤，否则将面临被歼灭。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

column1: Herr General, I hope you can withstand this cold.  The 1st SS PanzerKorps must capture V'Az'ma.  This city will be a stepping stone and a base of operations for the final attack on Moscow!
column2: 将军阁下，我希望你能顶住这样的严寒。党卫军第1装甲军必须夺取维亚济马(V'Az'ma)。这座城市将成为最后进攻莫斯科的踏脚石与作战基地！

column1: Herr General, I hope you enjoyed the last year spent at the academy teaching your tactics to Germany's future commanders.  However, we have need of you at the front once again.
column2: 将军阁下，我希望你在学院度过的这一年过得愉快——你向德国未来的指挥官们传授了你的战术。不过，前线再次需要我们使用你。

column1: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
column2: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城内。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很值得怀疑了。如果你能把赤色分子赶进多瑙河，我们或许还能阻止那头俄国熊把我们吞掉。

column1: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this resounding success.  British and Commonwealth forces have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence.  You will be, no doubt, honored when you return to the fatherland.
column2: 将军阁下，我必须为这次响彻四方的成功向你祝贺。英军和英联邦部队已经投降，希腊的抵抗也已瓦解。你以高超的技艺和智慧完成了这项艰巨的任务。当你回到祖国时，无疑将受到表彰。

column1: Herr General, it may have been to your advantage to have remained in captivity. This failure was completely unexpected from an officer of your caliber and experience. Your services will no longer be required!
column2: 将军阁下，也许一直待在战俘营对你更有利。以你的才干和资历，这次失败完全出乎意料。我们不再需要你的效劳了！

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

column1: Herr General, Kyiv is an extremely important tactical objective.  We are placing its capture in your hands; we have the greatest confidence in you.
column2: 将军阁下，基辅(Kyiv)是一个极其重要的战术目标。我们把它交到你手上；我们对你抱有最大的信心。

column1: Herr General, on every other front the Russians are melting before our forces like a slab of butter on a skillet.
column2: 将军阁下，在其他各条战线上，俄国人在我军面前就像热锅上的一块黄油般消融。

column1: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. Italy remains firmly in our camp, and the invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
column2: 将军阁下，你和你的勇士们再一次使我们免于坠入灾难的边缘。意大利仍牢牢留在我们阵营，入侵者已被逐出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份厚重的恩情。

column1: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. The invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
column2: 将军阁下，你和你英勇的部队再一次把我们从灾难边缘拉了回来。入侵者已被赶出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份大恩。

column1: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen.  You must break through along the Volokolamsk Highway.   There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
column2: 将军阁下，我们对莫斯科的推进相当顺利，但敌军抵抗日益顽强。您必须沿沃洛科拉姆斯克公路实施突破。毫无疑问，敌人必将投入其最精锐的部队保卫首都，但我们定能坚持到底。

column1: Herr General, Patton's Third Army has crossed the Moselle and its armor is probing toward the Saar. You will counterattack at once with the panzer reserves, smash the American spearheads around Arracourt and throw them back across the river.
column2: 将军阁下，巴顿(Patton)的第3集团军已渡过摩泽尔河(Moselle)，其装甲矛头正向萨尔(Saar)方向推进。你须立即率装甲预备队发起反击，粉碎阿拉库尔(Arracourt)地域的美军矛头，把他们赶回到河对岸。

column1: Herr General, Sea Lion has succeeded beyond expectation: London is encircled and the British army is falling back in disorder. Your panzers now drive into the Midlands to seize Birmingham and the industrial heart of England before the enemy can form a new front.
column2: 将军阁下，「海狮」的成功超乎预期：伦敦(London)已被合围，英军正溃不成军地后撤。你的装甲集群现在挺进中部地区，赶在敌人重组战线之前，夺取伯明翰(Birmingham)与英格兰的工业心脏。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。我相信你会干得非常出色。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，塔尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。

column1: Herr General, that was a very close thing.
column2: 将军阁下，那次真是千钧一发。

column1: Herr General, that was done by the narrowest of margins.  This offensive has just begun; you are in danger of falling behind schedule.
column2: 将军阁下，这次只是以极微弱的优势完成的。这场攻势才刚刚开始，你有落后于时间表的危险。

column1: Herr General, the 1st and 2nd Belorussian Fronts threaten Vilna, Riga and the Reich itself in East Prussia. You should defend the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!!
column2: 将军阁下，白俄罗斯第1与第2方面军威胁维尔纳(Vilna)、里加(Riga)，以及东普鲁士(East Prussia)的本土本身。你应当保卫本土的神圣土地！！！

column1: Herr General, the Allies are holding Aachen and they are using it as a communications and supply center.  This objective is critical to our winter offensive we have been planning.  Capture it so we may drive them back to the coast!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军据守着亚琛(Aachen)，把它当作通信与补给中心。这一目标对我们筹划已久的冬季攻势至关重要。拿下它，我们就能把他们赶回海边！

column1: Herr General, the Allies are in disarray!  Seize Antwerpen and end this war!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军一片混乱！夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)，结束这场战争！

column1: Herr General, the Allies are totally surprised.  The capture of Liege has provided a windfall of supplies.  Take your second objective now!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军完全措手不及。夺取列日(Liege)带来了意外的补给收获。现在去拿下你的第二个目标！

column1: Herr General, the British have successfully embarked their Expeditionary Force and the French continue to resist.
column2: 将军阁下，英国人已成功让他们的远征军登船，而法国人仍在抵抗。

column1: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await our attack.  Your presence is requested else where leave this rabble to us and we'll end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，敌人打得英勇，但这并没有挡住你。而现在，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着我们去进攻。别处需要你去——把这群乌合之众交给我们，我们会结束这场战争。

column1: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await our attack.  Your presence is requested else where leave this rabble to us and we'll end this war.
Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

column1: Herr General, the II SS Panzer Corps drives on Prokhorovka to rip open the southern face of the Kursk salient. The Soviet 5th Guards Tank Army is rushing to meet you head-on. Win this armored clash and the salient lies open.
column2: 将军阁下，亲卫队第2装甲军正向普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)突击，以期撕开库尔斯克(Kursk)突出部的南面。苏军近卫第5坦克集团军正迎面扑来。赢下这场装甲对决，突出部就将门户大开。

column1: Herr General, the invasion of France has begun.  Your force will move swiftly and quietly through the Ardennes and attack the French where they least expect.
column2: 将军阁下，入侵法国已经开始。你的部队将迅速而隐蔽地穿过阿登(Ardennes)，在法国人最意料不到之处发起攻击。

column1: Herr General, The Russians are trying to cross the Dnepr river, the last barrier to Western Ukraine. You should prevented this. You will need your bridging units !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)，这是通往西乌克兰(Ukraine)的最后一道屏障。你应当阻止这件事。你会需要你的架桥部队！！！

column1: Herr General, the Russians during Operation Zitadelle took the Orel Bulge. After your victory there you need to retake Orel to stabilize Army Group Center front.
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人在「堡垒」行动(Operation Zitadelle)期间夺取了奥廖尔突出部。你在那里取胜之后，需要夺回奥廖尔(Orel)，以稳住中央集团军群的战线。

column1: Herr General, the time has come to eliminate the British fortress of Malta once and for all. General Student's paratroops will drop onto the northern airfields while the assault convoys close in from the sea. Take the island and open the sea lanes to Africa.
column2: 将军阁下，彻底拔除马耳他(Malta)这座英国要塞的时机已经成熟。施图登特(Student)将军的空降兵将伞降夺取岛北各机场，突击船队同时从海上逼近。夺取该岛，打通通往非洲的海上航道。

column1: Herr General, the time has come to invade the British islands, your troops embark on Calais, along with other three division embarked on Boulogne-sur-Mer, both have to confront the enemy.
column2: 将军阁下，入侵不列颠诸岛的时刻到了。你的部队在加来(Calais)上船，另三个师在滨海布洛涅(Boulogne-sur-Mer)上船，两路都须与敌人交锋。

column1: Herr General, the Western Allies have landed in Normandy. We need to drive them to the sea !!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已在诺曼底(Normandy)登陆。我们得把他们赶下海去！！！

column1: Herr General, this defeat is out of the question, thanks to your stupidity the whole plan was unsuccessful.
column2: 将军阁下，这次失败绝不可容忍，多亏你的愚蠢，整个计划都未成功。

column1: Herr General, this is a disaster! Sixth Army is entirely lost to us.  Though this situation is not totally of your making, your career is obviously finished. You are dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，这是一场灾难！第6集团军已彻底损失。尽管这一局面并不完全由你造成，你的仕途显然已经结束。你被解职。

column1: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is ours.  It is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted.  Berlin is beautiful in the summer.  Enjoy yourself.
column2: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得大力褒奖。南方战线现已稳固，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰已归我们所有。我很高兴通知你，你的休假申请已获批准。夏日的柏林很美。尽情享受吧。

column1: Herr General, though able to achieve some limited success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us.
column2: 将军阁下，你虽取得了一些有限的成功，却没有展现出对德军战地指挥官所要求的主动性。你被期望做到的，不止是服从命令。布尔什维克仍在抗拒我们。

column1: Herr General, though you shamed the Wehrmacht with your miserable performance against the Poles, other recent victories have put the General Staff in a forgiving mood.  You have been granted another chance to lead an attack against our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 将军阁下，尽管你对付波兰人时的糟糕表现让国防军蒙羞，但近来的其他胜利让总参谋部心情宽宥。你获准再有一次机会，领导对我们宿敌法国的进攻。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

column1: Herr General, we are now at the second stage of our French campaign. Our victory here will cut off the French from their British allies. Good luck to you.
column2: 将军阁下，我们现在进入法国战役的第二阶段。我们在此取胜，就能把法国人与他们的英国盟友隔开。祝你好运。

column1: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of
column2: 将军阁下，我们有一个绝佳的机会给敌人一记重击——就在这里，斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)以北。如你所见，美军第3集团军的推进已使该段

column1: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland. Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，我们有一个绝佳的机会给敌人一记重击——就在这里，斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)以北。如你所见，美军第3集团军的推进已使该段防线防御空虚。你若能如利刃般直插斯特拉斯堡，美英两国就不得不停止向本土推进。祝好运！

column1: Herr General, we have arrived to our first important goal in our part of the operation; the assault on Bristol. The British are trying to make a defensive line here, using Bristol as an important reference point. Surely, we will face a harder resistance here than in the first days of the invasion. Fortunately, huge LuftWaffe formations will support us in order to suppress these heavy resistance into the streets of Bristol, as well as the 7th FJ Division of General Student, which is coming from the sea to take the British by surprise from their back. Intelligence reports that maybe the British Home Guard are hiding supplies into the nearly forests with the aim to make some skirmishes on our supply lines while we attack Bristol, so be aware about this. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，我们已到达我们这部分作战的第一个重要目标：突击布里斯托尔(Bristol)。英国人正试图在此建立一道防线，把布里斯托尔当作重要的基准点。我们在此遭遇的抵抗必定比入侵头几天更顽强。幸运的是，庞大的德国空军编队将支援我们，以压制布里斯托尔街巷中的顽强抵抗；施图登特(Student)将军的第7伞兵师也将从海上赶来，从背后出其不意地打击英国人。情报报告说，英国本土防卫队可能把补给藏在附近的森林里，意图在我们进攻布里斯托尔时袭扰我们的补给线，所以要当心这一点。祝你好运。

column1: Herr General, we have broken our teeth on the enemy defenses. The Bolsheviks are counterattacking all along our front. Army Group South has been shaken and must give ground. General Hoth will be assuming your duties. That is all.
column2: 将军阁下，我们在敌军防线上碰得头破血流。布尔什维克正沿我全线反扑。南方集团军群已经动摇，不得不后撤。霍特将军将接替你的职务。就这样吧。

column1: Herr General, we have crossed the English Channel departing from Le Havre, and now we are in front of Portsmouth, we must make a beach head here as quickly as possible, the Royal Navy is heading to Portsmouth in order to smash us, however, Kriegsmarine ships, Gneisenau, Admiral Scheer and Koeln will help us too!. Our main goals here are the following: at first Portsmouth and the Isle of Wight, then the city of Southampton. The 22nd FJ Division is here to support us, their mission is to take the Isle of Wight, however, you can change those plans if needed. Two LuftWaffe's Squadrons are above us, and they will show the British what the LuftWaffe is capable of with valuable air support, also, you could test our new amphibious Panzers!, we have just dropped them into the water, and now they are rumbling under the sea to the Isle of Wight!. Good Luck!
column2: 将军阁下，我们已从勒阿弗尔(Le Havre)出发渡过英吉利海峡(English Channel)，现在我们正面对着朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)，我们必须尽快在此建立滩头阵地；皇家海军正驶向朴茨茅斯，想把我们砸碎，不过德国海军的舰只——格奈森瑙号(Gneisenau)、舍尔海军上将号(Admiral Scheer)与科隆号(Koeln)——也会来帮我们！我们这里的主要目标如下：首先是朴茨茅斯与怀特岛(Isle of Wight)，然后是南安普敦(Southampton)城。第22伞兵师在此支援我们，他们的任务是夺取怀特岛，不过如有需要，你可以改变这些计划。我们上空有两个德国空军中队，他们将用宝贵的空中支援让英国人见识德国空军的本事；此外，你也可以检验我们新型两栖装甲车！我们刚把它们放下水，现在它们正轰隆隆地在海底下驶向怀特岛！祝你好运！

column1: Herr General, we have the opportunity of hitting the Russians as they move imprudently towards the west.  Do not fail us here Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，我们有机会趁俄国人轻率西进之机打击他们。在这里可别让我们失望，将军阁下！！！

column1: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，彻底包围了第6集团军。你必须向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。

column1: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.                                                    \x00
column2: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河(Don)，将第6集团军彻底合围。你必须向克列茨卡亚(Kletskaya)与谢拉菲莫维奇(Serafimov)推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不、绝不向红军投降；但要守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。                                                    \x00

column1: Herr General, we need your skill and daring once again!
column2: 将军阁下，我们再次需要你的才干与胆识！

column1: Herr General, welcome to Normandy. The British and Americans have assembled a huge force, and they will try to break out.  You must stop them.  Defend the Fatherland at all costs!
column2: 将军阁下，欢迎来到诺曼底(Normandy)。英军与美军已集结起庞大的兵力，他们会试图突围。你必须挡住他们。不惜一切代价保卫本土！

column1: Herr General, Well done!  You handled that counterattack splendidly.
column2: 将军阁下，干得好！你那次反击处理得极为出色。

column1: Herr General, With Bruxelles in our hands we are close to splitting the Allies
column2: 将军阁下，布鲁塞尔(Bruxelles)在我们手中，我们已接近把盟军一分为二

column1: Herr General, with your failure at Kursk, we are forced to remain on the defensive.
column2: 将军阁下，由于你在库尔斯克(Kursk)的失败，我们被迫转入防御。

column1: Herr General, you already know that the enemy has launched an amphibious operation south of Naples, near Salerno. The terrain in this part of Italy is hilly and rugged, and we have been able to contain the enemy beachhead thus far. It is of critical importance that the Americans and British are not allowed to gain a foothold on the continent. We are relying on you and your crack troops to throw the enemy into the sea. Failure here is not an option.
column2: 将军阁下，你已得知敌军在那不勒斯以南、萨莱诺附近发动了两栖行动。意大利这一带地形丘陵起伏、崎岖不平，我们迄今尚能遏制敌军滩头。绝不能让美英在欧洲大陆取得立足点，这一点至关重要。我们仰仗你和你的精锐部队把敌军赶进大海。此处不容有失。

column1: Herr General, you and your 1st SS PanzerKorps will spearhead the winter offensive that will split the British and American forces in Western Europe.  If you succeed, they will sue for peace.  Your first objective is Liege, Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，你和你的党卫军第1装甲军将充当冬季攻势的先锋，把西欧的英美军队一分为二。如果你成功，他们就会求和。你的第一个目标是列日(Liege)，祝好运！

column1: Herr General, you are moving far ahead of schedule.  Excellent!  Start your next attack! Seize Antwerpen and end this war!
column2: 将军阁下，你的进展远超时间表。好极了！开始你的下一次进攻！夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)，结束这场战争！

column1: Herr General, You defeated the Tank Armies that formed the last Russian reserves in this sector. If it wasn't for Hitler, we could drive on to Kursk and accomplish all of our goals.
column2: 将军阁下，你击败了构成俄国人在此段最后预备队的各坦克集团军。若不是希特勒，我们本可继续向库尔斯克推进，完成所有目标。

column1: Herr General, you destroy everything in your path.  It is a tremendous victory !!! Unfortunately the allies broke free elsewhere.
column2: 将军阁下，你一路摧枯拉朽。这是一场巨大的胜利！！！遗憾的是盟军在其他地方突围了。

column1: Herr General, you exceed our expectations!  The Russians are retreating on all fronts.  Prepare for your next objective!
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望！俄国人在各条战线上都在退却。为你的下一个目标做准备！

column1: Herr General, You failed to defeat the Tank Armies that formed the last Russian reserves in this sector.
column2: 将军阁下，你未能击败构成俄国人在此段最后预备队的各坦克集团军。

column1: Herr General, you failed to take V'Az'ma!
column2: 将军阁下，你没能拿下维亚济马(V'Az'ma)！

column1: Herr General, you got to break through the Soviet's iron grip and seize the city of Kursk. Good luck !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你必须打破苏军的铁腕掌控，夺取库尔斯克(Kursk)城。祝好运！！！

column1: Herr General, you have allowed enemy troops to remain on the sacred soil of the Fatherland.
column2: 将军阁下，你竟让敌军留在了祖国神圣的土地上。

column1: Herr General, you have disgraced the Wehrmacht with your conduct of this battle!  Many here demand your return to Berlin to face a court-martial.  Your services will no longer required.
column2: 将军阁下，你在这场战斗中的表现让国防军蒙羞！这里许多人要求你返回柏林接受军事法庭审判。你的效劳不再需要了。

column1: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。

column1: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

column1: Herr General, you have failed.  The British have successfully withdrawn.  We expected more from you.  Dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，你失败了。英军成功撤离了。我们对你的期望更高。解职。

column1: Herr General, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, the Soviet armies have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of beach defenses in Norway.  Dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，你勉强达成了目标。遗憾的是，苏联各集团军得以有序后撤，并在新的防线之后重新集结。你显然患有战斗疲劳症，将被调去监督挪威滩头防御工事的构筑。你被解职。

column1: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须沿波兰边境实施突破并包围敌军，充分利用其机动性不足的弱点。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有敌机阻碍您的推进。速度至关重要；此处的成功推进将使我们得以从北面和东面同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能够在德苏新边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联友军。倘若反过来是苏联人迎接我们，总参谋部绝不会高兴。

column1: Herr General, you must capture the bridge across the Vistula river.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须夺取维斯瓦河(Vistula)上的桥梁。

column1: Herr General, you must clear the banks of the Somme and Authie rivers from enemy soldiers. Near the Authie river location are standing strong enemy positions.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须肃清索姆河与欧蒂河(Authie)两岸的敌军士兵。欧蒂河一带设有坚固的敌军阵地。

column1: Herr General, you must occupy the bridge over Olesznica river and Pyszna river and defend the area.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须占领奥莱斯尼察河与皮什纳河上的桥梁，并防守该地区。

column1: Herr General, you must proceed west towards the coast as quickly as possible.  If you can reach it before June, you will cut the British and French forces in two.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须尽快向西朝海岸推进。如果你能在 6 月前抵达那里，就能把英法军队一分为二。

column1: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，把你如此成功地开始的事业进行到底。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复。现在正是我们把他们赶下海的机会。

column1: Herr General, you must take Obojan so that we can move unhindered towards Kursk.  The attack has stalled everywhere else.  Set an example and inspire the rest of the Wehrmacht to renew their efforts!
column2: 将军阁下，你必须拿下奥博扬(Obojan)，这样我们才能不受阻碍地向库尔斯克(Kursk)推进。其他各地的进攻都已停滞。树立一个榜样，激励国防军其余部队重新奋起！

column1: Herr General, you narrowly accomplished what was expected of you.  Because of this the Soviets held the rail lines long enough for more troops to arrive.  In addition, heavy snows are now falling.  Unfortunately our offensive cannot continue under these conditions.
column2: 将军阁下，你勉强完成了对你的期望。正因如此，苏军把铁路线守得够久，等来了更多部队。此外，现在正下着大雪。遗憾的是，在这样的条件下我们的攻势无法继续。

column1: Herr General, you not only defeated the enemy, but also took their starting positions !!! Unfortunately down south the 3rd and 4th Ukainian Fronts have crossed the Romanian border.
column2: 将军阁下，你不仅击败了敌人，还夺取了他们的出发阵地！！！可惜在南面，乌克兰第3方面军与第4方面军已越过罗马尼亚边境。

column1: Herr General, you succeeded.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective, Moskva.
column2: 将军阁下，你成功了。占领维亚济马(V'Az'ma)对你下一个目标莫斯科(Moskva)至关重要。

column1: Herr General, You've taken Zhytomyr after fierce resistance.
column2: 将军阁下，你在激烈抵抗之后拿下了日托米尔(Zhytomyr)。

column1: Herr General, your bold and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory.  And now the Finnish people have been given the will to face the Soviets with us in future campaigns.  Well done!

column2: 将军阁下，你夺取列日(Liege)已经改变了西线战争的进程。立刻利用这一形势，继续执行你的下一个目标。

column2: 将军阁下，你未能夺取布鲁塞尔(Bruxelles)，这意味着德国的整个命运就押在一次掷骰上！

column2: 将军阁下，你的部队已进入安特卫普(Antwerpen)的攻击距离，那是你的最终目标。现在就拿这座城，击败盟军！！！

Herr General, your victory at Lillehammer allows us an opportunity to crush our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 将军阁下，你在利勒哈默尔的胜利使我们有机会粉碎我们的宿敌法国。他们的军队号称是世界上最精锐的。我们走着瞧！现在，我们相信盟军会以进军比利时来回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率领你的部队穿过阿登地区，出现在敌人后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国成为强国。你在色当的胜利将使德国重获那一地位。

column1: Herr General,... well it would seem your year off has not improved your abilities.
column2: 将军阁下，……看来你这一年的休假并没有提升你的能力。

column1: Herr General. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines. You may leave at once.
column2: 将军阁下。即便此刻，敌军正在向我阵地推进。拿起一支步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。你可以立即离开了。

column1: Herr General. The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.   Unfortunately, some of the enemy has retreated into Romania.  No doubt, we will encounter these tough and vengeful troops again.  There are other repercussions as well.  The British and French have now declared war on Germany.
column2: 将军阁下。危机已过，波兰军队已经崩溃。遗憾的是，部分敌人已撤入罗马尼亚。毫无疑问，我们还会再遇上这些顽强而复仇心切的部队。还有别的后果：英法现已对德宣战。

column1: Herr General. You and your brave men have saved 6th Army.  They will live to fight another day !!!.
column2: 将军阁下。你和你勇敢的部下救了第6集团军。他们还能活下去，改日再战！！！

column1: Herr General. You and your brave men have saved 6th Army.  They will live to fight another day !!!.

Herr General: The 3rd Ukrainian Front has completed surrounded Budapest. The Hungarians and some of our troops resist bravely inside the city.  They can not hold for long. Relieve them Herr General!!!
column2: 将军阁下：乌克兰第3方面军已完成对布达佩斯(Budapest)的包围。匈牙利人和我们的一些部队正在城内英勇抵抗。他们撑不了多久。去解救他们，将军阁下！！！

column1: Herr General: The western allies are about to break through the Monte Cassino area in Central Italy. This will be the end of our front. You should prevent it !!!
column2: 将军阁下：西方盟军即将突破意大利中部的卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)地区。这将是我们的战线的终结。你应当阻止他们！！！

column1: Herr General: You achieved a complete victory !!!. You not only prevented the Russians from crossing the river, you also destroyed their beachheads !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了完全的胜利！！！你不仅阻止了俄军渡河，还摧毁了他们的桥头堡！！！

column1: Herr General: You achieved a great victory !!!. It will take a long time before the Russians can take the offensive here.
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了重大胜利！！！。俄国人要在这里发起攻势还得花很长时间。

column1: Herr General: You achieved victory under extremely difficult conditions. Most of the men of the 17th Army will fight again !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你在极其困难的条件下取得了胜利。第17集团军的多数官兵还能再战！！！

column1: Herr General: Your great victory here has secured the Central Italian front. Our lines are now impregnable !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你在此地的重大胜利确保了意大利中部战线。我们的防线现已固若金汤！！！

column2: 我知道条件一直很艰苦，但你们打得并不好！唯一的好消息是你和你的部队在这种新型装甲战中积累了一些经验。但是，新的西班牙政府以及我们的其他盟国，还没有学会尊重我们所需的军事能力！将军阁下，不要再让我们失望了。

column1: I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some experience in this new type of armored warfare.   But, the new Spanish government and our other allies have not yet learned to respect our military capabilities, which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us again.
column2: 我知道条件艰苦，但你打得很差！唯一的好处是，你和部队在这种新型装甲战中取得了一些经验。可是，新的西班牙政府与我们的其他盟友，还没有学会尊重我们的军事能力——而这正是我们所需要的！将军阁下，不要再让我们失望。

column1: I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  We have been forced to evacuate our troops from Norway. Hopefully you will fare better in the future Commander.
column2: 我知道条件艰苦，但你打得很差！我们已被迫从挪威(Norway)撤走部队。希望今后你能表现得更好，指挥官。

column1: I am confident you are eager to play a major role in the future operations of our Army. That’s why your new mission will be to prepare our forces in Congo to be ready to fight.
column2: 我相信你渴望在我们军队未来的行动中发挥重要作用。因此你的新任务将是整备我们在刚果的部队，使其做好战斗准备。

column1: I am considering proposing you for a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a well-executed counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
column2: 我正在考虑提议为您晋升！您以一次执行出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

column1: I am glad to hear that you have reshuffeled your positions in order to close the gap in our front. It now runs along an imaginairy line from Serafimovitch to Nizhne Chirskaya and so far, it looks alright with remains of the 1st Roumanian Pz supporting Axis troops holding the southern part.
column2: 很高兴得知你已调整了阵地，封住了我们正面的缺口。这条战线现在沿着从谢拉菲莫维奇到下奇尔斯卡亚的一条假想线延伸，目前看来还不错，罗马尼亚第1装甲师残部协同轴心国部队守住了南段。

column1: I am proposing you for a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a brilliant counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
column2: 我提议为您晋升！您以一次出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

column1: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you have acquired.
column2: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

column1: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
column2: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

column1: I congratulate you for you bravery, but sadly it was not possible... you will continue the fight on the Gustav line.
column2: 我祝贺你的勇敢，但遗憾的是这没能成功……你将在古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)继续战斗。

column1: I don't know a diplomatic way to say this, Commander.  You've been canned.  Oh, you'll get a medal and they'll probably call you a hero.  But, you know the truth, and you've got to live with it.
column2: 我不知道该怎么委婉地说，指挥官。你被解职了。哦，你会得到一枚勋章，他们大概还会称你为英雄。但你知道真相，而且你得带着它活下去。

column1: I don't know a diplomatic way to say this, commander. Your performance has been really awful, you will not see again the battlefield for a long time!
column2: 我不知道该怎样委婉地说这件事，指挥官。你的表现真是糟透了，你很长时间内都不会再见到战场了！

column1: I don't like owing the Navy a favor so don't do that again.
column2: 我不喜欢欠海军的人情，所以别再这样了。

column1: I don't think the snow and the bad weather conditions of the Manchurian Winter will be a major problem for you.
column2: 我认为满洲冬季的大雪和恶劣天气不会成为你的主要问题。

column1: I don't think the Soviets know how exposed we are here and have
column2: 我认为苏军不知道我们在这里暴露得多厉害，已经

column1: I had hoped for a deeper penetration General.
column2: 我本希望突入得更深一些，将军。

column1: I had hoped you would have performed better General.
column2: 我本希望你能表现得更好，将军。

column1: I hate to lose you, but I don't have any choice.
column2: 我不愿意失去你，但我别无选择。

column1: I have no choice but to ask for terms.
column2: 我别无选择，只能请求和谈条件。

column1: I have visited the Philippines in the past, and I can say the Lingayen Gulf offers good beachs to disembark your troops, select carefully where you are going to deploy your men, and the victory will be easy and swift. Also, I should say the high command has decided to land some of your troops nothwards from here, so, some of your command will come from the North.
column2: 我过去曾访问过菲律宾，我可以说林加延湾提供了良好的海滩供您的部队登陆，请谨慎选择部署您部下的地点，胜利就会轻松而迅速。另外，我应当说明，高层已决定让您的部分部队在此以北登陆，因此，您的一部分部队将从北方赶来。

column1: I hope you had enough rest from your participation on the Korean War.  As one of the heroes of the PRC the High Command of the PLA has a new mission for you.  The new North American government has retired the fleet that was guarding the Taiwan Strait.  This is the opportunity we have been waiting for; the assault on the rebel province of Taiwan.  You must end the existence of the KMT and its leader, Chiang-Kai-Shek.
column2: 希望你参加朝鲜战争之后已经休息够了。作为中华人民共和国的英雄之一，解放军最高统帅部给你一项新任务。新的北美政府已撤走守卫台湾海峡的舰队。这正是我们一直在等待的机会；进攻叛乱省份台湾。你必须终结国民党的存在及其领袖蒋介石。

column1: I hope you will do better in in your next mission.
column2: 希望您在下一个任务中表现更好。

column1: I hope your boys had a nice rest on the voyage.
column2: 我希望你的小伙子们在航行途中好好休息了。

column1: I know that you are upset and you feel that you've been betrayed by the High Command, but the Afrika Korps will rise again.
column2: 我知道您很沮丧，觉得自己被最高统帅部出卖了，但非洲军终将再度崛起。

column1: I know that you're upset and you feel that you've been betrayed by the High Command, but the Afrika Korps will rise again.
column2: 我知道你心里不痛快，觉得被最高统帅部出卖了，但非洲军团会重新站起来的。

column1: I know the Germans have given you a hard stroke but you have received as reinforcements our elite troops and you should have performed much better. I am afraid you should look for new challenges.
column2: 我知道德军给了您沉重一击，但您得到了我们的精锐部队作为增援，本应表现得更好。恐怕您该去找新的挑战了。

column1: I know the situation is dramatic and our troops are exhausted but I was expecting much more from you as commander.
column2: 我知道局势十分严峻，我们的部队已经精疲力竭，但作为指挥官我对你的期望要高得多。

column1: I know things have been quiet for you for the last few months, but you are needed now so I hope your men are ready.
column2: 我知道过去几个月你那边一直很平静，但现在需要你了，所以我希望你的部下已做好准备。

column1: I know this decision is difficult to understand since its means losing both Antwerpen/Anvers and Bruxelles/Brussel and leaving our strong positions at the "KW line" (Dyle position), but we have to be confident in our allies. The retreat will start in the night of the 17th/18th of May. You must ensure the IV and V Corps retreat to the new positions behind the Escaut/Scheldt river and stop the Germans over it to give time for the redeployment. Our army depots have also to be moved.
column2: 我知道这一决定难以理解，因为它意味着既要放弃安特卫普和布鲁塞尔，又要放弃我们在“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的坚固阵地，但我们必须信任盟友。撤退将于5月17日至18日夜间开始。您必须确保第4军和第5军撤往斯海尔德河后方的新阵地，并把德军阻止在河对岸，以便争取重新部署的时间。我军仓库也必须转移。

column1: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will check the German advance there.
column2: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们能在那里阻止德军前进。

column1: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will fight until our last round there.
column2: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们会在那里战斗到最后一弹。

column1: I know your forces are in need of a rest, nevertheless we must press on to Kyiv at once!
column2: 我知道你的部队需要休整，但我们仍必须立刻向基辅(Kyiv)推进！

column1: I must say, I do find it hard to believe that you secured a King's commission.  I believe promotion by purchase was banned in the last century. Your name, sir, shall be stricken from your regiment's otherwise honorable rolls.  Your services will no longer be required.
column2: 我得说，我实在难以相信你竟获得了国王的委任状。我相信买官晋职在上个世纪就被禁了。长官，你的名字将从你所在团原本光荣的名册上划掉。我们不再需要你的效劳。

column1: I need you to drive north, take the Seelowe Heights and hold them.
column2: 我要你向北推进，夺取塞洛高地(Seelowe Heights)并守住它。

column1: I need you to get down there and deal with it.
column2: 我需要你到那里去处理掉它。

column1: I recognize you have friends in Berlin, but keep this level of performance up and even they won't be able to save you.
column2: 我承认你在柏林有朋友，但你要是继续保持这种表现，连他们也救不了你。

column1: I should notice you, that due to the high number of units crossing the Ardenne forest, some Panzer units are still in the way, and will arrive in the next hours.
column2: 我应当提醒你，由于穿越阿登森林的部队数量太多，一些装甲部队还堵在路上，将在接下来几小时内到达。

column1: I suggest you do not fail me again.
column2: 我建议你不要再让我失望。

column1: I suggest you have that meeting further to the west.
column2: 我建议你把那场会面安排得更靠西一些。

column1: I think it would be good to place an article in the FAZ stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
column2: 我认为最好在《法兰克福汇报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

column1: I understand that the German Nationalist troops performed very well. The new tank was a great success.
column2: 我了解到德国民族主义部队表现非常好。新型坦克大获成功。

column1: I understand your trepidation at serving under the Americans, however they are our Allies and they do need your help. They will doubtless use your men in subsidiary roles and take the glory for themselves. They do not seem to trust us as much as they should, however I trust you to work with the Americans and make us proud.
column2: 我理解你在美国人手下服役的忐忑，但他们是我们的盟友，而且确实需要你的帮助。他们无疑会派你的部下担任次要角色，却把功劳据为己有。他们似乎不像应有的那样信任我们，但我相信你能与美国人合作，让我们感到骄傲。

column1: I was completely wrong about you and maybe also with your friend Zhou, hmmm or maybe not.  I think China deserves a return to the true Revolution to avoid the capitalist deformation that you have suffered.
column2: 我看错你了，也许也看错了你的朋友周，嗯，也许没有。我认为中国应当回归真正的革命，以避免你所沾染上的资本主义蜕变。

column1: I will be keeping my eye on you.  Do not fail us again!
column2: 我会盯着你。不要再让我们失望！

column1: I will give you one more chance to prove yourself. Do not disappoint us again.
column2: 我再给你一次证明自己的机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: I will give you one more chance to prove yourself. Do not dissapoint us again.
column2: 我再给你一次证明自己的机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: I will have to send someone else who is more competent to get the job done.
column2: 我只好另派一个更能干的人去把这件差事办成。

column1: I would have liked for more time, but this will have to do
column2: 我本想要更多时间，但也只能这样了

column1: I would invite you to tea Commander, but, there is simply no time.  My apologies.  Here is the situation. The Germans have held the fortress city of Metz for two months against American attacks, and now the Yanks have requested our help.  Our troops must  smash Jerry's resistance, then punch through the Maginot Line. Metz is the site of the German training schools for officers and NCOs, so you can expect a tough fight.  This mission is crucial, Commander.  You must act decisively.
column2: 指挥官，我本想请你喝茶，但实在没有时间。抱歉。情况是这样的。德军已顶住美军的进攻，守住了梅斯(Metz)这座要塞城市两个月，现在美国佬请求我们援助。我们的部队必须粉碎德国佬的抵抗，然后打穿马奇诺(Maginot)防线。梅斯是德军军官与军士训练学校所在地，所以你可以预料到会有一场硬仗。这次任务至关重要，指挥官。你必须果断行动。

column1: I'll bet Zhukov wishes he was never sent East.
column2: 我敢打赌，朱可夫(Zhukov)一定希望自己从没被派到东部去。

column1: I'll keep them bottled up, you head West
column2: 我会把他们封死在里面，你向西推进

column1: I'm giving you the top job in this sector.
column2: 我要把这一地段最重要的差事交给你。

column1: I'm impressed, you earned your pay. Now we've got some elbow room, which means we can break out of Normandy and get to work liberating France.  Commander, we need you over in Caen.  The Krauts have really dug in there and we need someone who can kick some tail so we can get a move on.
column2: 我很佩服，你这薪水挣得真不亏。现在我们有了些回旋余地，这意味着我们可以冲出诺曼底(Normandy)，动手解放法国了。指挥官，我们需要你去卡昂(Caen)。德国佬在那里真的挖壕固守了，我们需要一个能踢他们屁股的人，好让我们继续推进。

column1: I'm impressed.  Boy, you really earned your pay.  Now we've got some elbow room, which means we can get to work liberating France. Commander, I've got a special job for you. We need you over in Caen. The Krauts have really dug in there and we need someone who can kick some tail so we can get a move on.
column2: 我很佩服。好小子，你真对得起你的军饷。现在我们有了些回旋余地，这意味着我们可以动手解放法国了。指挥官，我有个特别任务给你。我们需要你去卡昂(Caen)。德国佬在那里真的挖壕固守了，我们需要一个能踢他们屁股的人，好让我们继续推进。

column1: I'm impressed. Boy, you really earned your pay. The Krauts never knew what hit them. Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you!
column2: 我刮目相看了。小子，你这薪水挣得真不亏。那些德国佬到死都不知道是什么打中了他们。是啊，多亏了你，我们的处境真不错！

column1: I'm really impressed by your skills!, the defensive lines established by the British here have been completely overrun and all the goals have been captured, also, the supply lines with the South have been secured... and now we can drive to London!.
column2: 你的本领让我大为赞叹！英国人在这里建立的防线已被彻底突破，所有目标都已夺取，与南面的补给线也已确保……现在我们可以向伦敦(London)推进了！

column1: I'm sure you remember the battle we fought here to open a supply route into Poland. Well, it turns out it was a big mistake to wait to attack Berlin. Soviet forces in Germany, desperate, encircled and low on supplies, have launched a counter-attack with what's left of their forces.You'll have to defend your base in this area and eventually lead a counter-attack into Berlin. Good luck.
column2: 我相信你还记得我们为打通通往波兰的补给线而在此打的那一仗。结果证明，迟迟不进攻柏林是个大错。德国境内那些绝望、被围、补给不足的苏军部队，已用残部发起反击。你必须守住你在此地的基地，最终率部反攻柏林。祝好运。

column1: I'm sure your pitiful excuse for failing to take Zhytomyr will prove quite amusing.
column2: 我敢肯定，你为没能夺取日托米尔(Zhytomyr)找的那套可怜借口会相当有趣。

column1: I'm surprised that your men have let you down this way Bob, maybe they are not yet ready for action.
column2: 我很意外你的部下竟然这样让你失望，鲍勃(Bob)，也许他们还没准备好上阵。

column1: I./36 / Stoluft XXII / XIX (mot.) AK / Gr. Kleist/
column2: I./36/第22航空联络参谋部/第19摩托化军/克莱斯特集群/
I/49/第26军航空联络部/第26军/第18集团军

column1: I/295e RI / 55e DI / Xe CA / 2e Armée / GA 1
column2: I/295步兵团/55步兵师/第10军/第2集团军/第1集团军群

column1: If it was not for the Americans you would have failed completely, this is not a performance we expected of you - unfortunately I will have to remove you from your command.
column2: 要不是有美国人，你早就彻底失败了；这不是我们期望你有的表现——很遗憾，我不得不解除你的指挥权。

column1: If Ivan gets through the Fulda Gap, he'll take Frankfurt and we'll have no place to stop him before the Rhine.
column2: 如果伊万穿过富尔达缺口，他就会拿下法兰克福(Frankfurt)，而在莱茵河(Rhine)之前我们再也无处阻他。

column1: If possible we will send in some air support to soften up the defenders.
column2: 如果可能，我们会派一些空中支援，削弱守军。

column1: If the situation were not so desperate, I would shoot you myself!
column2: 要不是局势如此绝望，我会亲手枪毙你！

column1: If this is the way you handle your forces, I do not think your PanzerKorps will be required for the final battle against the French.
column2: 如果你就是这样使用你的部队，我认为对法国的最后一战不需要你的装甲军了。

column1: If we accquire Massawa's Port, all of Eriatrea will be ours. The Africans won't have any choice but surrender prior to receiving supplies. Beware, some ships of Royal Navy are defending the Port.
column2: 若我们夺取马萨瓦港，整个厄立特里亚都将属于我们。非洲人在得不到补给的情况下除了投降别无选择。当心，皇家海军的一些舰艇正在守卫该港。

column1: If we acquire Massawa's Port, all the Erythrea will be ours, so Afrikans won't have any choice but surrender prior to receive supplies. Beware, some ships of Royal Navy are defending the Port.
column2: 如果我们拿下马萨瓦(Massawa)港，整个厄立特里亚(Erythrea)就都是我们的了，非洲人除了在获得补给之前投降别无选择。当心，皇家海军的一些舰艇正在守卫该港。

column1: If we can get their first, we'll cut their supply lines.
column2: 如果我们能先赶到那里，就能切断他们的补给线。

column1: If we can take it, we can use it for a base for further operations.
column2: 如果我们能拿下它，就可以把它用作后续作战的基地。

column1: If we don't breakthrough Ivan's lines, the Brits will not be able to hold.
column2: 如果我们不突破伊万的战线，英国人将守不住。

column1: If we get past them, we'll be out of the Urals and into European Russia.
column2: 只要我们越过他们，就能走出乌拉尔山(Urals)，进入俄罗斯欧洲部分。

column1: If we move fast, we can cut off two whole fronts.
column2: 如果我们行动迅速，就能切断整整两个方面军。

column1: If you archieve a brillant victory, your will attack the Anzio's beach (fiction).
column2: 你若取得辉煌胜利，你将进攻安齐奥海滩（虚构）。

column1: If you archieve a victory, you will choose retreat and follow the historical path.
column2: 你若取得胜利，你将选择撤退，走历史的老路。

column1: If you are here it is because you have tried to eliminate the Anzio beachhead.
column2: 你之所以在这里，是因为你曾试图清除安齐奥(Anzio)滩头。

column1: If you are skillful, you will fight in Afrika, Russia, and even England!
column2: 如果您足够娴熟，您将转战非洲、俄国，甚至英格兰！

column1: If you are successful here they won't have another chance, leaving them no option but to surrender to us.

column1: In 1936 Belgium started its policy of "Armed Independence", a policy supported by the majority of the Belgian people. As a consequence of the inability of France and Britain to react when Germany re-occupied the Rhine-land and the French refusal to extend the Maginot Line at the Belgian-French border (thus inviting the Germans to attack France through Belgium), Belgium put an end to the mutual defence pacts and decided to rely on its own armed forces to guarantee its independence. As a result at the outbreak of war Belgium had the best prepared army in its history, having spent 25% of the annual national budget on the military.
column2: 1936年，比利时开始推行“武装独立”政策，这一政策得到大多数比利时民众的支持。由于德国重新占领莱茵兰时法国和英国无力作出反应，以及法国拒绝将马奇诺防线延伸至比利时-法国边界（这无异于邀请德国取道比利时进攻法国），比利时终止了共同防御条约，决定依靠自身武装力量来保障独立。因此，战争爆发时比利时拥有其历史上准备最充分的军队，年度国家预算的25%用于军事。

column1: In 1939, France and Britain unilaterally guaranteed Belgium independence. Although there was no official coordination of military plans secret contacts were held. France and Britain would march into Belgium and take positions on the Dyle River (plan D) in case of a German attack. Therefore the Belgians had made this river their main defence line although it meant giving up half of their country.
column2: 1939年，法国和英国单方面保证比利时的独立。尽管双方没有官方的军事计划协调，但仍保持着秘密接触。一旦德国发动进攻，法国和英国将开进比利时并在戴尔河一线占领阵地（D计划）。因此比利时人把这条河作为主要防线，尽管这意味着放弃半个国家。

column1: In 1941 the Italian Army was unable to face the Brits in Africa. After a year of disasters, they called for help to his German allies. column2: 1941 年，意大利陆军在非洲无力对抗英国人。灾祸连连一年之后，他们向自己的德国盟友求援。德国无法在北非对英国人放手不管，遂于 1941 年 2 月 12 日把隆美尔(Rommel)将军连同第一批德国装备与人员派往的黎波里(Tripoli)。

column1: In 1941 the Italian Army was unable to face up to the British in Africa. After a year of disasters, they called for help from their German allies. Germany couldn't spare many resources to fight the British in Africa, so on February 12th 1941 they sent General Rommel plus the first German equipment and men to Tripoli.
column2: 1941年，意大利军队在非洲无力对抗英军。经历了一年的惨败之后，他们向德国盟友求援。德国抽不出多少资源在非洲与英军作战，于是在 1941年2月12日把隆美尔将军以及第一批德国装备和人员派往的黎波里。

column1: In 1943 there were sharp divisions among the German high command on whether an offensive on the Eastern Front should be launched that year.  Heinz Guderian, recently called back to active duty was of the opinion that Germany would only be able to go on the offensive again in 1944, as the divisions were much too weak presently to go on the attack.  Von Manstein on the other hand, believed it essential to deal the Red Army a series of powerful blows and to remove the threat to the Ukraine and Crimea.  After months of deliberation, Hitler decided to chase one more big victory in Russia, 'that will shine like a beacon around the world'.  This would be known as 'Operation Zitadelle'.
column2: 1943 年，德军最高统帅部内部就是否当年在东线发起一次攻势产生了尖锐分歧。新近被召回现役的海因茨·古德里安(Heinz Guderian)认为，德国要到 1944 年才能再次转入进攻，因为各师目前过于虚弱，无法发起进攻。而冯·曼施坦因则认为，必须给红军一连串有力打击，并消除对乌克兰与克里米亚的威胁。经过数月斟酌，希特勒决定在俄国再追取一次大胜，「它将像灯塔一样照耀全世界」。这次行动将被称为「堡垒行动」(Operation Zitadelle)。

column1: In December 1944 Mussolini wanted to make an offensive operation in order to raise the morale of his armies and make some kind of propaganda. The German Italian relitionship was delicate at this time, so OKW decided to follow Mussolini's plan. It was also hoped that the attack could have the benefit of attracting Allied units, which were pushing towards Bologna.
column2: 1944 年 12 月，墨索里尼(Mussolini)想发动一次攻势行动，以提振其军队的士气并做些宣传。此时德意关系十分微妙，因此国防军最高统帅部(OKW)决定依从墨索里尼的计划。当时还希望这次进攻能带来吸引盟军部队的好处——盟军当时正向博洛尼亚(Bologna)推进。

column1: In early March, the weakened divisions of von Manstein were smashed by a mighty assault by the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts between the Carpathian mountains and the Pripet marshes.  The Leibstandarte, fighting as part of the 24th Panzer Corps, was unable to stem the tide and by the 15th was all but annihilated - less than 1,250 men remained.  In the last week of the month, together with 4th Panzer Army it was encircled at Kamenets-Podolski.  The remains of the Leibstandarte fought out of the pocket and by mid-April had reached German lines.
column2: 3 月初，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)被削弱的各师在喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian mountains)与普里皮亚季沼泽(Pripet marshes)之间遭到乌克兰第1、第2与第3方面军(1st, 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts)的强大突击而崩溃。作为第24装甲军一部分作战的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)无法遏止这股洪流，到 15 日几乎被全歼——剩余不到 1,250 人。当月最后一周，它与第4装甲集团军一起在卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基(Kamenets-Podolski)被合围。警卫旗队的残部杀出包围圈，到 4 月中旬抵达德军防线。

column1: In February 1941, the Leibstandarte was transferred from Metz to Campalung in Romania, in response to the crisis in the Balkans.  The brigade was placed under the command of XIV Corps, 12th Army, in preperation for the upcoming campaign 'Operation Marita' - the invasion of Greece.  Following a pro-Allied coup de'etat in Yugoslavia however, access to the Greek border was blocked.  In response Hitler ordered 'Operation Strafe', another campaign against Yugoslavia to run concurrent with Marita.  The LSSAH moved once again to Temesvar in Bulgaria.
column2: 1941 年 2 月，为应对巴尔干危机，警卫旗队从梅斯调往罗马尼亚的肯帕隆(Campalung)。该旅被置于第12集团军第14军指挥之下，为即将到来的「玛丽塔行动」(Operation Marita)——入侵希腊——作准备。然而，南斯拉夫发生了一场亲盟军的政变，通往希腊边界的通道被阻断。作为回应，希特勒下令实施「惩罚行动」，即另一场与玛丽塔行动同时进行的对南斯拉夫作战。警卫旗队再次转移到保加利亚的泰梅什瓦尔(Temesvar)。

column1: In front of the Gustav Line the Germans made another defensive line called the Reinhard Line, a.k.a. "Winter Line". Here the Germans planned to delay the Allied offensive as long as possible with the goal to obtain the largest amount of time in order to strengthen the Gustav Line. The central point in the Reinhard Line was Mignano's throat and the two summits around: Camino mont and Sammucro mont. By the time however the Germans had neither the time nor the men to fortify it...
column2: 在古斯塔夫防线之前，德军又构筑了一道防线，称为莱因哈德防线(Reinhard Line)，又名「冬季防线」。德军打算在此尽可能久地迟滞盟军攻势，以争取最多时间来加强古斯塔夫防线。莱因哈德防线的中心点是米尼亚诺(Mignano)隘口及其周围的两座山峰：卡米诺山(Camino mont)与萨穆克罗山(Sammucro mont)。然而到那时，德军既无时间也无人力去把它筑垒设防……
