column1: In July 1939, the OKH decided to create a unique unit in preparation for the assault on Poland. This unit was officially designated as Panzer-Verbaende Ostpreussen, better known as Panzer Division Kempf. The division was composed of both Heer and Waffen SS units.
column2: 1939年7月，陆军总司令部决定组建一支独特的部队，为进攻波兰做准备。这支部队被正式命名为「东普鲁士装甲部队」，更广为人知的名字是肯普夫装甲师。该师由陆军和武装党卫军两部分单位编成。

column1: In late August 1944 the British 8th Army opened Operation Olive along the Adriatic coast, aiming to rupture the eastern end of the Gothic Line, take Rimini and break out into the Po plain. Hold the ridge lines and the Conca crossings - the Line must not break here.
column2: 1944 年 8 月下旬，英国第8集团军沿亚得里亚海(Adriatic)沿岸发起「橄榄枝」行动(Operation Olive)，企图撕裂哥特防线(Gothic Line)东端、夺取里米尼(Rimini)并突入波河(Po)平原。守住山脊线与孔卡河(Conca)各渡口——防线绝不能在这里被突破。

column1: In Mid August 1944 the British 8th Army was able to cross the Arno River and free Florence. The Germans were unable to confront them and had to retreat to the mountains, where they had some fortifications called the Gothic Line.
column2: 1944 年 8 月中旬，英国第8集团军得以渡过阿尔诺河(Arno)并解放佛罗伦萨(Florence)。德军无力与之对抗，只得退往山区，那里有他们称为哥特防线的一些工事。

column1: In Mola's plan the main goal  was the capture of Madrid.  The North of Spain was a secondary problem at the beginning of the subdivision.  It was soon obvious that Madrid would not fall by a frontal assault. General Mola has selected you as his most trusted officer to spearhead the attacks on the non-loyal northern  provinces of the rebellion.  Then, who knows?
column2: 在莫拉的方案中，首要目标是夺取马德里。在作战划分之初，西班牙北部只是次要问题。但很快就清楚，马德里不会因正面强攻而陷落。莫拉将军已选定你为他最信任的军官，去带头攻击那些不忠于叛军的北方省份。此后会怎样，谁知道呢？

column1: In most cases the retreat of the Belgian army towards the Dyle River succeeded without too much difficulty but for some divisions it was a very hazardous undertaking (e.g. the evacuation of the 3rd and 2nd division from Liege (Luik) or the encirclement of the 14th division at Lummen).
column2: 大多数情况下，比利时军队向迪尔河的撤退都相当顺利，但对某些师而言却极为凶险（例如第3师和第2师从列日撤出，或第14师在吕门被围）。

column1: In November the Leibstandarte was ordered back to the Eastern Front.  It travelled via Lvov to Tarnapol as part of 48th Corps of the 4th Panzer Army, and was rushed east into positions on the southern flank of the Kiev salient for a counter-attack that aimed at Zhitomir, and the Soviet bridgehead on the Dniepr.
column2: 11 月，警卫旗队奉命重返东线。它作为第4装甲集团军第48军的一部，经利沃夫(Lvov)开往塔尔诺波尔(Tarnapol)，随后被紧急调往东面，进入基辅(Kiev)突出部南翼的阵地，准备发起一次以日托米尔和第聂伯河上的苏军桥头堡为目标的反击。

column1: In October 1942, the LSSAH was transfered to Southern France for a spell of occupation duty. During this time, the unit was given a refit and was re-designated a Panzergrenadier Division.  In January 1943, the division was transfered back to the Eastern Front, with the situation of Army Group South verging on the collapse.  In February the division was re-designated once again, this time recieving the status of a Panzer Division.
column2: 1942 年 10 月，警卫旗队被调往法国南部执行一段占领勤务。在此期间，该部队得到整补，并被改称为装甲掷弹兵师。1943 年 1 月，该师被调回东线，当时南方集团军群的局势已濒临崩溃。2 月，该师再次被改称，这一次获得了装甲师的建制。

column1: In past years, Persia was a pro-German country, however in the first days of 1943 the Soviets, aided by some remaining British units who escaped from other fronts, (mainly of the 8th Army), have invaded the country. The King of Persia, Reza Shah (forced by the invaders) has abdicated. Fortunately for us, some Persian army officers, still loyal to Reza Shah, have contacted us offering their help to kick out the Soviets and the British from Persia. Loehr wil now begin to regroup our forces and start a fighting retreat that will probably only end north of Thermopylae. We could off course try to keep the Corinth Canal,but that would expose us to naval gunfire, and be far to dangerous. It is rumoued that your troops, that are not needed in this strategy, will be transferred to France.
column2: 勒尔现在将着手重整我们的部队，开始一场且战且退的撤退，这场撤退大概只会在温泉关以北才告结束。我们当然可以试着守住科林斯运河，但那会使我们暴露在舰炮火力之下，实在太危险。有传言说，这场战略中并不需要的您的部队将被调往法国。
伦敦(London) - 1946 年 4 月 30 日

column1: London is surrounded and we have sent a surrender offer to the British.
column2: 伦敦(London)已被包围，我们已向英国人发出投降提议。

column1: Look Commander, Metz was a tough nut to crack, and you did it.  But, there's a lot of talk at HQ about you right now.  The brass seems to think you could have moved a lot faster than you did.   Don't worry, we'll get them next time.
column2: 听着，指挥官，梅斯(Metz)是块难啃的硬骨头，而你啃下来了。但是现在司令部里有很多关于你的议论。上头似乎认为你本可以推进得快得多。别担心，下次我们会收拾他们。

column1: Looks like the war is over for you!!
column2: 看来这场战争对你来说已经结束了！！
低地国家(Low Countries) - 1945 年 7 月 30 日

column1: LSSAH has departed for Italy. We got their armored vehicles, bringing our Panzer forces up to strength.
column2: 警卫旗队已开赴意大利。我们接收了他们的装甲车辆，使我方装甲部队恢复满编。

column1: LSSAH was attached to XIII Corps, 8th Armee, Army Group South, with the task of defending the left flank of 10th Armee.  In the initial advance the Leibstandarte - a fully motorised unit - was put under the control of the 17th Infantry Division and was assigned the task of forward reconnaissance and the defence of slower moving units.
column2: 警卫旗队(LSSAH)配属给南方集团军群(Army Group South)第8集团军(8th Armee)第XIII军，任务是防守第10集团军(10th Armee)的左翼。在最初的推进中，完全摩托化的警卫旗队被置于第17步兵师指挥之下，受领前沿侦察与掩护较慢部队的任务。

column1: Luckily for me you are being sent with your 1st SS PanzerKorps, via train, to Normandy.
column2: 算我走运，你将率你的党卫军第1装甲军乘火车开赴诺曼底(Normandy)。

column1: Lys river was broken on the 27th May the order was given for a new retreat and Belgian troops evacuated Vinkt. Although some units managed to retreat to their new positions, the situation was dramatic: German breakthroughs everywhere, increasing casualties, lack of supplies, lack of contacts with some units... It was clear that the Belgian army was falling apart. Unlike in 1914 a retreat towards the Ijzer
column2: 利斯河一线被突破后，新的撤退命令下达，比利时部队撤出了芬克特。虽然一些部队成功撤到新阵地，但局势十分严峻：德军处处突破、伤亡不断增加、补给匮乏、与部分部队失去联系……很明显比利时军队正在瓦解。与1914年不同，撤向艾泽尔河
马其诺防线 - 1940 年 5 月 17 日
马奇诺防线(Maginot line)守军 - 1940 年 6 月 19 日

column1: Major Mannheim (Logistics Officer): I have excellent news, sir. We have captured a fully operational Soviet tank, and we have plenty of ammunition to go along with it.
column2: 曼海姆(Mannheim)少校（后勤军官）：我有极好的消息，长官。我们缴获了一辆完全可用的苏军坦克，还有充足的弹药可用。

column1: Major von Beck (Intelligence Officer): Sir, several of Colonel Talvela's units are isolated. Luckily, they have somewhat entrenched themselves and can hold out for some time in case they get discovered. We also have a unit of Fallschirmjager due to arrive in approximately six hours to assist them.
column2: 冯·贝克(von Beck)少校（情报军官）：长官，塔尔韦拉上校的几支部队已被孤立。所幸他们多少构筑了工事，万一被发现也能支撑一段时间。我们还有一支伞兵部队约六小时后抵达，前来支援他们。

column1: Make haste to the coast, Herr General!
column2: 赶快向海岸前进，将军阁下！
马耳他(Malta) - 1945 年 9 月 9 日

column1: Mannheim: Sir, 9.Armee has a captured Soviet tank and artillery piece and asks us not to fire at them.
column2: 曼海姆：长官，第9集团军有一辆缴获的苏军坦克和一门火炮，要求我们不要向它们开火。
向利摩日行军 1944年6月 辉煌胜利
向利摩日行军 1944年6月 失败
向利摩日行军 1944年6月 战术胜利
向利摩日行军 1944年6月 胜利
行军命令(Marching orders) - 1946 年 6 月 6 日

column1: Marshall Zhukov Belorussian fronts have broken the German defenses at Seelow and are about to take Berlin. The Germans counterattack to hold the Russians off.
column2: 朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的白俄罗斯方面军已突破塞洛(Seelow)的德军防线，即将攻取柏林。德军发起反击，以挡住俄军。

column1: Maybe the nuclear bomb dropped on Japan has played a role in the way the Kremlin understands the past agreements...
column2: 也许投在日本的那颗核弹，对克里姆林宫理解过去那些协定的方式起了一定作用……

column1: Me alegra verle de nuevo, Sr. General.  Well, after securing a victory at Guipuzcoa, we must turn our attention to Asturias.  Since July our brave comrades have been suffering under siege from the Reds.  In Gijon, our quarters have been surrounded and our men trapped.  They are rapidly running out of supplies and can barely continue resisting.   So in the future we can only anticipate more bad news from Gijon.  In Oviedo Colonel Aranda has secured the city.   However, the Asturian capital is also under siege and about to fall.
column2: 很高兴再次见到您，将军阁下。我们在吉普斯夸取得胜利之后，必须把注意力转向阿斯图里亚斯。自7月以来，我们勇敢的同志一直遭受赤色分子的围攻。在希洪，我们的营地被包围，弟兄们被困其中。他们的补给正迅速耗尽，几乎无法继续抵抗。因此今后我们只能预料从希洪传来更多坏消息。在奥维耶多，阿兰达上校已控制该城。然而，这座阿斯图里亚斯首府同样被围，即将陷落。

column1: Meanwhile French light troops intervened in the Neufchateau area but were forced to retreat behind the Maas River.
column2: 与此同时，法国轻装部队在讷沙托地区介入，但被迫撤退到马斯河之后。

column1: Meanwhile it has become quite clear that England is no longer a great power. They are bound hand and feet to the Americans, that still insist on an unconditional surrender.
column2: 与此同时，已经十分清楚的是，英国不再是一个大国。它已被美国人牢牢捆住手脚，而美国人仍坚持无条件投降。

column1: Meanwhile, American and French forces will assault and capture the Cassino area.
column2: 与此同时，美军与法军将突击并夺取卡西诺地区。
梅德宁(Medenine) - 1945 年 11 月 21 日
梅利托波尔(Melitopol)反击 - 1941 年 9 月 28 日
马特鲁港 - 1946 年 2 月 1 日

column1: Mersa Matruh is taken!, now, we must continue our drive on to Egypt.
column2: 马特鲁港已被拿下！现在，我们必须继续向埃及推进。

column1: Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that the Operation Hercules will be launched in the next hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding results.
column2: 马特鲁港(Mersa Matruh)已被夺取！最高统帅部想告诉你，「赫拉克勒斯」行动(Operation Hercules)将在数小时后发起，以夺取马耳他岛(Malta)，作为对你卓越战果的奖赏。
墨西拿 - 1945 年 8 月 8 日
梅斯(Metz) - 1945 年 12 月 12 日

column1: Mi General!  We have received an urgent telegram from Burgos:
column2: 将军阁下！我们收到布尔戈斯发来的紧急电报：

column1: Mi general, debo de comunicarle que.  The Republicans have begun attacking our positions at Alava and northwards to Vitoria.  Their main goal is to cut our lines and then attack Vitoria.  This will be very serious if don't take care of it now.
column2: 将军阁下，我必须向您报告。共和派已开始进攻我们在阿拉瓦的阵地，并向北进攻维多利亚。他们的主要目标是切断我们的交通线，然后进攻维多利亚。如果我们现在不处理，这将非常严重。

column1: Migoto!!!   The Chinese forces have suffered a decisive defeat; thousands of enemy units are surrendering to us!  They haven't another choice since their rearguard is blocked by our troops.  Only some pockets of resistance remain in the middle of China, but all their communications with the allies have been cut.
column2: 漂亮！！！中国军队已遭受决定性失败；成千上万的敌军部队正向我们投降！他们别无选择，因为他们的后方已被我军封锁。中国腹地只剩下少数几处抵抗据点，但他们与盟国的一切联系都已被切断。

column1: military capabilities which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us
column2: 军事能力——而这正是我们所需要的！将军阁下，不要让我们失望
明斯克 - 1941 年 6 月 26 日
明斯克 - 1941 年 6 月 30 日
明斯克(Minsk) 1946 - 1946 年 5 月 12 日

column1: Mission accomplished. The retreat was safe and our forces are almost intact.
column2: 任务完成。撤退很安全，我军几乎完好无损。

column1: Mission accomplished. The retreat was safe and our forces are almost intact.
mission. Casablanca is our ultimate objective: expect heavy resistance by the French only there. Also pay attention for the enemy vessels. Good luck.
column2: 任务。卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)是我们的最终目标：只在那里才会遇到法国人的顽强抵抗。另外要留意敌方的舰艇。祝好运。

column1: Mission: The chosen plan is to use two companies of Brandenburger and a battalion of San Marco to infiltrate in the coast of Malta, meanwhile the Raemcke Brigade and Folgore division will fall on the coast, after that, two infantry divisions will arrive by sea.
column2: 任务：选定的方案是用两连勃兰登堡部队和一个圣马可营渗透马耳他海岸，同时拉姆克旅和福尔戈雷师将在海岸实施空降，此后两个步兵师将经海路抵达。
米乌斯河(Mius River) (#3) - 1942 年 1 月 13 日

column1: Model's 9th Army in the North and Kempf's III Panzer Corps on our right flank have not made much progress. Hoth's Fourth Panzer Army has done better and we are now in a position to capture Prokhorovka and extend the bridgehead over the Psel river west of Prokhorovka.
column2: 北面的莫德尔(Model)第9集团军与我们右翼的肯普夫(Kempf)第III装甲军进展不大。霍特(Hoth)的第4装甲集团军干得更好，我们现在有能力夺取普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)，并把桥头堡扩展到普罗霍夫卡以西的普肖尔河(Psel)对岸。
卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)，1944 年 5 月 11 日

column1: Monty assures me that if you hold, he will take Berlin.
column2: 蒙蒂向我保证，只要你守住，他就会拿下柏林。

column1: Monty?, please, come in.  You have heard the news?  Maybe it is best that he did not return from Normandy.  After all, the shame of utter defeat would have been too much for him to bear.
column2: 蒙蒂？请进。你听到消息了吗？也许他没从诺曼底回来反倒是最好的。毕竟，彻底失败的耻辱会让他难以承受。
清剿(Mopping up) - 1946 年 3 月 7 日
莫斯科(Moscow) - 1946 年 7 月 2 日
莫斯科 - 1941 年 11 月 26 日

column1: Most important is Belgrade is captured, but we hoped your SS forces would be able to accomplish this task on their own, without the help from 2 Panzer divisions.
column2: 最重要的是贝尔格莱德已被拿下，但我们本希望你的党卫军部队能独自完成此任务，无需两个装甲师帮忙。

column1: Most of London's defenses are out because they died in Gloucester and Windsor battles, but remember that a big city can eat huge armies like a wolf. Bring down the enemy's morale by taking his most representative symbols, each second counts! You are dismissed!!! GO!!!
column2: 伦敦(London)的大部分防御已经失效，因为他们在格洛斯特(Gloucester)与温莎(Windsor)两场战斗中阵亡了，但要记住，一座大城市能像狼一样吞噬庞大的军队。夺取敌人最具代表性的象征，以此打垮他们的士气，每一秒都至关重要！你可以走了！！！出发！！！

column1: Most of the attacking units are composed of Basque battalions.  We expected this attack from the East via the Mondragon Valley.  Headquarters doesn't think the Basque troops will be able to hold the lines they have established.  Unfortunately at that location we are not prepared to stop their offensive.  So you are ordered to deploy your troops in Alava and stop the enemy offensive as soon as possible.  One more thing, we have numerical air superiority thanks to our German friends, but as you have seen the Republican flown soviet planes are superior to the German planes.  Use your air power carefully.
column2: 进攻部队大多由巴斯克营组成。我们预料到这次进攻会经蒙德拉贡谷地从东面而来。司令部认为巴斯克部队无力守住他们建立的战线。遗憾的是，在那一带我们并未做好阻止他们攻势的准备。因此，你受命在阿拉瓦部署部队，尽快阻止敌军攻势。还有一点，多亏我们的德国朋友，我们在航空兵力上占有数量优势，但如你所见，共和派驾驶的苏联飞机优于德国飞机。请谨慎使用你的空中力量。

column1: Most of the UN forces have escaped and you have suffered heavy causalities.  You, commander, will meet a People's Court to determine if you are a capitalist sympathizer.
column2: 大部分联合国军部队已经逃走，而你遭受了惨重伤亡。指挥官，你将面对人民法庭，以判定你是否是资本主义同情者。

column1: Move your troops by truck to the new front line north of the Waal River and south of the Lower Rhine River, an area known as "The Island". Once in position hold the line at all costs until relieved.
column2: 用卡车把你的部队运到瓦尔河(Waal River)以北、下莱茵河(Lower Rhine River)以南的新战线，这一地区被称为「岛屿」。一旦到位，就要不惜一切代价守住防线，直到有人来换防。

column1: Move your troops through the town of Vierville and down the road to St. Come du Mont.

莫扎伊斯克(Mozhaisk) - 1941 年 10 月 27 日

column1: Mr Churchill, we are withdrawing everything we can over the Nile. We can only hope to hold the line at the Suez Canal. Alexandria and Cario are not defensible with the forces at hand.
column2: 丘吉尔(Churchill)先生，我们正把所有能撤的部队撤过尼罗河(Nile)。我们只能寄望守住苏伊士运河(Suez Canal)一线。以手头的兵力，亚历山大(Alexandria)与开罗(Cario)无法防守。

column1: My best congratulations to you! You've eliminated the Allied disembarkment at Anzio and you've stopped the Allies at the Gustav Line. After so many hard hits and given the proximity of the Normandy landing it is doubtful that the allies will prepare another operation of great magnitudes in Italy. Here ends your campaign - leaving you with the greatest honors.
column2: 我最衷心地祝贺你！你消灭了在安齐奥(Anzio)登陆的盟军，并在古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)挡住了盟军。在遭受如此多打击、又临近诺曼底(Normandy)登陆的情况下，盟军是否会在意大利再筹备一次大规模行动很值得怀疑。你的战役到此结束——留给你的是最高的荣誉。

column1: My commendations, Commander!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well!  Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 我要表彰你，指挥官！在艰苦的条件下，你干得非常好！你的全胜表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: Navy warships will arrive to deal with the Royal Navy.  Good Luck and Banzai!!!!!

The dirty North American invaders and their South Korean allies have smashed the North Koreans.  Kim-Il-Sung was close to a total victory during the past summer, but he didn't protect his rearguard and as you know, the capitalist operation at Inch'on and Seoul has completely defeated the North Korean advance on Pusan.

column1: Nice work General. We are one step closer to Moscow.

Congratulations!  You have been awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 3rd class, it is not a high decoration, but Congratulations anyway.

column2: 既然我们已渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)、突破了俄军防线，第10装甲师将向叶利尼亚(Yelnya)推进，而你的部队受命夺取罗斯拉夫尔(Roslavl)。叶利尼亚将是我们最后向莫斯科(Moscow)推进的起点，罗斯拉夫尔则控制着这一地区的主要道路。

column1: Now the coasts are secured and we can go for the inner oil camps.
column2: 如今海岸已安全，我们可以向内陆的油田进发了。

column2: 现在俄军已发起他们自己的大规模攻势，企图夺取别尔哥罗德。我们被迫把装甲部队投入那里。苏军还在哈尔科夫以东发动了一场规模较小的攻势。您的第22装甲师须不惜一切代价阻止它。

column1: Now we can continue easily towards the major oil reserves in the world, the rear is secure.
column2: 现在我们能轻松地向世界上最大的石油储区推进了，后方已经稳固。

column1: Now we get to go on to the offensive!
column2: 现在该轮到我们进攻了！

column1: Oh, Commander, come on in. Well, it's almost over. We want you to capture the experimental airbase here at Dessau before the Commies can get there and before the Krauts can destroy everything else. Now, there's nothing complicated about this, just get there, fast. Good luck.
column2: 哦，指挥官，请进。嗯，快结束了。我们要你在赤党赶到之前、在德国佬毁掉其他一切之前，夺取德绍(Dessau)这里的实验空军基地。听着，这没什么复杂的，赶到那里就行，要快。祝好运。

column1: Oh, Commander, come on in. Well, it's almost over. We want you to capture the experimental airbase here at Dessau before the Commies can get there and before the Krauts can destroy everything else. Now, there's nothing complicated about this, just get there, fast. Good luck.
column2: 意大利海岸 - 1945 年 10 月 1 日

column1: Oh, shit, "megesz hersz lajos" or something like this, why haven't I learned Hungarian?
column2: 哦，该死，"megesz hersz lajos" 还是别的什么，我怎么就没学匈牙利语呢？

column1: OIL!  That's what we need, and we can get it from the Dutch colonies.  Our supplies of oil are running out, and the high command thinks we desperately need that resource.  We must secure it at all costs to maintain our war against the western powers.
column2: 石油！这正是我们需要的，而我们可以从荷兰殖民地得到它。我们的石油储备即将耗尽，高层认为我们迫切需要这一资源。为了维持对西方列强的战争，我们必须不惜一切代价夺取它。

column1: Okay, Commander, here's the deal.  We've been here for two months now.  We've got to push the Krauts out of Metz.  Once we've done that, we can smash through the Maginot Line and drive into Germany.  I'm counting on you and your men.  Good luck.
column2: 好，指挥官，事情是这样。我们到这里已经两个月了。我们必须把德国佬赶出梅斯(Metz)。一旦做到，我们就能突破马奇诺防线(Maginot Line)，直入德国。我指望你和你的部下。祝好运。

column1: Omedetogozaimasu!  The enemy garrison was overrun by your glorious troops.  Now Darwin will be our beach head in this country.  Be ready to continue the penetration to the South.
column2: 恭喜！敌军守备部队已被您光荣的部队击溃。如今达尔文将成为我们在这个国家的滩头阵地。请做好准备，继续向南挺进。

column1: Omedetogozaimasu!, althougth the mission was a hard one, you have achieved great success. The Allies will take time to reorganize themselves.
column2: 恭喜！尽管任务艰巨，您仍取得了巨大成功。盟军需要时间来重整旗鼓。

column1: Omedetogozaimasu!, the operation has been a complete success, now you can embark your units...
column2: 恭喜！行动取得了圆满成功，现在您可以登船撤离部队了……

column1: On 11th July, Leibstandarte took over the Caen sector from the seriously depleted Hitlerjugend.  Here, over the coming week it played its most crucial role in the Normandy battles.  Beginning on 17th July, three British armoured divisions attempted to break through the gap between Caen and the eastern heights, across a small bridgehead over the Orne River and through the four lines of man-made and natural defences, then across the hills of Bourgebus and to the open ground beyond.
column2: 7 月 11 日，警卫旗队从损耗严重的「希特勒青年团」师手中接过卡昂地段。在此后一周里，它在这里扮演了诺曼底战役中最关键的角色。从 7 月 17 日开始，三个英国装甲师试图突穿卡昂与东部高地之间的缺口，越过奥恩河(Orne)上的一处小桥头堡，穿过四道人工与天然防御线，再越过布尔格比(Bourgebus)丘陵，直抵其后的开阔地。

column1: On 13 May, the German XIX Army Corps forced three crossings near Sedan, executed by the motorised infantry regiments of 1st, 2nd and 10th Panzerdivision, reinforced by the elite Grossdeutschland infantry regiment. Instead of slowly massing artillery as the French expected, the Germans concentrated most of their tactical bomber force to punch a hole in a narrow sector of the French lines by carpet bombing. Hermann Goring had promised Guderian that there would be an extraordinary heavy air support of a continual eight hour air attack, from 8am until dusk...
column2: 5月13日，德军第19军在色当附近强渡，由第1、第2、第10装甲师的摩托化步兵团在精锐的大德意志步兵团加强下实施。德军没有像法军预料的那样缓慢集结炮兵，而是将大部战术轰炸机兵力集中，以地毯式轰炸在法军防线的一个窄段撕开缺口。赫尔曼·戈林曾向古德里安承诺，将从清晨8点至黄昏持续8小时，提供异常猛烈的空中支援……

column1: On 15th November, Army Group South had reached the Don River, the last natural obstacle before Stalingrad.  A penetration of some 600 miles into Soviet territory had been accomplished, in five months of bitter fighting.  The Leibstandarte was now transferred to the command of III Corps, 1st Panzer Army, and on the 17th began the attack on Rostov from the Black Sea coast.
column2: 11 月 15 日，南方集团军群已抵达顿河——斯大林格勒之前的最后一道天然障碍。经过五个月的苦战，已向苏联领土纵深突入约 600 英里。警卫旗队此时被转隶第1装甲集团军第3军指挥，并于 17 日从黑海沿岸发起对罗斯托夫的进攻。

column1: On 18th April the division was sent to France for rest and refitting, to counter the expected summer invasion of north-west Europe.  From the 25th it was headquartered at Turnhout, Belgium, as one of the elements of Dietrichs newly created I SS-Panzer Corps which was given the title Leibstandarte Adolf Hitler.  Here over 2,000 troops were transferred into the division from the 12th SS Division, and on the 3rd May Hitler decreed new equipment for the division, much of it to come straight from the factory.  With these and other replacements, by June 1944 the Leibstandarte had been rebuilt to a strength of 20,000.
column2: 4 月 18 日，该师被派往法国休整与重新装备，以应对预料中的夏季对西北欧的入侵。从 25 日起，其司令部设在比利时蒂伦豪特(Turnhout)，作为迪特里希(Dietrich)新组建的党卫军第1装甲军(I SS-Panzer Corps)的一部，该军被授予「阿道夫·希特勒警卫旗队」的称号。此地有 2,000 多名官兵从党卫军第12师调入该师，5 月 3 日希特勒下令为该师换装新装备，其中许多直接来自工厂。加上这些以及其他补充，到 1944 年 6 月，警卫旗队已重建到 20,000 人的规模。

column1: On 19 April the Leibstandarte which had meanwhile reached Grevena was ordered to advance southeastward in the direction of Yannina to cut off the Greeks' route of withdrawal to the south and complete their encirclement.
column2: 4 月 19 日，此时已抵达格雷韦纳(Grevena)的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)奉命向东南方向的约阿尼纳(Yannina)推进，以切断希腊人向南的撤退路线，完成对他们的合围。

column1: On 25th May, against Hitler's orders, Dietrich ordered an assault across the canal to eliminate the French artillery positions on the Wattenberg heights, which commanded the surrounding flatlands.  During the middle of the attack, General Guderian - to whose Panzer Corps the Leibstandarte was subordinate - appeared at Dietrich's HQ demanding to know why orders were being disobeyed.  Dietrich replied that the enemy on Mont Watten could 'look right down the throat' of anyone on the far bank of the canal.  Suitably appraised of the situation and encouraged by the early success of the advance, Guderian immediately approved the decision taken by Dietrich and ordered the 2nd Panzer Division to move up in support.
column2: 5月25日，迪特里希违抗希特勒的命令，下令越过运河发动进攻，以消灭瓦滕贝格高地上的法军炮兵阵地——那些阵地俯瞰着周围的平原。进攻进行到一半时，古德里安将军——警卫旗队所属装甲军的军长——出现在迪特里希的司令部，质问为何违抗命令。迪特里希回答说，蒙瓦滕的敌人能「直盯着」运河对岸任何人的喉咙。古德里安在恰当了解情况后，又受到推进初期成功的鼓舞，当即批准了迪特里希的决定，并命令第2装甲师前出支援。

column1: On 30th September as the remaining Polish units were being mopped up, the Leibstandarte was awarded a special standard in light of the heavy casualties it had suffered during the campaign.  The regiment suffered more than 400 killed, wounded or missing.  This was proof, the army believed that the SS was poorly trained and led, and reckless in attack.  The SS countered that the OKW had consistently given the SS the most dangerous tasks, and that the practice of dividing SS units amongst the army formations was detrimental to their effectiveness in battle.
column2: 9 月 30 日，当残余的波兰部队被肃清时，鉴于警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在战役中遭受的惨重伤亡，它被授予一面特殊的军旗。该团有 400 多人阵亡、负伤或失踪。陆军认为，这证明了党卫军训练与指挥拙劣、进攻鲁莽。党卫军反驳说，国防军最高统帅部(OKW)一直把最危险的任务交给党卫军，而把党卫军部队分散编入陆军建制的做法损害了它们在战场上的效能。

column1: On December 30th a Fuehrer order directed Totenkopf, Leibstandarte and Das Reich - the SS Panzer Corps - to return to Russia to strengthen Army Group South. Our trains were given absolute priority over all other railway traffic. As soon as they arrived on the front, our troops were used to try and stop the Bolsjevik advance. Thanks to our commander Hausser our troops could retreat out of Kharkov - against Fuehrer orders - and avoid certain destruction. This decision saved our SS Panzer Corps as a unit and allowed us to open the counterattack in N/E direction towards Kharkov.
column2: 12月30日，一道元首令命「骷髅」、「警卫旗队」和「帝国」各师——即党卫军装甲军——返回俄国，增援南方集团军群。我们的列车获得了高于所有其他铁路运输的绝对优先权。一到前线，我军就被投入阻止布尔什维克推进。多亏我们的指挥官豪塞尔，我军得以违抗元首令撤出哈尔科夫，避免了必定的覆灭。这一决定保全了党卫军装甲军作为一个建制单位，并使我们得以向哈尔科夫方向发起东北向的反击。

column1: On July 10th 1943 the US 7th Army, commanded by Patton, and the British 8th, commanded by General Montgomery, started the invasion on Sicily.
column2: 1943 年 7 月 10 日，由巴顿(Patton)指挥的美军第7集团军与由蒙哥马利(Montgomery)将军指挥的英国第8集团军开始入侵西西里(Sicily)。

column1: On May 11th, 1944 the Allies launched a great offensive against the Gustav Line. The Germans fought bravely, but their regiments were made up by less than two battalions and therefore were greatly outnumbered. After bloody battles they retreated.
column2: 1944 年 5 月 11 日，盟军对古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)发动大规模攻势。德军打得勇敢，但他们的团都不足两个营，因此兵力处于极大劣势。经过血战之后他们撤退了。

column1: On September 9th Vietinghoff was unable to establish comunication with Kesselring and give orders to the 14th Panzerkorps to quickly concentrate all forces in Salerno and try to eliminate the beachhead. As a result the Allies managed to disembark several divisions.
column2: 9 月 9 日，菲廷霍夫(Vietinghoff)未能与凯塞林(Kesselring)建立联络，因而无法命令第14装甲军迅速把全部兵力集中在萨莱诺(Salerno)，以图消除登陆场。其结果是盟军得以卸下几个师。

column1: On special request of Patton, experienced Waffen SS units will be engaged to assist you.
column2: 应巴顿(Patton)的特别请求，经验丰富的武装党卫军部队将参战协助你。

column1: On that May 14th 1940 General Student was hit in the head by a bullet from an SS sniper in Rotterdam. You and your SS friends are very lucky he survived.
column2: 1940年5月14日那天，施图登特将军在鹿特丹被一名党卫军狙击手的子弹击中头部。他和你们这些党卫军朋友非常走运，他活了下来。

column1: On the 10th the SS-Panzer Corps regrouped for the assault on Prokharovka.  Fighting through a sea of mud to the banks of the Psel River, to the west of the town and the last natural obstacle before Kursk, the SS formations had by late afternoon crossed the river and were in position to attack the rear of the Soviet concentration.  To the south 3rd Panzer Corps began battling toward Prokharovka, attempting to link up with the SS-Panzer Corps before Soviet reserves could be brought up.
column2: 10 日，党卫军装甲军重新集结，准备突击普罗霍夫卡。党卫军各部队在泥海中苦战，推进到该镇以西、库尔斯克之前最后一道天然障碍普肖尔河(Psel)畔；到下午晚些时候，他们已渡过该河，并进入可以攻击苏军集结地后方的位置。在南面，第3装甲军开始向普罗霍夫卡苦战前进，力图在苏军预备队调上来之前与党卫军装甲军会合。

column1: On the 11th May things were getting worse. The arrival of the main German troops, and notably of the 3rd and the 4th Panzerdivision, was too much for the Belgian 7th division. The Germans expanded the bridgeheads and drove the Belgian troops back.
column2: 5月11日，情况进一步恶化。德军主力部队，尤其是第3和第4装甲师的抵达，对比利时第7师来说过于沉重。德军扩大了桥头堡，把比利时军队击退。

column1: On the 12th, the Soviet Guards Tank Army launched a series of uncoordinated strikes with the intention to seperate the SS divisions.  In an area of only a few square miles, firing at almost point-blank range across the dust-choked plain, the superior German tank guns counted for nothing against suicidal attacks by Soviet tank crews.  In the heavy fighting that ensued the heavy company of the Leibstandarte's tank regiment engaged and destroyed the Soviet 181st Tank Regiment, without loss.  On both sides however, losses were high.  At the end of the day a thick pall of smoke hung over the battlefield.
column2: 12 日，苏军近卫坦克集团军发动了一系列互不协调的突击，意图把党卫军各师分割开来。在仅有几平方英里的地区内，在尘土窒塞的平原上以近乎抵近的距离对射，德军优越的坦克炮面对苏军坦克乘员自杀式的攻击也毫无用处。在随后爆发的激战中，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)坦克团的重型连击毁并歼灭了苏军第181坦克团，自身毫无损失。然而双方损失都很高。一天结束时，浓重的烟幕笼罩着战场。

column1: On the 20th of May three German divisions went over on the attack at Zelzate, Kwatrecht and Zingem. After some initial success, Belgians immediately started several counterattacks regaining most of the ground previously lost. All German attacks were repelled on the Belgian front and the Germans weren’t able to create bridgeheads over the Escaut and the Terneuzen Canal. Belgian command was confident that the Germans could be stopped at the Schelde/Escaut.
column2: 5月20日，德军三个师在泽尔扎特、夸特雷赫特和津海姆转入进攻。在取得初步胜利后，比利时人立即发起数次反击，夺回了先前失去的大部分土地。德军在比利时战线上的所有进攻均被击退，未能在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立桥头堡。比利时指挥部相信，德军能够在斯海尔德河被挡住。

column1: On the 27th of September, the Soviets launched a counter offensive aimed at the German southern flank.  It was a strong attack which breached the 3rd Romanian Army and Germany's XXX Armeekorps sector of the front and threatened an envelopment.  The Leibstandarte and elite German mountain divisions were rushed into the line to halt the attack, and then to force them back.
column2: 9 月 27 日，苏军对德军南翼发起反攻。这是一次强有力的进攻，突破了罗马尼亚第3集团军与德军第30军当面地段，并有造成合围之势。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)与德军精锐山地师被紧急投入战线，以阻止这次进攻，随后再迫使其后退。

column1: On the 28th the remaining British forces in Greece surrendered.  During the campaign the Leibstandarte had lost 93 killed, 225 wounded and 3 missing, and thus was afforded a few days rest.
column2: 28 日，希腊境内剩余的英军部队投降。战役期间警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)损失 93 人阵亡、225 人负伤、3 人失踪，因此获得了几天休整。

column1: On the 2nd day in a place near Meziers city, our support units - Grossdeutschland and 10th Panzer division will begin their attack.
column2: 次日，在梅济耶尔城附近，我方支援部队——大德意志师与第10装甲师——将发起进攻。

column1: On the 8th July the Allies launched Operation Charnwood, an operation to secure the city of Caen.  The Leibstandarte, along with other German units was rushed to the British sector and until the 9th was engaged in repulsing the attack, which cost the life of former Leibstandarte regimental commander and current Hitlerjugend commander Fritz Witt, killed in his HQ by naval gunfire.
column2: 7 月 8 日，盟军发起查恩伍德行动，目的是夺取卡昂城。警卫旗队与其他德军部队一起被紧急调往英军地段，直到 9 日都在击退这次进攻；此战使前警卫旗队团长、现任「希特勒青年团」师师长弗里茨·维特(Fritz Witt)丧命，他在自己的司令部里被舰炮火力击毙。

column1: On the day of the Geman invasion, 10th May, King Leopold III said "Belges! pour la second fois en un quart de siècle, la Belgique, loyale et neutre, est attaqué par l'Empire allemande, [...] La lutte sera dure. Les sacrifices et les privations seront considérables, mais nul ne peut douter du succès final" ("Belgians! for the second time in a quarter century, Belgium, fair and neutral, is attacked by the German Empire [...] The fight will be tough. The sacrifices and hardships will be considerable, but no one can doubt the ultimate success".
column2: 在德军入侵当天，即5月10日，国王利奥波德三世说：“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻，[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”（“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”。

column1: On the day of the German offensive snow was falling from low cloud and the temperature hovered on either side of zero degrees celcius.  The Leibstandarte began its attack at 0430 hours with an artillery barrage against the 68th Guards Rifle Division positions.  The Soviet defences were strong and well prepared, and the Leibstandarte lost a number of tanks to mines and flame-throwers.  Despite the shock of finding the Soviets well prepared, the Leibstandarte broke through, and by March 14th had reached Simontoya, securing a bridgehead over the Sio Canal by the 15th.  By this point however, the corps left flank was badly exposed, prompting Dietrich to recommend a retreat to defensive positions, as further advance was impossible, owing to the hilly, broken and wooded terrain.
column2: 德军攻势发起当天，低云中飘着雪，气温在零摄氏度上下徘徊。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)于 04 时 30 分以一次炮火准备对第68近卫步兵师阵地开始进攻。苏军防御坚固且准备充分，警卫旗队有多辆坦克损失于地雷与喷火器。尽管发现苏军准备充分令人震惊，警卫旗队仍突破了防线，到 3 月 14 日已抵达西蒙托亚(Simontoya)，并于 15 日在西奥运河(Sio Canal)上取得一个桥头堡。然而此时该军左翼已严重暴露，促使迪特里希(Dietrich)建议撤退至防御阵地，因为由于丘陵、破碎且多林的地形，继续推进已不可能。

column1: On the first day of the campaign the Leibstandarte had achieved almost all its objectives.  By the evening of the 1st, the bulk of the Regiment was across the river and ready to advance on Wieuroszov, where it would link up with the 17th Infantry Division.  This was accomplished, and in the early hours of the next morning, the Leibstandarte advanced towards Burzenin, where it received orders to cross the Warta River.
column2: 战役第一天，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已几乎达成全部目标。到 1 日傍晚，该团主力已渡过河，准备向维耶乌罗舒夫(Wieuroszov)推进，在那里与第17步兵师会合。会合如期完成；次日凌晨，警卫旗队向布热宁(Burzenin)推进，并在那里受命渡过瓦尔塔河(Warta)。
行军中(On the move) - 1945 年 10 月 7 日

column1: On the night of the 18th/19th of May the retreat of the Belgian Army to its new positions behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal was protected by the cavalry divisions and the 1st "Chausseurs Ardennaises"/"Ardense Jager" division. When the Germans crossed the Escaut/Scheldt river by using a tunnel not completely destroyed in the Antwerpen/Anvers region fierce battles occurred around Zwijndrecht between the German 208th infantry division and units of the Belgian cavalry. The German infantry was not able to advance further due to the attacks performed by Belgian tanks and AFV's (T13). At the end of the day the Belgian units retreated as ordered behind the Gent-Terneuzen canal.
column2: 5月18日至19日夜间，比利时军队撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方新阵地的行动由各骑兵师和第1“阿登猎兵”师掩护。当德军利用安特卫普地区一条未被彻底炸毁的隧道渡过斯海尔德河时，德军第208步兵师与比利时骑兵部队在兹韦恩德雷赫特周边爆发激战。由于比利时坦克和装甲车辆（T13）的攻击，德军步兵未能继续推进。当日结束时，比利时部队奉命撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方。

column1: On the night of the 18th/19th of May the retreat of the Belgian Army to its new positions behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal was protected by the cavalry divisions and the 1st "Chausseurs Ardennaises"/"Ardense Jager" division. When the Germans crossed the Escaut/Scheldt River by using a tunnel not completely destroyed in the Antwerpen/Anvers region fierce battles occurred around Zwijndrecht between the German 208th infantry division and units of the Belgian cavalry. The German infantry was not able to advance further due to the attacks performed by Belgian tanks and AFV's (T13). At the end of the day the Belgian units retreated as ordered behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal.

column1: On the plain outside the small town scene the forces massed for the largest tank battle yet seen, and the final decisive encounter on the Eastern Front.  For the battle the Germans could muster some 600 tanks while the Soviets sent around 850 into battle.
column2: 在这座小镇外的平原上，双方部队集结起来，准备进行迄今为止规模最大的坦克战，也是东线上最后一场决定性的交锋。为这一战，德军能集结约 600 辆坦克，而苏军投入了约 850 辆。

column1: On the political side this victory has stabilised Mussolini's regime a bit, but we are looking for a more competent replacement in the facsist movement. However, real power in Italy is in our hands now. In a few weeks we will take charge of militairy production and rearmement in Italy, meaning Italian industry will produce German arms. Paralel to the rearmement of the Italian army a few thousand advisors will retrain the army.
column2: 在政治层面上，这场胜利稍稍稳住了墨索里尼的政权，但我们正在法西斯运动中物色一个更能干的替代者。不过，意大利的实权如今已掌握在我们手中。数周之内我们将接管意大利的军事生产与重整军备，这意味着意大利工业将生产德国武器。在意大利军队重整军备的同时，数千名顾问将重新训练这支军队。

column1: On the Western approaches the 1st Battalion of the Leibstandarte fought bitterly to wrest Oltarzev from its stubborn defenders.  The Pole's although battered, were far from beaten and had declared Warsaw a fortress city.  Instead of withdrawing east, they began a retreat south-east and struck at the 8th Army.  The attacks temporarily threw the Germans off balance and the Leibstandarte was forced onto the defensive.
column2: 在西面接近地，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)第1营为从顽强的守军手中夺下奥尔塔泽夫(Oltarzev)而苦战。波兰人虽遭重创，却远未被击败，并已宣布华沙(Warsaw)为要塞城市。他们没有向东撤退，而是开始向东南退却，并打击了第8集团军(8th Army)。这些进攻一度把德军打得失去平衡，警卫旗队被迫转入防御。

column1: On to Moskva!  Nothing can stop you now!
column2: 向莫斯科(Moskva)进军！现在没什么能挡住你了！

column1: Once again the decisive battle will be fought in Stalingrad.
column2: 决战将再次在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)打响。

column1: Once again your mistakes heve been covered, this time by the 4th Infantry Division. We will be looking for much improvement if you are to keep your post Bob!!!!
column2: 你的错误又一次被掩盖了，这次是第4步兵师替你兜的。如果你想保住你的职位，我们期待你有大得多的进步，鲍勃(Bob)！！！！

column1: Once more the attack will be done by infantrymen without armour support but do not underestimate the German artillery and the Luftwaffe.
column2: 这次进攻仍将由没有装甲支援的步兵发起，但不要低估德军炮兵和德国空军。

column1: Once you do, we will have isolated Ivan's remaining forces.
column2: 一旦会合，我们就把伊万残余的部队孤立了。

column1: One last thing, you can expect air supremacy in this battle.
column2: 最后一件事，这场战斗中你可以指望掌握制空权。

column1: One of the reasons for the rapid German advance was the lack of cooperation between the Belgian and French troops. Both troops executed their plans without looking at what the other was doing, causing many disagreements and incidents.
column2: 德军推进迅速的原因之一是比利时与法国部队之间缺乏配合。两军各自执行自己的计划，不顾对方在做什么，造成许多分歧和事件。

column1: Only after bitter and bloody fighting were the Leibstandarte able to capture Bubry and the road junction at Sasselje.  Arriving at Kherson on the 17th of August, the division fought yet another bitter battle through the streets for three days before the defenders finally fled the city.
column2: 只有在经过艰苦血腥的战斗之后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)才得以夺取布布里(Bubry)与萨塞列(Sasselje)的路口。8 月 17 日抵达赫尔松(Kherson)后，该师又在街巷中苦战了三天，守军才最终弃城而逃。

column1: Operation Marita, the plan to capture Greece has been complicated after a coup d'etat in Yugoslavia. This coup has ousted the government we signed a protocol with 2 days earlier - which is 2 weeks ago now - a protocol that brought Yugoslavia in the Tripartite Pact. The new government has canceled the protocol and Hitler thinks they will sooner or later join the Allies. He has ordered our troops to not only invade Greece as planned, but Yugoslavia as well. The task of your troops - your division is renamed SS-Division Das Reich - is to cross the border from Rumania into Yugoslavia and to capture Belgrade. The Heer does not want the Waffen SS to capture Belgrade and has added the GrossDeutschland Regiment to your troops. They have also ordered the 8th Panzer division to move on Belgrade from Hungary and has given similar orders to the 11th Panzer Division stationed in Bulgaria.
column2: 「马里塔」行动——夺取希腊的计划在南斯拉夫发生政变后变得复杂起来。这场政变推翻了我们两天前（其实已是两周前）才与之签署议定书的政府，那份议定书把南斯拉夫拉进了三国同盟。新政府取消了议定书，希特勒认为他们早晚会加入盟国。他下令我军不仅按计划入侵希腊，也要入侵南斯拉夫。你的部队——你的师已改称党卫军「帝国」师——的任务是从罗马尼亚越过边境进入南斯拉夫，夺取贝尔格莱德。陆军不愿让武装党卫军拿下贝尔格莱德，于是把「大德意志」团编入你的部队。他们还下令第8装甲师从匈牙利向贝尔格莱德推进，并对驻保加利亚的第11装甲师下达了类似命令。

column2: 认为，英国人在斯大林受审之前就把他除掉了。

column1: Or you can choose to command the forces being part of the K Group ("Groupement K)" in the Ardennes whose mission is to delay the enemy's advance until our allies come.
column2: 或者你可以选择指挥阿登地区K集群（“Groupement K”）中的部队，其任务是迟滞敌军推进，直到我们的盟友赶到。

column1: Orders from the central ChCP comitte: it's time to capture Changchun, Siping, and Jilin to complete the conquest of Manchuria. The success on this offensive is extremely important, because it would allow us to undertake further penetrations on to Beijing and Nanjing in the next months.
column2: 中共中央委员会的命令：是时候夺取长春、四平和吉林，以完成对满洲的征服了。这次攻势的成功极其重要，因为它将使我们能在接下来几个月进一步向北平、南京推进。

column1: Our advance on Rome has been delayed very skillfully by the Germans and has stopped on the Gustav line, southeast of Rome. The southern part of the line runs along the Rapido and Gargliano rivers and is centred on the area around Monte Cassino.
column2: 我们对罗马的推进被德军非常巧妙地迟滞，已停在罗马东南的古斯塔夫防线上。防线南段沿拉皮多河(Rapido)与加里利亚诺河(Gargliano)走向，以蒙特卡西诺周边地区为中心。

column1: Our army lies broken. Greece is under Soviet control. And the subs are free to wreak havoc on Allied supply ships. You're hereby put on permanent leave.
column2: 我们的军队已经崩溃。希腊落入苏联控制之下。而潜艇则可以肆意袭击盟军的补给船。兹此命令你永久休假。

column1: Our army lies broken.Now that the Soviets know where our main force will land, Scandinavia will be practically impenetrable.And the subs are free to wreak havoc on Allied supply ships. You're hereby put on permanent leave.
column2: 我们的军队已残破不堪。既然苏军知道我军主力将在何处登陆，斯堪的纳维亚将几乎无法攻入。而那些潜艇则可以肆意蹂躏盟军补给船。特此将你永久停职。

column1: Our assault has been repelled. Our troops in Germany are surely doomed now. Dismissed!
column2: 我们的突击被击退了。我们在德国的部队现在肯定在劫难逃。解散！

column1: Our Aufklaerers have spotted the Big Ben!!, we have reached the London suburbs Herr General!. The last regular British forces are enclosed into the big city, we have offered the British the capitulation, but they have refused it!, this people are amazing me. This, will surely be a bloodbath, but they have decided the bad way.
column2: 我们的侦察兵已看到大本钟(Big Ben)！！我们已经到达伦敦(London)郊区，将军阁下！英国最后一支正规部队被围在这座大城市里，我们已向英国人提出投降要求，但他们拒绝了！这些人真让我惊讶。这必定会是一场血腥屠杀，但他们选择了糟糕的那条路。

column1: Our Aufklärers have spotted the Big Ben!!, we have reached the London suburbs Herr General!. The last regular British forces are enclosed into the big city, we have offered the British the capitulation, but they have refused it!, this people are amazing me. This, will surely be a complete cataclysm, but they have decided the bad way.
column2: 我们的侦察兵已看到大本钟(Big Ben)！！我们已经到达伦敦(London)郊区，将军阁下！英国最后一支正规部队被围在这座大城市里，我们已向英国人提出投降要求，但他们拒绝了！这些人真让我惊讶。这必定会是一场彻底的大灾难，但他们选择了糟糕的那条路。

column1: Our battle against the ancient landlords of oppression has been suddenly stopped... now we must again dress ourselves as peasants to avoid being captured by the enemy.
column2: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

column1: Our division has now been fully redrawn from Russia to Montauban/Toulouse in France and is renamed to SS Panzer Division "Das Reich". Our main concern is the large number of fresh troops (9000) in Das Reich - we even had to accept conscripts to fill our ranks.
column2: 我们师现已全部从俄罗斯调往法国的蒙托邦(Montauban)/图卢兹(Toulouse)，并改称党卫军「帝国」(Das Reich)装甲师。我们最担心的是「帝国」师里大量新兵(9000)——我们甚至不得不接受征召兵来填补编制。

column1: Our encircled units in the Falaise pocket must raise the blockade and connect with the rest of our units.
column2: 我部在法莱斯口袋中被合围的部队必须突破封锁，与主力会合。

column1: Our flank is secure so keep moving West.
column2: 我们的侧翼安全了，所以继续向西推进。

column1: Our fortune has changed, a massive soviet counter-offensive has destroyed our army and invaded Poland as well as East-Prussia.
column2: 我们的运气变了，一场大规模的苏军反攻摧毁了我们的集团军，并侵入了波兰与东普鲁士(East-Prussia)。

column1: Our Italian allies (don't make any joke, we both know that they are very poor) with a tremendous effort have passed through the channel taking some casualities.
column2: 我们的意大利盟友（别开玩笑，我们都知道他们很糟糕）以极大的努力通过了海峡，付出了一些伤亡。

column1: Our Italian friends thank you for your assitance. The British have been hit again.
column2: 我们的意大利朋友感谢你的协助。英国人又挨了一顿打。

column1: Our Luftwaffe will pave the way for landings of our glorious Wehrmacht, support will be given by fallschirmjägers too.
column2: 我们的空军将为我们光荣的国防军登陆铺平道路，伞兵也会提供支援。

column1: Our new mission is to take the Eastern end of the trans-Siberian railroad
column2: 我们的新任务是夺取西伯利亚大铁路的东端

column1: Our new operation to break the Allied offensive by driving to Avranches and destroying their forces has started on time, but with fewer troops than expected. Both the 116 (PzLehr) and the 1SS (LSSAH) have problems reaching the front. The attack has started with the 2Pz in the North and our division reinforced with a KG of the 17SS (Goetz von Berlichingen) in the South. Opposite us is the US 30ID which is putting up a stubborn defense.
column2: 我们为粉碎盟军攻势而发起的新行动——向阿夫朗什突进并歼灭其兵力——已按时开始，但兵力比预期少。第116装甲师（装甲教导）和党卫军第1师（警卫旗队）都难以抵达前线。进攻由北面的第2装甲师和我方在南面、得到党卫军第17师（「格茨·冯·贝利欣根」）一个战斗群加强的师发起。与我们相对的是美军第30步兵师，正在顽强抵抗。

column1: Our next step on the Pacific is in front of us. The north Americans are reagrouping troops in their Japanese bases. Japan is basically an American military colony after the US victory over this country. Our agents have provided us some informations, such as the remaning ships from the US navy are on the area. The Chinese comunist leader, Mao-Tse-Tung may help us in the first step of our plans in Japan with some chinese troops, with some equipment that we've sent them.
column2: 我们在太平洋的下一步就在眼前。北美部队正在他们在日本的基地里重新集结。在美国战胜这个国家之后，日本基本上成了美国的军事殖民地。我们的特工提供了一些情报，比如美国海军剩余的舰船就在这一地区。中国共产主义领袖毛泽东(Mao-Tse-Tung)可能会用一些中国部队，以及我们送给他们的一些装备，帮助我们实现在日本计划的第一步。

column2: 我们的侦察分队报告，该地区散布着若干临时构筑的掩体。

column1: Our right flank must be secured before Operation Barbarossa.
column2: 在巴巴罗萨行动之前，必须确保我们右翼的安全。

column1: Our Sicilian campaign has run into heavy resistance in the Simeto Valley. You job is to break the stalemate. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 我们的西西里战役在西梅托(Simeto)河谷遭遇了顽强的抵抗。你的任务是打破僵局。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Our Soviet advisors suggest that we let the enemy troops pass through the mountains and then annihilate them on a familiar battlefield.
column2: 我们的苏联顾问建议，让敌军穿过山区，然后在熟悉的战场上歼灭他们。

column1: Our spies have discovered the secret atomic bomb production center, your mission is to destroy it.
column2: 我们的间谍发现了秘密原子弹生产中心，你的任务是摧毁它。

column1: Our strategic air power has kept Ivan from building up his forces
column2: 我们的战略空军使伊万无法积聚兵力

column1: Our supply lines are now secured. Some remnants of partisan units during Warsaw Uprising last October are probably still in town, you are authorized to assist them but in no way this "parameter" may jeopardize comand of tactical operations. Stavka orders you to follow the axis line Warsaw-Poznan and to clear this area from Germans. For political reasons some Polish regular units of Berling's Army will assist you, those are temporarily under your command, use them wisely. Expel definitely Fascists from Warsaw!!!
column2: 我们的补给线现在已有保障。去年10月华沙(Warsaw)起义期间的一些游击队残部很可能仍在城里，你获准协助他们，但这个「参数」绝不能危害战术作战的指挥。最高统帅部命令你沿华沙(Warsaw)-波兹南(Poznan)轴线推进，肃清这一地区的德军。出于政治原因，贝林格(Berling)麾下的一些波兰正规部队将协助你，他们暂时归你指挥，要善加使用。把法西斯彻底逐出华沙！！！

column1: Our task here is over, report in Berlin at once.
column2: 我们这里的任务已经结束，立即到柏林报到。

column1: Our troops are taking their new positions behind the Terneuzen canal and the Escaut/Scheldt River. The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to secure this movement.
column2: 我军正在进入泰尔讷曾运河和斯海尔德河后方的新阵地。“骑兵军”必须保障这一行动。

column1: Our troops have finally taken positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position) to confront the Germans. The defensive line is well prepared, our Army is ready and this is where we are going to give the decisive battle.
column2: 我军终于进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）与德军对峙。防线准备充分，我军已就绪，我们将在这里进行决定性会战。

column1: Our winter counteroffensive with waffen SS units against a Soviet army corps must occupy Kharkov city, destroy many Red units and save time for our units.
column2: 我们以武装党卫军部队对苏军一个军发动的冬季反攻，必须占领哈尔科夫(Kharkov)城，消灭大量红军部队，并为我们的部队争取时间。

column2: 干得漂亮，将军，你在这里挡住了伊万(Ivan)。

column1: Outstanding work, General.  You have continued to display superior skill.  We will not be having much of a problem with the remaining Republicans.  Good luck on your next assignment.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军。你继续展现了高超的技能。收拾残余的共和军，不成问题。祝你在下一个任务中好运。

column1: Outstanding work, General.  You have displayed superior tactics and abilities.  I will recommend a promotion to your superiors.  Keep up the good work and advance to the battlefield at Spanish Pass.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军。你展现了高超的战术与才能。我会向你的上级建议晋升。继续努力，开赴西班牙山口(Spanish Pass)战场。

column1: Outstanding work, General.  You have displayed superior tactics and abilities.  I will recommend a promotion to your superiors.  Keep up the good work and advance to the battlefield at Spanish Pass.
Outstanding! We have proudly freed Poland. Take a few weeks off General. Rest up well because we have another tough job for you next month.
column2: 干得漂亮！我们骄傲地解放了波兰。休几周假吧，将军。好好休息，因为下个月我们还有一项艰巨任务给你。

column1: Overall, with their ability to redeploy rapidly from one sector of fighting to another, the Leibstandarte had proved the effectiveness of motorised units in battle.
column2: 总体而言，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)凭借从一个战区迅速重新部署到另一个战区的能力，证明了摩托化部队在战场上的效能。

column1: Pack your bags General. It's time to go home
column2: 收拾行李吧，将军。该回家了

column1: Pack your bags, it's time to go home.

column2: 肯普夫装甲师又在罗赞、沃姆扎、克莱奇姆和莫德林与波兰人打了几仗。波兰战役结束后，该师于1939年10月7日在奈登堡附近的告别阅兵式上解散。

column1: paratroopers would secure the most important points, and reinforcements

column1: Paris is in panic!, our divisions are driving into France quickly, and the Allied army is in a complete disarray. Herr General, your task now will consist in secure this area in order to allow the drive of our spearheads into the French soil. This, will avoid the joining of the Allied forces in the North, with the Southern allied forces, and will cut the Allied controlled space in two.
column2: 巴黎一片惊慌！我们的师正迅速突入法国，盟军已完全陷入混乱。将军阁下，你现在的任务就是确保控制这一地区，以便我们的先头部队向法国腹地推进。这将阻止北面的盟军与南面的盟军会合，并把盟军控制的地域一分为二。
巴黎近在眼前，你必须摧毁法国以及英国的陆、空、海军力量。

column1: Patton hasn't choice but retreat against our glorious advance of our Soviet army.
column2: 面对我们苏联军队的光荣推进，巴顿(Patton)别无选择，只能撤退。

column1: Patton was right, we cannot trust Soviets!
column2: 巴顿说得对，我们不能信任苏军！

column1: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.   Anyway we are shortly going to open the negotiations with the UN forces to terminate this conflict.
column2: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。不管怎样，我们很快就会与联合国军开始谈判，以结束这场冲突。

column1: Perfect! we are now at the gates of the most important soviet Pacific port.   Also more enemies of the revolution have been enlisted to fight the Bolsheviks alongside us.
column2: 完美！我们现在已抵达苏联最重要的太平洋港口城下。此外，还有更多革命的敌人被征召来与我们并肩对抗布尔什维克。

column1: Perfect!!!, our troops have overrunned the capital, the Japanese emperor is in the USA, escaping as a coward. There are fireworks and celebrations in all the USSR, like in Moscow, Leningrad or Stalingrad, where the workers are rebuilding the city.
column2: 完美！！！我们的部队已席卷首都，日本天皇逃到了美国，像个懦夫一样逃走了。全苏联都在放烟火、庆祝，莫斯科、列宁格勒(Leningrad)或斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)也一样，那里的工人正在重建城市。

column1: Perfect, the weapon has been destroyed, and now we have the information about their construction, ...  Now, its time to attack the USA mainland! Good times are waiting for the socialism!
column2: 太好了，那件武器已被摧毁，现在我们掌握了关于它们制造的情报，…… 现在，是时候进攻美国本土了！好日子正等着社会主义！

column2: 技巧3：苏军极为凶悍。登上滩头，并在防御性空中掩护下准备迎击进攻。

column1: Playing tip : (1) move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units). (2) When attempting to conquer the last VH on the island, move sea transportable units from PORT to PORT hexes using "strategic transport" button when right clicking on a unit from a PORT.
column2: 技巧：(1) 把运输船移动到与海岸相邻的任意格上，以便部署你的部队（一艘船就能让所有单位登陆）。(2) 在试图夺取岛上最后一个胜利格时，从（港口）格右键点击部队，用「战略运输」按钮把可海运单位从（港口）格移动到（港口）格。

column1: Playing tip : (1) Protect the Kremlin at all costs (2) Poke around forests south of Moscow to discover the HQ (sole hidden VH) where traitors are hiding.
column2: 技巧：(1) 不惜一切代价保护克里姆林宫(Kremlin) (2) 在莫斯科(Moscow)以南的森林里搜索，找出叛徒藏身的司令部（唯一的隐蔽胜利格）。

column1: Playing tip : Bridge layer unit allows you not only to cross rivers but also to deploy units wherever you move, close to or behind enemy lines for instance.
column2: 游戏提示：架桥车单位不仅让你能渡河，还能让你在移动到的任何地方部署部队，比如靠近或深入敌后。

column1: Playing tip : don't lose your Mobil Armee HQ unit since there are no supply hexes in this scenario. Deploy and Supply units allow to re-supply and give replacements to any ground or air unit even after it has moved as long as the unit ends up within 2 hexes of the Deploy and Supply unit. They allow the unit to retreat and re-supply on the same turn. Be aware that in the desert full re-supply only occurs in towns, ports, airfields and rough terrain. Those units have also the bridging ability.
column2: 游戏提示：不要丢掉你的摩托化集团军司令部单位，因为这个场景里没有补给格。部署与补给单位可以为任何地面或航空单位补给并提供补充兵员，即使该单位已经移动过，只要它最终位于部署与补给单位2格之内即可。它们还允许该单位在同一回合内撤退并补给。要注意，在沙漠中只有城镇、港口、机场与崎岖地形才能进行完全补给。这些单位还具有架桥能力。

column1: Playing tip : Mobile HQ units allow you not only to cross rivers but also to deploy units wherever you move, close to or behind enemy lines for instance.
column2: 游戏提示：机动司令部单位不仅让你能渡河，还能让你在移动到的任何地方部署部队，比如靠近或深入敌后。

column1: Playing tip : move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units).

column1: Playing tip : place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army).
column2: 游戏提示：把两栖舰船放在海岸相邻的任一格，就能随时部署你的部队（一艘船即可部署你的全军）。

column1: Playing tip : Use ground units starting from any PORT hex and select strategic transport to capture Amsterdam harbour (PORT hex) or use paratroops to capture Amsterdam (VH). Seaborne or airborne operations are both possible.

column1: So far so good Bob!! Although not all the objectives were taken we will be bulstered by the assistance of the 30th Corps for the next stage of operations.
column2: 到目前为止一切顺利，鲍勃(Bob)！！尽管并非所有目标都被夺取，但在下一阶段作战中，我们将因第30军的协助而得到增强。

column1: So far so good Bob!! Your division has taken it's objectives all except the canal bridge at Son which the enemy blew before we could take it. Hopefully the Engineers can get a makeshift bridge across to allow the advance of the 30th Corps to continue.
column2: 目前一切顺利，鲍勃！！你的师已夺取全部目标，只有松镇(Son)的运河桥除外——敌人在我们得手之前就把它炸了。但愿工兵能架起一座临时桥梁，好让第30军继续推进。

column1: So the snipers scared off your men Bob?? Well luckily the 401st GIB took your objective for you. Now we can attack over the river.
column2: 这么说狙击手把你的部下吓跑了，鲍勃(Bob)？？还好第401滑翔步兵团替你拿下了目标。现在我们可以渡河进攻了。

column1: So you have joined your men behind barbed wire Bob!!
column2: 这么说你也和你的部下一起进了铁丝网后面，鲍勃(Bob)！！

column1: So, CLEAR this area of any Chinese soldiers and General, I'm starting to hate the Chinese!
column2: 所以，把这地区的中国士兵都肃清掉，将军，我开始讨厌中国人了！

column1: Some members of the government expect to end the war in the next month and maybe we will have a new Crusade in the future.
column2: 政府中一些成员预计下个月就能结束战争，也许将来我们还会有一场新的十字军远征。

column1: Some of your units will protect the retreat.
column2: 您的一些部队将负责掩护撤退。

column1: Some UN forces have escaped from Hungnam, but at least we can now continue with our advance towards Seoul.
column2: 一些联合国军部队已从兴南逃走，但至少我们现在可以继续向汉城推进了。

column1: Some units of the "Corps de Cavalerie" must help the I Corps, and notably its 7th division, to defend the area of Eben-Emael and prevent the bridges over the Albert-canal in the Maastricht area to be taken by the Germans.
column2: “Corps de Cavalerie”的部分部队必须协助第1军，尤其是其第7师，防守埃本-埃马尔地区，并阻止德军夺取马斯特里赫特地区阿尔贝运河上的桥梁。

column1: Some US old guard generals refuse to surrender to the Soviet forces. Those generals are trying to keep alive the flame of the resistance in the formerly World Capital: New York. STAVKA cannot tolerate this and prepares a powerful offensive to defeat the last resistance pocket in North America.
column2: 一些美国老派将领拒绝向苏军投降。这些将军正试图在原世界首都纽约(New York)让抵抗之火继续燃烧。最高统帅部无法容忍这一点，正筹备一次强大攻势，以击败北美最后的抵抗包围圈。

column1: Soon you and your men will be deployed as reserves in Aragon and await further orders.
column2: 不久你和你的部下将被部署到阿拉贡作为预备队，等候进一步命令。

column1: Sorry to hear that another force took Berchtesgaden!!!
column2: 很遗憾听说另一支部队拿下了贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)！！！

column1: Sorry to hear that most of your men were either killed or captured Bob. I hope they are comfortable in their POW camp until we can liberate them.
column2: 听说你的部下大多非死即俘，我很遗憾，鲍勃(Bob)。我希望他们在战俘营里过得舒服，直到我们能把他们解救出来。

column1: Soviet attack to liberate Kiev, the capital of the SSR Ukraine.
column2: 苏军发起进攻，解放乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国(SSR Ukraine)的首都基辅(Kiev)。

column1: Soviet attacks across the Sarvis and Sio Canals were seen as an ominous sign of things to come.  It was clear from intelligence reports that the Soviets were attempting to cut off the Sixth Panzer Army.  On the 16th two Soviet armies launched a major attack between Szekesfehervar and the Vertes hills to the north.  By the 18th, the LSSAH was given orders to withdraw from Simontoya, thus ending the divisions last offensive action of the war.
column2: 苏军越过萨尔维斯运河(Sarvis)与西奥运河(Sio Canals)的进攻被视为不祥之兆。情报报告清楚表明，苏军正试图切断党卫军第6装甲集团军(Sixth Panzer Army)。16 日，两个苏军集团军在北面的塞克什白堡(Szekesfehervar)与韦尔泰什山(Vertes hills)之间发动大规模进攻。到 18 日，警卫旗队(LSSAH)接到命令从西蒙托亚(Simontoya)撤出，该师在战争中的最后一次进攻行动就此结束。

column1: Soviet attempt to defeat the  German-Romanian South Ukraine Army Group and knock Romania out of the war.
column2: 苏军试图击败德罗联军南乌克兰集团军群，使罗马尼亚(Romania)退出战争。

column1: Soviet direct attack on Berlin. Victory will mean the end of Nazi Germany.
column2: 苏军对柏林的直接进攻。胜利将意味着纳粹德国的终结。

column1: Soviet forces aim to retreive Odessa harbour facilities from Rumanian and German troops.
column2: 苏军力图从罗马尼亚(Rumania)与德军手中夺回敖德萨(Odessa)的港口设施。

column1: Soviet forces try and stop the Allied advance at Khabarovsk
column2: 苏军试图在哈巴罗夫斯克阻止盟军推进

column1: Soviet lines and open the road to Berlin.
column2: 苏军战线上打开缺口、打通通往柏林之路的任务。

column1: Soviet offensive to clear the Leningrad area across the Narva river.
column2: 苏军发起攻势，渡过纳尔瓦河(Narva)，肃清列宁格勒(Leningrad)地区。

column1: Soviet offensive to cross the Dnepr river and breach the German Eastern wall.
column2: 苏军发起攻势，强渡第聂伯河(Dnepr)，突破德军的东方壁垒。

column1: Soviet offensive to liberate the cities of Kharkov and Belgorov.
column2: 苏军解放哈尔科夫与别尔哥罗德(Belgorov)的攻势。

column1: Soviet offensive to take Bucharest and knock Romania out of the war.
column2: 苏军发起攻势，夺取布加勒斯特(Bucharest)，使罗马尼亚(Romania)退出战争。

column1: Soviet offensive to take Budapest and clear from German troops the Hungarian plains.
column2: 苏军发起攻势，夺取布达佩斯(Budapest)，并把德军逐出匈牙利平原。

column1: Soviet resistance to the US counterattack stiffens.
column2: 苏军对美军反击的抵抗趋于顽强。

column1: Soviets opposed a strong resistance, but you forced them to sue for peace.
column2: 苏军进行了顽强的抵抗，但你迫使他们求和。

column1: Splendid job out there, Commander. Now it's time to interrogate the scientist and find those missiles, before it's too late.
column2: 你在外面干得漂亮，指挥官。现在是审讯那名科学家、找出那些导弹的时候了，别等到来不及。

column1: Splendid job, Commander. Quite splendid.  Due to your, if I do say so myself, splendid performance at St. Lo, our forces will have the impetus they require to break out of Normandy and liberate France.  But now your services are needed at Caen, where Monty is having a spot of bother with Jerry.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。相当漂亮。多亏你——恕我直言——在圣洛(St. Lo)的出色表现，我军将获得冲出诺曼底(Normandy)、解放法国(France)所需的冲劲。但现在卡昂(Caen)需要你，蒙蒂(Monty)在那里和德国佬有点小麻烦。

column1: Splendid! Your terrific attack devastated and confused the Soviet army. Plus, we have rescued several important POWs which may aid us in the coming months. Good job.
column2: 好极了！你那次凌厉的进攻重创并打乱了苏军。此外，我们还救出了几名重要的战俘，他们在今后几个月里或许对我们有帮助。干得好。

column1: Stalin has ordered to invade the USA, in revenge for the cowardly invasion they did in Vladivostok. After their losses on the Pacific, US navy became weak, and the remaining north American troops in all the world are in the way to defend the USA's mainland. Firstly, our amphibious forces may attack the Aleoutians, that we will use as a base for future attacks on the USA west coast. Your mission is to manage this special amphibious Soviet forces.
column2: 斯大林已下令入侵美国，以报复他们在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的可耻入侵。在太平洋遭受损失后，美国海军变得虚弱，散布在世界各地的剩余北美部队都在赶去保卫美国本土。首先，我们的两栖部队可以进攻阿留申群岛(Aleoutians)，我们将把它用作未来进攻美国西海岸的基地。你的任务是掌管这支特殊的苏联两栖部队。

column1: Stalin has signed an alliance with Japan and is causing havoc in the Far
column2: 斯大林已与日本签订同盟，正在远东大肆破坏

column1: Stalin has turned the city into a fortress comprised of heavily entrenched infantry and anti tank. You will need to muster all of your skill to take the city. You have a small battle group of crack German troops and armor at your disposal to assist in the siege. General Patton's army has been sent south to Rostov to try and divert Russian forces from your objective.
column2: 斯大林(Stalin)已把这座城市变成一座堡垒，由深沟高垒的步兵与反坦克部队组成。你需要使出全部本事才能拿下它。你手上有支由德军精锐部队与装甲组成的小型战斗群，可用于协助攻城。巴顿(Patton)将军的集团军已被派往南面的罗斯托夫(Rostov)，试图把俄军兵力从你的目标引开。

column1: Stalin has vowed this will never happen.
column2: 斯大林发誓这绝不会发生。

column1: Stalin himself will come to London to build up the new British socialist goverment... the red flag is floating over the most important buildings of London...
column2: 斯大林本人将前来伦敦，建立新的英国社会主义政府……红旗正飘扬在伦敦最重要的建筑之上……

column1: Stalin is furious over this and the Kremlin said quite a few senior officers
column2: 斯大林为此暴怒，克里姆林宫说有好些高级军官

column1: Stalin orders to hang the Soviet flag at the top of the Reichtag before May, 1st.
column2: 斯大林下令在5月1日之前把苏联国旗挂上国会大厦(Reichtag)顶端。
斯大林格勒反击 - 1942年11月20日

column1: Staraya Russa, south of Novgorod, was an important communications center between Leningrad and Moscow.  Though the Germans made some progress, the Soviets prevented a complete breakthrough, delaying the German push to Moscow until the cold winter snows had fallen.
column2: 旧鲁萨位于诺夫哥罗德以南，是列宁格勒与莫斯科之间的重要通信中心。虽然德军取得了一些进展，苏军却阻止了完全突破，把德军向莫斯科的推进拖到了寒冬大雪降临之后。

column1: STAVKA is apparantly under the impression their troops are still advancing and has marched 3rd Tank Army - a mighty force of 3 Inf divisions, 3 Tank brigades and a Guard Cav Corps in a gap which had openend between our division and the Leibstandarte. Your task is to trap these formations and capture Kharkov.
column2: 苏联最高统帅部显然还以为他们的部队仍在推进，竟把第3坦克集团军——一支由3个步兵师、3个坦克旅和一个近卫骑兵军组成的强大兵力——开进了我们师与警卫旗队之间出现的缺口。你的任务是围住这些部队并夺取哈尔科夫。

column1: Stavka puts Koniev (Southern Army Group) and Zukov (Central Army Group) in competition for the capture of the Nazi lair.
column2: 最高统帅部让科涅夫(Koniev)（南方集团军群）与朱可夫(Zukov)（中央集团军群）竞争夺取这个纳粹巢穴。
步步为营(Step by step) - 1946 年 8 月 5 日

column1: Strock: At this crucial point in the war, we cannot allow any incompetent leaders to waste the lives of our men and equipment. Your XO will take over command and you will report immediately to the Chief of Staff in Berlin. Dismissed!
column2: 施特罗克：在战争的这一关键时刻，我们不能容许无能的指挥官白白浪费我们士兵的生命和装备。你的副指挥官(XO)将接掌指挥，你立即前往柏林向总参谋长报到。解散！

column1: Strock: At this crucial point in the war, we cannot allow any incompetent leaders to waste the lives of our men and equipment. Your XO will take over command and you will report immediately to the Chief of Staff in Berlin. Dismissed!

Strock: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall! You have captured General Patton!. We now have an armistice signed, and all fighting can stop. The U.S. is very lucky to have General Patton. He's a very reasonable man. He was instrumental in helping to draft the armistice. And you, my friend, there's talk about renaming a city in your honor. Come now, let us celebrate!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：恭喜，元帅阁下！你俘获了巴顿(Patton)将军！我们现在已签署了停战协定，一切战斗都可以停止了。美国能有巴顿将军真是幸运。他是个非常通情达理的人。他在协助起草停战协定上起了关键作用。而你，我的朋友，有人在谈论要以你的名字给一座城市重新命名。来吧，让我们庆祝一下！

column1: Strock: Due to your success in this campaign, the French are now on the run. Good job!
column2: 施特罗克：由于你在这场战役中的成功，法国人如今正在溃逃。干得好！

column1: Strock: Excellent work! The Italians should not have to worry anymore about the Allies being on their soil. Now, you must hurry your men to France. You can take only some of your ground units and all of your Luftwaffe, and head to Normandy. The rest will go further north. I will brief you again when we get up there.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：干得漂亮！意大利人不必再担心盟军踏上他们的国土了。现在，你必须把你的部下急调往法国。你只能带上一部分地面部队和你的全部空军，前往诺曼底(Normandy)。其余的将开往更北面。等我们到了那里，我会再向你交代。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! Now, our drive to Moscow is nearly complete. Also, the General Staff has successfully persuaded the Fuhrer to resume the manufacture of guns and tanks; so now in a matter of months, we will again have the ability to upgrade into the latest equipment.
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下！现在，我们向莫斯科的推进已接近完成。另外，总参谋部已成功说服元首恢复火炮与坦克的生产；所以再过几个月，我们就又能升级到最新装备了。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! You have successfully established a bridgehead in English territory!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下！你已成功在英格兰领土上建立桥头堡！

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. Despite the overwhelming number of American troops, you managed to pull through very well. I'm afraid that those are the kinds of numbers you will see in the future when you confront the Americans, so hang in there.
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。尽管美军兵力占压倒优势，你还是应付得非常好。恐怕今后你面对美军时，见到的就是这种数量的敌人，所以要挺住。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. Now, you and your reconnaisance crew need to do your celebrating in my plane, and your Luftwaffe needs to get rest right away for their journey to Berlin tomorrow. All of us have to get there ASAP. There, you will be briefed on the next mission. You are going to England!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。现在，你和你的侦察机组得到我的飞机上去庆祝，你的空军也得马上休息，明天还要飞往柏林。我们都得尽快赶到那里。在那里，你会听取下一个任务的简报。你要去英格兰了！

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. You have stopped the British offensive!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。你已挡住英军的攻势！

column1: Strock: Herr Feld-Marschall, the Soviets threaten Berlin. Zhukov is about to break the Oder Front and Konev has already broken the 3rd Panzer army lines in the South. You are the only one who can stop them !!! You are in the direct path of Konev. Feld Marschall Rommel came out of retirement to raise a Panzer Corps to slow down Zhukov.  He will try to buy some time for you. You should defeat Konev first and then Zhukov.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：元帅阁下，苏军威胁柏林。朱可夫(Zhukov)即将突破奥得河(Oder)防线，科涅夫(Konev)已突破南面的第3装甲集团军防线。只有你能挡住他们！！！你正处在科涅夫的正前方。隆美尔(Rommel)元帅已复出，组建了一个装甲军来迟滞朱可夫。他会尽力为你争取时间。你应当先击败科涅夫，再对付朱可夫。

column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。

Der Führer in his mercifulness recognizes that you had to fight against overwhelming forces, your knowledge of the French theatre and your excellent past records have given you a very last chance to keep an army leadership in the Wehrmacht. Make a good use of it!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。电报来了……元首(Der Führer)出于仁慈，承认你不得不对抗压倒优势的兵力；你对法国战场的了解与过去的优异履历，给了你最后一次在国防军中保留集团军指挥权的机会。好好利用它！

column1: Strock: Herr General the Americans have invaded Africa.  You should help the Afrika Korps to hold the line. A defeat there will threaten Italy directly.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，美国人已入侵非洲。你应当帮助非洲军守住防线。那里一败，意大利将直接受到威胁。

column1: Strock: Herr General The Western Allies have taken the island of Pantelleria outside the cost of Africa.  It is a direct threat to Sicily !!! You have to retake it.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，西方盟军已夺取非洲海岸外的潘泰莱里亚岛(Pantelleria)。这是对西西里(Sicily)的直接威胁！！！你必须把它夺回来。

column1: Strock: Herr General you have achieved victory, but the enemy has been able to withdraw most of its forces! The General Staff has decided to put somebody more daring in command for the final battles of the war! You will retire with honors, of course!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你取得了胜利，但敌人得以撤走了大部分兵力！总参谋部已决定为战争的最后几场战斗换一位更有胆识的指挥官！当然，你将带着荣誉退役！

column1: Strock: Herr General you have an opportunity to clear yourself. The Russians have broken our allies front accross the Don river. You should restore the situation !!!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，你有一个洗清自己的机会。俄国人已在顿河(Don)对岸突破我们盟友的战线。你应当恢复局势！！！

column1: Strock: Herr General, despite the enemy resistance you have destroyed the enemy factory!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，尽管敌人顽抗，你仍摧毁了敌军工厂！！

column1: Strock: Herr General, due your success at Sidi Barrani, Mussolini once again requests your guidance. This time, it is to recapture Benghazi in Cyrenaica. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，由于你在西迪拜拉尼的成功，墨索里尼再次请求你前往指导。这一次，是夺回昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)的班加西。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, here is another opportunity for you and your men to gain valuable battlefield experience. The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, and Finland has requested our help. You will meet with Colonel Talvela at Tolvajarvi to assist him at repelling their enemy. Because we basically gave Finland to the Soviet Union, you and your men will go only as volunteers. If you are captured, the German government will deny the legitimacy of your identity.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，这里又有一个让你和你的部下获得宝贵战场经验的机会。苏联已入侵芬兰，芬兰已请求我们援助。你将在托尔瓦耶尔维与塔尔韦拉(Talvela)上校会合，协助他击退敌人。由于我们基本上已把芬兰让给了苏联，你和你的部下只能以志愿兵身份前往。若你们被俘，德国政府将否认你们身份的合法性。

column1: Strock: Herr General, I need you to take some of General Heidrich's units and drive the British off of Cassino. You will also have some Italian units, Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，我需要你带上海德里希(Heidrich)将军的一部分部队，把英国人赶出卡西诺(Cassino)。你也会有一些意大利部队，祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, I want you to capture the political prisoners camps in Volchansk. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，我要你夺取沃尔昌斯克(Volchansk)的政治犯营。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, I want you to take some of your units, along with an attachment from General Strauss' 9.Armee, and lead the advance party to capture Moscow. Winter is upon us and we want to end this war quickly. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我要你带上你的一部分部队，连同施特劳斯(Strauss)将军第9集团军的一支配属部队，率领先遣队去夺取莫斯科。冬天已至，我们想尽快结束这场战争。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, Mussolini has requested your guidance, along with several reconnaissance, panzer, and artillery units to assist him in Egypt. Furthermore, since our Luftwaffe can deploy very quickly, you can bring all of your available aircraft. You and your detachment won't be away long and the rest will stay as a contingency force. This will be a great opportunity for some of your units to gain valuable battlefield experience. Good luck to you.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，墨索里尼(Mussolini)已请求你前往指导，并带上几支侦察、装甲与炮兵部队到埃及协助他。此外，由于我们的空军能极快部署，你可以带上所有可用的飞机。你和你的分遣队不会离开太久，其余部队将留作应急力量。这对你的一些部队来说，是获得宝贵战场经验的大好机会。祝你好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, the British have concentrated their last reserves in the Midlands. A victory here will be their doom!! End British resistance for good!!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，英国人已把最后的预备队集中在中部地区。在此取胜将是他们的末日！！彻底终结英国的抵抗！！！

column1: Strock: Herr General, the French have discovered that our west wall is weak, and numerous confrontations have erupted between our border guards and their patrols. The Fuhrer has decided to solve this problem in the same manner as the Polish campaign, and we have to do this now. Because as time passes, the Allies get stronger. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，法国人已发现我们的西墙虚弱，我方边防部队与他们的巡逻队之间已爆发多次冲突。元首已决定以与波兰战役相同的方式解决这个问题，而我们必须现在就动手。因为随着时间推移，盟军会越来越强。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, The Soviets are counterattacking in the direction of Kharkov. We have to stop them!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，苏军正向哈尔科夫(Kharkov)方向反击。我们必须挡住他们！

column1: Strock: Herr General, the Soviets are withdrawing in disarray! You achieved a great victory!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，苏军正溃乱撤退！你取得了重大胜利！

column1: Strock: Herr General, we are now in Operation Barbarossa. We have to neutralize Russia before we can conclude our war with England. We will do this by pushing back the Russian army far enough to keep their air forces from attacking our homeland and to deprive them of their use of naval bases. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们现在已进入巴巴罗萨行动(Operation Barbarossa)。我们必须在结束对英战争之前先解除俄国的威胁。办法是把俄军逼退得足够远，使其空军无法攻击我们的本土，并剥夺他们使用海军基地的能力。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, we have a pressing situation with Poland. For months now, the Führer has been trying to negotiate with them a generous settlement regarding Katowitz and Danzig. Since they have numerous allies on their side, including England, they have been very unreasonable and unrelenting in their demands. Several days ago, they have gotten so arrogant that they crossed our border at several places. The Führer felt obligated that in order to preserve the freedom of our citizens, we have to strike back. I want you to go forth with such force that they, and any future aggressors, will see that we will not be pushed into submission.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们在波兰问题上面临紧迫局势。数月来，元首一直在就卡托维兹(Katowitz)与但泽(Danzig)问题与他们商谈一项宽厚的解决方案。由于他们那边有众多盟友，包括英格兰，他们的要求一直极不讲理、毫不松口。几天前，他们变得如此狂妄，竟在几处越过了我们的边界。元首感到有义务回击，以保全我们公民的自由。我要你以如此强大的力量出击，让他们以及任何未来的侵略者都看到，我们绝不会被逼屈服。

column1: Strock: Herr General, we have a pressing situation with Poland. For months now, the Führer has been trying to negotiate with them a generous settlement regarding Katowitz and Danzig. Since they have numerous allies on their side, including England, they have been very unreasonable and unrelenting in their demands. Several days ago, they have gotten so arrogant that they crossed our border at several places. The Führer felt obligated that in order to preserve the freedom of our citizens, we have to strike back. I want you to go forth with such force that they, and any future aggressors, will see that we will not be pushed into submission.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们在波兰问题上面临紧迫局势。数月来，元首一直在就卡托维茨(Katowitz)与但泽(Danzig)问题与他们商谈一项宽厚的解决方案。由于他们那边有众多盟友，包括英格兰，他们的要求一直极不讲理、毫不松口。几天前，他们变得如此狂妄，竟在几处越过了我们的边界。元首感到有义务回击，以保全我们公民的自由。我要你以如此强大的力量出击，让他们以及任何未来的侵略者都看到，我们绝不会被逼屈服。

column1: Strock: Herr General, while the rest of the Luftwaffe are busy with the ports of Liverpool and Glasgow, your mission is to destroy a munitions factory nearby. Unfortunately, you have a ground restriction, we are only able to land two of your ground units. The rest of the ground units you will have attached to you are Fallschirmjager units that have been inserted several days ago. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，当空军其余部队忙于利物浦(Liverpool)与格拉斯哥的港口时，你的任务是摧毁附近的一座弹药工厂。不幸的是，你在地面兵力上有限制，我们只能让你空运两个地面部队。配属给你的其余地面部队，是几天前已潜入的伞兵部队。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, with the success of Operation Barbarossa on all fronts, our leadership has decided to shift production away from guns and tanks to U-boats and aircraft. Therefore, our ability to resupply will be reduced significantly in the coming months. Take care of our equipment.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，随着巴巴罗萨行动在各条战线上的成功，我们的领导层已决定把生产从火炮与坦克转向潜艇与飞机。因此，未来几个月我们的补给能力将大幅下降。爱惜我们的装备。

column1: Strock: Herr General, You have achieve a marvellous victory! It is almost a miracle! Kharkov is safe and our lines restored!. Good Job!!!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，你取得了了不起的胜利！这几乎是个奇迹！哈尔科夫(Kharkov)安全了，我们的战线也恢复了！干得好！！！

column1: Strock: Herr General, you have been selected to lead the invasion of England! Do not dissapoint us!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你已被选中领军入侵英格兰！不要让我们失望！

column1: Strock: I hear that the infamous General Patton is commanding the American army that you are going up against. The Americans are trying to invade Germany through Lorraine. You should defeat him, Herr General.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：我听说，那个臭名昭著的巴顿(Patton)将军正指挥着你要对阵的美国集团军。美国人正试图穿过洛林(Lorraine)入侵德国。你应该击败他，将军阁下。

column1: Strock: I'm glad you made it out of there in one piece. Those Americans took us completely by surprise, and we lost a lot of good men. Now we have to redeploy all of our troops and take them south. This is most unfortunate. ... Herr General, the war is over for you! You have to retire! With honors of course....
column2: 施特罗克：我很高兴你完好无损地从那里脱身。那些美国人完全打了我们一个措手不及，我们损失了许多好兵。现在我们必须重新部署所有部队，把他们调往南方。这真是太不幸了。……将军阁下，你的战争结束了！你必须退役！当然是带着荣誉……

column1: Strock: Let me be the first to congratulate you on your promotion, Herr Colonel! We are very pleased by your performance. I know you deserve to celebrate, but keep it short, you'll need your rest. You have a long day ahead of you tomorrow.
column2: 施特罗克：请允许我第一个祝贺你晋升，上校阁下！我们对你的表现非常满意。我知道你该庆祝一下，但别太久，你需要休息。明天还有漫长的一天等着你。

column1: Strock: Let me be the first to congratulate you on your promotion, Herr General! We are very pleased by your performance. I know you deserve to celebrate, but keep it short, you'll need your rest. You have a long day ahead of you tomorrow.
column2: 施特罗克：请允许我第一个祝贺你晋升，将军阁下！我们对你的表现非常满意。我知道你该庆祝一下，但别太久，你需要休息。明天还有漫长的一天等着你。

column1: Strock: The General Staff is very unhappy with your lucklaster performance Herr General! You need to do better or you are going to be replaced!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：总参谋部对你的平庸表现非常不满，将军阁下！你得干得更好，否则就要被替换了！

column1: Strock: The Oberkommando der Wehrmacht is highly dissapointed with your pitiful performance Herr General! You are demoted to rank of corporal where you can do less harm!
column2: 施特罗克：国防军最高统帅部(Oberkommando der Wehrmacht)对你那可怜的表现极为失望，将军阁下！你被降为下士，在那里你能少害些人！

column1: Strock: Your great victory Herr General has reduced the threat to Sicily and improved Italy's moral !!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你的重大胜利减轻了对西西里(Sicily)的威胁，也提升了意大利的士气！！！
施图登特(Student) - 1940 年 5 月 10 日

column1: Student's troops did such a great job, capturing the Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina that the Dutch capitulated before the 9th Panzer division and your troops came to the scene.
column2: 施图登特(Student)的部队干得如此出色，俘获了荷兰政府与威廉明娜(Wilhelmina)女王，以致荷兰在第9装甲师与你的部队赶到之前就已投降。

column1: Success will be encirclement of the Sixth Army.
column2: 成功即意味着对第6集团军的合围。

column1: sufficiently to resume his offensive, however, his defense is strong
column2: 以恢复攻势，然而他的防御十分坚固，
