column2: 概述 1940-1942 年席卷欧洲那场冲突的权威著作。我们非常

column1: summary of the conflict that engulfed Europe from 1940-1945.  We are most grateful that the author has allowed us to take an excerpt from his book:
column2: 概述 1940-1945 年席卷欧洲那场冲突的权威著作。我们非常感谢作者允许我们从他的书中摘录一段：

column1: Suomussalmi, but an even more powerful Soviet relief force is moving to
column2: 困住了一个苏军师，但一支更为强大的苏军解围部队正开赴

column1: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia!  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!  Your reputation in war is unparalleled.
column2: 表现得极为出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并求和。你助我们完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄国！我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的士兵睡在克里姆林宫！你在战争中的威望无与伦比。

column1: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia.  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!
column2: 表现得极为出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并求和。你助我们完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄国。我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的士兵睡在克里姆林宫！

column1: Superb performance, Comrade General.  I salute you.  You and your troops have successfully freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge.
column2: 出色的表现，将军同志。我向你致敬。你和你的部队已成功解放列宁格勒(Leningrad)。革命的诞生地又可以呼吸自由的甜美空气了。现在，我们必须帮助北面的芬兰兄弟摆脱法西斯的祸害。

column1: Superb performance, Herr General!  You have again broken the Soviet's back with your tenacity and skill!  Your troops have earned a well-deserved rest!
column2: 干得精彩，将军阁下！你再次以坚韧与技艺打断了苏军的脊梁！你的部队赢得了一次当之无愧的休整！

column1: Superb performance, we have destroyed or captured most of germany's forces in France. The end for Hitler is near! You are the best of the best, Commander!
column2: 干得漂亮，我们已消灭或俘获了德军在法国的大部分兵力。希特勒的末日近了！你是精英中的精英，指挥官！

column1: Superb work, Commander!  The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！意大利人已被逐出我们的殖民地。我军正在追击敌人，深入阿比西尼亚(Abyssynia)。意大利很快就会完全退出东非(East Africa)。

column1: Superb work, Commander! The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！意大利人已被逐出我们的殖民地。我军正在追击敌人，深入阿比西尼亚(Abyssynia)。意大利很快就会完全退出东非(East Africa)。

column1: Superb work, Herr General!  Thanks to your rapid advance across the Meuse, the Allies are in complete disarray.  You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army.  We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！多亏你迅速渡过默兹河，盟军已彻底陷入混乱。你证明了我们的战术优于那支曾号称世界最强的军队。我们现在必须迅速推进到英吉利海峡岸边，完成对敌人的击败。

column1: Superb work, Herr General!  Thanks to your rapid advance across the Meuse, the Allies are in complete disarray.  You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army.  We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
column2: 古斯塔夫防线，1944 年 1 月 17 日

column1: Supurb performance Herr General, textbook Blitkrieg. The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. The French 7th Army has been surrounded and will give up soon. We are getting in orders to move to a different sector of the front.
column2: 出色的表现，将军阁下，教科书式的闪电战。比利时国王已与我们联系，商讨投降条款。法国第7集团军已被包围，很快会放弃。我们正接到命令，要开往战线的另一地段。

column1: Sure, Cassino and the Gustav Line were tough nuts to crack, and you did the job. Anyway a lot op people at HQ think that you performance could have been much more brilliant. Very soon you'll another chance to show your talent.
column2: 没错，卡西诺(Cassino)与古斯塔夫防线是难啃的硬骨头，而你办成了。不过司令部里很多人认为你的表现本可以出色得多。很快你就会再有机会展示你的才干。

column1: surprise strike through the dense Ardennes forest, emerging at Sedan to
column2: 穿过茂密的阿登(Ardennes)森林发起突袭，前出至色当(Sedan)，

column1: surrounded 101Abn at Bastogne and keep on moving north, threatening to cut us of
column2: 被围的第101空降师，并继续北进，威胁要切断我们

column1: Take a few days for rest and refit. We have another important job for you.
column2: 花几天时间休整与整补。我们还有一项重要任务给你。

column1: Take advantange of this surprise advance and take easily the city.
column2: 利用这次突袭推进，轻松夺取该城。

column1: Take all your objectives by Paradrop, split your force to deal with the obectives simultaneously.
column2: 以伞降夺取你所有的目标，分散你的兵力以便同时处理各目标。

column1: Take back the city of Raate and while you are there, teach the Soviets a little Blitzkrieg!
column2: 夺回拉泰(Raate)城，顺便在那里给苏军上一小课闪电战！

column1: Take the city of Antwerp and advance South West. There is no time for sightseeing, this is Blitzkrieg warfare! Opposite you are the remnants of the Belgian Army and the retreating French 7th Army that was rushing into The Netherlands only a few days ago. The Belgian King has ordered 2 infantry divisions to prevent you from crossing the Schelde river. Rumor is that a cavalry division is reorganizing behind the front. The bulk of the French forces comes from the 9th Mechanized Division.
column2: 夺取安特卫普城，向西南推进。没时间观光了，这是闪电战！你面对的是比军残部和几天前还急冲入荷兰、如今正在撤退的法国第7集团军。比利时国王已下令两个步兵师阻止你渡过斯海尔德河。据传有一个骑兵师正在战线后方重整。法军主力来自第9机械化师。

column1: Take three divisions and move to conquer the city of Maldon, meanwhile another three units are moving to Watfort to close the paths to London from the North.
column2: 带三个师去攻取莫尔登(Maldon)城，同时另三个单位正开往沃特福德(Watfort)，以封闭从北面通往伦敦(London)的道路。

column1: Take your forces East and try and stabilize the situation.
column2: 带你的部队向东，设法稳定局势。

column1: Take your PanzerKorps and capture the important town of Zhytomyr.  Intelligence reports the remainder of a Soviet army group is in the vicinity, but you should be able to handle them and destroy any Russian forces foolish enough to continue fighting!
column2: 率你的装甲军夺取重要城镇日托米尔(Zhytomyr)。情报报告说，一个苏军集团军群的残部就在附近，但你应该能应付他们，并消灭任何蠢到继续顽抗的俄军部队！

column1: technological advancements that the Soviets can now employ against us,
column2: 技术进展上倒退数月、数年，苏军现在可以把这些成果用来对付我们，
特拉维夫(Tel Aviv) - 1946 年 3 月 1 日

column1: Telegram from Burgos, Generalisimo HQ:  Well done my General - stop - The entire Euzkadi is in our hands now - stop  All the industries and factories are now producing for  National Spain - stop  From now on you will receive orders exclusively from this HQ - stop.
column2: 布尔戈斯，大元帅司令部电报：干得好，我的将军 - 停止 - 整个欧斯卡迪现在都在我们手中 - 停止 所有工业和工厂现在都在为民族西班牙生产 - 停止 从现在起，你只接受本司令部的命令 - 停止。

column1: Tens of thousands of our troops are trapped in the Falaise pocket. Nothing is going to stop the Allies now from reaching the fatherland. Retreat east with the troops you have left.
column2: 我们数万部队被困在法莱斯包围圈中。如今再没什么能阻止盟军打到本土了。带你剩下的部队向东撤退。

column1: Tha landings at Anzio have gone ahead as expected although our failure to penetrate the Gustav Line will have a great impact on the battle. Send you men to the rear as per your orders, you will refit and resupply in preparation for future offensives.
column2: 安齐奥的登陆已如期进行，尽管我们未能突入古斯塔夫防线，这将对战局产生重大影响。按你的命令把你的人送往后方，你们将整补、补给，为未来的攻势做准备。

column1: Thank god we could divert some Marines to finish your job.
column2: 谢天谢地，我们能抽调一些海军陆战队来替你把事情办完。

column1: Thank god you managed to restore the situation and kept up the morale.
column2: 谢天谢地，您设法恢复了态势并维持住了士气。

column1: Thank you for playing this campaign to the very end. I hope you enjoyed it. Please post your feedback on the web forum listed in the readme.
column2: 感谢你把本战役玩到最后。希望你喜欢。请在 readme 中所列的网页论坛上留下你的反馈。

column1: Thankfully you were able to hold out long enough for the 4th Armoured Division to breakthrough and relieve you.
column2: 幸好你坚守得够久，第4装甲师得以突破并解了你的围。

column1: Thanks are in order to you and your devoted troops, you are true Communists.  The enemy is fleeing before us. And now, our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Good work, Comrade General.
column2: 应当向你和你忠诚的部队致谢，你们是真正的共产党人。敌人正在我们面前逃窜。如今，我军已成功渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)。干得好，将军同志。

column1: Thanks for defending our Reich until the end!
column2: 感谢你为保卫我们的帝国战斗到最后！

column1: Thanks for playing the 1939 campaign for Open Panzer General
column2: 感谢游玩 Open Panzer General 的 1939年战役

column1: Thanks to Maarten for letting me convert his campaign..
column2: 感谢 Maarten 允许我转换他的战役。

column1: Thanks to our combined divsions the Germans are on the run now!!
column2: 多亏了我们各师的合力，德国人现在正在逃窜！！

column1: Thanks to the movement sanctions imposed by Hitler on the German forces on the Western Front, the Leibstandarte was not immediately able to respond to the Allied landings on June 6th.  This left the 21st Panzer, Panzer Lehr and 12th SS Panzer Divisions to bear the brunt of the Allied assaults in the early stages of the battle for Caen.  Not until 28th of June were elements of the Leibstandarte - the 1st Panzergrenadier Regiment - able to arrive at Caen.
column2: 由于希特勒对西线德军施加的调动限制，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)无法立即对 6 月 6 日盟军的登陆作出反应。这使得第21装甲师、装甲教导师(Panzer Lehr)与党卫军第12装甲师在卡昂(Caen)之战初期承受了盟军突击的主要压力。直到 6 月 28 日，警卫旗队的部队——第1装甲掷弹兵团——才得以抵达卡昂。

column1: Thanks to the use of glider infantry and elite-pioneer troops Germans succeeded in taking not only two bridges over the Canal Albert (Vroenhoven and Veldwezelt, which were not destroyed on time) but also destroying the strong fortress of Eben-Emael. The capture of Eben-Emael was extremely important as it dominated the whole region and protected all the bridges in this region.
column2: 借助滑翔机步兵和精锐工兵部队，德军不仅成功夺取了阿尔贝运河上的两座桥梁（弗鲁恩霍芬和费尔德韦泽尔特，这两座桥未能及时炸毁），还摧毁了坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞。夺取埃本-埃马尔极为重要，因为它俯瞰整个地区，并保护该地区所有桥梁。

column1: Thanks to this victory, the 9th army under your command and the 16th army can help each other. The 16th will move to the north while we will move to the West.
column2: 多亏这场胜利，由你指挥的第9集团军和第16集团军可以互相策应。第16集团军将向北移动，而我们将向西移动。

column1: Thanks to you great successes, now we have the possibility to surround the rookie armies going to the Tunisian coast, more exactly, the city of Bone.
column2: 多亏你的重大胜利，现在我们有机会包围开往突尼斯海岸的新手军队，更确切地说，是博纳城。

column1: Thanks to you great successes, now we have the possibility to surround the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, city of Bone.
column2: 多亏了你的巨大成功，现在我们有机会包围那些正开往突尼斯海岸的新手军队，更确切地说，是博讷(Bone)城。

column1: Thanks to you they will be needed!
column2: 多亏了你，他们才会派上用场！

column1: Thanks to you we've got Ivan on the run.
column2: 多亏了你，我们已让伊万(Ivan)溃逃。

column1: Thanks to your brilliant command you have managed to evacuate the germ of a new Belgian army. The fight can now continue in France, in Congo or wherever is needed to restore the independence and freedom of Belgium.
column2: 由于你出色的指挥，你成功撤出了新比利时军队的种子。战斗如今可以在法国、在刚果，或任何需要的地方继续，以恢复比利时的独立与自由。

column1: Thanks to your feeble efforts, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on.  You will return immediately to Germany to face a court martial. Your replacement here will be Herr General Rommel.  You are dismissed.
column2: 由于你软弱无力的表现，北非的战事将继续拖延下去。你须立即返回德国接受军事法庭审判。你在此处的继任者是隆美尔将军阁下。你可以退下了。

column1: Thanks to your feeble efforts, the war in the Med will continue to drag on.  You will return immediately to England to face a court martial. Your replacement here will be General Montgomery.  You are dismissed.
column2: 多亏你软弱无力的努力，地中海(Med)的战事还将继续拖延下去。你将立即返回英格兰(England)接受军法审判。接替你这里职务的是蒙哥马利(Montgomery)将军。你可以走了。

column1: Thanks to your good work, our base at Linjiang is now safe.  In addition, we are now in a good position to attack Changchun, Jilin and Siping during the next summer offensive.  We will wait for good weather to arrive in Manchuria.
column2: 多亏你出色的工作，我们的临江基地现在安全了。此外，我们现在处于有利地位，可以在下一次夏季攻势中进攻长春、吉林和四平。我们将等待满洲好天气的到来。

column1: Thanks to your great performance in the 1938 manouvres, you have been assigned to command the "1ère Divison de Cavalerie" of our army. As you know, this an elite motorized division of the regular army that thanks to its greater mobility can help other units where needed, notably performing reconnaissance and providing protection. We are confident you will honour your tasks.
column2: 由于你在1938年演习中的出色表现，你被任命为我军第1骑兵师（“1ère Divison de Cavalerie”）的指挥官。如你所知，这是正规军中的一支精锐摩托化师，凭借其更强的机动能力可以在需要之处支援其他部队，尤其是执行侦察和提供掩护。我们相信你能够胜任这些任务。

column1: Thanks to your great successes, we now have the possibility of surrounding the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, the city of Bone.
column2: 多亏你取得的巨大胜利，我们现在有机会合围正在向突尼斯海岸推进的新手部队，更确切地说，是博讷城。

column1: Thanks to your heroic resistance we were able to reach Kalach. We have started a huge evacuation of Stalingrad and initiated the retreat of the Caucasus army.
column2: 多亏您的英勇抵抗，我们才得以抵达卡拉奇。我们已开始大规模撤离斯大林格勒，并着手让高加索集团军后撤。

column1: Thanks to your superb last success, we have the posibility of enclosing the rookie armies reaching to the Tunisian coast, particularly the city of Bone.
column2: 多亏您上一次的出色胜利，我们有机会围歼正在抵达突尼斯海岸的新兵部队，特别是博讷城。

column1: That defeat has galvanized Soviet forces across the map.
column2: 那场失败使全图的苏军都振作了起来。

column1: That didn't go as well as I hoped.
column2: 事情进展得不如我希望的那样顺利。

column1: that his troops would capture the old city of Caen on the first day of the
column2: 他的部队将在诺曼底登陆的第一天

column1: That is correct, Mr Churchill, he was captured by Rommel himself, or so they say; what a shame. General Montgomery arrived here early this morning and has taken over the defense of our positions at El Alamein, all is not lost yet.
column2: 没错，丘吉尔先生，他是被隆美尔本人俘虏的，至少他们是这么说的；真令人惋惜。蒙哥马利将军今天一早抵达这里，已接管我们在阿拉曼阵地的防御，还没有全盘皆输。

column1: That performance makes m e think you're auditioning for a command in
column2: 那样的表现让我觉得你是在为太平洋(Pacific)战区

column1: That railroad provided nearly half of Ivan's supplies to his forward units.
column2: 那条铁路为伊万(Ivan)的前线部队提供了近一半的补给。

column1: That terrain was brutal but you wern't slowed down a bit. I smell a promotion coming your way.
column2: 那地形极为恶劣，但你丝毫没有被拖慢。我闻到你就要升官了。

column1: That was a little too close for my liking general.
column2: 那对我来说有点太近了，将军。

column1: That was a very close run thing, but you held
column2: 那真是千钧一发，但你守住了

column1: That was as fine an example of mobile warfare as I've ever seen.
column2: 这是我所见过的最漂亮的运动战范例。

column1: That was close but you pulled it off.
That was close General, but you pulled it off.
column2: 那很险，将军，但你成功了。

column1: That was close General, but you pulled it off.
column2: 比利时(Belgium) - 1945 年 8 月 10 日

column1: That was one heck of a bit of soldiering.
column2: 那可真是一手了不起的军人本事。

column1: That was truely brilliant Commander! You have shattered the last Russian reserves. The road to Novograd is open.
column2: 那真是出色极了，指挥官！你打碎了俄国人最后的预备队。通往诺沃格拉德的道路已经打开。

column1: That would change the whole nature of this war.
column2: 那会改变这场战争的整个性质。

column1: The "1re Division de Chassesurs Ardennaises" has already been sent to the town of Vinkt to reinforce the front.
column2: “第1阿登猎兵师”已奉命前往芬克特镇增援前线。

column1: The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to protect the north flank of the deployment replacing the French troops which are moving back to France.
column2: “骑兵军”必须掩护部署的北翼，接替正撤回法国的法军部队。

column1: The "Corps de Cavalerie" is being reorganized behind the front line but you may be requested to provide some support if the situation requires so. We have been informed that the Germans will try to test our positions around the city of Leuven.
column2: “骑兵军”正在前线后方整编，但如形势需要，可能会要求您提供支援。我们已获悉德军将试探鲁汶城周边的我军阵地。

column1: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has been broken in some places but I am confident that it will check the German advance. You just need to gather your troops and take again the bridgehead the Germans have made
column2: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）在若干地段被突破，但我相信它能阻止德军前进。您只需收拢部队，夺回德军建立的桥头堡。

column1: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has resisted as we thought. The Germans have suffered heavy losses and have not been able to break through our lines.
column2: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）果然如我们所料顶住了。德军损失惨重，未能突破我军防线。

column1: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has withstood German pressure well. The Germans have suffered important losses and have had a rough time to get some small bridgeheads. They will soon be cleaned up.
column2: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）很好地顶住了德军的压力。德军损失重大，费了很大力气才夺得几处小桥头堡。这些桥头堡很快就会被肃清。

column1: The 1st Polish Armor division has made contact with the US 90th Infantry Division near Chamboix causing multiple divisions of ours, between Falaise and Argentan, to be cut off during our retreat East. Your division got out in time. Counterattack and break through the Polish lines to get as much troops out of the Falaise pocket as possible.
column2: 波兰第1装甲师已在尚布瓦附近与美军第90步兵师会合，使我们在向东撤退途中、位于法莱斯与阿让唐之间的多个师被切断。你的师及时脱身。反击并突破波军防线，尽可能多地把我军救出法莱斯包围圈。

column1: The 1st SS PanzerKorps has been reformed and I've placed you in charge.
column2: 党卫军第1装甲军已重建，我已让你担任指挥。

column1: The 21st Red army defends the bridges, you must occupy all the bridges and hold them as long as the relief comes.
column2: 红军第21集团军防守着那些桥梁，你必须占领所有桥梁，并坚守到援军到来。

column1: The 26 and the 47 infanterie divisions are already taking positions around the Somme River, which is a possible bridgehead. Your mission is to deploy your forces here to aid in the crossing of the Somme River. Amiens is the biggest objective of your mission. Intelligence reports show that the garrison of Amiens consist only of one BEF regiment, but personally, I know the Frenchs will fight hard trying to avoid the crossing of the Somme.
column2: 第26与第47步兵师已在索姆河周边占领阵地，那里可能成为桥头堡。你的任务是把部队部署在此，协助强渡索姆河。亚眠是你这项任务中最大的目标。情报显示亚眠的守军只有一个英国远征军(BEF)团，但就我个人所知，法国人会拼命作战，力图阻止我们渡过索姆河。

column1: The 26th Pz and 334th infantry divisions are on their way from the northwest.
column2: 第26装甲师与第334步兵师正从西北开来。

column1: The 29th PzGrenadier Division has been ordered to the area and will arrive from the northwest.
column2: 第29装甲掷弹兵师已奉命开赴该地区，将从西北抵达。

column1: The 3rd PzGrenadier division is on the way towards Alife from the north.
column2: 第3装甲掷弹兵师正从北面开往阿利费(Alife)。

column1: The 4th Romanian Army and a German Panzer Corps try to open land communication with the troops surrounded in Stalingrad.
column2: 罗马尼亚第4集团军与一个德国装甲军试图打通与被围在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的部队的陆上联系。

column1: The 50st Red army is defending the Bryansk area. You must attack the  Bryansk and Orel city areas and break down the resistance of the Soviet army - especially tank brigades and strong artillery batteries.
column2: 红军第50集团军正在防守布良斯克地区。你必须进攻布良斯克与奥廖尔(Orel)城区，打垮苏军的抵抗——尤其是坦克旅和强大的炮兵连。

column1: The 82nd and 101st ABs will hold their bridges and the road open at any cost. SHAEF cannot stress how important it is this road is held. The success or failure of the entire battle hinges on this objective.
column2: 第82与第101空降师将不惜任何代价守住他们的桥梁并保持道路畅通。盟国远征军最高司令部(SHAEF)怎么强调守住这条道路的重要性都不过分。整场战斗的成败就系于这一目标。

column1: The 82nd has 2 of their three bridges secure and will launch an attack on the northern Nijmegan bridge tomorrow.
column2: 第82师的三座桥已有两座确保无虞，明天将对奈梅亨(Nijmegan)北面的那座桥发起攻击。

column1: The 82nd has taken the Nijmegan bridge and the way to Arnhem is clear.
column2: 第82师已夺取奈梅亨(Nijmegan)大桥，通往阿纳姆(Arnhem)的道路已经打开。

column1: The advance through France continue successfully, like in Italy.
column2: 穿越法国的推进像在意大利一样顺利继续。

column1: The aims of Operation Spring Awakening were as wildly ambitious as those laid out for the Ardennes offensive three months previously.  They were: to destroy the Soviet forces in the region bounded by Lake Balaton and the Danube and Drava rivers, secure the Hungarian oil deposits, and establish bridgeheads over the Danube with a view to further offensive operations.
column2: 「春醒」行动(Operation Spring Awakening)的目标，与三个月前为阿登攻势所定的目标一样狂妄。它们分别是：消灭巴拉顿湖(Lake Balaton)与多瑙河(Danube)、德拉瓦河(Drava)之间地域内的苏军，确保匈牙利的油田，并在多瑙河上建立桥头堡，以便进一步发起攻势作战。

column1: The Allied attacks were not making progress at the Gustav Line and instead the Allies therefore lauched an attack from Anzio called "Operation Diadem". This attack was pointed at Rome. The Germans were not able to stop it.
column2: 盟军对古斯塔夫防线的进攻毫无进展，于是转而从安齐奥发起一次名为「王冠行动」(Operation Diadem)的进攻。这次进攻直指罗马。德军未能挡住它。

column1: The Allied forces attempt to breakout in Normandy against the Germans.
column2: 盟军部队试图在诺曼底(Normandy)对德军实施突围。

column1: The Allies breakout of the mountains onto the Steppes
column2: 盟军冲出山地，进入草原

column1: The Allies continue their drive on Astrakhan
column2: 盟军继续向阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)推进

column1: The Allies controls the passes between mountains and they are now in the Po River valley.
column2: 盟军控制着各条山口之间的通道，他们现在已经进入波河(Po River)谷地。

column1: The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot do any more attacks, we will only defend our positions because our units are in bad shape!
column2: 盟军已能挡住我们的推进！从现在起我们不能再发动任何进攻，我们只能防守我们的阵地，因为我们的部队状况很差！

column1: The allies have been barely stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Anyway, now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
column2: 盟军在仰光城下勉强被挡住了。不管怎样，现在我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

column1: The allies have been stop you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成既定目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而你手上的部队又太少。

column1: The allies have been stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
column2: 盟军在仰光城下被挡住了。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

column1: The allies have been stopped you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成预定目标。我们明白，这确实非常艰难，而且你手里的部队太少了。

column1: The Allies have been stopped you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成既定目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而你手上的部队又太少。

column1: The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible deception for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
column2: 盟军已摧毁你的部队。这对我们的人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是一场可怕的欺骗。你的下一个目的地是西伯利亚(Siberia)。

column1: The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible dissapointment for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
column2: 盟军已消灭你的部队。这对我们的人民、对PCUS、对斯大林都是可怕的失望。你的下一个去处是西伯利亚。

column1: The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible shock for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia. Vorkuta is a perfect destination for a diet...
column2: 盟军消灭了你的部队。这对我人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是可怕的打击。你的下一个去处是西伯利亚(Siberia)。沃尔库塔(Vorkuta)是个减肥的绝佳去处……

column1: The Allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible treachery for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
column2: 盟军已摧毁你的部队。这对我们的人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是一场可怕的背叛。你的下一个目的地是西伯利亚(Siberia)。
盟军希望入侵萨哈林岛(Sakhalin Island)，打苏联人一个措手不及

column1: The Allies landed in Normandy June 6 1944, 2 days ago. Yesterday preparations were made to come to march readiness. Today we are moving out. First stop is the Limoges-Tulle area. We will travel there in two columns. Be aware of partisan attacks. Resistance activity has increased considerably over the last few days throughout France.
column2: 两天前，也就是1944年6月6日，盟军在诺曼底登陆。昨天已做好行军准备。今天我们就要开拔。第一站是利摩日-图勒地区。我们将分两路纵队前往。提防游击队袭击。过去几天，全法国的抵抗活动已明显加剧。

column1: The Allies Meet stiff resistance at Kazan
column2: 盟军在喀山(Kazan)遭遇顽强抵抗

column1: The Allies pushed us to the mountains, but we still keep the important passes.
column2: 盟军把我们逼进了山里，但我们仍守着那些重要的隘口。

column1: The Allies surround Soviet forces at Ekaterinburg
column2: 盟军在叶卡捷琳堡包围苏军

column1: The Allies try to kick the Germans out of the fortified city of Metz.
column2: 盟军试图把德军逐出设防城市梅斯(Metz)。

column1: The Allies, after securing a beachhead in Italy, try to push the Germans
column2: 盟军在意大利(Italy)取得滩头阵地之后，试图把德军

column1: The Allies, after securing a beachhead in Italy, try to push the Germans away from Salerno and drive northward towards Naples.
column2: 盟军在意大利(Italy)取得滩头阵地之后，试图把德军逐离萨莱诺(Salerno)，并向北朝那不勒斯(Naples)推进。

column1: The American forces have been defeated!  All of North Africa is now under our control.  The American missile base has been destroyed and is no longer a threat.
column2: 美军已被击败！整个北非现在都在我们控制之下。美军的导弹基地已被摧毁，不再是威胁。

column1: The American presence in our motherland has been eliminated with one hit. I am sure that they won't try any more similar thing. Good work!
column2: 美国人在我们祖国的存在被一击清除。我确信他们不会再尝试类似的事情了。干得好！

column1: The American tanks are inferior to ours but their air power should not be underestimated.  Intelligence has reported a new American submarine that is deadly.  Fortunately only one of these submarines is expected in the area and should not cause any problems to our mighty Navy.
column2: 美军的坦克不如我们，但他们的空中力量不可低估。情报报告了一种致命的新型美国潜艇。所幸该地区预计只有一艘这样的潜艇，不会给我们强大的海军带来任何麻烦。

column1: The Americans and British have pushed us back across the Rhine. We no longer have the strength to halt them. All that is left for the fatherland is defeat and disgrace. But you have already experienced that. Haven't you, Herr General?
column2: 美军和英军已把我们赶回莱茵河对岸。我们再也没有力量阻止他们。留给祖国的只剩失败与耻辱。可你早已体会过这一切了，不是吗，将军阁下？

column1: The Americans are quite hard-headed; after their bloody nose at Nancy they are probably planning an assault on our fortress city of Metz. You are to stop them at all costs.
column2: 美国人相当顽固；在南锡碰得头破血流之后，他们大概正计划进攻我们的要塞城市梅斯。您须不惜一切代价阻止他们。

column1: The Americans have launched a full scale offensive across the Vire. You will counterattack, restore the situation and make sure we keep St. Lo.
column2: 美国人已全线发起横渡维尔河的攻势。您将实施反突击，恢复态势，并确保我们守住圣洛。

column1: The Americans have retreated up the coast; for now.  Prepare your defenses for an expected counterattack.
column2: 美军已沿海岸后撤；至少眼下如此。做好防御准备，迎接预料中的反击。

column1: The Americans have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of German to escape.
column2: 美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马(Rome)——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: The Americans must capture the German town and airfield at Dessau.
column2: 美军必须夺取德绍(Dessau)的德国城镇与机场。

column1: The Anglo-American forces have disembarked in French territory, and set off at full speed following a route to Tunisia. After your defeat in Egypt, this is the only defendable sector of Africa that we have left.
column2: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，并沿通往突尼斯的路线全速开进。在你们于埃及战败之后，这是我们在非洲仅剩的可守之地。

column1: The Angloamerican attempt to surprise us from behind was a complete failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
column2: 英美联军从背后偷袭我们的企图彻底失败了，从现在起我们可以专心考虑下一个进攻目标。

column1: The Angloamerican attempt to surprise us from behind was a complete failure, now we can concentrate on fight agaisnt Monty in the Mareth Line.
column2: 英美军队想从背后偷袭我们，结果彻底失败，现在我们可以专心在马雷特防线(Mareth Line)对付蒙蒂(Monty)了。

column1: The Angloamerican forces have disembarked in French territory, at full speed following a route to Tunisia, after your defeat in Egypt, this is the only defendible sector of Afrika that we have left.
column2: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，正全速取道突尼斯；你在埃及战败之后，这是我们手中非洲唯一还可防守的地段了。

column1: The assault on Monte Cassino has succeeded and we can breach the line at our current strength. Unfortunately the landings at Anzio have not gone ahead as expected.
column2: 对卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)的突击已经成功，我们以现有兵力就能突破这道防线。遗憾的是安齐奥(Anzio)的登陆没有按预期进行。

column1: The attack began at first light on the 16th December against the American lines, which were thinly held by six divisions of resting and newly arrived troops.  The LSSAH attack came after the intial defences had been breached by the 12th Volksgrenadier Division, and the division - split into Kampfgruppe - made it's way through the heavy snow and narrow roads towards their objectives.
column2: 进攻于 12 月 16 日拂晓发起，直指美军防线；该防线由六个正在休整和新到的师稀疏地防守着。警卫旗队的进攻是在第12国民掷弹兵师突破最初防御之后发起的，该师分成若干战斗群，穿过大雪与狭窄的道路，向各自的目标前进。

column1: The attack on Moscow is in its preparation stages. Your forces are being positioned around the city itself along with the majority of Allied forces.
column2: 对莫斯科的进攻正处于准备阶段。你的部队正与该地区大部分盟军部队一起，部署在该城周围。

column1: The attack on neutral Bulgaria proved a blessing for us: The Bulgarian government invited the English in and on the outskirts of Sofia these violently clashed with the Soviet troops. This was all the incident Churchill needed: the case of Bulgaria was blown up in the Anglo-American press, and thus came about the cease-fire with the western allies you undoubtedly heard of.
column2: 对中立国保加利亚的进攻结果反倒成了我们的幸事：保加利亚政府把英国人请了进来，在索菲亚近郊他们与苏军发生了激烈冲突。这正是丘吉尔所需要的事件：保加利亚事件在英美报界被大肆渲染，于是便有了您无疑已听说过的与西方盟国的停火。

column1: The attack on north and north-east line of operations on Zhukovka and Turgenevo cities is now about to start. If you can close nearer to Tula we could launch an attack on Moscow this year. Make this happen!
column2: 对茹科夫卡(Zhukovka)与图尔格涅沃(Turgenevo)两城北面与东北面作战地段的进攻即将开始。你若能逼近图拉，我们今年就能对莫斯科发起进攻。务必办到！

column1: The attack was launched at 03:30hrs on the 5th of July.  The three SS divisions moved on three parallel lines of advance.  Fighting through thick minefields north of Byelgorod, Leibstandarte was by 19:30hrs on the southern outskirts of Jakovleva, a village within the second defensive line some 14 miles into Soviet territory, and had taken 97 killed and 522 wounded.
column2: 进攻于7月5日03:30时发起。三个党卫军师沿三路平行轴线推进。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在别尔哥罗德(Byelgorod)以北穿过浓密雷场奋战，到19:30时已进抵雅科夫列沃(Jakovleva)南郊——该村位于深入苏联领土约14英里的第二道防线之内——自身阵亡97人、负伤522人。

column1: The Axis fascists are at Stalingrad.  It is time to show the Party that you are the one to lead Soviet troops to the final victory in Berlin.
column2: 轴心国法西斯分子已打到斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)。现在该向党证明，你才是能率领苏军走向柏林最终胜利的人。

column1: The Axis forces have reached the El Alamein line. I am sure you are aware of the news from Russia, Germany has just launched a major offensive aimed at advancing to the Volga and into the Caucasus. After El Alamein there is nothing to stop Rommel advancing to the Nile and controlling the Suez Canal, the Allies are retreating on all fronts - we will retreat no further!
column2: 轴心国部队已抵达阿拉曼防线。我相信你已知道来自俄国的消息，德国刚刚发动了一场大规模攻势，目标是推进到伏尔加河(Volga)并进入高加索(Caucasus)。过了阿拉曼，就没有什么能阻挡隆美尔推进到尼罗河并控制苏伊士运河了，盟军正在各条战线上撤退——我们绝不再退！

column1: The Axis never found themselves in a position to assault Malta.
column2: 轴心国从未具备进攻马耳他的条件。

column1: The Axis players take on the Allied players.
column2: 轴心国玩家对阵盟国玩家。

column1: The Axis powers attack the Allies at Monte Cassino to relieve the pressure on the Central Italian Front.
column2: 轴心国军队在卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)进攻盟军，以减轻意大利中部战线的压力。

column1: The Axis powers try to recover Pantelleria island taken by the Western Allies.
column2: 轴心国试图夺回被西方盟军占领的潘泰莱里亚岛(Pantelleria)。

column1: The Axis powers try to stop the Western Allies drive into Tunis.
column2: 轴心国试图阻止西方盟军向突尼斯(Tunis)推进。

column1: The Axis troops try desperately to find a path to evacuate their troops isolated in the Crimea.
column2: 轴心国部队拼命寻找一条路径，以撤出被孤立在克里米亚(Crimea)的部队。

column1: The Axis-held island of Pantelleria has proved to be a thorn in our side. Aircraft from this island bastion are harassing our convoys and threaten our proposed invasion opf Sicily. You must capture the island so we can proceed with our invasion plans.
column2: 轴心国占据的潘泰莱里亚(Pantelleria)岛已成为我们的一根刺。从这个岛屿堡垒起飞的飞机正袭扰我们的船队，并威胁我们计划中的西西里登陆。你必须夺取该岛，好让我们能继续实施入侵计划。

column1: The bad news is that we're not done yet.
column2: 坏消息是，我们还没打完。

column1: The bad news is the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.
column2: 坏消息是安齐奥的美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: The base remains in Soviet hands, and our forces have taken serious losses.
column2: 基地仍在苏军手中，我军遭受了严重损失。

column1: the battle and the amount of casualties taken on both sides. Try not to
column2: 以及双方遭受的伤亡并不满意。尽量别

column1: The Battle of Bzura was distinguished by the great bravery of the trapped Polish forces, who by now facing annihilation, put up a spirited defence.  By the 19th however, the jaws closed around them.
column2: 布祖拉河之战以被围波兰军队的极大勇气而著称，他们此时已面临覆灭，仍进行了顽强的防御。然而到 19 日，钳口已在他们周围合拢。

column1: The battle of Kharkov cost the Leibstandarte 167 officers, 4,373 NCOs and soldiers - 44 percent of its fighting strength.  The square in Kharkov was renamed 'Leibstandarteplatz' in the division's honour, and on March 21st, Hitler awarded Dietrich the Swords to his Knights Cross.
column2: 哈尔科夫(Kharkov)之战让警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)付出了 167 名军官、4,373 名军士与士兵的代价——占其战斗力的 44%。哈尔科夫广场被更名为「警卫旗队广场」(Leibstandarteplatz)以纪念该师，3 月 21 日，希特勒授予迪特里希(Dietrich)骑士铁十字勋章的双剑饰(Swords)。

column1: The BEF and some troops of the French 1st army have created a defensive perimeter around Dunkerque to ensure the evacuation of the greatest number of troops. Our 14 DI, which has been in Yser for some days to cover the rear of the army in case of a German advance from the west, has begun to build bridges to allow you to retreat.
column2: 英国远征军和法国第1集团军的部分部队已在敦刻尔克周围建立防御圈，以确保尽可能多的部队撤离。我们的第14步兵师已在伊瑟河一带驻守数日，以便在德军自西面推进时掩护军队后方，现在它已开始架桥，供你撤退。

column1: The Belgian Army has taken positions on the Terneuzen canal, Gent/Gand bridgehead and the Escaut/Scheldt River. Most of our divisions are under strength and have already lost 1/3 of their material after ten days of continuous fight and several retreats. Some units are close to collapse but the Army in general can still fight.
column2: 比利时军队已在泰尔讷曾运河、根特桥头堡和斯海尔德河上占领阵地。经过十天连续作战和数次撤退，我们大多数师都不满编，且已损失三分之一的装备。有些部队濒临崩溃，但全军总体上仍能战斗。

column1: The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. Because of your slow advance, the French 7th Army has escaped South before it could be surrounded. Prepare to get orders to move to a different sector of the front.
column2: 比利时国王已与我们联系，商讨投降条款。由于你推进迟缓，法国第7集团军在尚未被包围前就南逃了。准备接受命令，开往战线的另一地段。

column1: The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. The French 7th Army has been surrounded and will give up soon. We are getting in orders to move to a different sector of the front.
column2: 比利时国王已与我们联系，商讨投降条款。法国第7集团军已被包围，很快会放弃。我们正接到命令，要开往战线的另一地段。

column1: The Belgian unconditional surrender came into effect at 04:00 on 28 May. Recriminations abounded with the British and French claiming the Belgians had betrayed the alliance. The reality was that since 25 May the Allies were aware of the critical Belgian situation. In spite of that, the Belgians extended their resistance for almost three days, frequently holding after British unexpected withdrawals, allowing the Allied armies to prepare their evacuation. On the contrary, when it was inquired if any Belgians were to be evacuated, the Chief of General Staff for the British Expeditionary Force replied "We don't care a bugger what happens to the Belgians".
column2: 比利时的无条件投降于5月28日04:00生效。英国和法国指责比利时背叛了联盟，怨言四起。事实是，自5月25日起盟国就已知道比利时的危急处境。尽管如此，比利时人仍把抵抗延长了近三天，常常在英军意外撤退后继续坚守，使盟军得以准备撤离。相反，当有人询问是否要撤出比利时人时，英国远征军总参谋长回答说“我们才不在乎比利时人怎么样”。

column1: The biggest tank battle of all time wis about to begin. Soviet tank armies, infantry, heavy artillery and Red air force will render your task highly difficult. Soviet defences are strong, they have fortified the area and have the resolution to hold it at all cost.
column2: 史上规模最大的坦克战即将开始。苏军坦克集团军、步兵、重炮兵与红军空军将使你的任务极为艰难。苏军防御坚固，他们已将该地区筑垒设防，并有不惜一切代价守住的决心。

column1: The bolshevik bidgehead has been crushed, but Russian forces have crossed the Mius at multiple other locations. Kharkov is now under severe Russian pressure. Send your troops to the Kharkov area to safeguard the city. Your well-trained Panther battalion will join you shortly.
column2: 布尔什维克的桥头堡已被粉碎，但俄军已在其他多处渡过米乌斯河(Mius)。哈尔科夫(Kharkov)现在承受着俄军的沉重压力。把你的部队派往哈尔科夫地区，保卫该城。你那支训练有素的「黑豹」营很快就会与你会合。

column1: The bolsheviks have crossed the Mius South of the Kursk salient near the village of Stepanovka in an effort to divert forces from the attack on Kursk. Throw them back to the other side of the river.
column2: 布尔什维克已在库尔斯克突出部以南、斯捷潘诺夫卡村附近的米乌斯河渡河，试图牵制用于进攻库尔斯克的兵力。把他们赶回河对岸。

column1: The Borodino scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, a Russian armored train was added and the Russian air units were renamed.
column2: 博罗季诺(Borodino)场景及其使用的地图由汉内斯·格鲁伯(Hannes Gruber)制作。做了一些小改动：部署格、增加了一列俄国装甲列车，并重新命名了俄国空军部队。

column1: The brigade recon battalion, commanded by Kurt 'Panzer' Meyer was then odered to advance further through the Klissura Pass and on to Lake Kastoria.  One of the most infamous incidents of the SS is recorded from this assault.  Finding his soldiers pinned down by enemy fire and unwilling to attack, Meyer decided to toss a grenade at his own soldiers.  The effect was immediate, the soldiers picked themselves up and wrested control of the enemy positions from the ANZAC defenders.
column2: 旅属侦察营在库尔特·「装甲」·迈尔(Kurt 'Panzer' Meyer)指挥下，随后奉命继续穿过克利苏拉山口(Klissura Pass)，向卡斯托里亚湖(Lake Kastoria)推进。党卫军最臭名昭著的事件之一就记录于这次突击之中。迈尔发现自己的士兵被敌军火力压制住、不愿进攻，便决定朝自己的士兵扔手榴弹。效果立竿见影，士兵们爬起来，从澳新军团(ANZAC)守军手中夺下了敌军阵地。

column1: The British 1st AB will continue it's assault on Arnhem with the objective being to capture and hold the northern end of the bridge until it can be reinforced by Paradrop and Gliders. They must also hold their Drop Zone.
column2: 英国第1空降师将继续其对阿纳姆(Arnhem)的突击，目标是夺取并守住大桥北端，直到能由伞降与滑翔机增援。他们还必须守住自己的空降场。

column1: The British 1st Airborne Division is to land on the clear ground northwest of Arnhem, protect this dropzone for the 2nd drop tomorrow and advance towards Arnhem.
column2: 英国第1空降师将在阿纳姆(Arnhem)西北的开阔地着陆，为明天的第2次空投保护这个空降场，并向阿纳姆推进。

column1: The British are hanging on and will be saved by the 30th Corps when they arrive.
column2: 英军仍在苦撑，等第30军赶到就能得救。

column1: The British are in control of Gibraltar and are receiving support from the best that the Americans and Soviets can offer.  We have mined their naval port but this is not expected to keep them out of the battle for too long.
column2: 英军控制着直布罗陀，并正得到美国人与苏联人所能提供的最好的支援。我们已对他们的海军港口布雷，但料想这无法长久把他们挡在战斗之外。

column1: The British attempt to smash Rommel's armor south of Tobruk.  Rommel
column2: 英国人试图在托布鲁克(Tobruk)以南击碎隆美尔(Rommel)的装甲部队。隆美尔

column1: The British attempt to smash Rommel's armor south of Tobruk.  Rommel launches a counter-attack in the afternoon.  By sunset, every British unit trying to get to the "Cauldron" has been driven back.
column2: 英军试图在托布鲁克(Tobruk)以南击碎隆美尔的装甲部队。隆美尔在下午发起反击。到日落时，每一支试图冲进「大锅」的英军部队都被击退了。

column1: The British Expeditionary Force has been evacuated from the mainland at Dunkirk. The best divisions of the French Army have surrendered or are in disarray and on the run. Our Panzers are in pursuit heading South. Your forces are ordered to take part in mopping up the Maginot line - a complex of fortifications along the German-French border. You will attack the fortresses from the rear while 2 infantry divisions of the 7th Armee / Armee Gruppe C get the difficult task of attacking the fortresses head-on. Orders are to capture the command posts of the 2 big fortresses in the area. Das Oberkommando has asked you to prevent French troops from fleeing into Switzerland. Brandenburg Kommandos are on site to recon the area.
column2: 英国远征军已从敦刻尔克撤离大陆。法军最精锐的各师或已投降，或溃不成军、四处奔逃。我们的装甲部队正向南追击。你的部队奉命参加清剿马奇诺防线——德法边境上的一片筑垒体系。你将从后方攻击这些要塞，而第7集团军／C集团军群的两个步兵师则承担正面强攻要塞的艰巨任务。命令是夺取该地区两座大型要塞的指挥所。最高统帅部要求你阻止法军逃入瑞士。勃兰登堡突击队已到场侦察该地区。

column1: The British Expeditionary Force is making a last stand at Dunkirk.  They are starting to evacuate much of their army back to England.
column2: 英国远征军(British Expeditionary Force)正在敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)做最后的抵抗。他们已开始把大部分军队撤回英格兰。

column1: The British have finally admitted that their tanks are worthless against ours.  In order to delay our advance into Lebanon, the enemy is using swarms of infantry and older aircraft in the hopes that they can destroy some small portion of your Core Army.
column2: 英国人终于承认，他们的坦克对我们的坦克毫无价值。为了迟滞我们向黎巴嫩(Lebanon)的推进，敌人正动用成群结队的步兵和老旧飞机，指望能消灭你核心军队的一小部分。

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!!
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！！

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!.
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shot you with my Walter P-38!!.
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！

column1: The British however seem more and more inclined to peace after their defeat at Arnhem.......
column2: 不过英国人在阿纳姆战败之后，似乎越来越倾向于和平……

column1: The British offensive has been stopped fortunately. However, we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
column2: 幸好英军的攻势已被挡住。不过，我们必须把部队撤到更安全的位置。

column1: The British offensive has been stopped fortunately. However, we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
The British ran into heavy resistance north of Arnhem and haven't yet reached the city but will be bulstered by a second paradrop tomorrow.
column2: 英军在阿纳姆(Arnhem)以北遭遇顽强抵抗，尚未抵达该城，但明天将有第二次伞降增援他们。

column1: The British resistance into the British streets has been really hard, but finally we get the control over the city. Now we are controlling most of the South East coast of England.
column2: 英军在英国的街巷中抵抗得十分顽强，但我们最终还是控制了这座城市。现在我们控制着英格兰(England)东南海岸的大部分地区。

column1: The British showed us a fierce resistance, but finally they have been defeated. Now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
column2: 英国人向我们展示了顽强的抵抗，但他们最终还是被击败了。现在，我们可以在这里建立我们的司令部，并开始从大陆本土接收补给。

column1: The British will hold onto the north end of Arnhem bridge and their Drop Zone if they can and hope the 30th Corps can get through in time to relieve them.
column2: 英国人若能守住阿纳姆(Arnhem)大桥北端及其空降场，他们就会守住，并指望第30军能及时打过来解救他们。

column1: The Brits are driving from the West and should link up with your forces.
column2: 英国人正从西面推进，应当会与你的部队会合。

column1: The Brits are sending support from your left, they should be here by
column2: 英国人正从你左翼派出支援，他们应在

column1: The Brits say they can see the effect on Soviet attacks.
column2: 英国人声称他们能看出对苏军进攻的影响。

column1: The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and thank you for playing.
column2: 战役已到尽头，你的表现极为出色，胜过了历史上的实况。恭喜，并感谢你的游玩。

column1: The campaign represents operation "Fall Gelb" from the Belgian perspective. It reproduces some of the battles held during the 18 days the Belgian army fought against the Germans.
column2: 本次战役从比利时的视角再现了“黄色方案”行动。它重现了比利时军队与德军作战的18天中发生的一些战斗。

column1: The Central Committee is very displeased.  Leningrad continues to suffer under enemy bombardment.  You are clearly unfit to lead troops into combat.  Report at once to Ulyanovsk.  A detachment of Red Octobrists are waiting for you to join them.
column2: 中央委员会极为不满。列宁格勒(Leningrad)仍在敌军轰炸下受苦。你显然不适合带兵作战。立即前往乌里扬诺夫斯克(Ulyanovsk)报到。一支红色十月分队正等着你加入。

column1: The Central Committee is very displeased.  Leningrad continues to suffer under enemy bombardment.  You are clearly unfit to lead troops into combat.  Report at once to Ulyanovsk.  A detachment of Red Octobrists are waiting for you to join them.
The city is ours. However, the Germans are not impressed with the length of
column2: 城市已归我们所有。不过，德国人对这场战斗的时长

column1: The city of Kalach on the Don River is their objective.
column2: 他们的目标是顿河(Don)上的卡拉奇(Kalach)城。

column1: The city of London still resist to our efforts Herr General. We need your intervention to take the city and end British resistance for good!!!
column2: 伦敦城仍在抗拒我们的努力，将军阁下。我们需要你出手拿下该城，彻底终结英国的抵抗！！！

column1: The city remains in Soviet hands, blockading the northern roads to Moscow.
column2: 该城仍在苏军手中，封锁着通往莫斯科(Moscow)的北方道路。

column1: The Civil War in Spain provided a testing ground for the German

The Civil War in Spain provided a testing ground for the German Wehrmacht, as well as the Soviet and Italian armies. In the battle of Guadalajara, northwest of Madrid, both sides committed some of their best units as the Nationalists tried to cut off Madrid, still held by the Republic despite repeated attacks.
column2: 西班牙内战为德国国防军以及苏联和意大利军队提供了试验场。在马德里(Madrid)西北的瓜达拉哈拉(Guadalajara)之战中，双方都投入了一些最精锐的部队——国民军试图切断马德里，而共和国虽屡遭进攻，仍守住了这座城市。

column1: The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our offer of surrender. Now we must assault the city to end the British control over North Africa.
column2: 埃及海岸已被封锁，亚历山大和塞得港都在我们控制之下，然而英国人并未接受我们的投降提议。现在我们必须突入该城，以终结英国对北非的控制。

column1: The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our surrender. Now, we must assault the city in order to end the British control over North Africa.
column2: 埃及海岸已被封锁，亚历山大(Alexandria)与塞得港(Port Said)都在我们控制之下，然而英国人还没有接受我们的招降。现在，我们必须突击该城，以终结英国对北非的控制。

column1: The combined German and Italian army attempts to push back British forces in North Africa.
column2: 德意联军试图在北非击退英军。

column1: The communist troops have been completely defeated by your quick actions. The problems with the guerrillas of the ChCP are finished for a long time, I hope.  Congratulations! you have been awarded the Order of the Golden Kite 2nd class.
column2: 共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予二等金鵄勋章。

column1: The complete division reached Normandy about 20th June and was kept in reserve for more than a week.
column2: 全师于 6 月 20 日前后抵达诺曼底(Normandy)，并作为预备队保留了一周多。

column1: The convoy's path is cleared with plenty of time to spare. And the Soviet forces are reeling from your counter-attack behind their lines. Keep it coming Commander.
column2: 运输队的通路已清空，还富余出大量时间。而苏军正因你在其战线后方的反击而踉跄后退。继续干，指挥官。

column1: The convoy's path is cleared. And the Soviet forces are reeling
column2: 运输队的通路已清空。而苏军正因你在其战线后方的

column1: The cutting off of the Greek withdrawal to the south was accomplished by 20 April, following a pitched battle in the 5,000 foot high Metsovon Pass in the Pindus Mountains. Realizing the hopelessness of the situation, the Greek commander offered to surrender his army, which then consisted of fourteen divisions. After brief negotiations, which, on strict orders from Hitler, were kept secret from the Italians, the surrender was accepted with honorable terms for the defeated. In recognition of the valor with which the Greek troops had fought, their officers were permitted to retain their side arms. The soldiers were not treated as prisoners of war and were allowed to go home after the demobilization of their units.
column2: 4 月 20 日，在品都斯山脉(Pindus Mountains)中 5,000 英尺高的迈措翁山口(Metsovon Pass)进行了一场激战之后，切断希腊军队向南撤退的任务完成。希腊指挥官意识到局势已无望，提出率其当时由 14 个师组成的军队投降。经过短暂谈判——按照希特勒的严令，谈判对意大利人保密——投降被接受，战败方获得了体面的条件。为表彰希腊部队作战的英勇，他们的军官获准保留随身武器。士兵没有被当作战俘对待，在部队复员后获准回家。

column1: The DAS REICH campaign puts you in control of the SS units known as SS-Division Verfuegungstruppe, SS-Division Das Reich, SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich and 2SS Panzer Division Das Reich. The division was one of the classic SS divisions that quickly earned a reputation for courage and bravery.
column2: 本「帝国」师战役让你指挥党卫军部队——党卫军「武装」师(SS-Verfuegungstruppe)、党卫军「帝国」师(SS-Division Das Reich)、党卫军装甲掷弹兵「帝国」师(SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich)和第2党卫军装甲师「帝国」师。该师是经典的党卫军师之一，很快以勇敢无畏赢得了声誉。

column1: The defense of Nancy is very important right now. President Beck is desperately trying to make peace with the western allies. In order to attain this he has permitted the Italians, the Bulgarians and the Finns to get out of the war, and has withdrawn from Greece. At this moment secret negotiations are taking place in Spain: though Churchill is still insisting on an unconditional surrender he is the only one receiving our envoy.
column2: 当前保卫南锡至关重要。贝克总统正拼命设法与西方盟国媾和。为此他已允许意大利、保加利亚和芬兰退出战争，并已从希腊撤军。此刻在西班牙正在进行秘密谈判：尽管丘吉尔仍坚持无条件投降，但他是唯一接见我方使者的人。

column1: The disembark has been succesful, but now we've reached the heart of the British Empire: London. I am sure that the red flag will look very well in the top of the Big Ben. Churchill and the Royal Family have escaped from the country, and they are travelling to Canada, the British moral is broken, but it will not avoid a furious fight on the suburbs of London. Good Luck... you will need it.
column2: 登陆成功了，但我们现在已抵达大英帝国(British Empire)的心脏：伦敦(London)。我确信红旗挂在大本钟(Big Ben)顶上会非常好看。丘吉尔(Churchill)与王室已逃离这个国家，正在前往加拿大(Canada)，英国人的士气已经崩溃，但这仍无法避免在伦敦郊区的一场狂怒战斗。祝好运……你会需要它的。

column1: The dissarray of the greeks against their goverment has lead to a people's revolution, where the comunists greek partisans are taking the lead of that revolt. Our mission is to help the partisans in their fight. In all the ways, Stavka have been planed to attack Greece to avoid a potential allied land here. Our comrades spies are sending reports us about the allied presence in this area, take care, a defeat here will bring the allies the opportunity to attack our motherland.\x00\x00
column2: 希腊人对其政府的混乱状态导致了一场人民革命，共产主义希腊游击队员正在领导这场起义。我们的任务是帮助游击队员进行斗争。无论如何，最高统帅部已计划进攻希腊，以防盟军在此登陆。我们的同志间谍正把这一地区盟军存在情况的报告送给我们，小心，这里的失败会给盟军进攻我们祖国的机会。\x00\x00

column1: The division's troops saw action in Poland, The Netherlands, Belgium, France, The Balkans, Russia, Normandy, The Ardennes, Hungary, Vienna and Prague. Expect a Blitzkrieg type of campaign with battalion size units.
column2: 该师部队转战波兰、荷兰、比利时、法国、巴尔干、俄国、诺曼底、阿登、匈牙利、维也纳和布拉格。这是一场营级规模的闪电战式战役。

column1: The Dniepr River offers the strongest natural defensive line in western European Russia, but the losses incurred in battles to the east of the river denied Hitler the resources adequately to man and fortify the line and, coupled with the fact that the Red Army had established five bridgeheads over the river, the positions the Wehrmacht held was at best tenuous.  The stark reality of the situation was that in just two and a half months Army Group Centre and South had been forced back for an average of 150 miles on a front 650 miles long, and in so doing, had the lost the most valuable territory taken during the advances of 1941-42.
column2: 第聂伯河是俄国西部最强的天然防线，但在该河以东各次战斗中遭受的损失，使希特勒没有资源为这道防线配备足够兵力并加以筑垒设防；再加上红军已在该河上建立了五个桥头堡，国防军所守的阵地充其量也只是勉强维持。形势的严酷现实是：仅仅两个半月，中央与南方两个集团军群就在一条 650 英里长的战线上平均后退了 150 英里，并因此丢掉了 1941-42 年推进中所夺取的最宝贵领土。

column1: The Dukla pass is one of the few roads into Slowakia. You are to defend it at all costs.
column2: 杜克拉山口是通往斯洛伐克的少数几条道路之一。您须不惜一切代价守住它。

column1: The Dutch forces have suffered a stinging defeat.  This means the outcome is a technical victory in this campaign.  The enemy is still holding some critical positions in other sectors, we must clear them.
column2: 荷兰军队遭受了惨重失败。这意味着本次战役的结局已可算作技术性胜利。敌军仍在其他地区死守一些关键阵地，我们必须将其肃清。

column1: The Dutch forces have suffered a total defeat, Java is free!!!
column2: 荷兰军队彻底失败，爪哇自由了！！！

column1: The Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina managed to escape to England, but the Dutch capitulated after a few days of fighting. Congratulations.
column2: 荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王成功逃往英格兰，但荷兰人在几天战斗后即告投降。恭喜。

column1: The Dutch have resisted in this jungle area since January General.  Bogor and other nearby places are the last bases which the enemy still holds on this island. Your command will be split in two groups; your task is to clear the jungle of enemy elements and to seize all other objectives.  Select carefully the jungle paths for your troops.  I think the jungle will be our worst enemy here.
column2: 将军，自1月以来荷兰人一直在这片丛林地区顽抗。茂物及附近其他地点是敌军仍在该岛据守的最后基地。您的部队将分为两路；您的任务是肃清丛林中的敌军，并夺取所有其他目标。请为部队谨慎选择穿越丛林的路线。我想丛林将是我们在这里最大的敌人。

column1: The emperor again wants to give you the opportunity to select your next destination. By taking the Australian flag, you will go to New Guinea.  If you decide instead to take the British flag, your troops will be deployed in our coming campaign in Burma. Where will you go?
column2: 天皇再次希望给您选择下一个目的地的机会。夺取澳大利亚国旗，您将前往新几内亚。如果您改为夺取英国国旗，您的部队将被部署到我们即将展开的缅甸战役中。您要去哪里？

column1: The Emperor Hiro-Hito sends his best and most sincere congratulations to you.
column2: 裕仁天皇向您致以最诚挚的祝贺。

column1: The encirclement of the 6th Army at Stalingrad was a disaster of the worst kind for Germany.  A vast gap was formed in the line, through which Soviet troops stormed forward, towards Rostov, Kursk and Kharkov.  As Kursk fell on the 8th February, the right flank of Army Group B was forced onto Kharkov.  Hitler, remembering the way the Waffen-SS units defended themselves during the winter of 1941 ordered the SS-Panzer Corps to hold Kharkov.  SS-Panzer Corps commander  Paul Hausser disobeyed orders and pulled out of the city.  There they held firm and halted the Soviet attack.  Von Manstein now prepared an assault to destroy the Soviet troops around Kharkov.
column2: 第6集团军在斯大林格勒被合围，对德国来说是最糟糕的一类灾难。防线上出现了一个巨大的缺口，苏军由此向前猛冲，直指罗斯托夫、库尔斯克和哈尔科夫。2 月 8 日库尔斯克陷落后，B 集团军群的右翼被迫退向哈尔科夫。希特勒想起武装党卫军部队在 1941 年冬天自卫的方式，命令党卫军装甲军守住哈尔科夫。党卫军装甲军军长保罗·豪塞尔(Paul Hausser)违抗命令，撤出了该城。他们在那里坚守，挡住了苏军的进攻。冯·曼施坦因随即准备一次突击，以消灭哈尔科夫周围的苏军。

column1: The enemy airforce is completely destroyed, so our Stukas can work without any opposition, and bomb the enemy positions easily. We expect a fast and complete victory here which allow us to get the complete surrender of the French forces.
column2: 敌军航空兵已被彻底摧毁，因此我们的斯图卡(Stuka)可以毫无阻碍地行动，轻易轰炸敌军阵地。我们期待在此迅速取得全胜，从而迫使法国军队全面投降。

column1: The enemy commander Stilwell and the British forces escaped to India and China.
column2: 敌军指挥官史迪威与英军已逃往印度和中国。

column1: The enemy commander, Stilwell has been captured and  the British and China forces destroyed!.  The victory in Burma is complete!!
column2: 敌军指挥官史迪威已被俘，英军与中国军队均被歼灭！缅甸的战事已大获全胜！！

column1: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
column2: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

column1: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now, the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
column2: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

column1: The enemy has been surprised, however we could not get the complete victory, some units have escaped, and surely the British will launch a counteroffensive...
column2: 敌人被打了个措手不及，但我们未能取得全胜，部分敌军逃脱了，英军肯定会发动反攻……

column1: The enemy has been unable to crack our new Funkschlüssel and is spread thin across thousands of kilometers of coastal territory.  The time is right to invade British occupied Algeria.
column2: 敌人一直未能破译我们新的无线电密钥(Funkschlüssel)，且兵力稀薄地散布在数千公里的沿海地带。现在正是入侵英占阿尔及利亚(Algeria)的时机。

column1: The enemy has regrouped and launched a counter offensive against our quickly erected defenses.  You must immediately repel the attack and continue our Egyptian campaign to eliminate the Americans.
column2: 敌人已重整并对我方仓促构筑的防线发起反攻。你必须立即击退这次进攻，并继续我们的埃及战役，消灭美军。

column1: The enemy have stopped our units. We must dig in and await the next British strikes, this won't be easy General...
column2: 敌人挡住了我军。我们必须构筑工事，等待英军的下一次打击，这不会轻松，将军……

column1: The expected German attack has started. Early in the morning the Germans have crossed the Dutch border and in few hours they will arrive at our delaying line ("Position de Couverture") situated behind the Canal Albert and the Maas river from Antwerp to Arlon. With the support of the strong fortress of Eben-Emael, you must contain the Germans in the "Position de couverture" for as long as possible in order to allow our troops, as well as that of our French and British allies, to occupy their positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position for our allies), the main defence line where is foreseen to fight the decisive battle.
column2: 预料中的德军进攻已经开始。清晨德军越过了荷兰边境，几小时内他们就会抵达我们位于阿尔贝运河与马斯河之后、从安特卫普到阿尔隆的迟滞线（“Position de Couverture”）。在坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞支援下，你必须在“Position de couverture”尽可能久地遏制德军，以便我军以及法国和英国盟军的部队进入“Ligne KW”（我们的盟友称之为戴尔河阵地）的阵地，那是预计将进行决定性会战的主要防线。

Expect the Italians to let the Americans and their inferior weapons fight the battle for them.
column2: 意大利战役的最后阶段已定：入侵西西里。保护好你的登陆艇，从一个港口移动到另一个港口太费时间。意大利海军残余正在守卫海峡。务必当心，不要在错误的一侧海峡部署过多兵力。预计意大利人会让美国人和他们那些低劣的武器替他们打仗。

column1: The Finns are very impressed.  Your elite divisions bring glory to the Fatherland.  Germany needs more Generals like you!

column1: The first stage of our operations is over, we've secured the coasts and now is our turn to go inside the island.
column2: 我们作战的第一阶段已经结束，海岸已经确保，现在轮到我们深入岛内了。

column2: 即将展开的这场战斗将在您迄今遇到的最恶劣地形上进行。我们预计地形对您推进的阻滞作用将超过敌军。这是我们在印度和中国边境之前阻止我们的最后机会。

column2: 法国人挡住了我们的主攻！这完全是场灾难。现在我们对低地国家的进攻被挡住了，我们将面对又一场堑壕战……就像 1914 年那样。你被解职了。

column1: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
column2: 总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志丝毫没有瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，就能打开通往苏伊士运河和石油资源丰富的中东的道路。

column1: The General Staff has just decided to play a bold card on the table, commander: you are to lead another amphibious assault aimed at Anzio and the nearby villages, just behind the enemy defensive line. The idea is to cut off the way to Rome for the Nazi. If this operation succeeds, the Krauts will be forced to leave the Gustav Line to defend Rome or avoid any encirclement. Anyway, it won't be easy for your forces, since as you well know feldmarschall Kesselring has already demonstrated his ability to prevent our plans and react quickly on the battlefield. So be aware: in a few time your landing force could be challenged by strong enemy counterattacks. Hope that bad weather does not set in or it will be extremely hard.
column2: 指挥官，总参谋部刚刚决定在桌上打出一张大胆的牌：你将指挥又一次登陆作战，目标是安齐奥(Anzio)及附近村庄，就在敌军防线正后方。用意是切断纳粹分子通往罗马(Rome)的道路。如果这次行动成功，那些德国佬就不得不放弃古斯塔夫防线去保卫罗马，或者避免被合围。不管怎样，对你的部队来说这都不会轻松，因为你很清楚，凯塞林(Kesselring)元帅已经证明他有能力破坏我们的计划并在战场上迅速反应。所以要当心：不久之后，你的登陆部队就可能遭到敌军猛烈反击。但愿坏天气不要到来，否则会极其艰难。

column1: The General Staff is pleased with your manoeuvre. You have protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" and stopped the German advance. You must now join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
column2: 总参谋部对您的机动感到满意。您掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，并阻止了德军前进。现在您必须与主力会合，继续作战。

column1: The General Staff is proud of your commendable manouvre. You have not only protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" but you have reconquered Zwijndrecht and stopped the German advance, forcing them to cross the Escaut river back. You must now join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
column2: 总参谋部为您值得称赞的机动感到自豪。您不仅掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，还夺回了兹韦恩德雷赫特，阻止了德军前进，迫使他们退回斯海尔德河对岸。现在您必须与主力会合，继续作战。

column1: The General Staff is satisfied with your manoeuvre. You have protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" but the Germans have not stopped and are already putting pressure on our new positions. You must quickly join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
column2: 总参谋部对您的机动感到满意。您掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，但德军并未停下，已经在向我军新阵地施压。您必须迅速与主力会合，继续作战。

column1: The German "trade space for time" strategy seems quite successful. They are exploiting very well the terrain conditions to delay our advance while putting up the Gustav Line. Commander, if you are able to wipe out soon enough the enemy positions before the Garigliano and Rapido rivers we may have a chance to break the Gustav Line by the end of the year. Let's see if you can do it.
column2: 德军的「以空间换时间」策略看来相当成功。他们很善于利用地形迟滞我军推进，同时构筑古斯塔夫防线。指挥官，如果你能及时肃清加里利亚诺河(Garigliano)与拉皮多河(Rapido)一线的敌军阵地，我们或许有机会在年底前突破古斯塔夫防线。就看你的了。

column1: The German 18th Army is tempting to cross our lines in several places. Your mission is to hold the line and avoid the Germans creating any bridgehead.
column2: 德军第18集团军正试图在多处突破我军防线。您的任务是守住防线，不让德军建立任何桥头堡。

column1: The German 56th Infantry Division has crossed the Canal de Dérivation defended by the 4 "Division d'Infaterie" and has established a bridgehead around the village of Meigem.
column2: 德军第56步兵师已渡过由第4“步兵师”防守的分洪运河，并在梅海姆村周围建立了桥头堡。

column1: The German army has launched a general offensive against our lines. Their main effort seems to be on the Leie/Lys river but our positions at the "Canal Dérivation de la Lys" are also being attacked simultaneously on several places.
column2: 德军已对我军防线发起总攻。其主攻方向似在利斯河，但我们在“利斯河分洪运河”上的阵地也在多处同时遭到攻击。

column1: The German army has made significant progress.  Your PanzerKorps must complete an encirclement by capturing Ternopil' from the east.  Of course, in the process, destroy the Soviet forces defending it.
column2: 德军已取得重大进展。你的装甲军必须从东面夺取捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')，以完成合围。当然，在此过程中还要消灭守御该地的苏军。

column1: The German army has made significant progress.  Your PanzerKorps must complete an encirclement by capturing Ternopil' from the east.  Of course, in the process, destroy the Soviet forces defending it.
column2: 德军已取得重大进展。你的装甲军必须从东面夺取塔尔诺波尔(Ternopil')，以完成合围。当然，在此过程中还要消灭守御该地的苏军。

column1: The German Army is holding defensive positions in the vicinity of Metz. This will be a tough assignment Commander. Hopefully you are up to the task.
column2: 德军正在梅斯附近据守防御阵地。指挥官，这将是一项艰巨的任务。但愿你能胜任。

column1: The German assault in the west finally began before daylight on May 9th, with extensive air attacks on Dutch and Belgian airfields and the seizure of vital river crossings by paratroops.  When dawn came, the Leibstandarte, as part of 18th Army, Army Group B, drove into Holland, with its main column striking towards the southern Netherlands to envelop the southern flank of the 'Vesting Holland' region.
column2: 西线的德军进攻终于在 5 月 9 日天亮前开始，包括对荷兰与比利时机场的大规模空袭，以及伞兵夺取重要的渡河点。黎明到来时，警卫旗队作为 B 集团军群第18集团军的一部开入荷兰，其主力纵队向荷兰南部突击，以包抄「荷兰要塞」地区的南翼。

column1: The German defenders try to prevent an easy victory for the Americans.
column2: 德军守备部队则力图不让美军轻松取胜。

column2: 德军试图把美国东部一分为二，而美军则力图守住诺克斯维尔——黄金储备所在地。

column1: The German plan for the 1940 campaign in the west centered around a surprise strike through the dense Ardennes forest, emerging at Sedan to drive across France to the English Channel. This portion of the French line was considered the safest outside of Maginot, shielded as it was by the heavily forested Ardennes.
column2: 德军1940年西线战役的计划核心，是穿过茂密的阿登森林发动突然打击，在色当穿出，然后横贯法国直抵英吉利海峡。法军防线的这一段被认为是马奇诺防线之外最安全的地段，因为有森林密布的阿登作为屏障。

column1: The German player tries to release the 6th Army encircled in Stalingrad.
column2: 德军玩家试图解救被合围在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的第6集团军。

column1: The German troops try to clear Polish forces from Mlawa and Ciechanow.
column2: 德军试图把波兰部队从姆瓦瓦(Mlawa)与切哈努夫(Ciechanow)清除出去。

column1: The German troops try to clear Polish forces from Mlawa and Ciechanow.  The Polish army attempts to defend their homeland against the German invaders.
column2: 德军试图把波兰军队逐出姆瓦瓦(Mlawa)与切哈努夫(Ciechanow)。波兰军队则力图保卫家园，抗击德国入侵者。

column1: The German-Italian force attempts to capture Tobruk in North Africa.
column2: 德意军队试图夺取北非的托布鲁克。
