column1: The Germans and Romanians fight desperately to gain time for the 17th Army to evacuate Sevastopol.
column2: 德国人与罗马尼亚人拼死苦战，为第17集团军撤离塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)争取时间。

column1: The Germans and Romanians try to reopen the supply line to Stalingrad, while the Soviets dig in and await the attack.
column2: 德国人和罗马尼亚人试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒的补给线，而苏军则挖壕据守，等着他们进攻。

column1: The Germans and their allies invade the USA near Savannah.
column2: 德国及其盟友在萨凡纳附近入侵美国。

column1: The Germans are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in capturing the Ruhr, you drove the Nazis back to Berlin. Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allies and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 你和你勇敢的部下打出的重击，让德国人晕头转向、摇摇欲坠！你不仅成功夺取了鲁尔，还把纳粹赶回了柏林。指挥官，就在我们说话的此刻，盟国与德国的外交代表正在会晤……你在这里以及在整个欧洲一连串的胜利，是无可比拟的。你该回到心怀感激的祖国了。

column1: The Germans are holding the main battleline and are certain a swift strike from the NW around Dropov, plus an airborne landing with naval resupply in the NE around Rostoff and also a huge armour spearhead up the West flank, will cause the eventual collapse of the whole front.
column2: 德军正固守主战线，并确信：从西北方向德罗波夫一带发起的迅猛突击，加上东北方向罗斯托夫一带的伞降登陆与海上补给，以及西翼一支庞大的装甲矛头，终将导致整条战线全面崩溃。

column1: The Germans are on the run now!!
The Germans attack the American and French forces near Strasbourg.
column2: 德军进攻斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)附近的美军与法军部队。

column1: The Germans attack the American and French forces near Strassbourg.
column2: 德军进攻斯特拉斯堡(Strassbourg)附近的美军与法军。

column1: The Germans attack the flank of the Russians spearheads heading West after Stalingrad.
column2: 德军进攻斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)之后向西开进的俄军矛头的侧翼。

column1: The Germans attack the flank of the Russians spearheads heading West.
column2: 德军向正在西进的俄军先头部队侧翼发起攻击。

column1: The Germans attack the Western Allies in the Ardennes.
column2: 德军在阿登(Ardennes)进攻西方盟军。

column1: The Germans attack to cut the Western Allies Front in two.  Bastogne and St. Vith are their objectives.
column2: 德军发起进攻，以把西方盟军的战线切成两段。巴斯托涅(Bastogne)与圣维特(St. Vith)是他们的目标。

column1: The Germans attempt to push through central Norway, hoping to destroy
column2: 德军试图突穿挪威中部，希望在

column1: The Germans attempt to push through central Norway, hoping to destroy the Norwegian army before the British Expeditionary Force arrives.
column2: 德军试图穿过挪威中部，希望在英国远征军抵达之前歼灭挪威军队。

column1: The Germans attempt to push through the Australian and New Zealand
column2: 德军试图突破澳大利亚与新西兰

column1: The Germans attempt to push through the Australian and New Zealand lines on the way to Athens, Greece.
column2: 德军试图在通往希腊雅典的路上突破澳大利亚和新西兰军队的防线。

column1: The Germans counterattack to destroy the Allies beachheads.
column2: 德军反击，以摧毁盟军的滩头阵地。

column1: The Germans defend St. Lo the key to the Normandy peninsula from the Western Allies attack.
column2: 德军防守圣洛(St. Lo)——诺曼底(Normandy)半岛的钥匙——抵御西方盟军的进攻。

column1: The Germans drive on the road towards Moscow.
column2: 德军沿公路向莫斯科推进。

column1: The Germans failed to take this city in 1942.
column2: 1942 年德军未能攻下这座城市。

column1: The Germans have had a difficult time but despite your efforts our position is very weak and sooner than expected we will need to evacuate Vinkt.
column2: 德军打得很艰难，但尽管你努力了，我们的阵地仍非常虚弱，我们将比预期更早地需要撤出芬克特。

column1: The Germans have just entered into Luxembourg and will soon cross the Belgian border and enter into the Belgian Ardennes. You must support the "1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais
column2: 德军刚刚进入卢森堡，很快就会越过比利时边界，进入比利时阿登地区。你必须支援“1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais

column1: The Germans have launched a major offensive in the Ardennes region in the dead of winter.  Our American allies are reeling from the blows.  Once again, you must go to their aid.
column2: 德军在隆冬时节于阿登(Ardennes)地区发动了一场大规模攻势。我们的美国盟友被打得摇摇欲坠。你又一次必须前去救援。

column1: The Germans have pushed us back to our starting point. We will be lucky if we can halt them.  Your brave men have suffered terribly. You are ordered back to London where you will face a firing squad!
column2: 德国人已把我们逼回出发点。我们若能挡住他们就算走运了。你勇敢的部下伤亡惨重。你被命令返回伦敦(London)，在那里等候你的将是一排行刑枪手！

column1: The Germans have pushed us back.  We will be lucky if we can hold Antwerp. The war may still be lost!  You are ordered back to London where you will face a firing squad!
column2: 德国人把我们打退了。能守住安特卫普(Antwerp)就算我们运气好。这场战争可能还是会输！兹命令你返回伦敦(London)，你将在那里面对行刑队！

column1: The Germans have received reinforcements (225th Infantry Division) and have now secured the bridgehead of Meigem. They are now attacking the positions near Vinkt. This is an important crossroads that has to be held at all costs.
column2: 德军得到了增援（第225步兵师），现在已经稳固控制了梅海姆桥头堡。他们正在进攻芬克特附近的阵地。这是一个重要的十字路口，必须不惜一切代价守住。

column1: The Germans managed to give the Belgians a tactical defeat. The 7th division was almost completely destroyed and had to be sent to France for reorganisation. The Belgians could only stop the Germans for one day at the Albert canal instead of the three days initially planned. But worse, the loss of the Eben-Emael fortress was a serious psychological blow.
column2: 德军得以给比利时人一场战术失败。第7师几乎被全歼，不得不被送往法国整编。比利时人在阿尔贝运河只能阻挡德军一天，而不是原计划的三天。但更糟的是，失去埃本-埃马尔要塞是一次严重的心理打击。

column1: The Germans must inflict a severe enough defeat that the Allies begin evacuating the beaches.
column2: 德军必须给盟军以足够沉重的打击，迫使他们开始从海滩撤离。

column1: The Germans try to break through the Anglo-French lines and capture
column2: 德军试图突破英法联军防线，夺取

column1: The Germans try to break through the Anglo-French lines and capture the French city of Dunkirk.
column2: 德军试图突破英法联军防线，夺取法国城市敦刻尔克。

column1: The Germans try to eliminate the Kursk bulge.
column2: 德国人试图消除库尔斯克(Kursk)突出部。

column1: The Germans try to liberate Eastern Germany and the Baltic coast from the Russian occupation. Objectives: Danzig, Konisberg and Memel.
column2: 德国人试图把东德与波罗的海沿岸从俄国占领下解放出来。目标：但泽(Danzig)、柯尼斯堡(Konisberg)与梅梅尔(Memel)。

column1: The Germans try to open the gate to Moscow at Klin, while the Soviet
column2: 德军试图在克林(Klin)打开通往莫斯科的门户，而苏军

column1: The Germans try to open the gate to Moscow at Klin, while the Soviet forces attempt to slam it closed.
column2: 德军试图在克林打开通往莫斯科的大门，而苏军则试图把这扇门砰然关上。

column1: The Germans try to rescue Mussolini jailed in the Abruzzi.
column2: 德国人试图营救被囚于阿布鲁佐(Abruzzi)的墨索里尼(Mussolini)。

column1: The goal is to destroy the Army Group and to open the direct road to
column2: 目标是消灭该集团军群，并打开直通

column1: The good news is you have performed brilliantly, as usual - a textbook offensive. The Poles and the French army have performed way beyond all expectations, and the American did not do too badly either.
column2: 好消息是你一如既往地表现出色——一场教科书式的攻势。波兰人与法国陆军的表现在各方面都远超预期，美国人也干得不算差。

column1: The good news is you have performed well. The bad news is that the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.
column2: 好消息是你表现良好。坏消息是安齐奥的美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: The Great Stalin himself congratulates you and your devoted young troops; you are true Communists.  The fascists are fleeing before us, and now our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Very good work, Comrade.
column2: 伟大的斯大林本人向你和你忠诚的年轻部队致贺；你们是真正的共产党人。法西斯分子正在我们面前逃窜，如今我军已成功渡过第聂伯河。干得非常好，同志。

column1: The Great War - A summary of the conflict from 1940-1945
The greatest first successes were scored by 5th and 56th British Infantry Divisions in the zone of Garigliano River, where they captured the towns of Minturno and Castelforte.
column2: 最初最大的战果由英国第5与第56步兵师在加里利亚诺河(Garigliano)一带取得，他们夺取了明图尔诺(Minturno)与卡斯泰尔福尔特(Castelforte)两镇。

column1: The high command sends it highest regards!  Every other army commander envies you and your SS PanzerKorps!  Continue with the war, Herr General!
column2: 最高统帅部致以最崇高的敬意！其他每一位集团军司令都羡慕你和你的党卫军装甲军！继续打下去，将军阁下！

column1: The high command thinks that it's time to strike the enemy again, like in the past, surprising the Allies from the South. Your task is to surround the enemy from the South, and capture the Alexandria Supplyline. The Alam Halfa ridge is an important and strategical place, you must secure it also. Viel Gluck!.
column2: 最高统帅部认为现在该再次打击敌人了，像过去那样从南面让盟军措手不及。你的任务是从南面包围敌人，并夺取亚历山大(Alexandria)补给线。阿拉姆哈勒法岭(Alam Halfa ridge)是一个重要的战略要点，你也必须确保它。祝好运！(Viel Gluck)

column1: The historical dialectic has once again proven its inevitable truth.  We stand at the gates of the fascist capital.  It is your task, Comrade General, to destroy this nest of vipers so that the Soviet peoples' sacrifices will not have been pointless.  Once the enemy along the Seelow Heights have been eradicated, the road to the fascist capital will be open.  Good luck, Comrade.
column2: 历史辩证法再一次证明了它必然的真理。我们已兵临法西斯首都城下。将军同志，你的任务是摧毁这个毒蛇之巢，使苏联人民的牺牲不致白费。一旦肃清塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)沿线的敌人，通往法西斯首都的道路就将打开。祝你好运，同志。

column1: The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally and repel the soviets.
column2: 匈牙利首都布达佩斯(Budapest)正被红军围困。德军必须突破苏军防线，帮助他们最后剩下的盟友并击退苏军。

column1: The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally.
column2: 匈牙利首都布达佩斯被红军围困。德军必须突破苏军防线，去援助他们硕果仅存的盟友。

column1: The II and III Ukrainian Fronts attack the Axis Southern Ukraine Army Group across the Dniestr river.  A Soviet victory will lead to the destruction of the Army Group and the occupation of Romania.
column2: 乌克兰第2与第3方面军(II and III Ukrainian Fronts)渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)进攻轴心国南乌克兰集团军群。苏军获胜将导致该集团军群被歼灭，罗马尼亚(Romania)被占领。

column1: The initial landing area has proven to be inhospitable.  Scout the region for a better landing area.
column2: 最初的登陆场已被证明不宜登陆。侦察该地区，另寻一处更好的登陆场。

column1: The invasion of France has begun!, after the conquest of Poland in 1939, and with the still unfinished Operation Weserübung, the Wehrmacht has crossed the Ardennes Forest, and you are the general with the duty of manage the attack, starting at Sedan, where the French Army will surely be completely surprised. Can you drive the Wehrmacht to Paris?
column2: 入侵法国已经开始！在1939年征服波兰之后，在「威瑟演习」行动(Operation Weserübung)尚未结束之际，国防军已穿过阿登森林(Ardennes Forest)，而你就是那位肩负指挥这次进攻之责的将军，进攻从色当(Sedan)开始——法国陆军在那里必定会完全措手不及。你能把国防军带到巴黎(Paris)吗？

column1: The invasion of Poland is in its fourth day. While German panzer divisions are spearheading toward Warsaw, the German 8th Army has reached the river Warta. The Poles have set up a strong defensive Line and await the German assault.
column2: 入侵波兰已进入第四天。当德国装甲师正作为矛头直指华沙之际，德军第8集团军已抵达瓦尔塔河。波军已筑起一道坚固防线，等待德军进攻。

column1: The invasion of Poland marked the start of World War II in Europe.
column2: 入侵波兰标志着第二次世界大战在欧洲爆发。

column1: The invasion of this area of the British Islands has been a total success. A big beachhead has been established.
column2: 对这一带英伦诸岛的入侵取得了完全成功。一个大滩头阵地已经建立。

column1: The invasion of this southern area of England has been succesfully, a beachhead has been established, and now our army can fully disembark. Good Work, Stalin is delighted with your actions.
column2: 对英格兰(England)这一南部地区的入侵已经成功，滩头阵地已经建立，如今我军可以全面登陆了。干得好，斯大林对你的行动非常满意。

column1: The Italian naval aircraft Re 2001 can be repaired and resupplied on the carrier and on any Axis airfield.
column2: 意大利海军飞机 Re 2001 可在航母上以及任何轴心国机场修理与补给。

column1: The Italian naval aircraft Re 2001 can be repaired and resupplied on the carrier and on any Axis airfield.\x00
column2: 意大利海军飞机 Re 2001 可以在航母上以及任何轴心国机场进行修理与补给。\x00

column1: The Italians are grateful because we help them to recover their colonies
column2: 意大利人很感激，因为我们帮助他们收复了他们的殖民地

column1: The IV SS Panzer Corps strikes from the Veszprem area to break the Soviet ring around Budapest and relieve the encircled garrison. The attack must succeed before the city falls.
column2: 亲卫队第4装甲军自维斯普雷姆(Veszprem)地域发起突击，打破苏军对布达佩斯(Budapest)的合围圈，解救被围守军。必须在城市陷落之前达成突破。

column1: The Japanese had their "reward", but this might happen to us too.
column2: 日本人得到了他们的「回报」，但这种事也可能发生在我们身上。

column1: The Kharkov scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, supply hexes and prestige management.
column2: 哈尔科夫场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。为使其适配本战役，仅作了轻微修改：部署格、补给格与威望管理。

column1: The King himself wants to decorate you!  That will have to wait however,
column2: 国王(King)本人要亲自给你授勋！不过那得等一等，

column1: The KMT troops are badly wounded.  Our victories at Changchun and Siping have decimated their men, commander, and you must put an end to the nationalist resistance in Manchuria.  Your mission is to secure the communications between our base at Siping and our groups in the South, near to Shenyang.  Then you must take Shenyang.  It is the historical Manchurian capital and is both an important industrial and political center.  The capture of Shenyang will open the way to Beijing and Nanjing.
column2: 国民党军队已遭重创。我们在长春和四平的胜利使他们的兵力大减，指挥官，你必须终结国民政府军在满洲的抵抗。你的任务是确保我们四平基地与我们在南方沈阳附近各部队之间的交通线。然后你必须夺取沈阳。它是满洲的历史首府，既是重要的工业中心，也是政治中心。夺取沈阳将打开通往北平与南京的道路。

column1: The Konotop scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. One slight modification was made: deployment hexes were added.
column2: 科诺托普(Konotop)场景及其使用的地图由汉内斯·格鲁伯(Hannes Gruber)制作。做了一处小改动：增加了部署格。

column1: The Konotop scenario and the map on which it is played are made by Hannes Gruber.
column2: 科诺托普场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。

column1: The Kriegsmarine is providing a large Task Force throughout this campaign to get rid the Mediterranean of American, British, and Soviet occupation.  There exists no current capability to overstrength or replace Naval units during the campaign.  Damaged units will be restored to their original strength at the start of each scenario.
column2: 整个战役期间，海军(Kriegsmarine)将提供一支大型特混舰队，把美国、英国与苏联的占领势力逐出地中海。目前尚无在战役中让海军部队超编加强或替换的能力。受损部队将在每个场景开始时恢复至原有兵力。

column1: The last of the American forces are entrenched along the coast.  Quickly embark and destroy them.  Expect heavy enemy air power in the region.  Intelligence reports a secret missile base in the desert. You must act quickly before the base becomes operational.  Be cautious of enemy submarines.
column2: 美军的最后部队正沿海岸构筑工事。迅速登船并消灭他们。预计该地区会有强大的敌军空中力量。情报报告沙漠中有一处秘密导弹基地。你必须在基地投入使用之前迅速行动。提防敌军潜艇。

column1: The last Russian reserves have succeeded in recapturing Moscow. Gather your forces once more and throw them out again.
column2: 俄国人最后的预备队成功夺回了莫斯科。再次集结你的部队，把他们再赶出去。

column1: The last stand will be Beijing, this won't be easy, as you know, the best PLA units are deployed there.  The price maybe high, but it deserves a try.  You can become the new premier of the People's Republic of China!
column2: 最后的决战将是北京，这不会容易，如你所知，解放军最好的部队都部署在那里。代价也许很高，但值得一试。你可以成为中华人民共和国的新总理！

column1: The late spring on the Eastern Front was quiet, a respite that afforded the division vital needed time for rest and refitting.
column2: 东线晚春一片平静，这段间歇让该师获得了迫切需要的休整与重新装备的时间。

column1: The Leibstandarte advanced into Yugoslavia alongside the 9th Panzer Division, starting from the border town of Kustendil, and heading towards Skopje.  Only after heavy fighting against the fully mobilised Yugoslav 3rd Army was the brigade able to achieve its objectives, and continue south to advance on Greece.
column2: 警卫旗队与第9装甲师并肩突入南斯拉夫，从边境城镇丘斯滕迪尔(Kustendil)出发，向斯科普里(Skopje)前进。只有在与全面动员的南斯拉夫第3集团军激战之后，该旅才得以达成目标，并继续南下向希腊推进。

column1: The Leibstandarte attack was eventually thwarted by blown bridges and a stubborn defence by the American troops.  By December 23rd, the division was being pushed back following its intial success.  Kampfgruppe Peiper, isolated and under heavy attacks at Stoumont, was given permission to break out to the east while the rest of the division provided cover.  Leaving behind 150 U.S. prisoners and some wounded to destroy his remaining tanks, Peiper led his battered and weary troops back to German lines.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的进攻最终因桥梁被炸毁与美军顽强防御而受挫。到 12 月 23 日，该师在取得初期的成功之后正被向后压迫。在斯图蒙(Stoumont)被孤立并遭猛攻的派佩尔战斗群(Kampfgruppe Peiper)获准向东突围，由该师其余部队提供掩护。佩佩尔留下 150 名美军战俘和一些伤员去炸毁自己剩余的坦克，然后带领他疲惫不堪的残部返回德军防线。

column1: The Leibstandarte began its life as the 'SS-Stabswache Berlin', acting as bodyguards for the Nazi leader Adolf Hitler.  It was the first armed SS formation and, by most measures, the most capable.  Initially they were referred to contemptuously by the Heer regulars as the 'asphalt soldiers' for their obsessive spit and polish drill and purely ceremonial duties.  After the campaigns in Poland and France, contempt gave way to geniune respect as the Leibstandarte earned a reputation as a combat unit which lived for the 'sheer beauty of the fighting'.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)最初是「党卫军柏林参谋卫队」(SS-Stabswache Berlin)，充当纳粹领袖阿道夫·希特勒(Adolf Hitler)的保镖。它是第一支武装党卫军部队，而且从各方面衡量都是最能干的一支。起初，国防军正规军轻蔑地称他们为「沥青士兵」，因为他们痴迷于队列操练与纯粹的礼仪勤务。在波兰与法国战役之后，轻蔑让位于真诚的敬意，因为警卫旗队赢得了「为战斗的纯粹之美而活」的战斗部队之名。

column1: The Leibstandarte briefly rested after the fall of Dunkirk, and then moved south with Von Kleist's armoured group where it took part in some minor actions.  The campaign in France cost the Leibstandarte some 500 casualties.  The unit was amply rewarded for its performance and in August was upgraded to Brigade status and began training for Operation Sealion - the proposed invasion of Britain.
column2: 敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)陷落后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)稍作休整，随后随冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)装甲集群南下，参加了一些小规模行动。法国战役让警卫旗队付出了约 500 人的伤亡。该部队因其表现得到丰厚回报，8 月被提升为旅级，并开始为「海狮」行动(Operation Sealion)——即拟议中的入侵英国——进行训练。

column1: The Leibstandarte had been preparing for the Polish campaign since June, and in August had recieved orders to move from their Lichterfelde Barracks to an assembly area in East Berlin. The OKW remained sceptical of SS combat abilities, yet had little option but to accept Hitler's wish that the SS be involved in the attack.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)自 6 月起就在为波兰战役做准备，8 月接到命令，从利希特费尔德(Lichterfelde)营区开赴东柏林(Berlin)的一处集结地域。国防军最高统帅部(OKW)对党卫军的作战能力仍持怀疑态度，但除了接受希特勒要让党卫军参与进攻的意愿之外别无选择。

column1: The Leibstandarte was attached to the 227th Infantry Division, and had been given the role of penetrating the enemy defences and securing the road and river bridges along the advance to the Ijssel River after they had been captured by airborne troops.
column2: 警卫旗队被配属给第227步兵师，其任务是突穿敌军防御，并在空降部队夺取艾瑟尔河(Ijssel)沿线公路与河流桥梁之后，确保这些桥梁的安全。

column1: The Leibstandarte was held in reserve for the opening stages of the assault on the Soviet Union due to the unit's ongoing reorganisation.  A week after the invasion the division crossed the Vistula and headed into Western Ukraine as part of III Panzer Corps, 1st Panzer Army.  Due to the rapid advance made by the Panzer units of Army Group South, the foot infantry was finding itself being left behind, with gaps appearing between the forces.  It was in this situation that the Leibstandarte showed the usefulness of motorised infantry by filling the gaps that had been left behind.
column2: 由于部队仍在整编，警卫旗队在进攻苏联的开局阶段被留作预备队。入侵一周后，该师渡过维斯瓦河，作为第1装甲集团军第3装甲军的一部进入乌克兰西部。由于南方集团军群的装甲部队推进迅速，徒步步兵发现自己被甩在后面，各部队之间出现了缺口。正是在这种情况下，警卫旗队填补了那些留下的缺口，显示出摩托化步兵的用处。

column1: The Leibstandarte was instrumental in preventing any Soviet breakout's during the encirclement, as the Soviets threw armour, cavalry and scores of infantry in their direction.  Each time the division was able to repel these attacks, and for its efforts the Leibstandarte earned considerable praise from corps commander, Generalmajor Kempf.  The encirclement was completed on the 8th of August when the 6th Army met the 17th Army on the Southern Bug River, trapping two whole Soviet armies and a large part of another.
column2: 在合围期间，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在阻止苏军突围方面起了关键作用，因为苏军把装甲部队、骑兵和大量步兵朝他们的方向投来。每一次该师都能击退这些进攻，由于这些努力，警卫旗队赢得了军长肯普夫(Kempf)少将(Generalmajor)的相当赞誉。8 月 8 日，第6集团军与第17集团军在南布格河(Southern Bug River)会师，合围得以完成，困住了苏军整整两个集团军以及另一个集团军的大部。

column1: The Leibstandarte was now transfered to the command of 1st Panzer Army, which was heading in the direction of Rostov.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)此时转隶第1装甲集团军(1st Panzer Army)，该集团军正向罗斯托夫(Rostov)方向前进。

column1: The lightning advances of December and early January provide us with the opportunity to easily retake Seoul for the North Koreans.  However, the situation is becoming dangerous.  Our supply lines to China are long and are constantly being bombed and strafed by the UN air force.  Because of this they are preparing a counterattack to again liberate Seoul.  Our Korean spies have told us that a great number of troops are concentrating South of Suwon, including modern tanks and heavy artillery.
column2: 12月和1月初的闪电推进，为我们提供了轻松为朝鲜人夺回汉城的机会。然而，局势正变得危险。我们通往中国的补给线漫长，并不断遭到联合国空军的轰炸和扫射。因此，他们正准备发动一次反击，以再次解放汉城。我们的朝鲜间谍告诉我们，大量部队正在水原以南集结，包括现代化的坦克和重炮。

column1: The location for our summer offensive is clear: the great salient around Kursk. Success here will shorten the front by 500km and create a reserve that can be used in the West. Model's 9th Army will strike from the North and Hoth's 4th Pz Army will attack from the South. The SS Corps is part of Hoth's Army.
column2: 我们夏季攻势的地点很明确：库尔斯克周围的大突出部。在此取胜将使战线缩短500公里，并腾出一支可用于西线的预备队。莫德尔的第9集团军将从北面出击，霍特的第4装甲集团军将从南面进攻。党卫军装甲军隶属霍特的集团军。

column1: The long retreat ends today. The plan is to break through the Axis lines in the north - your men will be attacking at the strongest point, where the Axis have built strong defensive positions. Once you reach your objectives you will be able to break through their lines and stop any retreat of German and Italian forces.
column2: 漫长的撤退今天结束。计划是在北面突破轴心国战线——你的部下将在最强点发起进攻，那里轴心国已构筑了坚固的防御阵地。一旦你抵达目标，就能突破他们的战线，堵住德意部队的任何退路。

column1: The loss of Tobruk has been a crushing blow to the morale of the Empire, you would do better to resign now. I am sure we can find a new command for you ... somewhere.
column2: 托布鲁克的失守对帝国的士气是一记沉重打击，你现在辞职倒更好些。我相信我们能给你找个新职务……在某个地方。

column1: The LSSAH was given the order to cross the river in the south and to advance on Burzenin.  The objective was achieved despite heavy resistance and casaulties, which caused a certain delay in the advance.  The rest of the attack towards Lodz was characterised by brutal fighting, stubborn defence, fierce counter-attacks and bloodshed all round.
column2: 警卫旗队(LSSAH)奉命在南部渡河并向布尔泽宁推进。尽管遭遇顽强抵抗与伤亡并因此使推进有所延迟，目标仍然达成。向罗兹(Lodz)进攻的其余过程，以残酷的战斗、顽强的防御、凶猛的反击和四处的流血为特征。

column1: The Maginot Line is named after French Minister of Defense Andre Maginot, is a line of concrete fortifications, tank obstacles, artillery casemates, machine gun posts, and other defenses, which France has built along its borders with Germany and Italy, in the light of experience from World War I, and in the run-up to World War II. Generally the term describes either the entire system or just the defenses facing Germany, while the Alpine Line is used for the Franco-Italian defenses.
column2: 马其诺防线以法国国防部长安德烈·马其诺命名，是一系列钢筋混凝土工事、反坦克障碍、炮兵炮台、机枪阵地及其他防御设施，法国在第一次世界大战的经验与二战前夕沿德、意边境修建。通常该词指整套体系或仅指面向德国的防御，而「阿尔卑斯防线」用于法意之间的防御。

column1: The main objective is to take Barcelona.  It is the last important Republican city as their government is located there.  By taking Barcelona we may be able to put an end to this bloody war.  The Republicans are trying to build fortified lines in Catalonia so we are going to need to use the German tactics of troop concentration, close air and artillery support to quickly overwhelm them.
column2: 主要目标是夺取巴塞罗那。那是共和派最后一座重要城市，因为他们的政府就设在那里。夺取巴塞罗那，我们或许就能结束这场血腥的战争。共和派正试图在加泰罗尼亚修筑筑垒防线，因此我们需要运用德军的战术——集中兵力、近距空中和炮兵支援——迅速压垮他们。

column1: The main part of the American 7 th army is destroyed, and already messages are coming in that they are evacuating their last bridgehead near Licata. In a few weeks the whole strategic situation in the Mediterrenean has changed beyond recognition. We will now change Sicily into an inassailabe fortress.
column2: 美军第七集团军主力已被歼灭，而且已有消息传来，他们正在撤离利卡塔附近的最后一个桥头堡。数周之内，地中海的整体战略态势将变得面目全非。我们现在要把西西里变成一座无法攻克的堡垒。

column1: The manoeuvres have been a relative success. You have proved the value of motorized forces but improvements are needed.
column2: 演习取得了相对成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值，但仍有需要改进之处。

column1: The Mediterranean is now ours.  Now it is time to finish this campaign and seal the entrance at...
column2: 地中海现在归我们所有。现在是结束这场战役、封住……的入口的时候了。

column1: The mission is re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
column2: 任务是恢复这里1941年的战线：夺取班加西(Bengazhi)，然后进抵梅基利(Mechilli)。

column1: The mission is to re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
column2: 任务是在此重建 1941年的战线，夺取班加西，随后进抵梅基利。

column1: The motorisation of the Cavalry Corps ("Corps de Cavalerie") decided in 1935 is now almost completed. This mobile force will complement our main fortified positions and defence lines providing support where needed.
column2: 1935年决定的骑兵军（“Corps de Cavalerie”）摩托化如今已接近完成。这支机动部队将配合我们的主要筑垒阵地和防线，在需要之处提供支援。

column1: The naval aircrafts can be repaired and resupplied on the carrier and on any Allied airfield.
column2: 海军飞机可以在航母上以及任何盟军机场进行修理与补给。

column1: the Norwegian army before the British Expeditionary Force arrives.
column2: 英国远征军抵达之前消灭挪威军队。

column1: The Norwegian Navy will not be much of a problem. However an British flotilla has been sighted and will likely engage your units, so speed is of highest importance.
column2: 挪威海军不会构成太大问题。不过已发现一支英国分舰队，很可能会与您的部队交战，因此速度至关重要。

column1: The offensive has not gone as well as we hoped. In your sector you have managed to control the passes but we still have not captured our objectives - Bologna, in particular, is still in enemy hands.
column2: 攻势进行得不如我们希望的那样顺利。在你的地段，你设法控制了各个山口，但我们仍未夺取目标——尤其是博洛尼亚，仍在敌人手中。

column1: The offensive has not gone as well as we hoped. In your sector, at least, you have not even managed to control the passes!
column2: 攻势的进展不如我们希望的那样顺利。至少在你这一段，你连各山口都没能控制住！

column1: The offensive is codenamed Operation Diadem; the plan is to break through the Gustav Line and drive towards the next line of defense, the so-called Hitler Line. The Polish 2nd Corps, with assistance of some British and Canadian units have the unenviable task of the final assault of Monte Cassino. In the southern part of the line the French Expeditionary Corps and the US 2nd Corps will attack the German mountain positions. The most difficult part is left to you.
column2: 这场攻势的代号是王冠行动(Operation Diadem)；计划是突破古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)，向下一道防线即所谓的希特勒防线(Hitler Line)推进。波兰第2军在一些英军与加拿大部队的协助下，承担着对蒙特卡西诺发起最后突击这一吃力不讨好的任务。在防线南部，法国远征军与美国第2军将进攻德军的山地阵地。最困难的部分留给了你。

column1: The official explanation for moving the unit into Ostpreussen in July 1939 was that it would participate at the Tannenberg Celebration to commemorate Hindenberg's victory at the Tannenberg in WW1.
column2: 1939年7月把这支部队调往东普鲁士的官方解释是，它将参加坦能堡纪念庆典，以纪念兴登堡在第一次世界大战中坦能堡的胜利。

column1: The oil is ours, German engineers are on the way to put refineries online.
column2: 石油归我们了，德国工程师正在赶来让炼油厂开工。

column1: The only landing zone is covered in Sea Mines.  Take care because intelligence reports a large enemy Naval task force in the region.  The British are hiding their tanks from us but eventually you will find them and destroy them.
column2: 唯一的登陆区布满了水雷。要小心，因为情报报告该地区有一支庞大的敌军海军特混舰队。英国人正把他们的坦克藏起来不让我们发现，但你最终会找到并消灭它们。

column1: The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some
column2: 唯一的好处是，你和你的部队已经获得了一些

column1: The operation was a real challenge since the Belgian Army had to retreat in some cases 100 km, transport its ammo depots (a lot being destroyed/fired as it was not possible to transport it), use secondary roads (the main ones being used by French and British) packed with compatriot refugees, and all this under the constant presence of the Luftwaffe.
column2: 这次行动是真正的挑战，因为比利时军队有时必须后撤100公里，运送弹药库（由于无法运输，许多弹药被销毁或引爆），走满是同胞难民的次要道路（主要道路被法军和英军占用），而这一切都是在德国空军不断出现的情况下进行的。

column1: The Party has brought the Great Patriotic War to a victorious end and we celebrate your role in this final battle.  The banners of the SSSR fly over the Reichstag, and our liberation mission is complete.  All the peoples of the world herald your name for freeing them from the fascist nightmare. Comrade General, a dacha on the Black Sea has been granted you and awaits your pleasure. And now, Vodka!
column2: 党已把伟大的卫国战争引向胜利的结局，我们在此庆祝你在这场最后之战中的作用。苏联(SSSR)的旗帜飘扬在国会大厦(Reichstag)上空，我们的解放使命已经完成。全世界的人民都在传颂你的名字，因为你把他们从法西斯的噩梦中解放出来。将军同志，黑海(Black Sea)畔的一座别墅已划拨给你，静候你享用。现在，上伏特加！

column1: The people celebrates your recent victory ! Time is needed to rebuild those installations, this time is long enough for us to destroy them.
column2: 人民在庆祝你最近的胜利！重建那些设施需要时间，而这段时间足够我们摧毁它们。

column1: The plan called for a converging strike by the 9th Army in the north and 4th Panzer Army to the south in the aim of enveloping the Kursk salient.  The Leibstandarte now with a new commander - Theodor Wisch, because of Dietrich's promotion - would operate in the south with 4th Panzer Army.  They were given the task of driving through the defences of the Voronezh Front before moving North-East to take Prokharovka.
column2: 计划要求北面的第9集团军与南面的第4装甲集团军实施向心突击，以包围库尔斯克突出部。警卫旗队此时换了新任指挥官——因迪特里希(Dietrich)晋升而由特奥多尔·维施(Theodor Wisch)接任——将在南面随第4装甲集团军作战。他们的任务是突穿沃罗涅日方面军的防御，然后向东北推进，夺取普罗霍夫卡。

column1: The Plan was better than expected. Now we have to finish the second stage of Seelöwe.
column2: 计划进展得比预期更好。现在我们得完成「海狮」(Seeloewe)行动的第二阶段。
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 辉煌胜利
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 失败
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 战术胜利

column1: The Poles are clamoring to throw a big bash for their liberator, enjoy
column2: 波兰人正吵着要为他们的解放者办一场盛大宴会，

column1: The Poles are happy to be out from under Ivan's boot.
column2: 波兰人很高兴摆脱了伊万(Ivan)的靴子。

column1: The Poles are in utter confusion and have already sued for terms.
column2: 波兰人已陷入极度混乱，并已求和。

column1: The Polish army attempts to defend their homeland against the German
column2: 波兰军队试图保卫自己的家乡，抵御德国

column1: The position of the Greek First Army, still fighting in Albania, was seriously jeopardized by the rapid advance of the XL Panzer Corps via Florina and by the British withdrawal to positions behind the Aliakmon. The Greek command therefore had to come to grips with the necessity of withdrawing southward from Albania. However, it was not until 13 April that the first Greek elements began to withdraw toward the Pindus Mountains. On the next day an advance detachment of the 73d Infantry Division encountered Greek troops withdrawing from Albania across the Pindus Mountains into the area west of Kastoria. Heavy fighting took place on that and the following day, especially at Kastoria Pass, where the Germans blocked the Greek withdrawal, which by then extended to the entire Albanian front, with the Italians in hesitant pursuit.
column2: 仍在阿尔巴尼亚(Albania)作战的希腊第1集团军，其处境因第40装甲军经弗洛里纳(Florina)的快速推进，以及英军撤往阿利亚克蒙(Aliakmon)河后方阵地而严重恶化。因此希腊统帅部不得不面对从阿尔巴尼亚向南撤退的必要性。然而，直到 4 月 13 日，首批希腊部队才开始向品都斯山脉(Pindus Mountains)撤退。次日，第73步兵师的一支先遣支队遇到了正从阿尔巴尼亚越过品都斯山脉、撤入卡斯托里亚(Kastoria)以西地区的希腊部队。当天及随后一天发生了激战，尤其是在卡斯托里亚山口，德军在那里阻断了希腊人的撤退——此时撤退已扩展到整个阿尔巴尼亚战线，而意大利人则迟疑地尾随追击。

column1: The Prokhorovka scenario is influenced by Jorge Gabitto's Kursk campaign.
column2: 普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)这一场景受到 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克(Kursk)战役的影响。

column1: The quest for dominance of the Mediterranean begins with Malta.  The previous administration made the mistake of letting the British stay on this strategically placed island.  Malta must now become ours!
column2: 争夺地中海霸权的起点是马耳他(Malta)。前任政府犯下的错误，就是让英国人留在这座战略位置重要的岛上。马耳他现在必须归我们所有！

column1: The quick defeat of Australia will allow us to continue the conquest of the South Pacific. Now it's New Zealand's turn, where some Australian and American troops have escaped to.  They must not have another base here, New Zealand is like a big carrier, and it eventually could support an allied invasion of our new possessions in Australia.  From Tokyo, your orders are to assault the Auckland sector from two sides.  Special Naval Landing Forces (2nd and 3rd Yokosuka with paratrooper training) will support your mission.  Also seize the key island of Waiheke and its airstrip.   Like other battles we must capture all the enemy airbases because they have relative air superiority.   At the beginning of this battle I advice you to keep your air units in a defensive role.
column2: 澳大利亚的迅速溃败使我们得以继续征服南太平洋。现在轮到新西兰了，一些澳大利亚和美国部队逃到了那里。他们绝不能在那里再拥有基地，新西兰就像一艘巨大的航母，最终可能支撑盟军对我们新占领的澳大利亚领土发起反攻。来自东京的命令是：从两个方向进攻奥克兰地区。特别海军陆战队（接受伞兵训练的第2、第3横须贺部队）将支援您的行动。同时夺取关键的怀赫科岛及其简易机场。与以往其他战斗一样，我们必须夺取敌军所有空军基地，因为他们拥有相对的空中优势。战斗开始时，我建议您让航空部队采取防御姿态。

column1: The Red Army and Tito's partisans are liberating Belgrade together.
column2: 红军与铁托(Tito)的游击队正一同解放贝尔格莱德(Belgrade)。

column1: The Red army at Santander has been completely destroyed.  Only a few remnants have escaped to Asturias where they are now joined with the Asturian forces.  The enemy knows where to stop us in the mountains, but it's isolated.  The Republican government at Valencia can't send any kind of aid to the Asturians and it's just a matter of time until they are defeated.  However we must not allow the enemy to stage a heroic defense.  The winter in the mountains of Asturias is very hard and it will be the best ally for the Republicans.  Your task, mi General, is to get a quick and smashing victory.  Then, we will be able to turn our attention to the Aragon front.
column2: 桑坦德的红军已被彻底消灭。只有少数残部逃入阿斯图里亚斯，现在与阿斯图里亚斯部队会合。敌人知道在哪里能阻挡我们，但那是块与世隔绝的地方。巴伦西亚的共和派政府无法向阿斯图里亚斯人提供任何援助，他们被击败只是时间问题。然而我们绝不能容许敌人上演一场英雄式的防御。阿斯图里亚斯山区的冬天十分严酷，它将成为共和派最好的盟友。你的任务，将军阁下，是取得一场迅速而彻底的胜利。此后，我们就能把注意力转向阿拉贡前线。

column1: The Red Army has opened a massive offensive on the Don bend, smashing into the sectors held by our Romanian allies. General, the Leader demands that you hold the river line and cover the flanks of our Stalingrad armies. Counterattack at once and restore the front.
column2: 红军在顿河(Don)弯道发起了大规模反攻，直冲罗马尼亚盟军据守的地段。将军，领袖要求你坚守沿河一线，掩护我斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)集团的两翼。立即反击，恢复战线。

column1: The Red Army opens the Riga offensive, driving to cut Army Group North off from the Baltic coast.
column2: 苏军发起里加(Riga)攻势，直插波罗的海(Baltic)沿岸，力图切断北方集团军群的陆上联系。

column1: The remnants of the British army have retreated south to fortified positions in the hills.  With no place left to run, expect massive amounts of troops to surrender.  It is believed that the enemy navy is operating out of the numerous ports in the region.
column2: 英军残部已南撤至山中的设防阵地。他们已无处可逃，要料到会有大量部队投降。据信敌军海军正以该地区众多港口为基地活动。

column1: The Riukiu islands must not fall into the enemy hands!.
column2: 琉球群岛绝不能落入敌手！

column1: the Rodina you will still direct operations of the final assault on Berlin.
column2: 祖国立下的功绩，你仍将指挥对柏林最后突击的作战。

column1: The Romanian army, with the help of its German ally, musters its strength
column2: 罗马尼亚军队在其德国盟友的帮助下集结力量，

column1: The Romanian army, with the help of its German ally, musters its strength to capture the Soviet controlled city of Kishinev.
column2: 罗马尼亚军队在德国盟友的帮助下集结兵力，准备夺取苏军控制的基希讷乌城。

column1: The Romanians cross the Dniestr river invading the Soviet Union.
column2: 罗马尼亚人渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)，入侵苏联。

column1: The Romanians invade Hungary alongside the Red Army.  They are trying to settle old feuds with the Hungarians.
column2: 罗马尼亚人随红军一起入侵匈牙利(Hungary)。他们试图了结与匈牙利人的旧怨。

column1: The Romanians try desperately to close the mountain passes to the Red Army. A successful defense could save the country from invasion.
column2: 罗马尼亚人拼命封锁通往红军的山口。一次成功的防御或许能使国家免遭入侵。

column1: The Romny scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, victory conditions and forced delayed arrival of core reinforcements during the scenario.
column2: 罗姆内(Romny)场景及其使用的地图由汉内斯·格鲁伯(Hannes Gruber)制作。做了一些小改动：部署格、胜利条件，以及场景中核心增援部队的强制延迟到达。

column1: The Russian 33rd Army was able to relieve the 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps. Instead of Russian troops, lots of German divisions are now trapped behind enemy lines.
column2: 俄军第33集团军成功解救了第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军。如今被困在敌后的不是俄军，而是大批德军师。

column1: The Russian 39rd Army followed by the 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps have broken through our lines near Rzhev and are advancing South on Vyazma. Our Corps has just closed the lines behind these Bolshevik forces. Your orders are to hold Vyazma and stop the relief attempt by the Russian 33rd Army - that is advancing on Vyazma from the East - by capturing Maloyaroslavets and thus also cutting the 33rd Army off from their own lines.
column2: 俄军第39集团军，随后是第29集团军和第11骑兵军，已在勒热夫附近突破我军防线，正向南推进，直指维亚济马。我军已刚刚在这些布尔什维克部队身后封闭了战线。你的命令是守住维亚济马，并通过夺取小雅罗斯拉韦茨，阻止从东面向维亚济马推进的俄军第33集团军的解围企图——这样也就切断了第33集团军与其本方战线之间的联系。

column1: The Russian 5th Guards tank army that got badly mauled at Prokhorovka when meeting your forces in mid July has been rebuilt, rushed through the gap between our 4th Pz Army and Group Kempf and is now threatening Kharkov. A Kampfgruppe of the 3rd Pz Division, the 198ID and some corps troops are defending the city. They urgently need your help to stop the flood of T34 tanks.
column2: 7 月中旬在普罗霍夫卡与我军遭遇时被打得残破不堪的俄国近卫第5坦克集团军已经重建，它穿过我们第4装甲集团军与肯普夫(Kempf)集群之间的缺口突进，如今正威胁哈尔科夫。第3装甲师的一支战斗群、第198步兵师和一些军属部队正在守卫该城。他们急需你的帮助来挡住洪流般的 T34 坦克。

column1: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 俄国人被你和你英勇部队的重击打得晕头转向！你不仅成功解围了布达佩斯，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。将军阁下，德国和苏联的外交代表此刻正在会晤……你在这里以及西线的一连串胜利无人能及。你将回到一个感恩的祖国。

column1: The Russians attack Army Group Center holding to the Belorussian
column2: 俄军进攻据守白俄罗斯(Belorussian)

column1: The Russians attack the Finns at Viipuri.
column2: 俄军在维堡(Viipuri)进攻芬兰人。

column1: The Russians attack the Finns at Viipuri. A victory here will put Finland out of the war.
column2: 俄军在维堡(Viipuri)进攻芬兰人。在此取胜将使芬兰(Finland)退出战争。

column1: The Russians attack the German Capital from the East and South.  Germans try desperately to stop the Russian onslaught.
column2: 俄国人从东面和南面进攻德国首都。德国人拼死试图挡住俄国的猛攻。

column1: The Russians attack the northern flank of Army Group Center trying to
column2: 俄军进攻中央集团军群的北翼，试图

column1: The Russians attack the rocket research center located at Peenemunde.
column2: 俄军进攻位于佩内明德(Peenemunde)的火箭研究中心。

column1: The Russians attack Warsaw whereas Germans crushed the Poles during Warsaw uprising in October 1944.
column2: 俄军进攻华沙(Warsaw)，而德军已在1944年10月的华沙起义中镇压了波兰人。

column1: The Russians attack Zhitomir trying to break the link between Army Groups Center and South.
column2: 俄国人进攻日托米尔(Zhitomir)，试图切断中央与南方两个集团军群之间的联系。

column1: The Russians attempt to relieve their encircled forces at Kiev. You must respond with a counter attack.
column2: 俄国人试图解救他们在基辅被围的部队。你必须以反击回应。

column1: The Russians break the Axis troops front in the Don river. The Germans counterattack to restore the front.
column2: 俄国人在顿河(Don)突破轴心国部队的战线。德军反击以恢复战线。

column1: The Russians cross the Bug river into Romanian held territory. The Germans try to stop the invasion of Romania.
column2: 俄军渡过布格河(Bug river)进入罗马尼亚控制的领土。德军力图阻止对罗马尼亚的入侵。

column1: The Russians defeated the Finns at Viipuri. A combined German-Finnish Army counterattacks to recover Viipuri.
column2: 俄国人在维堡(Viipuri)击败了芬兰人。一支德芬联军反击，以夺回维堡。

column1: The Russians have agreed to an armistice.
The Russians have almost completely encircled Vienna. Your division's task is too hold open the bridges over the Danube to let as many troops as possible escape to the west.
column2: 俄国人几乎完全包围了维也纳。你师的任务是守住多瑙河上的桥梁通道，让尽可能多的部队西撤。

column1: The Russians have assembled a Guards Tank Army at Prokhorovka, destroy them!
column2: 俄国人在普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)集结了一个近卫坦克集团军，消灭他们！

column1: The Russians have erected considerable defenses around Moskva, but you must break through and capture their capitol.  Move quickly before they bring in more reinforcements from the east.
column2: 俄国人在莫斯科(Moskva)周边构筑了相当规模的防御，但你必须突破并夺取他们的首都。要在他们从东面调来更多补充兵员之前迅速行动。

column1: The Russians have isolated Budapest the Hungarian Capital. The Germans counterattack to break the ring surrounding the City.
column2: 俄国人已孤立匈牙利首都布达佩斯(Budapest)。德军反击，以打破围住该城的包围圈。

column1: The Russians have suffered horrific losses in the air over the past month so the only planes you should see overhead will be ours. Good luck Commander.
column2: 过去一个月里俄国人在空中遭受了惨重损失，所以你在头顶应该只会看到我们的飞机。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: The Russians invade the Baltic states and Northern Poland. The Germans try to stop their onslaught.
column2: 俄国人入侵波罗的海各国与波兰北部。德国人试图挡住他们的猛攻。

column1: The Russians isolate a German Infantry Corps in Cherkassy, Ukraine.  The Germans counterattack to break the encirclement.
column2: 俄国人在乌克兰(Ukraine)的切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)孤立了一个德军步兵军。德军反击以打破合围。

column1: The Russians position can be characterised as a big wedge with Pommerania to the north of it, and Silesia south of it. You are to start a slow attack on the head of it. In the mean time we will transfer large formations of new panzers to Silesia and Pommerania. These wil then march on the besieged city of Posen, and trap the Whiterussian front.
column2: 俄军的态势可以形容为一个巨大的楔子，其北面是波美拉尼亚，南面是西里西亚。您要对这个楔子的头部发起缓慢进攻。与此同时，我们将把大批新式装甲部队调往西里西亚和波美拉尼亚。它们随后将向被围的波兹南城进军，并合围白俄罗斯方面军。

column1: The Russians try to cross the Dniepr river. It is the last great geographical barrier to German controlled territory.
column2: 俄国人试图渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)。这是通往德军控制区最后一道巨大的地理屏障。

column1: The Russians try to cross the Kerch straits to invade Crimea.
column2: 俄国人试图渡过刻赤海峡(Kerch straits)入侵克里米亚(Crimea)。

column1: The Russians try to expel the Germans from Western Ukraine. The action starts after they have broken the German front.
column2: 俄国人试图把德国人逐出西乌克兰(Western Ukraine)。行动在他们突破德军战线之后开始。

column1: The Russians were hoping a massive push down the East Flank around Salem plus increasingly supplied partisan activity in the SW and also a new Navy beachhead in the SE around Oil Depot Alpha would finally bring the Germans to their knees.
column2: 俄军则期望：沿东翼萨勒姆一带大举推进，加上西南方向补给日益充足的游击队活动，以及东南方向“阿尔法油库”一带新的海军登陆场，能最终迫使德军屈服。

column1: The salient around Kursk, created by the Soviet advances after the German loss at Stalingrad, drew the Germans' attention.  The German plans, code named "Zitadelle", were to cut the bulge by capturing Prokhorovka.  While the Germans waited to receive their new Tiger and Panther tanks before attacking, the Soviets, knowing of the German plan, took this time to deploy their forces in depth.
column2: 德军在斯大林格勒失利后，苏军推进形成的库尔斯克周边突出部吸引了德军的注意。德军的计划代号「堡垒」，意图通过夺取普罗霍夫卡来切掉这个突出部。当德军等待接收新的「虎」式和「豹」式坦克再发动进攻时，已得知德军计划的苏军利用这段时间把部队作了纵深配置。

column1: The Sarin gas facility is down.  Although you accomplished your objectives,
column2: 沙林毒气设施已瘫痪。尽管你达成了目标，

column1: The Sarin gas facility is down.  Although you accomplished your objectives,

The scientist you rescued in Riga has informed us of the location of Stalin's nuclear silos. Apparently they are being constructed in the area around Kiev, in the Ukraine. Luckily, our invasion forces in the southern part of Russia have managed to push into the surrounding area, and are supporting you in this operation. Hurry, Commander. If Stalin has nuclear missiles already built in these silos, then he could launch them at London, Paris and Berlin. We must capture the silos in Kiev before he gives the order to launch...
column2: 你在里加(Riga)救出的那位科学家已告知我们斯大林(Stalin)核导弹发射井的位置。看来它们正在乌克兰的基辅(Kiev)周边地区建造。幸运的是，我们在俄罗斯南部的入侵部队已成功突入周边地区，正在这次行动中支援你。快点，指挥官。如果斯大林已在这些发射井里造好了核导弹，他就能把它们射向伦敦(London)、巴黎(Paris)和柏林(Berlin)。我们必须在他下令发射之前夺取基辅的发射井……

column1: the sea slowed enough to allow the Allied mobile forces to escape from
column2: 海边推进的速度本可能被拖慢到足以让盟军机动部队从

column1: The Seelow Heights marked the last place before Berlin offering good
column2: 塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)是柏林之前最后一处能为德军提供良好

column1: The Seelow Heights marked the last place before Berlin offering good defensive terrain for the German forces.
column2: 塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)是柏林之前最后一处能为德军提供良好防御地形的地方。

column1: The situation has changed a lot in Burma over the last 2 years. Our decisive victory was not achieved on China, and now, the Chinese, Indians and the British have reorganized and strengthened their forces. The imperial glory will be stoped for the moment... your mission is to stop the Allied onslaught we are awaiting. Reports show that the Indian units will strike on Akyab, your mission is to stop them at all costs!. I would like to suggest you inspect the area, and use the mountain road to surprise them with the rearguard...
column2: 过去两年间缅甸的局势变化很大。我们未能在中国的作战中取得决定性胜利，如今中国军队、印度人和英国人已重整并加强了他们的部队。帝国的荣光暂时要止步了……您的任务是阻止我们正等待着的盟军猛攻。报告显示印度部队将进攻阿恰布，您的任务是不惜一切代价挡住他们！我建议您勘察一下地形，利用山路从后方给他们一个奇袭……

column1: The situation has changed, even the important Brighton Port is under British domain, your troops must move to the east to take the city along with the 8th Panzer Division coming from Dover.
column2: 局势已经变化，连重要的布赖顿(Brighton)港也仍在英国人手中；你的部队必须向东推进，与从多佛(Dover)开来的第8装甲师一同夺取该城。

column1: The situation is as follows: As you know Hitler has died of a bomb blast in the Wolfsschanze and the army has performed a coup d'etat. General Beck, the old chief of staff has become head of state, marshall Von Witzleben commander in chief, and the parliament of 1933 including the communists has been called back. Becoming chancellor Herr Speer has played an admirable role in the whole affair winning over a lot of officials to the new order.
column2: 情况如下：如您所知，希特勒已在狼穴死于炸弹爆炸，陆军已发动政变。原总参谋长贝克将军已出任国家元首，冯·维茨莱本元帅任总司令，1933年的国会（包括共产党人在内）已被重新召集。出任总理的施佩尔先生在整个事件中表现令人钦佩，为新的秩序争取到了许多官员。

column1: The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy air superiority, plus the minefileds, are making a big amount of losses into our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.
column2: 局势正变得非常危险，我们严重缺乏燃料与坦克，而敌方的空中优势加上雷场，正给我们部队造成大量损失……我们将对英国人发起最后一击，希望像过去那样让他们措手不及——否则你必须不惜一切代价战斗，直到最后一人！

column1: The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy has air superiority. Also the minefileds, are inflicting big losses on our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.
column2: 局势正变得极为危险，我们严重缺乏燃料和坦克，而敌人握有制空权。此外，雷场也让我们的部队损失惨重……我们将对英军发动最后一击，希望能像过去那样打他们一个措手不及——否则你就必须不惜一切代价战斗到底，直到最后一人！

column1: The situation is critical, if they are successful they will split our main forces in the North, on the cities of Maldon and Watfort, preventing our forces to resupply.
column2: 局势危急，如果他们得手，就会把我们北面的主力——在莫尔登(Maldon)与沃特福德(Watfort)两城的部队——割裂开来，使我军无法获得补给。

column1: The situation is dramatic. Several German breakthroughs have been reported. The front is about to break and there are no more reserves to restore the line. A new retreat to the Ijzer/Yser River as suggested by General Weygand is not possible: we would simply lose our ammunition depots since we no longer have the capacity to move them once more. In addition, in the current state of fatigue and demoralization a new retreat would mean the total disintegration of the Army (I guess you are aware of the recent mass surrender of several large units in Gand/Gent). Finally, our British allies have decided to evacuate their expeditionary force in Northern France. In view of the situation King Leopold III has requested, and the Germans have accepted, unconditional surrender. The cease-fire will start at 4.00 A.M of the 28th May.
column2: 局势十分严峻。已有多处德军突破的报告。战线即将崩溃，再没有预备队来恢复防线。魏刚将军建议再次撤退到艾泽尔河/伊瑟河已不可能：我们只会失去弹药库，因为我们已没有能力再把它们搬运一次。此外，在当前疲惫和士气低落的状态下，再次撤退将意味着军队的彻底瓦解（我想你已经知道最近在根特有几支大部队集体投降）。最后，我们的英国盟友已决定撤走他们在法国北部的远征军。鉴于这种局势，国王利奥波德三世已请求无条件投降，德军也已接受。停火将于5月28日凌晨4时开始。

column1: the situation isn´t lost after all, but you are relieved of your
column2: 局势毕竟还没有无可挽回，但你暂时被解除

column1: The Sixth and Fourth Panzer Armies start the direct assault of Stalingrad.
column2: 第6与第4装甲集团军开始对斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)发起直接突击。

column1: The southern half of Haguenau is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
column2: 阿格诺(Haguenau)的南半部现在已在我们手中，我们已准备好进入本土。

column1: The Soviet "Pensylvanya Front" is attacking from the North, and it's already smashing the US defenses in the "Queens" quarter, while forces from the "NY Front" are heading to overrun the pocket of Brooklyn and then, join the forces coming from the North in order to cross the East river and smash the whole Manhattan, where the resistance will surely be even harder.
column2: 苏联「宾夕法尼亚方面军」(Pensylvanya Front)正从北面进攻，已经粉碎了「皇后区」(Queens)的美军防御，而「纽约方面军」(NY Front)的部队正向布鲁克林(Brooklyn)包围圈压去，随后将与从北面来的部队会合，渡过东河(East river)，粉碎整个曼哈顿(Manhattan)，那里的抵抗肯定会更加顽强。

column1: The Soviet air force has retreated back home to Russia.  Our blockade of the Black Sea has kept the Soviet Navy in local waters.  You must make your landing immediately before they have a chance to stop us.
column2: 苏联空军已撤回俄国本土。我们对黑海(Black Sea)的封锁把苏联海军困在近海水域。你必须立即登陆，不能给他们阻止我们的机会。

column1: The Soviet armies are fleeing east; The Fuher himself has demanded your presence in Berlin to award your medal!
column2: 苏军正向东逃窜；元首本人已要求你前往柏林，为你授勋！

column1: The Soviet attack had been driven off, but at a heavy price, and the SS-Panzer Corps now held the area around Prokhorovka and the railroad.  In the north however, the Soviets had launched a strong counter-attack behind the 9th Army, threatining them with encirclement - forcing General Model to halt his advance, and pull back his forces.  With the situation in the north becoming increasingly precarious, Hitler called 'Zitadelle' off on the 13th July.
column2: 苏军的进攻已被打退，但代价沉重，党卫军装甲军(SS-Panzer Corps)现在控制着普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)周边地区与铁路。然而在北面，苏军已在第9集团军后方发动强大反击，以合围相威胁——迫使莫德尔(Model)将军停止推进并后撤其部队。随着北面局势日益危急，希特勒于 7 月 13 日叫停了「堡垒」(Zitadelle)。

column1: The Soviet attacks Berlin, Stalin has put Zhukov and Koniev into competition for the fall of the Capital city of the Reich. You must put an end to this plan and defeat both Soviet armies, Berlin will be the place where Stalin was stopped!!!
column2: 苏军进攻柏林，斯大林已让朱可夫(Zhukov)与科涅夫(Koniev)竞争夺取帝国首都之功。你必须终结这一计划，击败两支苏军，柏林将成为斯大林被挡住的地方！！！

column1: The Soviet forces attack the flanks of the Sixth Army guarded by
The soviet horde has been destroyed, and now our manchukoan allies can sleep well, without the red menace from the West. Emperor Pu-Yi sends you his congrats.
column2: 苏联大军已被消灭，如今我们的满洲国盟友可以安睡了，不必再担心来自西方的红色威胁。溥仪皇帝向您致以祝贺。

column1: The Soviet super tank is crushed. The base has been captured, but in the
column2: 苏联的超级坦克已被摧毁。基地已被夺取，但以

column2: 苏军进攻佩列科普(Perekop)城，以切断

column1: The Soviet troops attack the city of Perekop to cut the land conmmunication between Ukraine and the Crimean peninsula.
column2: 苏军进攻佩列科普(Perekop)城，以切断乌克兰(Ukraine)与克里米亚半岛(Crimean peninsula)之间的陆上联系。

column1: The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, Herr General, and our Finnish friends have trapped a Soviet division in the town of Suomussalmi. Unfortunately, an even greater Soviet relief force is moving to aid their comrades, and the Finns are outnumbered. It is your task to destroy the isolated enemy and prevent the relief force from reaching him. Of course, due to our non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union, you and your troops will be considered volunteers.  If you are defeated, the General Staff will deny any knowledge of your participation, and you may expect the worst if captured.
column2: 苏联已入侵芬兰，将军阁下，我们的芬兰友军已将一支苏军师围困在苏奥穆萨尔米镇。不幸的是，一支规模更大的苏军救援部队正前去接应他们的同志，而芬兰人兵力处于劣势。您的任务是歼灭这支被孤立的敌军，并阻止救援部队与之会合。当然，鉴于我们与苏联签有互不侵犯条约，您和您的部队将被视为志愿者。倘若您战败，总参谋部将否认知悉您的参与，而您一旦被俘，就别指望有什么好下场。

column1: The Soviet winter offensive is rolling toward the Lutsk-Rovno sector and our front there is giving way. You will take over the sector, stop their rifle divisions and counterattack before the spring mud paralyzes all movement.
column2: 苏军冬季攻势正扑向卢茨克(Lutsk)—罗夫诺(Rovno)方向，我军该地段正在动摇。你立即接管该地段，挡住敌步兵集团，并赶在春季泥泞瘫痪一切机动之前发起反击。

column1: The Soviets are disrupted and the Brits have stabilized their
column2: 苏军已被打乱，而英国人已稳住了他们的

column1: The Soviets are in control of Libya and they are ready to repel our offensive.  You must act quickly before they can entrench themselves.  A naval port is required to bring in reinforcements from Tunisia.
column2: 苏军控制着利比亚，并已准备好击退我们的攻势。你必须在他们得以构筑工事之前迅速行动。需要一处海军港口，以便从突尼斯运入补充兵员。

column1: The Soviets are in disarray and the Brits are pushing them back in
column2: 苏军陷入混乱，英国人正把他们逼回
