column2: 苏军已严重陷入混乱，而英国人已稳住他们的

column1: The Soviets attack the 3rd Romanian Army in an effort to turn the flank of  the 6th German Army at Stalingrad.
column2: 苏军进攻罗马尼亚第3集团军，力图迂回斯大林格勒德国第6集团军的侧翼。

column1: The Soviets attack the Eighth Italian Army to threaten the flanks of Von Manstein relief force.
column2: 苏军进攻意大利第8集团军，以威胁冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)解围部队的侧翼。

column1: The Soviets attack the German Army Group South.  The Romanians try to hold desperately their lines in the Mius river.
column2: 苏军进攻德国南方集团军群(Army Group South)。罗马尼亚人竭力守住他们在米乌斯河(Mius river)的战线。

column1: The Soviets attempt to break the German attack aimed at Kursk.
column2: 苏军试图打破德军指向库尔斯克(Kursk)的进攻。

column1: The Soviets attempt to break the German siege of Leningrad.
column2: 苏军试图打破德军对列宁格勒(Leningrad)的围困。

column1: The Soviets attempt to cut the Axis supply line going to Stalingrad.
column2: 苏军试图切断通往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的轴心国补给线。

column1: The Soviets attempt to destroy the German-Romanian troops surrounded at Sevastopol.
column2: 苏军试图消灭被围在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的德罗联军。

column1: The Soviets attempt to knock the Finns out of the war.
column2: 苏军试图把芬兰人逐出战争。

column1: The Soviets attempt to liberate Latvia and take Riga the capital city.
column2: 苏军试图解放拉脱维亚(Latvia)并夺取其首都里加(Riga)。

column1: The Soviets attempt to surround the new German Sixth Army at Cherkassy in the  Ukraine.
column2: 苏军试图在乌克兰(Ukraine)的切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)包围新的德国第6集团军。

column1: The Soviets attempt to surround the new German Sixth Army at Cherkassy in the Ukraine.
column2: 苏军试图在乌克兰的切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)包围德军新的第6集团军。

column1: The Soviets counterattack from the west and the east. Be careful, Soviet tank units will attack your position. Look toward the brunt of the battle being in the south-east and east. The second attack will come in the northwest. You must repel ground attacks and occupy two bridges on Kharkov river in order to secure our units attacking Voronez and the city of Stalingrad.
column2: 苏军从西面和东面反击。小心，苏军坦克部队会进攻你的阵地。预计战斗的主要压力在东南与东面。第二次进攻将来自西北。你必须击退地面进攻，并占领哈尔科夫河上的两座桥梁，以保障我军进攻沃罗涅日与斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)城的部队。

column1: The Soviets counterattack to take the German held salient of Orel.
column2: 苏军发起反击，夺取德军据守的奥廖尔(Orel)突出部。

column1: The Soviets cross the middle Dnepr river at the junction between Army
column2: 苏军在第聂伯河(Dnepr)中游、集团军

column1: The Soviets cross the Oder river and start a direct attack towards Berlin.
column2: 苏军渡过奥得河(Oder)，开始向柏林(Berlin)发起直接进攻。

column1: The Soviets defend with the entire Sixty Second Army and units of the
column2: 苏军以整个第62集团军以及第

column1: The Soviets go on the attack against the Germans in what was to
column2: 苏军向德军发起进攻，这场战斗后来

column1: The Soviets go on the attack against the Germans in what was to become the largest tank battle in the world.
column2: 苏军向德军发起进攻，这场战斗后来成为世界上规模最大的坦克战。

column1: The Soviets have assembled the best of their remaining forces around Voronezh.  Take your 1st SS PanzerKorps and finish them off!
column2: 苏军已在沃罗涅日(Voronezh)周边集结了他们残余部队中最精锐的部分。率你的党卫军第1装甲军去把他们解决掉！

column1: The Soviets have become extremely desperate in light of recent Allied success in capturing and holding Volgorad. Intelligence reports that the Soviets have begun testing of a super-heavy tank, which if produced in time for the assault on Moscow could easily turn the tide of the war. This must not happen.
column2: 鉴于盟军最近夺取并守住伏尔加格勒(Volgorad)的胜利，苏军已变得极为绝望。情报报告，苏军已开始试验一种超重型坦克；若它能及时投产用于莫斯科攻势，就很容易扭转战局。绝不能让它得逞。

column1: The Soviets have been driven onto the island of Crete.  Finish them off and make the Mediterranean ours!
column2: 苏军已被赶进克里特岛(Crete)。把他们彻底解决，让地中海归我们所有！

column1: The Soviets have been removed from Turkey.  Now on to Greece to finish the job.
column2: 苏军已被逐出土耳其。现在开赴希腊，把这件事了结。

column1: The Soviets have erected an impressive defensive perimeter around Kursk.  You are the only one who can break through.  Once you make headway, the attack will commence on all the other fronts and we can push these Soviets back to Siberia!
column2: 苏军在库尔斯克(Kursk)周边构筑了令人印象深刻的环形防御。只有你能突破。一旦你取得进展，其他各条战线都将发起进攻，我们就能把这些苏军赶回西伯利亚！

column1: The Soviets have set up defensive position in the mountains.  You must find a way through the mountains, escarpments, and minefields to rid Turkey of the Soviet occupation.
column2: 苏军已在山区建立防御阵地。你必须找到一条穿过山地、断崖与雷场的通路，把苏军占领者逐出土耳其。

column1: The Soviets have slipped south into Greece and Turkey.  A large naval task force has been spotted in your region.  Find a suitable landing area quickly and get the Soviets the Hell out of Helles!
column2: 苏军已南下潜入希腊(Greece)与土耳其(Turkey)。你所在区域发现一支大型海军特混舰队。赶快找到一处合适的登陆场，把苏军从赫勒斯赶出去！

column1: The Soviets have started to ask about terms.
column2: 苏军已开始询问停战条件。

column1: The Soviets held a considerable bridgehead over the Gran river, north of Eztergom.  This position was seen as a potential assembly area for a possible thrust towards Vienna and as such it had to be elminated before the main offensive - aimed at elimating the Soviet units from the area west of the Danube and north of the Drava rivers and to secure the Nagykanizsa oil deposits - could begin.  This peliminary operation was given the code-name South Wind.
column2: 苏军在埃斯泰尔戈姆(Eztergom)以北的格兰河(Gran river)上占据着一个相当大的桥头堡。这个位置被视为可能向维也纳(Vienna)突击的潜在集结地域，因此必须在主要攻势开始之前将其清除——主要攻势的目标是清除多瑙河(Danube)以西、德拉瓦河(Drava)以北地区的苏军部队，并确保瑙吉考尼饶(Nagykanizsa)油田。这次预备性作战的代号是「南风」。

column1: The Soviets launch an assault across the Dnepr.
column2: 苏军发起强渡第聂伯河(Dnepr)的进攻。

column1: The Soviets now have serious suspisions that we are talking to the Americans. We therefore expect the Soviets to make an all out effort to capture terrain before we can make peace in the west.
column2: 苏联人现在严重怀疑我们正在与美国人谈判。因此我们预计，苏军将全力以赴，力求在我们与西方缔结和平之前夺取更多地盘。

column1: The soviets sent a lot of troops; however you and your brave soldiers have reached all the operation goals with the desired final result.  Now the hills and other strategic locations are in our hands.  Maybe in the future Vladivostok could be the next target in this area. Congratulations for your promotion to General of the Imperial Army!
column2: 苏联人派来了大量部队；不过，您和您勇敢的士兵们还是以理想的最终结果达成了作战的全部目标。如今各高地及其他战略要点都在我们手中。也许今后这一地区的下一个目标就是符拉迪沃斯托克。祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军！

column1: The Spanish Civil War was a major conflict in Spain that started after an attempted coup d etat by a group of Spanish Army generals against the government of the Second Spanish Republic. The Civil War devastated Spain from 17 July 1936 to 1 April 1939.
column2: 西班牙内战是西班牙的一场重大冲突，始于一批西班牙陆军将领对第二共和国政府发动的未遂政变。这场内战使西班牙满目疮痍，自1936年7月17日持续至1939年4月1日。

column1: The Spanish Republic has been re-established. The leaders of the fascist rebellion has been sent to a long holidays in... Siberia. Good work, Comrade!
column2: 西班牙共和国已经重建。法西斯叛乱的头目们已被送去……西伯利亚(Siberia)度长假。干得好，同志！

column1: The spy's information points to a submarine pen in southern Greece. The Soviets are developing new advanced submarines there that could disrupt Allied shipping and bring our war effort crashing to a halt. Unfortunately, Greece is currently being invaded by the Soviets, and our troops are stretched too wide to help them. Take your troops in, destroy those bloody submarines and get back before the main army discovers your force. The French have pledged their navy to assist us in this operation.
column2: 那名间谍的情报指向希腊(Greece)南部的一处潜艇洞库。苏联人正在那里研制新型先进潜艇，那可能破坏盟军航运，使我们的事业骤然停摆。不幸的是，希腊目前正遭苏联入侵，而我们的部队铺得太开，无力援助他们。率你的部队进去，摧毁那些该死的潜艇，并在苏军主力发现你的部队之前撤回。法国人已承诺派海军协助我们这次行动。

column1: The SS-Division "Reich" and parts of the 10th Panzer Division were approaching the Borodino battlefield 100 km west of Moscow. Between them and the Russian Capital stood the reinforced 32nd Siberian Rifle Division, just arrived by train to man the partly completed Mozhaisk Defense Line. After five days of brutal fighting, the SS finally got through, but fresh units filled in behind the survivors.
column2: 党卫军「帝国」师和第10装甲师一部正逼近莫斯科以西100公里的博罗季诺战场。在他们与俄国首都之间，横着得到加强的第32西伯利亚步兵师——该师刚乘火车赶到，以守御尚未完工的莫扎伊斯克防线。经过五天残酷战斗，党卫军终于突破，但新鲜部队又填补到幸存者的背后。

column1: The story of 3 SS divisions attacking Prokhorovka with hundreds of Tiger and Panther tanks is a myth and so is the SS divisions loosing +400 tanks in the engagement. The Panther battalions were in Germany and each division had only 1 Tiger company. At the start of  Zitadelle, the 3 divisions of II SS Panzer Corps, totalled no more than about 350 tanks. By the time the battle for Prokhorovka started, the number of operational tanks had dropped to 211. Only 15 were Tigers. After the battle, II SS Panzer Corps reported 163 operational tanks. Russian tank losses were close to 650. Leibstandarte's 13th Tiger company (leader) was commanded by 2nd Lt. Michael Wittmann.
column2: 所谓 3 个党卫军师以数百辆「虎」式与「豹」式坦克进攻普罗霍夫卡(Prokhorovka)的故事是个神话，说党卫军各师在此战中损失 400 多辆坦克同样如此。「豹」式营当时还在德国，每个师只有 1 个「虎」式连。在「堡垒」(Zitadelle)行动开始时，党卫军第2装甲军(II SS Panzer Corps)的 3 个师总计不过约 350 辆坦克。到普罗霍夫卡之战打响时，可用坦克数量已降到 211 辆。其中只有 15 辆是「虎」式。战斗结束后，党卫军第2装甲军报告有 163 辆可用坦克。俄军坦克损失接近 650 辆。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的第13「虎」式连（连长）由少尉米夏埃尔·维特曼(Michael Wittmann)指挥。

column1: The subs are at the bottom of the ocean. But now our men must recuperate from this shallow victory before we can proceed to our next objective.
column2: 潜艇已经沉到海底。但现在我们必须从这场惨胜中恢复过来，然后才能着手下一个目标。

column1: The subs are lying at the bottom of the sea. But we have suffered a grievous loss in men and materials. Are you sure you're not a spy?
column2: 那些潜艇正躺在海底。但我们在人员与物资上遭受了惨重损失。你确定你不是间谍？

column1: The success of this mission was uncertain, and finally, the large number of reinforcements the allies sent to the battlefield have overwhelmed us. Now, it's time to retreat and reorganize our units.
column2: 这次任务本就胜负难料，最终盟军投向战场的大量增援压垮了我们。现在该撤退并重整我们的部队了。

column1: The success of this operation is in your hands!\x00
column2: 这次作战的成败掌握在你手中！

column1: The Supreme Council of the Soviet Union has decorated you with the Golden Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union and Order of Lenin, but don't let your head be turned. We still remember you were imprisoned for Trockists' Deviationism, any false move will not be forgiven...!
column2: 苏联最高苏维埃已授予你苏联英雄金星勋章与列宁勋章，但别让脑袋发昏。我们还记得你曾因托洛茨基式的偏离而身陷囹圄，任何错误的举动都不会被原谅……！

column1: The tension between USSR and USA has reached a critical point.
column2: 苏联与美国之间的紧张已到临界点。

column1: The Tenth Panzer division lies between your forces and the bridges at Arnhem. You must defeat them and continue on to Arnhem.
column2: 第10装甲师横在你部与阿纳姆的桥梁之间。你必须击败他们，继续向阿纳姆前进。

column1: The terrain up there suits his tanks just fine.
column2: 那里的地形正好适合他的坦克。

column1: The Third Armored Division has been ordered to attack towards Dessau
column2: 第3装甲师已奉命向德绍(Dessau)进攻

column1: The Third Armored Division has been ordered to attack towards Dessau in an attempt to beat the Soviets to the experimental airbase nearby.  The Americans must capture the German town and airfield at Dessau.  The German defenders try to prevent an easy victory for the Americans.
column2: 第3装甲师已奉命向德绍(Dessau)进攻，力图抢在苏军之前夺取附近的试验机场。美军必须夺取德绍的德国城镇与机场。德军守备部队则力图不让美军轻松取胜。

column1: The threat of our armies in Southern Russia being encircled has been countered although you did not recapture Kharkov as intended. We destroyed or severely damadged 4 Soviet Armies and regained most of the territory lost in January. Prepare your troops for a Summer offensive near Kursk.
column2: 我军在南俄被合围的威胁已被化解，尽管你未能如期夺回哈尔科夫。我们歼灭或重创了4个苏军集团军，并夺回了1月丢失的大部分领土。让你的部队为库尔斯克附近的夏季攻势做好准备。

column1: The threat of our armies in Southern Russia being encircled has been countered. We destroyed or severely damadged 4 Soviet Armies and regained most of the territory lost in January. Prepare your troops for a Summer offensive near Kursk.
column2: 我军在南俄被合围的威胁已被化解。我们歼灭或重创了4个苏军集团军，并夺回了1月丢失的大部分领土。让你的部队为库尔斯克附近的夏季攻势做好准备。

column1: The tide has turned.  After a long struggle, the British Empire returns to the Continent.  You now lead British forces into battle with the final goal of unconditional surrender of the Axis powers.
column2: 形势已经逆转。经过长期苦战，大英帝国重返欧洲大陆。你现在率英军投入战斗，最终目标是轴心国无条件投降。

column1: The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have again recaptured Cyrenaica.  Now we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points we will be able to siege Benghazi again and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
column2: 反攻的时刻到了。在去年取得最初的胜利之后，英军再次夺回了昔兰尼加。现在我们处于有利位置，可以进攻布赖加港，或许接着进攻阿杰达比亚。如果我们能夺回这些要点，就能再次围困班加西，或许还能收复昔兰尼加，恢复去年的战线。

column1: The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have recaptured Cyrenaica again. Now, we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points, we will be able to besiege Benghazi again, and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
column2: 反攻的时机到了。在去年最初的几场胜利之后，英国人再次夺回了昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)。现在，我们处于有利位置，可以进攻布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)，也许随后再进攻阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)。如果我们能夺回这两处，就能再次围困班加西(Benghazi)，也许还能重新夺回昔兰尼加，恢复去年的战线。

column1: The time has come for us to relieve the beleagared Finns. You must force out the Russian occupation force before major Soviet renforcements arrive. You will be assisted by a small contigent of Finnish rebels. Watch your southern flank commander.
column2: 我们为受困的芬兰人解围的时候到了。你必须在苏军大股增援到达之前赶走俄国占领军。你将得到一支芬兰叛军小分遣队的协助。当心你的南翼，指挥官。

column1: the tough battles with the Allies later in the war.
column2: 战争后期与盟军的艰苦战斗。

column1: The troops at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position) river were not particularly hard pressed and two attempts to cross the Dijle/Dyle River around Leuven/Louvain were fairly easily beaten off.
column2: “KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的部队并未受到特别猛烈的压力，两次试图在鲁汶附近强渡迪尔河的行动都被相当轻松地击退。

column1: The troops in the pocket were finally eliminated on 22nd August, but the focus of the Leibstandarte's advance had already shifted towards the industrial centre of Kherson.
column2: 包围圈内的部队最终于 8 月 22 日被清除，但警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)推进的重心已转向工业中心赫尔松(Kherson)。

column1: the Ukrainian and Belorussian Fronts that will cross the Vistula river
column2: 乌克兰方面军与白俄罗斯方面军的作战，它们将渡过维斯瓦河(Vistula)

column1: The UN forces have massed their units to protect their silly so-called ''No-Named line''.  Anyway, this situation fits perfectly with our People's War doctrine.  Launch your armies and over run the dirty capitalist's invaders on your way to recapture Seoul.
column2: 联合国军已集结部队来保卫他们那愚蠢的所谓"无名线"。无论如何，这种局面完全符合我们的人民战争学说。发动你的部队，在重夺汉城的路上碾碎肮脏的资本主义侵略者。

column1: The uprising at Guangzhou against the local warlords was successful and access by sea for Soviet aid was secured.  Now, comrade Mao from Hunan is planning an assault on the city fortress of Changsha against the local warlords and KMT troops placed at that city. The central Chinese Communist Party director dislikes this operation, but we are going to dispatch your troops there to help our comrades in the offensive.  Personally, I don't want the prestige of Mao Zedong to overly influence the ChCP.  He seems to gain more power each day.
column2: 广州反抗地方军阀的起义取得了成功，苏联援助的海上通道已得到保障。现在，来自湖南的毛泽东同志正计划进攻长沙城防，打击当地军阀和驻守该城的国民党军队。中共中央的负责人不喜欢这次行动，但我们还是要把你的部队派去协助我们同志进攻。就我个人而言，我不愿毛泽东的声望过分影响中国共产党。他似乎一天比一天更有权势。

column1: The uprising was successful and Nanchang is ours!  This has become the first major stronghold of Marxism in China.  Now it is time to create a Revolutionary Committee in this city to manage our goals.  We must get Soviet aid by sea with another uprising in Guangzhou.  Our comrades there will receive our support from Nanchang.
column2: 起义成功了，南昌是我们的了！这里已成为马克思主义在中国第一个主要据点。现在该在这座城市建立革命委员会来管理我们的目标。我们必须通过在广州的另一场起义来获得苏联的海上援助。那里的同志将得到我们自南昌的支援。

column1: The US 101st AB is to hold the road between Eindhoven and Grave open at all costs. Also the Veghel bridge,and their two Drop Zones. Engineers are working on a temporary bridge at Son which will allow the 30th Corps to continue it's advance. The 101st AB is not permitted to advance beyond Grave.
column2: 美国第101空降师必须不惜一切代价保持埃因霍温(Eindhoven)与赫拉弗(Grave)之间的道路畅通，还要守住费赫尔桥(Veghel bridge)及其两个空降场。工兵正在松村(Son)架设一座临时桥梁，以便第30军继续推进。第101空降师不得越过赫拉弗继续推进。

column1: The US 101st Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 501st south of Veghal to take the canal bridge, and the 506th to land north of Eindhoven to take the northern bridges, protect the dropzone for Glider-borne reinforcement and enter the city, then to hold the road open for the 30th Corps' advance.
column2: 美国第101空降师将在两个空降场着陆：第501团在费赫尔(Veghal)以南夺取运河桥，第506团在埃因霍温(Eindhoven)以北着陆，夺取北面的各座桥梁，保护空降场以便滑翔机增援，并进入该城，随后守住道路以保障第30军推进。

column1: The US 82nd AB is to hold Nijmegan, the Grave bridge and their Drop Zones. Assault boats will be delivered as soon as possible to allow the 504th to cross the Maas river upstream and attack the north end of the bridge while the 30th Corps attacks from the south. The 82nd AB is not permitted to advance beyond the northern end of Nijmegan bridge.
column2: 美国第82空降师要守住奈梅亨(Nijmegan)、赫拉弗桥(Grave bridge)及其空降场。突击舟将尽快送达，使第504团得以在马斯河(Maas)上游渡河，在第30军从南面进攻的同时攻击大桥北端。第82空降师不得越过奈梅亨桥北端继续推进。

column1: The US 82nd Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 504th south of Nijmegan to capture the north and south bridges and the 505th to land near Grave and capture the Grave bridge and protect their dropzone in preperation for Glider-borne reinforcement.
column2: 美国第82空降师将在两个空降场着陆：第504团在奈梅亨(Nijmegan)以南夺取南北两座桥，第505团在赫拉弗(Grave)附近着陆，夺取赫拉弗桥并保护其空降场，为滑翔机增援做准备。

column1: The victory in capturing Rostov was a brief one.  During the following week the 1st Panzer Army, racked by sickness, badly overstreched and plagued by shortages, was battered by a fierce offensive by Tiimoshenko's 9th and 39th Armies.  Although retreat was the only viable option given the situation, Hitler refused to allow such a move.  In response to Hitler's 'no retreat' order, Von Rundstedt issued an ultimatum - either the order be rescinded or he be relieved of his command.  He was soon replaced by Walther von Reichenau.
column2: 夺取罗斯托夫的胜利十分短暂。在随后一周里，饱受疾病折磨、战线过长、物资短缺的第1装甲集团军，遭到铁木辛哥第9与第39集团军的猛烈攻势打击。尽管就当时形势而言撤退是唯一可行的选择，希特勒却拒绝允许这样的行动。针对希特勒的「不得撤退」命令，冯·伦德施泰特(von Rundstedt)发出最后通牒——要么撤销该命令，要么解除他的指挥权。他很快被瓦尔特·冯·赖歇瑙(Walther von Reichenau)取代。

column1: The war effort has come to a critical junction, Commander.  Now that British and Commonwealth troops have landed on the beaches of Normandy, we must surge ahead.  The big push will come at St. Lo, where Jerry is well entrenched.  You must force him back and drive through his lines.  If you cannot achieve some level of success quickly,  the Germans could well give us a hard time in this hedgerow country forever!  Press on.
column2: 战事已到了一个关键的转折点，指挥官。既然英国与英联邦(Commonwealth)部队已在诺曼底(Normandy)各海滩登陆，我们必须乘势猛进。主攻将在圣洛(St. Lo)发起，德国佬在那里构筑了坚固工事。你必须把他逼退，并打穿他的防线。如果你不能迅速取得一定程度的成功，德国人很可能在这片树篱地区永远让我们吃尽苦头！继续推进。

column1: The war is OVER!, this is our victory day in Asia, the Primuski Republic is now dealing his independence with Moscow while Stalin is begging for the armistice with Germany!. China, Burma and India are now also included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere. We have liberated Asia from the Europeans, but, who will free Asia from us? HAHAHA!. Your name is now included in the japanese history as one of the heroes of our sacred nation.
column2: 战争结束了！今天是我们在亚洲的胜利日，滨海共和国正与莫斯科谈判其独立，而斯大林正在乞求与德国停战！中国、缅甸和印度如今也纳入了共荣圈。我们把亚洲从欧洲人手中解放了出来，可是，谁又能把亚洲从我们手中解放出来？哈哈哈！您的名字如今已作为我们神圣民族的英雄之一载入日本史册。

column1: the war to a close. Many Soviet officials were tried and found guilty of war
column2: 终结了战争。许多苏联官员受审并被判犯有危害国家罪。

column1: The war was over and there were no possibilities left for the Germans. The Soviet armies were about to crush Berlin. The German command in Italy asked the Führer for permission to retreat towards the natural defensive line at the Po River. Hitler however denied and ordered the defense of Bologna at all cost!. The Allies now launched an offensive against the remaining, equipment-lacking German Army.
column2: 战争已经结束，德国人再无任何可能。苏军即将碾碎柏林。意大利的德军指挥部请求元首准许退往波河(Po)一线的天然防线。但希特勒拒绝了，并下令不惜一切代价防守博洛尼亚(Bologna)！盟军随即对残余的、装备匮乏的德军发起攻势。

column1: The WEST BANK General, I wanted us on the WEST BANK!
column2: 西岸，将军，我要我们待在西岸！

column1: The Western Allieds launch a massive air attack against the Romanian oil installations at Ploesti.  Commando actions are coordinated with the air raid.
column2: 西方盟军对普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti)的罗马尼亚石油设施发动大规模空袭。突击队行动与空袭协同进行。

column1: The Western Allies attack Monte Cassino to break the Axis Central Italian Front.
column2: 西方盟军进攻卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)，以突破轴心国意大利中部战线。

column1: The Western Allies land in Sicily. The Axis powers try to throw them into the sea.
column2: 西方盟军在西西里(Sicily)登陆。轴心国试图把他们赶下海去。

column1: The Western Allies touch European soil at Salerno. The Axis powers try to throw them into the sea.
column2: 西方盟军在萨莱诺(Salerno)踏上欧洲土地。轴心国力图把他们赶下海。

column1: The Western Allies, with the help of the newly formed German Territorial Force, have recaptured Berlin, and are attempting to drive the Soviets back across the Oder.
column2: 西方盟军在新组建的德国国土防卫部队协助下已重新夺回柏林，并正试图把苏军赶回奥得河(Oder)对岸。

column1: The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on to Egypt.
column2: 整个昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)地区现在都在我们控制之下，但我们知道敌人已在加扎拉(Gazalla)与比尔哈凯姆(Bir Hacheim)两村之间建立了一道防线。侦察报告显示，英国人在该防线上同时使用反步兵与反坦克雷场，以阻止我们向埃及推进。

column1: The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on towards Egypt.
column2: 整个昔兰尼加地区现在都在我们控制之下，但我们知道敌人已在加扎拉和比尔哈凯姆两村之间建立了一道防线。侦察报告显示，英军在这道防线上布设了反步兵和反坦克雷场，以阻止我们向埃及推进。

column1: The whole front is in general retreat.
column2: 整条战线都在全面撤退。

column1: The whole world is watching General, do not disappoint me.
column2: 全世界都在看着，将军，不要让我失望。

column1: The worst has happened, the British have cut off our supply lines with the port, and we are isolated here!. If we can escape from here, a Military council would be waiting for you in Berlin!!.
column2: 最坏的情况发生了，英国人切断了我们与港口之间的补给线，我们在这里被孤立了！如果我们能从这里脱身，一个军事法庭会在柏林等着你！！

column1: The yankees are waiting us on San Francisco, but in truth we'll disembark in Los Angeles and surprise them. After around a hundred years, north Americans will have the war in their own homeland. Our paratroopers have landed in a place named "Hollywood" in order to capture a nearly airport. Your mission is to disembark your troops and make a beachhead, and later, take the big city of Los Angeles. Be aware, if our comrades paratroopers fall, our mission will be a failure.
column2: 美国佬正在旧金山(San Francisco)等着我们，但实际上我们将在洛杉矶(Los Angeles)登陆，打他们一个措手不及。大约一百年之后，北美将在自己的本土上经历战争。我们的伞兵已在一个叫「好莱坞」(Hollywood)的地方降落，以夺取一座近便的机场。你的任务是让部队登陆并建立桥头堡，然后夺取洛杉矶(Los Angeles)这座大城市。注意，如果我们的伞兵同志失败，我们的行动就会失败。

column1: The Zitadelle scenario is influenced by Jorge Gabitto's Kursk campaign.
column2: 「堡垒」场景受 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克战役启发。

column1: their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland. Good luck.
column2: 他们的战线防御不足。如果你能直插斯特拉斯堡，美国人和英国人将被迫停止向德国本土推进。祝你好运。

column1: There are many more Commanding General's more than willing to take your place!
column2: 还有很多指挥官巴不得来接替你的位置！

column1: There are many more Commanding Generals more than willing to take your place!
column2: 还有很多指挥官巴不得来接替你的位置！

column1: There are no upgrading or over-strengthening restrictions.
column2: 没有升级或超编加强的限制。

column1: There are only few steps left to gain the control of whole Europe. It´s well known that the allies know nothing about defence and we have borne the weight of the war against Germany, this is an invaluable experience.
column2: 只差几步就能控制整个欧洲。众所周知，盟军对防御一窍不通，而承受对德战争重担的是我们，这是无价的经历。

column1: There are plenty of Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough house to house fighting.
column2: 该地区有大量德军，他们会狂热地保卫自己的家乡，所以要准备好打艰苦的逐屋战斗。

column1: There are reports of many Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough fighting.
column2: 有报告说该地区有大量德军，他们会狂热地保卫自己的家乡，所以要准备好打艰苦的战斗。

column1: There are rumors from Berlin about a replacement for your command.
column2: 柏林有传言说要有人接替你的指挥职务。

column1: There is a heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.
column2: 大西洋(Atlantic)上有频繁的活动，所以要小心。

column1: There is also a ray of hope: since our cease-fire with the west the synthetic oil production has picked up surprisingly fast, and more and more new jet plains are batteling for the skies over Silesia.
column2: 还有一线希望：自从我们与西方停火以来，合成油产量回升得出奇地快，越来越多的新式喷气式飞机正在西里西亚上空争夺制空权。

column1: There is heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.
column2: 大西洋上活动频繁，请当心。

column1: There shouldn't be any strong resistance there but maybe you´ll find some German units scattered, so be careful.
column2: 那里不应有顽强的抵抗，但也许你会遇到一些散落的德军部队，所以要小心。

column1: There's nothing available to come to our relief.
column2: 没有任何可用的部队来解救我们。

column1: Therefore, our strategic goal has changed here in the Far East.
column2: 因此，我们在远东的战略目标已经改变。

column1: They are always looking for potential submariners...
column2: 他们一直在物色有潜力的潜艇兵……

column1: They cut our supply lines and our soldiers are between the wall and the sword.
column2: 他们切断了我们的补给线，我们的士兵进退维谷。

column1: They have launched a counterattack and cut our rear.
column2: 他们发动了反击，切断了我们的后方。

column1: They pretended it was a misunderstanding, they claim they misinterpreted Yalta's Agreements about the borderlines. They spoke about an "incident" caused by the lack of clarity of clauses discussed at Yalta. They now try to minimize the events.
column2: 他们假装这是一场误会，声称他们误解了雅尔塔关于边界线的协定。他们谈到一起因雅尔塔讨论的条款不够明确而引发的「事件」。他们现在试图尽量淡化这些事。

column1: They should be able to resume the offensive soon.
column2: 他们应该很快就能恢复攻势。

column1: They tried (cowardly) to attack our motherland with a ridiculous invasion, but they couldn't did it. North American troops are trapped in the island of Sakhalin, which Americans thought using as a base to manage the invasion. STAVKA has designed a operation to free Sakhalin and to capture the invaders, maybe we could destroy the Americans Pacific Fleet, that is anchoraged near to Poronask.
column2: 他们（怯懦地）试图以一次可笑的入侵进攻我们的祖国，但没能得逞。北美部队被困在萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)上，美国人原本想把它当作指挥入侵的基地。最高统帅部已设计了一次行动，以解放萨哈林并俘获入侵者，也许我们还能摧毁锚泊在波罗奈斯克(Poronask)附近的美国太平洋舰队。

column1: They will be studying this battle at the Point for centuries to come.
column2: 未来几百年里，西点(the Point)都会研究这一战。

column1: They'll be using this one at the armor school for quite a few years.
column2: 装甲学校会用这个战例讲上好些年。

column1: They've fortified the area in front of you.
column2: 他们已在你正面的地区构筑工事。

column1: This 16 scenarios long linear campaign is designed for skilled players whereas the 31 scenario long "Reich defense" campaign (17 scenarios longest path) is easier and includes what if scenarios. Both campaigns were designed in order to enhance original SSI "Defending the Reich" campaign.
column2: 这条 16 个场景的线性战役是为熟练玩家设计的，而 31 个场景的「帝国保卫战」战役（最长路径 17 个场景）则较容易，并包含假想场景。两场战役都是为了扩充 SSI 原版「帝国保卫战」战役而设计的。

column1: This battalion level scenario is loosely based on Hannes Gruber's regimental level Moscow scenario. The map on which it is played is created by Hannes Gruber.
column2: 这个营级场景大致依据 Hannes Gruber 的团级莫斯科场景改编。所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。

column1: This campaign features two extensively modified versions of Craig Miller's original campaigns "Blitzkrieg!" and "Greater Europe". At the choice scenario following Dunkirk you can choose which campaign to play.  If you choose to do the "Greater Europe" campaign path please be aware that you will need a moderate air force (3-4 fighters) in order to win the scenario Invasion!.
column2: 本战役包含 Craig Miller 原版战役“闪击战！”和“大欧洲”的两个经大幅修改的版本。在敦刻尔克之后的抉择场景中，您可以选择游玩哪条战役线。如果您选择“大欧洲”战役路线，请注意您需要一支中等规模的空军（3-4架战斗机）才能赢下“入侵！”场景。

column1: This campaign follows the battles of the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment of the US 101st Airborne Division from D Day to VE Day.
column2: 这场战役记述美国第101空降师第506伞降步兵团从诺曼底登陆日(D Day)到欧战胜利日(VE Day)的战斗历程。

column1: This Campaign is for experts only. If you can even survive the last two missions you deserve a Victoria Cross!
column2: 本战役仅供行家。如果你连最后两个任务都能活下来，你就该获得维多利亚十字勋章(Victoria Cross)！

column1: This campaign is for the General who is willing to risk everything to win.
column2: 本战役是给那种为了取胜不惜押上一切的将军准备的。

column1: This campaign reflects the true historical battles in which the German Army fought bravely.
column2: 本战役反映了德国陆军曾英勇作战的那些真实历史战役。

column1: This campaign traces the defensive battles fought by an undocumented group called 7.Panzerarmee. You determine the fate of Germany and the mental health of its leader.
column2: 本战役记述了一支名为第7装甲集团军(7.Panzerarmee)的无正式记录部队所进行的防御战。德国的命运，以及其指挥官的精神状态，都由你决定。

column1: This campaign was designed for experts and is not for the faint at heart. There are 22 scenarios and I would say the difficulty level varies from challenging to extremely difficult. I tried to make it very challenging because so many campaigns are just too easy and rapidly become boring. If you find it too difficult try playing it at 150 prestige. Good luck Commander!
column2: 本战役是为高手设计的，胆小鬼请勿尝试。共有 22 个场景，我敢说难度从富有挑战到极其困难不等。我力求把它做得很有挑战性，因为太多战役都太容易，很快就变得无聊。如果你觉得太难，试试用 150 威望来玩。祝你好运，指挥官！

column1: This is the plan we suggest; in the past month the units under your direct management have been deployed on the coast of the Sea of China in preparation for the Coup.   We are ready to support you by sea.  The Chinese navy will remain loyal to Mao, but it is not powerful enough to deal with a minor Soviet submarine unit.  After we secure the entire coast by taking Tanggu, you must launch the counterattack against the government loyalist units which surely will be sent to defeat our plans.  Take the Tanggu airfield as soon as possible as this will allow us to send you reinforcements by air.  Our planes will be painted with the PRC symbols.  You must avoid the Americans as we don't need any problems with them now.  The incident should be only between Chinese forces.

column1: Victory conditions: retreat 24 units, hold the two VH and ensure that the army depot survive.
column2: 胜利条件：撤出24个单位，守住两个胜利格，并确保陆军仓库存活。

column1: Victory conditions: take all VH by turn 8 for a BV, turn 9 for a V and turn 10 for a TV.
column2: 胜利条件：第8回合前夺取全部胜利格为决定性胜利，第9回合为胜利，第10回合为战术胜利。

column1: Victory conditions: This is a defensive scenario. You have to defend at least one VH for 22 turns. On the 22nd turn a hidden VH will appear giving you a TV.
column2: 胜利条件：这是一个防御场景。你必须守住至少一个胜利格达 22 个回合。在第 22 回合会出现一个隐蔽胜利格，给你一个战术胜利。

column1: Victory conditions: to hold 4 VH for a BV, 3 VH for a V and 2 VH for a TV.
column2: 胜利条件：守住4个胜利格为决定性胜利，3个为胜利，2个为战术胜利。

column1: Victory conditions: to hold 5 VH for a BV, 3 VH for a V and 2 VH for a TV.
column2: 胜利条件：守住5个胜利格为决定性胜利，3个胜利格为胜利，2个胜利格为战术胜利。

column1: Victory conditions: to retreat 12 units. In addition, you have to keep Halen and Kortenaken until turn 9.
column2: 胜利条件：撤出12个单位。此外，您必须守住哈伦和科特纳肯直到第9回合。

column1: Victory conditions: to take the VH before turn 8 for a BV, 10 for a V and 12 for a TV.
column2: 胜利条件：第8回合前夺取胜利格为决定性胜利，第10回合前为胜利，第12回合前为战术胜利。

column1: Victory conditions: withdraw 50 units for TV (BV and V are not possible).
column2: 胜利条件：撤出50支部队为战术胜利（不可能取得决定性胜利和胜利）。

column1: Victory conditions: You have to defend at least Fiorenzuola and Mercatale towns for 22 turns. On turn 22 a hidden VH will appear and allow you to make a BV.
column2: 胜利条件：你必须守住菲奥伦佐拉(Fiorenzuola)与梅尔卡塔莱(Mercatale)两镇至少 22 个回合。在第 22 回合会出现一个隐蔽胜利格，使你能够取得辉煌胜利。

column1: Victory!   We have crossed that damned bridge and many comrades have died, but their lives were not lost, they have contributed to the success of our retreat to save the Revolution.  Congratulations for your actions.
column2: 胜利！我们已跨过那座该死的桥，许多同志牺牲了，但他们的生命没有白费，他们为我们撤退以挽救革命的胜利作出了贡献。祝贺你的行动。

column1: Victory!!!, the British have been kicked from another place more!. Now, the Mediterranean is closed, and the South Bank is secured. Of course, we will put a permanent garrison in Spain, surely this won't please to Franco, but... this is not important! HAHAHAHAHA!
column2: 胜利！！！英国人又被我们从一个地方踢了出去！现在，地中海已经封闭，南岸也已确保。当然，我们会在西班牙驻一支永久守备部队，这肯定不讨佛朗哥(Franco)喜欢，但……这不重要！哈哈哈哈哈！

column1: Victory!!!, the British have been kicked from another place more!. Now, the Mediterranean is closed, and the South Bank is secured. Of course, we will put a permanent garrison in Spain, surely this won't please to Franco, but... this is not important! HAHAHAHAHA!
column2: 波美拉尼亚壁垒(Wal Pomorski) -「波美拉尼亚阵地」(Pommernstellung)

column1: Victory!, we have destroyed the British defensive lines with our Panzer Divisions, all the goals have been captured, the supply lines restored... and now, to London!.
column2: 胜利！我们用装甲师摧毁了英军防线，所有目标都已夺取，补给线已经恢复……现在，向伦敦进军！

column1: Viel Gluck!, we need a complete victory here to continue the drive to the French Channel..
column2: 祝好运！我们需要在此取得全胜，才能继续向法国海峡推进。
维也纳(Vienna) - 1945 年 4 月 6 日

column1: Vienna fell to the Russians and your division ends it glorious history is Bolshevik captivity. I am sure your troops wished they escaped to the west to seek refuge with our former enemies - the Western Allies.
column2: 维也纳落入俄国人之手，你的师在布尔什维克的战俘营中结束其光荣历史。我相信你的部队宁愿当初西撤，投奔我们昔日的敌人——西方盟国——寻求庇护。

column1: Vienna fell to the Russians and your division ends it glorious history is Bolshevik captivity. I am sure your troops wished they escaped to the west to surrender to the Americans.
column2: 维也纳落入俄国人之手，你的师在布尔什维克的战俘营中结束其光荣历史。我相信你的部队宁愿当初西撤，向美国人投降。

column1: Vienna fell to the Russians. The Der Führer regiment was sent to Prague for a (successful) rescue mission of the entrapped garrison forces, the Deutschland regiment clashed with American forces near St Poelten Austria and the rest of the division was sent to Dresden.
column2: 维也纳(Vienna)已落入俄军之手。元首(Der Führer)团被派往布拉格(Prague)，执行解救被围守军的任务（并获成功）；德意志(Deutschland)团在奥地利圣珀尔滕(St Poelten)附近与美军交火；该师其余部队则被派往德累斯顿(Dresden)。

column1: Vienna is falling. Your division is ordered to fight a delaying action in the suburbs, holding the southern approaches while the remnants of the corps disengage to the west. Make the Russians pay for every street, Herr General - and then get your men out.
column2: 维也纳(Vienna)即将陷落。你师奉命在城郊实施迟滞作战，扼守南面通道，掩护军残部向西脱离接触。让俄国人为每一条街道付出代价，将军阁下——然后把你的人带出来。
维捷布斯克(Vitebsk)'46 - 1946 年 6 月 30 日
符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok) - 1946 年 6 月 1 日

column1: Vladivostok is now isolated from other soviet controlled areas, and will soon be in our hands.
column2: 符拉迪沃斯托克如今已与其他苏联控制区隔绝，很快将落入我们手中。

column1: von Beck: Sir, after three hours of interrogating the Soviet General, we are convinced that he really does not know the whereabouts of the Generalissimo of the Red Army.
column2: 冯·贝克(von Beck)：长官，审讯了那名苏军将军三个小时之后，我们确信他真的不知道红军最高统帅的下落。

column1: von Beck: Sir, since we can only land two ground units, may I suggest that we land our recon units? As far as the Fallschirmjager units are concerned, there is a problem. In the process of acquiring ground transports, they have been compromised, and the British home guards are alerted. The good news is that they have stolen an AAA gun for our protection.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，既然我们只能空运两个地面部队，我建议空运我们的侦察部队？至于伞兵部队，有个问题。他们在搞地面运输车辆的过程中暴露了，英国国民自卫队已提高警惕。好消息是他们偷来了一门高射炮供我们自卫。

column1: Von Beck: Sir, the Americans are on the rampage, and we only have enough time to set up a defense perimeter.
column2: 冯·贝克(Von Beck)：长官，美国人正在横冲直撞，我们只来得及布置一道环形防线。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there are additional enemy fighters on the way to add to what they currently have. They are several days away, but exactly how many days, we don't know.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，还有更多敌军战斗机正在赶来，将加入他们现有的兵力。它们距此有数日路程，但究竟几天，我们不知道。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there are enemy anti-aircraft batteries and at least two enemy fighter units operating in the area. For support, we are receiving a fighter and a bomber unit, which are due to arrive in eight hours. Additional infantry support is delayed and won't be arriving for another two and a half days.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，该地区有敌军高炮连，至少还有两支敌军战斗机部队在活动。作为支援，我们将得到一支战斗机部队和一支轰炸机部队，约八小时后抵达。额外的步兵支援被延误，还要再过两天半才能到达。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there is a fighter unit and a bomber unit that are six hours away and two unmotorized infantry units that are about fourteen hours away to reinforce us. Other than those, the Italians have no more forces to commit.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，有一支战斗机部队和一支轰炸机部队距此六小时路程，还有两支非摩托化步兵部队约十四小时路程，可用来增援我们。除此之外，意大利人再无兵力可投入。

column1: von Beck: Sir, You have achieved a great victory liberating all the Bolchevicks polytical prissoners!
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，你取得了一场重大胜利，解放了所有布尔什维克的政治犯！

column1: von Beck: The Americans are on a rampage again, sir. They act as if we are raping their women and children. Anyway, we have little time to get set up before they arrive.
column2: 冯·贝克(von Beck)：美国人又在横冲直撞了，阁下。他们那副样子，就好像我们在糟蹋他们的妻儿。不管怎样，我们没多少时间在他们到达之前完成部署。

column1: Von Manstein attacks the Soviet Fifty First Army in order to open the road to the encircled Sixth Army in Stalingrad. The 17th Panzer division is on its way to support the attack while the Soviets are rushing the 2nd Guards Army to defend the Myshkova line.
column2: 冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)进攻苏军第51集团军，以打开通往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)被围第6集团军的道路。第17装甲师正在赶来支援这次进攻，而苏军则急调第2近卫集团军防守梅什科瓦河(Myshkova)一线。

column1: Wan shan!  All the mission objectives were achieved before the Japanese could send reinforcements to this area.  Now your task is to hide your guerrillas and wait for new orders.
column2: 万岁！在日军能向这一地区派出增援之前，所有任务目标都已达成。现在你的任务是隐藏你的游击队，等待新的命令。

column1: Wan Shan!  Did you see how the capitalists are escaping from us??   Pyongyang is again a communist stronghold, and we must continue to pursue and annihilate the UN forces.
column2: 万岁！你看到资本主义者是怎样从我们面前逃跑的吗？？平壤再次成为共产主义据点，我们必须继续追击并歼灭联合国军。

column1: Wan shan!  The KMT have suffered a great defeat.  I'm sure we will be celebrating our victory over Chiang Kai Shek's troops during the coming year of 1948.
column2: 万岁！国民党遭到了一场大败。我相信在即将到来的1948年，我们将庆祝对蒋介石部队的胜利。

column1: Wan Shan!  We have saved a lot of our men from the Kuomingtan onslaught.  We must hope to counterstrike the dirty nationalists as soon as we receive some Soviet aid through Manchuria.
column2: 万岁！我们已从国民党的猛攻中救出了许多人员。我们必须寄望于一旦通过满洲获得一些苏联援助，就立即反击那些肮脏的国民政府军。

column1: war in Spain, to the blitzkrieg victories of early World War II, and then to
column2: 内战，到二战初期闪击战的胜利，再到

column1: war still going on in the Pacific, I hope they're right.
column2: 太平洋(Pacific)的战事还在继续，我希望他们说得对。

column1: Warning: only four units can be deployed and there is no airfiled available (in case you still have some airforce left).
column2: 警告：只能部署四个单位，且没有可用机场（如果您还有空军的话）。

column1: Warning: only six core units can be deployed and supply has become extremely difficult due to the supremacy of the German Luftwaffe.
column2: 警告：只能部署六支核心部队，而且由于德国空军的压倒性优势，补给已变得极其困难。

column1: Warning: only three core units can be deployed.
column2: 警告：只能部署三个核心单位。

column1: Warning: some units may collapse and stop fighting.
column2: 警告：有些部队可能会崩溃并停止战斗。

column1: Warning: the 17 DI will retreat in the first turns. You can only deploy 5 units.
column2: 警告：第17步兵师将在最初几个回合撤退。您只能部署5个单位。

column1: Warning: there is no more coordination between the Allied armies (if ever existed).
column2: 警告：盟军之间已不再有任何协调（如果有过的话）。

column2: 华盛顿已决定，我们在太平洋需要更强的火力，并且

column1: Watch out for the fanatical SS men who will do everything to stop you.
column2: 当心那些狂热的党卫军，他们会不惜一切阻止你。

column1: Watch out, a few Kriegsmarine units are nearby as mobile artillery...
column2: 当心，附近有几支海军部队充当机动炮兵……

column1: We already warned our allies some months ago but the French strategists considered the region impracticable for motorized troops (sic).
column2: 我们几个月前就警告过盟友，但法国战略家们认为该地区不适合摩托化部队通行（原文如此）。

column1: We also hope to find anti-soviet elements in the population of the conquered areas or even in the enemy army units.  Our plan is to set up of an anti-soviet ''independent'' republic there, the Primurski Republic, like in the 20s.
column2: 我们还希望在所征服地区的民众乃至敌军部队中找到反苏分子。我们的计划是在那里建立一个反苏的“独立”共和国——滨海共和国，就像20年代那样。

column1: We are about to launch Operation Husky, the invasion of Sicily. You are to give support to the Bradley 2nd US Corps in assaulting the beaches around the port of Gela. Our marines have just landed at Scoglitti, but the main bulk of this mission lies on your shoulders: rough terrain and enemy entrenched positions will be the biggest problems to deal with. Most of all you will not be able to rely on your formidable air force until you capture the airfield of Ragusa. Therefore this should be the very first objective on your schedule. Good luck!
column2: 我们即将发起哈士奇行动(Operation Husky)，即西西里(Sicily)登陆。你要支援布拉德利(Bradley)指挥的美军第2军，突击杰拉(Gela)港周边的海滩。我们的陆战队刚刚在斯科利蒂(Scoglitti)登陆，但这次任务的主要重担压在你肩上：崎岖地形与敌军坚固阵地将是最难对付的问题。最重要的是，在夺取拉古萨(Ragusa)机场之前，你无法依靠你那强大的空中力量。因此这应当是你计划中的第一个目标。祝好运！

column1: We are at a critical stage of the battle Bob.
column2: 我们正处在战斗的关键阶段，鲍勃(Bob)。

column1: We are at the doors of the Iraqi Capital City, the main obstacle is the Arab Legion and the 10th Indian Division brought as
column2: 我们已抵达伊拉克首都城下，主要障碍是阿拉伯军团和作为增援

column1: We are closing to the land where the very first people loved by Hitler were originated (kiddin'). The High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS to "silence" the sector.
column2: 我们正逼近那片土地——希特勒最先喜爱的那类人正是发源于此（开玩笑的）。最高统帅部说，整个领土上有很多犹太民兵部队，征服之后我们将派党卫军去「封住」这一地区。

column1: We are facing a terrible situation, the 8th Army is going to attack our last bastion and our scout units reported that Monty has sent the 2nd division NZ through the mountains, at the same time, he is going to launch a full frontal attack against our lines.
column2: 我们面临极为糟糕的局势：第8集团军即将进攻我们最后的堡垒，我方侦察部队报告蒙蒂已派新西兰第2师穿越山区，同时他还将对我们的防线发起全面正面进攻。

column1: We are facing a terrible situation, the British 8th Army is going to attack our last bastion and our scout units say that Monty has sent the 2nd NZ division through the mountains, at the same time, he is going to launch a full frontal attack against our lines.
column2: 我们面临严峻的局势，英国第8集团军将要进攻我们最后的堡垒，而我们的侦察部队称蒙蒂已把第2新西兰师派过山地，同时他将对我们的防线发动全面正面进攻。

column1: We are fortunate that the weather hasn't completely turned to hell!
column2: 我们很走运，天气还没有彻底变得一团糟！

column1: We are in an unstoppable advance along the African coasts. Now Oran is the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clear it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and makes us an impossible duty to perform.
column2: 我们正沿着非洲海岸势不可挡地推进。现在奥兰是盟军下一个设防目标，您的任务是在敌人得以增援并使这项任务变得不可能完成之前，尽快肃清它。

column1: We are in the doors of the Iraqi Capital City, the main obstacle is the Arab Legion and the 10th Indian Division brought as reinforcements, so do whatever you can and take the needed oil for the Deutsches Reich!
column2: 我们已来到伊拉克首都的门前，主要障碍是阿拉伯军团(Arab Legion)和作为增援调来的第10印度师，所以尽你所能，为德意志帝国(Deutsches Reich)夺取所需的石油！

column1: We are involved at the Mongol-Manchu border into a fierce fight agaisnt Soviet and Mongol troops since March, as the Soviets continues refusing to recognise the true boundaries of Jap... err of our Manchukuoan allies. The Soviets have massed an enormous force at the West bank of the Khalkhin Gol river to retake the vicitinies of the Nomonhan village. What the Kwantung army wants from you, is to deploy your command there, and face the Soviets. Your skills, probably will be the solution for this new... incident.
column2: 自3月以来，我们与苏联和蒙古军队在满蒙边境陷入了激战，因为苏联人始终拒绝承认日……呃，承认我们满洲国盟友的真正边界。苏联人已在哈拉哈河（哈拉哈河）西岸集结了庞大兵力，企图夺回诺门罕村的失地。关东军希望您做的，就是把您的部队部署到那里，去面对苏联人。您的本领，或许正是解决这场新……事件的办法。

column1: We are isolated just like the Sixth Army in 42.
column2: 我们像 42 年的第6集团军一样被孤立了。

column1: We are nearing the land where the very first people loved by Hitler originated (kiddin'). High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS in to "silence" the sector.
column2: 我们正接近那片希特勒所宠爱的民族最初发源的土地（开玩笑的）。最高统帅部称整片领土上散布着许多犹太民兵部队，征服之后我们将派党卫军进去“让”这一带“安静下来”。

column1: We are not on schedule, but again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. The Bolsheviks made the mistake of committing all their troops to the first line of defense. Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Partisan activity makes it increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
column2: 我们未按计划推进，但又有数十万俄军被困在我们后方的包围圈里。布尔什维克犯了把全部部队都投入第一道防线的错误。你一旦突破，他们便再无预备队可以阻挡你。游击队活动使从前线附近的机场出动越来越困难（这就是那些机场未能提供补给的原因）。现在是向东推进的时候了。目标是莫斯科。但愿我们没有损失太多时间。情报报告西伯利亚部队已经抵达前线。

column1: We are taking measures to make the American public sick of this war. We started a big offensive towards Liege and get in the back of the American 1st and 9th armies near Aachen.
column2: 我们正在设法让美国公众对这场战争感到厌倦。我们已向列日方向发起一场大规模攻势，插到亚琛附近美国第1、第9集团军的后方。

column1: We are victorious!, now London is completely besieged by our forces, and the last British defenders are enclosed into the capital, they have two options: surrender, or die!
column2: 我们胜利了！如今伦敦(London)已被我军彻底包围，最后一批英国守军被困在首都之内，他们只有两个选择：投降，或者死亡！

column1: we can force the allies to surrender.
column2: 我们可以迫使盟军投降了。

column1: We can now build up our forces for the seizure of Vladivostok.
column2: 现在我们能积聚兵力，以夺取符拉迪沃斯托克。

column1: We can't advance West until our flank is secure.
column2: 在我们的侧翼稳固之前，我们无法向西推进。

column1: We can't allow this situation; the capitalist unification of Korea must not be completed.  A capitalist state in Korea would be like a gun aimed at the People's Republic of China, and we know that the puny North American general McArthur has maintained some conversations with Chaing-Kai-Shek about a possible continuation of the war against us.
column2: 我们不能容许这种局面；资本主义统一朝鲜绝不能完成。朝鲜若出现一个资本主义国家，就像一支枪对准中华人民共和国，而且我们知道，那个微不足道的北美将军麦克阿瑟已与蒋介石就继续对我们作战的可能性进行过一些会谈。

column1: We cannot continue the offensive, now you must prepare to fall back and defend yourself.
column2: 我们无法继续进攻，现在您必须准备后撤并转入防御。

column1: We cannot leave the entrance of the Port under the British control, however we must send our main units to overrun El Cairo. Following that ideas, the High Command have designed an operation to take Port Said using few units, like in May of 1940 in the Low Countries.
column2: 我们不能让该港的入口留在英国人控制之下，但我们又必须派出主力部队去攻占开罗(El Cairo)。基于这一思路，最高统帅部设计了一次只用少量部队夺取塞得港(Port Said)的行动，就像1940年5月在低地国家那样。

column1: We don't have much choice but to try again.
column2: 我们别无多少选择，只能再试一次。

column1: We don't have the choice, we have to surrender, the lack of supplies don't let us do anything else.
column2: 我们没有选择，只能投降；补给短缺让我们别无办法。

column1: We had expected you to move faster. Move your troops South. They are needed in the North of France where we have encircled a large number of enemy forces.
column2: 我们本以为你能推进得更快。把你的部队调往南面。法国北部需要我们围住的大批敌军，那里正需要他们。

column1: We had restore all colonies of our ally and we control the whole Red Sea, but we have to gain another strong point controlled by the British: Mombasa.
column2: 我们已收复盟友的全部殖民地，并控制了整个红海，但我们必须再夺取一个由英国人控制的据点：蒙巴萨(Mombasa)。

column1: We had to abandon our original plan 'Fall Gelb' after one of our Fallschirmguys lost the plans to the Belgians when his plane crashed. The new Sichelschnitt plan is much more daring, shifting the focus of the attack from The Netherlands and Belgium to the South of Belgium: the supposedly impassable Ardennes. This leaves the forces that need to capture the Netherlands much weaker than originally planned. Generalleutnant Student will land his FliegerKorps XI Fliegerdivision 7 and Luftlandedivision 22 near The Hague, Rotterdam and the bridges at Dordrecht and Moerdijk. Your task is to follow Generalleutnant Schmidt's 9th Panzerdivision through the South of the Netherlands. Once your forces arrive as West as Moerdijk, turn North to the Hague and follow the path cleared by Student's troops.
column2: 由于我们的一名伞兵在飞机坠毁时把计划落到了比利时人手里，我们不得不放弃原定的「黄色方案」。新的「镰刀切割」方案大胆得多，把进攻重心从荷兰和比利时转到比利时南部：据信无法通过的阿登地区。这使得负责攻占荷兰的兵力比原计划削弱了许多。施图登特中将将把他的飞行军——第7航空师和第22空降师——投送到海牙、鹿特丹附近，以及多德雷赫特和莫尔代克两座桥。你的任务是跟随施密特中将的第9装甲师穿越荷兰南部。你的部队一旦抵达最西面的莫尔代克，就转向北方前往海牙，沿着施图登特部队开辟的通道前进。

column1: We had to break up our 11SS Regiment to bring the Deutschland and Der Fürher regiments up to strength again. Some of our units have started to run out of ammo. But even though the  mud, rain and cold slowed us down, we have come close to the end goal of our offensive: the capture of Moscow. The 10th Pz Division will again be fighting at our left flank. Make us proud General.
column2: 我们不得不拆散党卫军第11团，好把「德意志」团与「元首」团补足建制。我们有些单位已开始弹药不足。但尽管泥泞、雨水与严寒拖慢了我们，我们已接近此次攻势的最终目标：攻取莫斯科(Moscow)。第10装甲师将再次在我方左翼作战。让我们为你骄傲，将军。

column1: We have a big problem Commander. Get your men ready to move!
column2: 指挥官，我们遇到大麻烦了。让你的人准备好出发！

column1: We have a chance for victory over Red army, but enemy resistance will be very strong. Soviet units from Siberia are tough troops. Bad weather, the severe frost, difficult trackless ground... in short it is a pure Soviet battlefield.
column2: 我们有机会战胜红军，但敌人的抵抗将非常顽强。来自西伯利亚的苏军部队是强悍的部队。恶劣天气、严寒、难以通行的无路地带……总之，这是一片纯粹的苏军战场。

column1: We have a disastrous situation on our hands and where it not for you, sixth army would be all but finished now. East of Serafimovitch two Russian corps have broken through the Romanian lines, destroyed three Roumanian divisions, and routed three divisions of Sixth Army. South of Stalingrad the Roumanian fourth army has been annihalated. Though it still holds Kalach, sixth army is surrounded in a perimeter west of Stalingrad, and in a disastrous position.
column2: 我们手上是一个灾难性的局面，要不是你，第6集团军现在几乎就完了。在谢拉菲莫维奇以东，两个俄国军突破了罗马尼亚人的防线，歼灭了三个罗马尼亚师，并击溃了第6集团军的三个师。在斯大林格勒以南，罗马尼亚第4集团军已被全歼。第6集团军虽然仍据守卡拉奇，却已被围在斯大林格勒以西的一个环形阵地中，处境极为不利。

column1: We have a plan, use the first group of spies to attract the attention in order to leave their base with less defenses, and with the second group cut the fence and destroy the installations.
column2: 我们有一个计划：用第一组间谍吸引注意力，使他们基地的防御变弱，再由第二组剪断围栏并摧毁设施。

column1: We have air superiority, more men and equipment and plenty of supplies, furthermore Intelligence tells us that Rommel is in Germany on sick leave, the enemy should be easily defeated once we breach its fortifications.
column2: 我们拥有空中优势、更多的兵员与装备以及充足的补给，此外情报部门告诉我们，隆美尔正在德国休病假，一旦我们突破敌人的工事，应该就能轻易将其击败。

column1: We have avoided each country of Western Europe to become a puppet state vassal to U.S.S.R.
column2: 我们避免了西欧(Western Europe)每一个国家沦为苏联(U.S.S.R.)的傀儡附庸国。

column1: We have been informed that some German troops of the 208 Infantry Division have crossed the Escaut/Scheldt river through one of the tunnels in Antwerpen/Anvers that, due once more to the absence of coordination with our allies, has not been completely destroyed.
column2: 我们已获悉，德军第208步兵师的一些部队已通过安特卫普的一条隧道渡过斯海尔德河——这条隧道又一次因为与盟军缺乏协调而未被彻底炸毁。

column1: We have come up against the Gothic Line, stretching approximately east to west across Italy along the Appenines. The basic plan to break the Line calls for 3 attacks, the US army will attack in the west and centre, while our own forces will attack along the Adriatic in the east, aiming for Ravenna - this is codenamed Operation Olive.
column2: 我们已抵近哥特防线，它沿亚平宁山脉(Appenines)自东向西横贯意大利。突破该防线的基本计划要求发动 3 次进攻，美军将在西面与中央发起进攻，而我们自己的部队将沿东面的亚得里亚海(Adriatic)方向进攻，目标是拉韦纳(Ravenna)——这次行动的代号是橄榄行动(Operation Olive)。

column1: We have completed the Italian Campaign.  Italy is once again a part of the German empire.
column2: 我们已完成意大利战役。意大利再次成为德意志帝国的一部分。

column1: We have crossed Australia, without any significant resistance, just some kangaroos in the dirty roads of this country hahaha!  Well, now we think the Australians are planning to use the majority of their troops to protect their southeast corner where their major important cities and bases are located:  Adelaide, Sidney, Brisbane or Canberra for example.  Your mission is to get Adelaide.  This will completely cut Australia in two.  Meanwhile, disembark some troops from the sea against Brisbane and Sidney to keep the remainder of Australian troops busy.  Our brave navy will also be here in the Adelaide sector to help you deal with the enemy.
column2: 我们已横穿澳大利亚，没有遇到任何像样的抵抗，只有这国家泥泞道路上的几只袋鼠，哈哈哈！好，现在我们认为澳大利亚人正打算用其大部分兵力保卫他们东南角，那里有他们最重要的城市和基地：例如阿德莱德、悉尼、布里斯班或堪培拉。您的任务是攻取阿德莱德。这将把澳大利亚彻底切成两半。同时，从海上派兵登陆布里斯班和悉尼，以牵制澳大利亚其余部队。我们英勇的海军也将出现在阿德莱德方向，协助您对付敌人。

column1: We have failed to save the trapped men....but it was a lost cause.  The thick fog and heavily bogged roads made rapid advance impossible.  Now we, ourselves must try and escape before we are encircled.
column2: 我们没能救出被困的部队……但那本就是一桩注定失败的事。浓雾和严重泥泞的道路使快速推进成为不可能。如今我们自己也得在被合围之前设法突围。

column1: We have fought until the end, we don't have fuel, ammo neither equipment or food, however the Führer has formally forbidden to evacuate Afrika, so we must ask you to do the better you can under those circumstances.
column2: 我们已经战斗到最后，没有燃料，没有弹药，也没有装备与食物；但元首已正式禁止撤离非洲，所以我们只能要求你在这种处境下尽力而为。

column1: We have freed Tunisia from the British.  Rest up well because we have another tough job for you next month.
column2: 我们已把突尼斯(Tunisia)从英国人手中解放出来。好好休整，因为下个月我们还有另一项苦差事交给你。

column1: We have gained the necessary time to finish the fortifications along the Gustav Line. Now we can retreat. I hope you didn't suffer to many losses..
column2: 我们已赢得必要的时间来完成古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)沿线的工事。现在我们可以撤退了。我希望你没有遭受太多损失……

column1: We have got the victory!, now London is completely besieged by our forces, and the last British defenders are enclosed into the capital, they have two options; surrender, or die!
column2: 我们胜利了！如今伦敦(London)已被我军彻底围困，英国最后的守军被围在首都之内，他们只有两个选择：投降，或者死亡！

column1: We have however indications from General Richthofen that large formations, probably the Soviet first guard corps are on their way east to your sector. So, be on your guard against an attack from the east as well as a renewed attack from the north !
column2: 不过，我们从里希特霍芬将军那里得到迹象表明，庞大的编队——很可能是苏联近卫第1军——正向东开往你的战区。因此，你要警惕来自东面的进攻，也要警惕北面再次发起的进攻！

column1: We have just established our HQ on Lyme, your next mission after seizing the port, is to make the roads safe we will use to drive our attack on Bristol. We need to capture the city of Taunton, intelligence reports that the British could be preparing a counter-attack from the other side of the river which crosses Taunton; we must avoid this, if the British destroy our communications with the port, our units in Bristol would be completely isolated. We expect the best from you, General.
column2: 我们刚在莱姆(Lyme)建立了司令部。夺取港口之后，你的下一个任务是确保我们将用来向布里斯托尔(Bristol)发起进攻的道路安全。我们需要夺取汤顿(Taunton)城；情报报告说，英国人可能正从横穿汤顿的河对岸准备一次反击；我们必须防止这一点，如果英国人破坏我们与港口之间的交通，我们在布里斯托尔(Bristol)的部队就会完全被孤立。我们期待你拿出最好的表现，将军。

column1: We have just heard that General Patton's army has taken Kiev! Now rest your men Commander. Your next assignment begins on August 5th.
column2: 我们刚听说巴顿(Patton)将军的部队已夺取基辅(Kiev)！现在让你的部下休整吧，指挥官。你的下一个任务将于 8 月 5 日开始。

column1: We have just one step left to kick-out the americans from the east coast, start to move!
column2: 我们只差一步就能把美国人赶出东海岸，开始行动！

column1: We have left Algiers and are now in Morocco, your quick advance didn't give our enemies time to strengthen their defensive positions. You have to advance faster and avoid the mistakes you have already made in the past.
column2: 我们已离开阿尔及尔(Algiers)，现在在摩洛哥(Morocco)，你的迅速推进没给我们的敌人时间去加强他们的防御阵地。你必须推进得更快，并避免你过去已经犯过的错误。

column1: We have located a battery of 105mm guns that are firing on Utah beach and have the potential to inflict damage on our assault force.
column2: 我们已定位一个105毫米炮兵连，它正向犹他滩(Utah beach)射击，有可能对我们的突击部队造成损伤。

column1: We have lost our three divisions here!!! they have been unarmed into Spain, this is a completely disaster!. A military council is waiting for you in Germany.
column2: 我们在这里损失了三个师！！！他们已在西班牙被解除武装，这是一场彻底的灾难！军事法庭正在德国等着你。

column1: We have made a peace agreement in poor conditions with the Americans.
column2: 我们在恶劣条件下与美国达成了和平协议。

column1: We have more battles for you to win!
column2: 我们还有更多的仗要你去打赢！

column1: We have pushed the British out of Algeria and now the time has come to liberate Tunisia from Churchill's tyranny.
column2: 我们已把英军逐出阿尔及利亚，现在是从丘吉尔(Churchill)的暴政下解放突尼斯的时候了。

column1: We have pushed the Russians out of Germany and now the time has come to liberate Poland from Stalin's tyrany. A small contingent of German nationalist troops will be covering your flank and are scheduled to arrive in two days. Consider them as "advisors" against fighting the Russians. You must complete this first phase prior to the end of the month.
column2: 我们已把俄国人逐出德国，现在是从斯大林的暴政下解放波兰(Poland)的时候了。一支德国民族主义部队小分遣队将掩护你的侧翼，预定两天后到达。就把他们当作对抗俄国人的「顾问」。你必须在月底前完成这第一阶段。

column1: We have reached the Atlantic coasts of France, the Allies and the survivors from the French army are embarking to England. Stalin has naming you as one of the peoples heroes after this action.
column2: 我们已抵达法国的大西洋海岸，盟军与法军残部正登船前往英格兰。此役之后，斯大林已把你列为人民英雄之一。

column1: We have recruited an special division in Okinawa, (the ''boeitai'') plus some auxiliary units too. Also, the Yamato group is coming from Japan with fuel for just one way, to aid you with smashing the enemy fleet. Make good use of your brave kamikaze warriors, they can inflict severe casualities upon the enemy warships.
column2: 我们在冲绳征募了一个特别师团（“防卫队”），还有一些辅助部队。此外，大和部队正从日本驶来，所携燃料只够单程，前来协助您粉碎敌军舰队。好好使用您勇敢的神风特攻勇士，他们能对敌军战舰造成严重伤亡。

column1: We have reports of an elite heavy unit operating in the area.
column2: 我们接到报告，有一支精锐重型部队正在该地区活动。

column1: We have secured the city of Taunton, and now the way to Bristol is clear. We expect the improvement of your actions, otherwise we will be forced to remove you from the command.
column2: 我们已确保汤顿(Taunton)城，如今通往布里斯托尔(Bristol)的道路已经畅通。我们期待你的行动有所改善，否则我们将不得不解除你的指挥权。

column1: We have seized the Norwegian capital of Oslo, but still the Norwegians and their British allies resist us.  They are attempting to keep us out of the valley leading north from Oslo through Lillehammer.  Your forces are tasked with securing this important communications center.  Good luck, Herr General.
column2: 我们已夺取挪威首都奥斯陆，但挪威人及其英国盟友仍在抵抗。他们正试图阻止我们进入从奥斯陆经利勒哈默尔向北延伸的谷地。你的部队受命夺取这一重要的交通枢纽。祝你好运，将军阁下。

column1: We have sent elements from the Atlantic fleet as reinforcements; they will arrive shortly.  Our missile batteries are being installed but we suggest you do not wait and commence the final assault.
column2: 我们已从大西洋舰队派出部队作为增援；他们很快就会到达。我们的导弹连正在安装，但我们建议你不要等待，直接发起最后突击。

column1: We have stopped the offensive, but our casualities have been too high.  You have permission to retreat your armies behind the Han river to avoid future losses.
column2: 我们挡住了这次进攻，但我们的伤亡太大了。允许你把部队后撤到汉江以北，以避免今后的损失。

column1: We have the scientist in Allied hands now. Unfortunately, we have lost a great sum of men and vehicles. Try to be more careful in the future, ok?
column2: 科学家现在已在盟军手中。遗憾的是，我们损失了大量人员与车辆。以后尽量小心些，好吗？

column1: We have the silos. Our forces will have to rest before we can restart the drive
column2: 我们拿下了那些发射井。我们的部队必须休整，才能重新开始向

column1: We have to get across quickly to keep our advance moving before
column2: 我们必须迅速渡过去，以保持推进势头，赶在

column1: We have to seize a beach head and move inland quickly.
column2: 我们必须夺取滩头阵地，并迅速向内陆推进。

column1: We have tranferred you to the quiet Italian part of the front. Your assignment is the same as you had with the Roumanians; providing them with the anti-tank capability they lack. We have sent the Italians lots of Bohler guns that are obsolete, but may be better than nothing.
column2: 我们已将您调往意军驻守的平静地段。您的任务与在罗马尼亚军那里时相同：为他们提供所缺乏的反坦克能力。我们已给意大利人送去大量过时的博勒火炮，但聊胜于无。

column1: We heared these messages were received on the radio:
column2: 我们听说电台收到了这些消息：

column1: We hope you're good in maths, 'cause you're not in strategy, Comrade Stalin has ordered you to count the trees in Siberia...
column2: 我们希望你的数学不错，因为你的战略不行，斯大林同志已命令你去数西伯利亚(Siberia)的树木……

column1: We keep on our unstoppable advance by the Afrikan coasts. Now Oran in the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clean it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and make this conquest an impossible duty to perform.
column2: 我们继续沿非洲海岸不可阻挡地推进。现在奥兰(Oran)是盟军下一个设防目标，你的任务是尽快肃清它，抢在我们的敌人增援之前——否则这次征服就将成为一项不可能完成的任务。

column1: We know that you've recently arrived from El Alamein but the severity of the situation right here demand your services.
column2: 我们知道你刚从阿拉曼(El Alamein)赶到，但此地的严峻局势需要你来效力。

column1: We know that you've recently arrived from El Alamein but the severity of the situation right here demands your services.
column2: 我们知道您刚从阿拉曼赶来，但此地局势的严重性需要您效力。

column1: We know that your army is tired, but the Americans are preparing an invasion to Vladivostok, and we have to stop it at all cost.
column2: 我们知道你的部队已经很疲惫，但美国人正在筹备入侵符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)，我们必须不惜一切代价阻止它。

column1: We lost this battle, but it isn't still all over. We will continue our fight!
column2: 我们输掉了这一仗，但一切还没有结束。我们将继续战斗！

column1: We may have helped them reopen the front there, but I have no
column2: 我们也许帮他们重新打开了那里的战线，但我无

column1: We missed the chance to trap 600,000 Bolsjeviks in what would have been the Kiev pocket. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the raspoetitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 我们错失了把60万布尔什维克困进本可形成的基辅包围圈的机会。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: We must congratulate you to have saved Seelöwe from a disaster! The Führer himself sends you his honest thanks and in Germany you are a national Hero.
column2: 我们必须祝贺你使「海狮」(Seeloewe)免于一场灾难！元首亲自向你致以诚挚的谢意，在德国你是一位民族英雄。

column1: We must seize Dunkirk as soon as possible.
column2: 我们必须尽快夺取敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)。

column1: We need to solve it quickly, otherwise the enemy will have a possible beach head  in our backyard.
column2: 我们必须迅速解决此事，否则敌人就可能在我们的后院获得一个登陆场。

column1: We need to take the installations for Soviet benefit, but it will be heavily defended.
column2: 我们需要为苏联的利益夺取那些设施，但它会防守严密。

column1: We now expect the Russians to poor in troops in order to march on the Chir, be ready for an attack from the east.

column1: Welcome back, Commander. It's been roughly 2 months since your destruction of the Soviet submarine pen in Sweden, and almost all of Scandanavia is back under Allied control. However, your next assignment is far from the Scandanavian region, in the vicinity of Salerno, Italy. Italy was a hotspot for much of the early war. Eventually the combined might of British and French forces pushed the Soviet forces back into the sea, making it a safe haven for Allied weapon testing. The Soviets have learned of a very important development in our tests going on here at Salerno, however, and have landed a sizeable force to stop our development process.
column2: 欢迎回来，指挥官。自你摧毁瑞典(Sweden)的苏联潜艇洞库以来大约过了 2 个月，斯堪的纳维亚(Scandanavia)几乎全部回到了盟军控制之下。不过，你的下一项任务远离斯堪的纳维亚，在意大利的萨莱诺(Salerno)附近。战争前期的大部分时间里，意大利一直是热点地区。最终英法联军合力把苏军赶回了海里，使这里成为盟军武器试验的安全避风港。然而苏联人已得知我们在萨莱诺这里进行的试验中有一项非常重要的进展，并已投送一支规模可观的兵力来阻止我们的研制进程。

column1: Welcome to Mediterranean 46! This is a fictional campaign. The premise is simple; Germany has risen from the ashes! A leadership change has sparked the superior capability of the Wehrmacht to retake what was once theirs.  This campaign begins at the final stage of the Italian offensive and takes the German commander throughout the Mediterranean; establishing bases in preparation for future expansion of the German empire in Africa and the Middle East.
column2: 欢迎来到地中海'46！这是一个虚构战役。前提很简单：德国已从废墟中崛起！一次领导层的更替激发了国防军(Wehrmacht)的卓越能力，去夺回曾经属于他们的东西。本战役始于意大利攻势的最后阶段，带领德军指挥官走遍地中海；建立基地，为德意志帝国日后在非洲与中东的扩张做准备。
欢迎来到波兰，将军阁下。

column1: Welcome to Red Menace! This is a fictional campaign which takes place in early post war Europe. The basic premise is that international tensions regarding the division of Germany become explosive and  minor border skirmishes between German and Russian forces erupts into a full scale Soviet invasion. The campaign takes the German commander from trying to resist the initial Soviet advances to taking the initiative and forcing the Russians all way back to Red Square.

With your troops clear Darwin and establish a beach head to allow further penetrations into Australia.
column2: 欢迎来到濠北地区。若要确保帝国安全，就必须拔除盟军在这个国家的大型基地。尽管我方情报显示达尔文一带筑有工事，但周边地区都是荒漠；看来澳大利亚人已把居民和部分设施撤往内陆。请率部肃清达尔文，建立一个滩头阵地，以便进一步向澳大利亚内陆挺进。

column2: 干得好。我们夺回了重要的班加西港，现在，向托布鲁克前进！

column2: 干得好。你已突破敌军战线，但现在你必须切断隆美尔的退路。

column2: 好，将军阁下，尽管条件艰苦，你表现得相当不错！你的胜利表明，你已在这种新型战争中积累了宝贵经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府或许会在未来岁月中成为有用的盟友。
