column2: 好，这下完了。我们收到报告，苏军伞兵正降落在

column1: Well that was a nasty surprise!  You survived that counterattack but we must move quickly now against Dunkirk.
column2: 这可真是个讨厌的意外！你顶住了那次反击，但我们现在必须迅速行动，对付敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)。

column1: Well that was a nasty surprise!  You survived that counterattack but we must move quickly now against Dunkirk.
Well we have Khar'kov.  However, the Russians still pose a threat.
column2: 好啊，我们拿下了哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)。不过，俄国人仍构成威胁。

column1: Well we're across the river, but Ivan was able to withdraw far too many
column2: 好吧，我们渡过了河，但伊万(Ivan)撤走的兵力实在

column1: Well you did it, but at a very high cost.
column2: 嗯，你做到了，但代价极其高昂。

column1: Well you have taken their capital; they won't be capable of continuing the fight much longer.
column2: 不管怎么说，你已夺取了他们的首都；他们撑不了多久了。

column1: Well you stopped most of Ivan's forces, but some did make it to the
column2: 嗯，你挡住了伊万(Ivan)的大部分部队，但有些还是逃进了

column1: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.  Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，由克林向费多罗夫卡发起一次大胆突击，即可合拢对莫斯科的包围。若能推进至此，敌国首都必归我有。祝您好运！

column1: Well,  you had a spot of trouble while capturing Caen.  Nevertheless, British pluck won out in the end. However, the battle of Caen will soon be forgotten as other more glorious victories are won.  Onward, Commander.
column2: 嗯，你在夺取卡昂(Caen)时遇到了点麻烦。尽管如此，英国人的胆气最终还是占了上风。不过，随着其他更光荣的胜利到来，卡昂之战很快就会被遗忘。前进，指挥官。

column1: Well, althought it appears that you did manage to take all the objectives, the enemy has withdrawn and regrouped, and now await us some 20 miles down the road. Next time we need a decisive victory from you.
column2: 嗯，尽管看来你确实夺取了全部目标，但敌人已经后撤并重新集结，现在正在前方约 20 英里处等着我们。下次我们需要你取得一场决定性的胜利。

column1: Well, commander the battle was, shall we say, slightly difficult, and Jerry managed to cause problems for us. Britain has returned to the continent, and for this we are grateful. At least, the enemy must stretch their resources even further.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，这场战斗可以说稍嫌艰难，杰里(Jerry)还是给我们制造了麻烦。英国已重回大陆，对此我们心怀感激。至少，敌人不得不把他们的资源摊得更薄。

column1: Well, Commander, I would offer you tea, but after your disappointing performance, it would be difficult to have you in the vicinity without choking on my crumpet.  There's talk at GHQ of your relief.  It seems to be the most positive solution under the circumstances.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，我本想请你喝茶，但在你令人失望的表现之后，要让你待在近旁而不被我的烤面饼噎住，那太难了。总司令部(GHQ)有人在议论撤你的职。在目前情况下，这似乎是最积极的解决办法。

column1: Well, Commander, our invasion of Normandy has bogged down near Caen.  Do you know Caen was home to William the Conqueror, 1066 and all that?   At any rate, Commonwealth forces must drive through Caen and press on into France.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，我们对诺曼底(Normandy)的入侵在卡昂(Caen)附近陷于停滞。你知道卡昂是征服者威廉(William the Conqueror)的家乡吗，就是1066年那一套？无论如何，英联邦(Commonwealth)部队必须打穿卡昂，继续深入法国(France)。

column1: Well, Commander, you are to be given not only a promotion, but also an audience with the Duke of Penzance. It is very important to portray a picture of  success and, thanks to your failure, this will be extremely difficult.  Good day, Commander.  We will not meet again.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，你将得到的不仅是一次晋升，还有一次觐见彭赞斯公爵(Duke of Penzance)的机会。塑造一幅成功的图景非常重要，而多亏你的失败，这将极其困难。再见，指挥官。我们不会再见面了。

column1: Well, Commander, you have managed to establish a beachhead on Sicily after a hard fight, but the enemy were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces on the island.  Unfortunately, the battle for Sicily will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain further effort in this theater of operations.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，经过一场苦战，你成功地在西西里建立了滩头阵地，但敌人仍能撤走并加强他们在岛上的兵力。遗憾的是，西西里之战将继续拖延下去，因为我们缺乏资源在这个战区维持进一步的行动。

column1: Well, Comrade General, thanks to your abject failure, the Finns continue to defy us and capitalist rule is still in place.  The Party is most displeased with your inept performance.  You are relieved of your command.
column2: 唉，将军同志，多亏你惨败，芬兰人仍在顽抗，资本主义统治依旧存在。党对你无能的表现极为不满。你被解除指挥权。

column1: Well, comrade general, this schnaps is ooouughh quite good, and the fraulein, whatsoever, also nice... Twelve times before stopped to move, uyhhpfg...
column2: 嗯，将军同志，这烧酒 ooouughh 相当不错，那德国姑娘，不管怎么说，也挺好……十二次之前停下不动，uyhhpfg……

column1: Well, comrade, thanks to the brilliant command of the Great Stalin your troops has broken German defenses and pursue the enemy. Zhukov is pleased with you, but we shall still look carefully at you.
column2: 嗯，同志，多亏伟大的斯大林(Stalin)的英明指挥，你的部队突破了德军防线并追击敌人。朱可夫(Zhukov)对你很满意，但我们仍会仔细盯着你。

column1: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight  furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
column2: 好，继色当的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，在比利时的盟军部队就将陷入包围。把英国军队变成俘虏，我们就能按我们的条件决定和平。当然，英国人明白这种可能，他们会拼死保卫自己的撤退路线。祝你好运。

column1: Well, following your success in East Africa, we have a mission of utmost importance. Incompetent command by your successor in Egypt has allowed Rommel and his Afrika Korps to overrun all of the territory you worked so hard to attain. Now Egypt is once again threatened. Only you can lead us to victory!
column2: 好，继你在东非的成功之后，我们有一项极其重要的任务。你在埃及的继任者指挥无能，使隆美尔和他的非洲军(Afrika Korps)蹂躏了你辛苦夺取的全部地区。如今埃及再次受到威胁。只有你能领导我们走向胜利！

column1: Well, Herr General, you have managed to take Tobruk after a hard fight, but the English were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces in Egypt.  Unfortunately, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain a major effort in the desert.
column2: 唉，将军阁下，你经过苦战拿下了托布鲁克，但英军仍得以撤退，并加强了在埃及的兵力。遗憾的是，北非战争将继续拖延，因为我们缺乏资源在沙漠维持大规模行动。

column1: Well, I don't think that all is over, the Italians have launched an attack from Lybia.
column2: 嗯，我认为一切还没有结束，意大利人已从利比亚(Lybia)发起进攻。

column1: Well, it appears you did manage to take the city, but it seems that, this is all you managed to do.  The enemy has withdrawn and regrouped, and now await us some 20 miles down the road.  Another indifferent performance like this one and the Yanks will be claiming they are winning the war!
column2: 嗯，看来你确实拿下了该城，但似乎你也就只做到了这些。敌人已撤退并重整，如今在沿路约20英里外等着我们。再来一次像这样平庸的表现，美国佬就要声称是他们在打赢这场战争了！

column1: Well, nice work.  Now, we've got men and machines rolling into southern Italy, and rumor has it that Italy's on the verge of surrendering.  Good goin', Commander.
column2: 嗯，干得漂亮。现在，我们的人马正滚滚涌入意大利南部，还有传言说意大利即将投降。干得好，指挥官。

column1: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr General.
column2: 唉，我们的部队强攻英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们攻占伦敦的推进已陷入停滞。现在需要你夺取温莎——一个重要的交通枢纽。这个铁路交叉点一旦落入我手，伦敦将与其工业中心隔绝，被迫投降。祝你好运，将军阁下。

column1: Well, that turned out to be rather nasty didn't it. Yu did very well though and finished up before schedule.
column2: 唉，结果那事弄得相当麻烦，不是吗。不过你干得很好，还提前完成了。

column1: Well, that was a tough assignment but you did it!.. Now it's time for us to go over to the attack again. Get your men ready Commander.
column2: 唉，那是个艰难的任务，但你办成了！……现在又轮到我们转入进攻了。让你的人准备好，指挥官。

column1: Well, that was tricky but Ivan has been stopped and now we can get back to our original plans.
column2: 嗯，那确实棘手，但伊万(Ivan)已经被挡住了，现在我们可以回到原定计划。

column1: Well, the British resistance had been really strong again, but finally we have achieved victory. However, you need a little improvement of your tactics, or maybe the British would kick us from Great Britain.
column2: 嗯，英军的抵抗又一次十分顽强，但我们终于取得了胜利。不过，你的战术还需要一点改进，否则英国人说不定会把我们踢出不列颠。

column1: Well, the British resistance had been really strong again, but finally we have achieved victory. However, you need a little improvement of your tactics, or maybe the British would kick us from Great Britain.
Well, The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.
column2: 好，总参谋部对你的表现感到满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。你在战场上的能力持续令敌人困惑。

column1: Well, The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.

Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one could have reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人能够到达这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one has ever reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人到达过这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one has reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人到达过这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Well, this attack was not very succesful. Another mistake and you'll be counting trees in Siberia...
column2: 嗯，这次进攻不太成功。再犯一次错误，你就要去数西伯利亚的树木了……

column1: Well, what about being a captain now? We have always claimed you had been the traitor of the Rodina...
column2: 那么，现在当个上尉怎么样？我们一直都说你是祖国的叛徒……

column1: Well, what can I say?  You did manage to secure your objectives as well as capture a few  Jerries. A comparatively successful performance, commander, but you could do much better!
column2: 嗯，我还能说什么呢？你确实保住了你的目标，还抓了几个德国兵。算是比较成功的表现，指挥官，但你本可以干得好得多！

column1: Well, what can I say?  You did manage to secure your objectives as well as capture a few Jerries.  A comparatively successful performance, and the war has been won.
column2: 嗯，我还能说什么呢？你确实确保了目标，还俘虏了几个德国佬。一次相对成功的表现，而且战争已经打赢了。

column1: Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the conquest of England is the positive result.  Now, the English will have no choice but to sue for peace.  You have been lucky, Herr General, with this narrow victory.
column2: 唉，你只是勉强完成了任务，但征服英格兰是积极的成果。如今，英国人将别无选择，只能求和。这场险胜，你真是走运，将军阁下。

column1: Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the sea lanes are safe. You have been lucky, commander, with this narrow victory.
column2: 嗯，你勉强完成了任务，但海上航道安全了。指挥官，你这次险胜，算是运气好。

column1: Well, you barely achieved you objectives. I'm sorry Commander but we need someone with a little more initiative for these operations.
column2: 唉，你勉强达成了目标。抱歉，指挥官，但这些行动我们需要一个更有点主动性的人。

column1: Well, you barely escaped destruction there. I sincerely hope you can improve your performance otherwise I will be forced to revieve you. Now you need to head south and try to plug a nasty gap which is forming in our lines. God speed commander.
column2: 唉，你在那里险些被消灭。我真心希望你能改进表现，否则我将不得不撤你的职。现在你需要南下，设法堵住我们防线上正在形成的一个麻烦缺口。一路顺风，指挥官。

column1: Well, you did your best and you will be given another chance to prove yourself.  Good luck, Commander.
column2: 嗯，你已尽了最大努力，你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。祝你好运，指挥官。

column1: Well, you dropped the ball this time. The capture of Port Lyautey was really critical to move into Tunisia. Instead, we're still bogged down. We're going to have to go this thing all over again. But this time, with another guy in charge!
column2: 唉，这次你搞砸了。夺取利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)对进军突尼斯(Tunisia)本当至关重要。结果我们却还陷在原地。我们只好把这件事从头再做一遍。不过这一次，换个头儿！

column1: Well, you gave Ivan a bloody nose, but some of his forces escaped.
column2: 嗯，你让伊万碰了个头破血流，但他有些部队逃脱了。

column1: Well, you really dropped the ball this time.  It was crucial...critical to get past Metz and move into Germany.  Instead, we're still bogged down.  There's no time for fooling around; we're going to have to go this thing all over again.  But this time, with another  guy in charge.  I'm sending you stateside, Commander.
column2: 唉，你这次真是把事情搞砸了。越过梅斯(Metz)进入德国可是至关重要……极其关键的。可我们却仍然陷在原地。没时间瞎折腾了；我们只好把这桩事从头再干一遍。但这一次，换个人来负责。我要把你送回国内，指挥官。

column1: Well, your performance was lower that we had initially expected, anyway, you will receive much prestige to buy new transports. We know that it isn't enough, but our supply line was seriously blocked due to your delay.
column2: 嗯，你的表现低于我们最初的预期，不过你还是会获得大量威望来购买新的运输工具。我们知道这不够，但由于你的延误，我们的补给线被严重切断了。

column1: Well, your performance was not so good, commander, but you did your best and you will be given another chance to prove yourself. Good luck.
column2: 嗯，你的表现不算太好，指挥官，但你已尽了全力，你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。祝好运。

column1: Wellcome and congratulations as the new commander of this sector.  Please, let me explain the current situation.  We are pressing the chinese from the North and have a solid base at Canton.  Since our devastating attack on Pearl Harbour the United Kingdom has declared war on us.  The presence of their two european outposts - the portuguese Macao and british Hong Kong are a problem. Up to now, our main objective here is to crush the chinese resistance, just attack the european positions if you are able to do it, otherwise, focus your efforts on the chinese troops only.
column2: 欢迎您，并祝贺您出任本战区的新任指挥官。请允许我说明当前形势。我们正从北方压迫中国军队，并在广州拥有稳固的基地。自从我们对珍珠港发动毁灭性袭击以来，英国已向我们宣战。他们的两处欧洲前哨——葡属澳门和英属香港——的存在是个麻烦。到目前为止，我们在此的主要目标是粉碎中国的抵抗，只有在您有能力时才进攻欧洲人的阵地，否则就只把力量集中在中国军队身上。

column1: Western Europe. You must stop the Soviets from over running Germany.
column2: 西欧的全面入侵。你必须阻止苏军蹂躏德国。

column1: What a disaster! Consider yourself relieved!
column2: 真是一场灾难！你被撤职了！

column1: What a disaster! We thought the Germans were licked and they have been able to smash even your elite army. All the HQ is very disappointed.
column2: 真是一场灾难！我们以为德国人已被打垮，他们却连你的精锐集团军都能击溃。整个司令部都非常失望。

column1: What a pitiful performance Herr General. This is the end of the French campaign for your troops. Luckily other generals performed much better and France will soon be in our hands. I don't understand why, but Hitler is giving you command over the complete SS-V division. The division will be renamed to SS Reich.
column2: 多么可悲的表现，将军阁下。对你和你的部队来说，法国战役到此为止了。好在其他将军表现好得多，法国很快就会落入我们手中。我不明白为什么，但希特勒把整个党卫军第5师交给你指挥。该师将改称党卫军「帝国」师。

column1: What a pitiful performance Herr General. Von Kleist will have to divert more troops to the North to capture Belgrade now. This will delay the next phase of our invasion of Greece. The plan to capture Crete has been given up already in order not to further delay the invasion of Russia.
column2: 多么可悲的表现，将军阁下。冯·克莱斯特现在不得不抽调更多兵力北上夺取贝尔格莱德。这将延误我们入侵希腊的下一阶段。为不再延误入侵俄国，夺取克里特的计划已经被放弃。

column1: What a poor performance Herr general. You were lucky that the Leibstandarte on your left flank has performed much better than your troops. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
column2: 表现得多差啊，将军阁下。你运气好，左翼的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)打得比你的部队好得多。比利时国王已投降，英军正撤向敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)港。德国空军(Luftwaffe)可以继续负责消灭被围的部队。把你的部队东调，解决马奇诺防线(Maginot line)的守备部队。

column1: What the sam hill happened Commander?  Right when the war is about to end you get yourself clobbered by the Krauts. Is that the way to end a war, mister? I don't think so.  At least it's all over and we won. You're dismissed.
column2: 到底出了什么事，指挥官？正当战争就要结束的时候，你却被德国佬狠揍了一顿。这就是结束一场战争的方式吗，先生？我可不这么想。至少一切都结束了，我们赢了。你被解职了。

column1: What's the matter General, can't hack it against the first team?
column2: 怎么了，将军，对付一流球队你就招架不住了？

column1: When already deployed on ground, the ground Deploy and Supply "Mobil Armee HQ" can also be used to deploy other units too.
column2: 当「机动集团军司令部」(Mobil Armee HQ)已部署到地面后，这个地面部署与补给单位也可以用来部署其他单位。

column1: When Guderian's and Hoth's troops closed the encirclement around Smolensk, the fate of 100,000 Russians was sealed. The Bolsheviks also lost 2000 tanks and 2000 guns in the Smolensk encirclement.
column2: 当古德里安和霍特的部队合拢对斯摩棱斯克的包围时，10万俄国人的命运已成定局。布尔什维克还在斯摩棱斯克包围圈中损失了2000辆坦克和2000门火炮。

column1: When on the 10th of January 1940 German military plans were captured after a German plane crashed, Belgian King Leopold III was prepared to accept allied troops in his country on some conditions (Belgian participation in the peace negotiations, guarantee of Belgium's integrity and of his colonies, and financial support to rebuild Belgium after the war). However, these conditions were unacceptable for Britain and France and their troops did not enter into Belgium until the German attack.
column2: 1940年1月10日，一架德国飞机坠毁后德军军事计划被缴获，比利时国王利奥波德三世准备在一定条件下接受盟军部队进入本国（比利时参与和平谈判、保证比利时及其殖民地的完整、以及战后重建比利时的财政支持）。然而，这些条件对英国和法国来说无法接受，他们的部队直到德国发动进攻才进入比利时。

column1: When Soviet commander Budenny began moving a section of his forces on Odessa, leaving the remainder around Uman, Hitler found his hand forced.  He ordered the 6th Army to move south-east in the hopes of linking with the 17th Army, and trapping Soviet forces at Uman.  The Leibstandarte would have the task of parrying any Soviet counter-thrusts aimed at Von Kleists armoured column.
column2: 当苏军指挥官布琼尼(Budenny)开始把一部兵力调往敖德萨(Odessa)、把其余部队留在乌曼(Uman)一带时，希特勒觉得自己别无选择。他命令第6集团军向东南推进，希望与第17集团军会合，把苏军困在乌曼。警卫旗队的任务将是挡开任何针对冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)装甲纵队的苏军反击。

column1: When the Dunkirk evacuation started on 27 May the Belgian Army was to the brink of collapse. The Belgians had practically exhausted all available means of resistance. They had no reserves, the Luftwaffe had air supremacy, rail networks were destroyed and roads were blocked by 3 million civilian refugees. Under these circumstances further retreat was not feasible and resistance useless. On the evening of 27 May King Leopold III requested an armistice. Despite the advice of his government, the King decided to stay in Belgium to share the fate of his army and people.
column2: 当5月27日敦刻尔克撤退开始时，比利时军队已濒临崩溃。比利时人几乎耗尽了所有抵抗手段。他们没有预备队，德国空军掌握着制空权，铁路网被摧毁，道路被300万平民难民堵塞。在这种情况下，进一步撤退已不可行，抵抗也毫无意义。5月27日傍晚，国王利奥波德三世请求停战。尽管政府提出建议，国王仍决定留在比利时，与他的军队和人民共命运。

column1: When the Soviet attacks halted, Hitler's gaze fixed onto Uman, a major transport hub for the Crimea, which had the added attraction of encircling the Soviet forces holding up the 17th and 18th armies.
column2: 当苏军的进攻停下来时，希特勒的目光转向了乌曼(Uman)——克里米亚(Crimea)的一处主要交通枢纽，它还另有一个诱人之处：可以合围拖住第17与第18集团军的苏军部队。

column1: Whilst the Germans prepared Fruhlingerwachen, the Soviets had their own plans - an attack aimed toward Vienna, to begin on 15th March. column1: With the route to Warsaw now wide open, the 10th Army turned its axis of advance north and advanced toward the capital from the south-west, while the 4th Army closed from the north.  Guderian's armoured corps linked up with von Kleist's armoured corps at Brest-Litovsk on the 14th, effectively cutting off any potential escape route.
column2: 通往华沙(Warsaw)的道路已完全敞开，第10集团军将进攻轴线转向北面，从西南方向首都推进；第4集团军则从北面压上。14 日，古德里安(Guderian)的装甲军与克莱斯特(von Kleist)的装甲军在布列斯特-立托夫斯克(Brest-Litovsk)会师，彻底切断了任何可能的退路。

column1: With victory at Uman secured, the Leibstandarte moved south to take the city of Cherson.  During the march another attrocity is alleged to have taken place.  According to a postwar account of a Waffen-SS journalist serving with the 4th Battalion, east of Gejgova, men from the battalion found the mutilated bodies of six fellow SS soldiers who had been captured and executed at the town's NKVD headquarters.  In reprisal, Dietrich ordered the Leibstandarte to shoot all surrendering Soviet troops for three days, and in the ensuing slaughter an estimated 4,000 were killed.  The allegations remain unproven.
column2: 乌曼(Uman)之战取胜后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)南下夺取赫尔松(Cherson)城。据称在行军途中又发生了一起暴行。根据一名战后撰文的、在党卫军第4营服役的武装党卫军记者的记述，在盖戈瓦(Gejgova)以东，该营的士兵发现了六名党卫军同袍被肢解的尸体——他们被俘后在该镇的内务人民委员部(NKVD)总部遭处决。作为报复，迪特里希(Dietrich)命令警卫旗队在三日内枪杀所有投降的苏军，在这场随后的屠杀中估计有 4,000 人被杀。这些指控至今未获证实。

column1: You and your troops have freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge. That will be all, Comrade General.
column2: 你和你的部队解放了列宁格勒(Leningrad)。革命的诞生地又可以呼吸自由的甜美空气了。现在，我们必须帮助北面的芬兰兄弟摆脱法西斯的祸害。就这些，将军同志。

column1: You are again needed for and important mission; you are our best general here in China. The Burmese front remains quiet, and we need your leadership on this mission.  The morale of our men is really low in China, the constant retreats, and attacks have had a negative effect, and we need a decisive victory.  Your task is to seize the city of Changteh.  If we can get all our goals in this ambitious operation, we will be able to do further penetrations into the Chinese heartland, and possibly to end the war in China...
column2: 又有一项重要任务需要您出马；您是我们在中国最好的将军。缅甸战线依旧平静，我们需要您来领导这次任务。我们在中国的部队士气十分低落，不断的撤退与进攻带来了消极影响，我们需要一场决定性的胜利。您的任务是夺取常德城。如果这次雄心勃勃的作战能达成全部目标，我们就能进一步向中国腹地渗透，甚至可能结束在中国的战事……

column1: You are aware that after we split the Republic into two territories the Reds launched a powerful strike across the Ebro River in August.  Although they took us by surprise and inflicted some losses; the brave National Army reacted quickly stopping the enemy at the gates of Gandesa.  Your orders are to deploy your troops and ruthlessly crush the Reds in the Ebro pocket.
column2: 你清楚，在我们把共和国切成两块领土之后，赤色分子于8月跨过埃布罗河发动了一次强大突击。尽管他们打了我们一个措手不及并造成了一些损失，但英勇的国民军迅速反应，在甘德萨城下挡住了敌人。你的命令是部署部队，在埃布罗河袋形阵地无情地粉碎赤色分子。

column1: You are facing another Russian offensive. They have broken through our front lines and are now bearing down on your position. You must meet this offensive and force it back.
column2: 你正面临俄军的又一次攻势。他们已突破我们的前线，如今正向你的阵地压来。你必须迎击这次攻势，并把它逼退。

column1: You are now to retreat from Alsace and go to the east.
column2: 您现在要从阿尔萨斯撤退，向东转移。

column1: You are requested in Berlin at once!

You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your horrible actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这糟糕的行动毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！

column1: You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your horrible actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.

You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这拙劣的行动毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！

column1: You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor performance!, now it is supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这拙劣的表现毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！

column1: You are the commander of the best units in the whole PLA, and your mission is to counter-strike the Soviet invaders.  If we want to continue with our own interpretation of the Marxism, we must defeat the Soviets.  Also Mao would be most pleased, if your men capture the important city of Khabarovsk.  He says that these territories are historically Chinese and no soviets must remain on Chinese lands!
column2: 你是整个解放军中最精锐部队的指挥员，你的任务是反击苏联入侵者。如果我们想继续走自己对马克思主义的解释，就必须击败苏联人。而且，如果你的部队夺取重镇哈巴罗夫斯克，毛泽东将会极为满意。他说这些领土历史上属于中国，中国土地上不得留下一名苏联人！

column1: You are the nearest General with available troops, your mission is stop that offensive, otherwise our rearguard will be exposed.
column2: 你是附近唯一拥有可用部队的将军，你的任务是阻止那次攻势，否则我们的后卫部队将暴露无遗。

column1: You are to return home to a grateful nation!
column2: 您将回到家园，受到感恩的国民迎接！

column1: You are to send a detachment to the area around Ste. Marie du Mont and destroy these guns then capture the town.
column2: 你要派一支分遣队前往圣玛丽迪蒙(Ste. Marie du Mont)一带，摧毁这些火炮，然后夺取该镇。

column1: You are to strike back, just drive the Soviets back across the Oder! We want you to force Soviets to sit at table of negotiations. Teach them a lesson Commander!
column2: 你要反击，把苏军赶回奥得河(Oder)对岸去！我们要你迫使苏军坐上谈判桌。给他们一个教训，指挥官！

column1: You are victorious! Unfortunately it's a Pyrhus Victory because you have suffered too many losses, as a result the assault in Egypt demands fresh troops. Report to the Führer immediately in Berlin for your promotion, you've earned the Knight cross with brilliants, sword and oak leaves. The Führer wants more troops on the Eastern front for Stalingrad and the Caucasus campaign, you might convince him to change his mind and exploit your advantage in the Mediterranian with reinforcements.
column2: 你胜利了！遗憾的是这是一场皮洛士式的胜利，因为你蒙受了太多损失，其结果是埃及的突击需要生力军。立刻到柏林向元首报到接受晋升，你已赢得带钻石、剑与橡叶的骑士十字勋章。元首想向东线增调部队用于斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)与高加索(Caucasus)战役，你也许能说服他改变主意，用增援来扩大你在地中海的战果。

column1: You are, according to the instructions of Kesselring, commander of the Hermann Goring Panzer Division. You must advance south and contain the Allied beachhead in Gela. The Allied navy and artillery will not let you advance to Gela, so your mission is gain a little time for us to organize and avoid our army being isolated in the north.
column2: 你受凯塞林(Kesselring)之命，担任赫尔曼·戈林装甲师(Hermann Goring Panzer Division)的指挥官。你必须向南推进，把盟军滩头压制在杰拉(Gela)一带。盟军海军与炮兵不会让你推进到杰拉，所以你的任务是为我们争取一点时间完成组织，避免我军被孤立在北面。

column1: You better resign and open a "friterie/frituur".
column2: 你最好辞职，去开一家“薯条店”。

column1: You better ressign and open a "gaufre" shop.
column2: 你最好辞职，去开一家“gaufre”店。

column1: You bought us the time we need to finish the defenses at Fulda.
column2: 你为我们争取到了完成富尔达(Fulda)防御工事所需的时间。

column1: You can choose to command the forces at disposal of the Ist Army Corps ("I Corps d'Armée") to provide it support to defend the Canal Albert line and the Eben Emael fort.
column2: 你可以选择指挥第1军（“I Corps d'Armée”）麾下的部队，支援其防守阿尔贝运河一线和埃本-埃马尔要塞。

column1: You can decide your next destination; the emperor has given you this golden opportunity.  By taking the Wake Island flag, your next destination will be the attack on the US base in the Philippines.  On the other hand, if you take the Hong Kong flag, your next destination will be the South of China, with Hong Kong and Macao as your main objectives. Taking the Dutch flag, you will go to fight in the Dutch East Indies.
column2: 您可以决定下一个目的地；天皇把这个千载难逢的机会交给了您。夺取威克岛的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是进攻美国在菲律宾的基地。另一方面，如果您夺取香港的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是华南，以香港和澳门为主要目标。夺取荷兰国旗，您将前往荷属东印度作战。

column1: You clumsy traitor! You'll be issued to the penal battalion at Leningrad front. Maybe there you'll show your love for the communism and Motherland!!!
column2: 你这笨手笨脚的叛徒！你将被发配到列宁格勒(Leningrad)前线的惩戒营。也许在那里你能表现出你对共产主义和祖国的热爱！！！

column1: You complete your mission on schedule, commander, but the Axis has been able to hit your landing forces much more than expected. Next time you should try to keep the casualties down.
column2: 指挥官，你按期完成了任务，但轴心国对你登陆部队的打击远超预期。下次你应当设法压低伤亡。

column1: You could not prevent the scuttling of a large part of the Vichy French fleet. Mussolini will have to do with less ships than he had hoped for.
column2: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队的很大一部分被凿沉。墨索里尼拿到的舰船将比他期望的少。

column1: You couldn't force allies to get back in Tunis, so it's impossible to attack with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯(Tunis)，以我们手头这点部队，是无法发起进攻的。

column1: You couldn't make allies to get back in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯(Tunisia)，以我们手头这点部队，是无法守住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯的。

column1: You couldn't make allies to get back in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunizia with the few units we have.
column2: 你没能迫使盟军撤出突尼斯(Tunisia)，所以我们凭手上这点兵力不可能守得住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯。

column1: You decide the outcome of the Winter War.
column2: 冬季战争的结局由你决定。

column1: You defended the empire during dark times and for that we are grateful. Good luck for the future.
column2: 在黑暗的岁月里你保卫了帝国，我们对此心存感激。祝你今后好运。

column1: You deserve a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a fast and brilliant counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
column2: 您应该得到晋升！您以迅速而出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

column1: You did it commander! Even if with a lot of casualties, we got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官！尽管伤亡很大，我们拿到了想要的东西，你为我们干得很出色。

column1: You did it Commander! We got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.  And now son, it's time to go home. You've done your country proud. Here have a cigar. See you stateside.
column2: 你办到了，指挥官！我们得到了想要的东西，你为我们干得很出色。现在，孩子，该回家了。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄。咱们国内见。

column1: You did it Commander.  We got what we came for. You've done a fine job for us.  It's time to go home.  You've done your country proud.  Here, have a cigar! See you stateside.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官。我们得到了我们想要的东西。你为我们干得很出色。该回家了。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄！回国见。

column1: You did it Commander.  We got what we came for. You've done a fine job for us.  You've done your country proud.  Here, have a cigar!  See you stateside.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官。我们得到了想要的东西。你为我们干得很出色。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄！回国见。

column1: You did not prevent the scuttling of most of the Vichy French fleet. Hitler will be furious. What does he have to tell Mussolini?
column2: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队的大部分被凿沉。希特勒会暴怒。他拿什么去跟墨索里尼交代？

column1: You did not prevent the scuttling of the Vichy French fleet. Hitler will be furious. What does he have to tell Mussolini?
column2: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队被凿沉。希特勒会暴怒。他拿什么去跟墨索里尼交代？

column1: You did not succeed in eliminating the US beachhead. US forces have outflanked us by breaking through our lines near Coutance. Your mission is to push West to the shore in order to restore the front line and cut off the US divisions that have broken through. Do not fail us again!
column2: 你未能肃清美军滩头阵地。美军在库唐斯附近突破我军防线，迂回到我们侧后。你的任务是向西推进到海岸，以恢复战线并切断已突破的美军各师。别再让我们失望了！

column1: You didn't cut it, but our forces are close enough that they won't be able
column2: 你没能切断它，但我军已逼近到他们无法

column1: You failed to break through even the first Russian defensive lines. After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
column2: 你连俄军第一道防线都未能突破。接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消「堡垒」行动。

column1: You failed to close the encirclement around Smolensk. The Russian 16th, 19th and 20th Armies escaped and are now blocking the roads to Moscow. Reaching Moscow before winter sets in will be a tough job that is better left to more competent generals than you.
column2: 你未能合拢对斯摩棱斯克的包围。俄军第16、第19和第20集团军逃脱，如今正堵着通往莫斯科的道路。要在入冬前抵达莫斯科将是一项艰巨任务，最好交给比你更能干的将军。

column1: You failed to cutoff Berlin making Monty's job significantly harder.
column2: 你未能切断柏林，这让蒙蒂(Monty)的任务难度大增。

column1: You fascist nit!!! You'll die in Gulag together with your buddy Paulus!
column2: 你这个法西斯蠢货！！！你会和你的哥们儿保卢斯(Paulus)一起死在古拉格(Gulag)！

column1: You got lucky of avoiding Siberia! You will not get once more a second
column2: 你运气好，躲过了西伯利亚(Siberia)！你不会再得到第二次

column1: You had best pray this war lasts a bit longer so you will have a chance to redeem yourself.
column2: 你最好祈祷这场战争再持续久一点，好让你有机会挽回自己。

column1: You had better do better next time
column2: 你下次最好干得好一点

column1: You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy armies to escape.  It is possible that the campaign against the British and French could go on as long as the last war.  Herr General, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.
column2: 你完成了任务，但你的行动迟缓让敌军得以逃脱。对英法的战事有可能像上次大战那样长期拖延下去。将军阁下，毫无疑问，我们还会再次请你效力。

column1: You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy to escape.  It is possible that this campaign could go on as long as the last war.  Commander, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.
column2: 你完成了任务，但你速度不足，让敌人逃脱了。这场战役有可能像上一场战争那样旷日持久。指挥官，我们无疑还会再次召你效力。

column1: You have achieved a Great Victory, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Very good.
column2: 你取得了一场大捷，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。很好。

column1: You have again dealt a blow to the Americans, but they still refuse to receive our envoy. We have however been able to influence the American press to write about our peace offer, and a debate has started in America.
column2: 您再次给美国人以重击，但他们仍拒绝接见我方的使者。不过我们已能影响美国报界刊登我方的和平提议，美国国内也掀起了一场辩论。

column1: You have again stopped very powerfull forces attempting to conquer your positions ! Meanwhile, Manstein has moved up troops and armoured divisions to launch a counterattack that will decide the fait of sixth army and with it the future of our empire.
column2: 您再次挡住了试图攻占您阵地的强大敌军！与此同时，曼施坦因已调上部队与装甲师，即将发动一场反攻，此战将决定第六集团军的命运，也决定我们帝国的未来。

column1: You have an explanation for this abysmal failure?
column2: 你对这次惨败有什么解释吗？

column1: You have been awarded with the Order of the Rising Sun 3rd Class.
column2: 您已被授予三等旭日章。

column1: You have been defeated Comrade General.  The Party is most displeased with your performance.  Due to your failure, at Prohkorovka, many workers and peasants are no longer with us.  Report immediately for punishment, you will be informed of your trial date later.
column2: 你被打败了，将军同志。党对你的表现极为不满。由于你在普罗霍夫卡(Prohkorovka)的失败，许多工人和农民已不在我们身边。立即前去接受惩处，审判日期另行通知。

column1: You have been defeated, but at least you've tried. Now the allies has overrun the Gustav Line and you must retreat to the Gothic Line.
column2: 你已被击败，但至少你努力过。现在盟军已突破古斯塔夫防线，你必须退往哥特防线。

column1: You have captured the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered.  You have achieved a great victory, Herr General.
column2: 你俘虏了英国远征军，法国也已投降。你取得了一场大捷，将军阁下。

column1: You have choosen to attack Anzio's beach.
column2: 你选择了进攻安齐奥(Anzio)滩头。

column1: You have choosen to fight in the eastern part of the Gothic Line.
column2: 你选择了在哥特防线(Gothic Line)东段作战。

column1: You have choosen to follow the historical path.
You have chosen the fight in the western part of the Gothic Line.
column2: 你选择了在哥特防线(Gothic Line)西段作战。

column1: You have crushed the UN forces with a smashing victory!  Now, we can continue with our advance towards Seoul.
column2: 你以一场猛烈的胜利粉碎了联合国军！现在，我们可以继续向汉城推进了。

column1: You have dealt the German Army a crippling blow. However, the sacrifice of Tenth Panzer allowed other german ubits to overwhelm our forces at Arnhem. All your good work was in vain.
column2: 你已给德军一记毁灭性打击。然而，第10装甲师的牺牲让德军其他部队在阿纳姆(Arnhem)压倒了我们的部队。你所有的努力都白费了。

column1: You have dealt the german Army a severe blow buit you failed to reach Arnhem in time. The war will now be lengthened.
column2: 你已给德军一记重击，但你未能及时抵达阿纳姆。战争现在将被拖长。

column1: You have dealt the Red Army a crippling blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer a large number of  troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Superlative work, Herr General.
column2: 你已给红军一记毁灭性的打击。随着我们的战线缩短，我们将能把大量部队转调给斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的保卢斯(von Paulus)元帅。无与伦比的工作，将军阁下。

column1: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.
column2: 你给了红军沉重一击。随着我方战线缩短，我们将能抽调部分部队支援斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯陆军元帅。干得好，将军阁下。

column1: You have dealt the Russians a crippling blow. Take a deserved rest Commander.
column2: 你给了俄国人一记致残性的打击。好好休息一下吧，指挥官，这是你应得的。

column1: You have decided to continue the war in China, and onto the Asian mainland.
column2: 您已决定在中国、进而在亚洲大陆继续战争。

column1: You have decided to continue the war with our assault on the Philippines.  Get ready for the planned invasion on that US colony.
column2: 您已决定以进攻菲律宾来继续战争。请为这场针对美国殖民地的既定入侵做好准备。

column1: You have decided to continue with the war in the Dutch East Indies.
column2: 您已决定在荷属东印度继续战争。

column1: You have decided to fight in New Guinea.
column2: 您已决定在新几内亚作战。

column1: You have decided to take part in the Burma campaign.
column2: 您已决定参加缅甸战役。

column1: You have defeated the Afrika Korps and thousands of Italians have surrendered.  But now, a crisis of the utmost urgency has arisen. The Axis has launched an invasion of Iceland. Only you can save the Island from defeat. If Iceland falls the sealanes from North America will be imperiled. The fate of our nation is in your hands!
column2: 你已击败非洲军，数千意大利人已经投降。但现在出现了一场极其紧迫的危机。轴心国已发起对冰岛(Iceland)的入侵。只有你能拯救该岛免于失败。如果冰岛陷落，来自北美(North America)的海上航线将受到威胁。我们国家的命运掌握在你手中！

column1: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to retreat fresh troops, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
column2: 您让我们失望了。如果连未受重创的部队都撤不出来，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

column1: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to stop the Germans in well prepared positions, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
column2: 您让我们失望了。如果在准备充分的阵地上都无法挡住德军，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

column1: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to successfully retreat some elite troops from the Ardennes, less will you able to command troops in a real battle.
column2: 你让我们失望了。如果你连从阿登成功撤出一些精锐部队都做不到，就更不可能在真正的战斗中指挥部队了。

column1: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to temporally stop the German infantry, less will you able to fight the panzers.
column2: 您让我们失望了。如果您连暂时挡住德军步兵都做不到，就更不用说与装甲部队交手了。

column1: You have disappointed us. You were not able to protect the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" and now not only the unit has been overran and does not longer exit but the German army is just behind us.
column2: 您让我们失望了。您未能掩护“第17步兵师”的撤退，如今该师不仅已被击溃、不复存在，德军还紧追在我们身后。

column1: You have disgraced the Allied forces, and on a more specific note, the British Army. You are being sent on a rather long leave. Enjoy your leisure years.
column2: 你让盟军蒙羞，更具体地说，是英国陆军。你被送去度一个相当长的假期。好好享受你的闲居岁月吧。

column1: You have disgraced the Allied forces, and on a more specific note, the British Army. You are being sent on a rather long leave. Enjoy your leisure years.
You have done an excellent job. Congratulations!!!.
You have done splendidly General. Now that we control Vitebsk the Russians are denied an important railhead and transportation center. We've really got them on the run now.
column2: 你干得非常出色，将军。既然我们控制了维捷布斯克，俄国人就失去了一个重要的铁路终点站与运输中心。现在我们真把他们打跑了。

column1: You have done well, General.  However, you will need to improve if you want to remain as Commander of Germany's Elite Panzer Divisions.
column2: 你干得很好，将军。不过，若想继续担任德国精锐装甲师的指挥官，你还得有所改进。

column1: You have driven the Russians deep into the desert surrounding Agedabia.  No time for rest, you must continue the assault.
column2: 你已把俄国人赶进阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)周边的沙漠深处。没有时间休整，你必须继续进攻。

column1: You have exceeded our expectations!  The enemy has been crushed.  We are victorious.   Now, the Red Army holds the initiative.  This is good, very good.  To the west, Comrade!
column2: 你超出了我们的期望！敌人已被粉碎。我们胜利了。现在，红军掌握着主动权。这很好，非常好。向西，同志！

column1: You have fail to make allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你没能迫使盟军在突尼斯(Tunisia)撤退，所以我们凭手上这点兵力不可能守得住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯。

column1: You have failed and your casualities have been huge, the Americans have triumphed in El Guettar.
column2: 你失败了，伤亡惨重，美军在盖塔尔(El Guettar)取得了胜利。

column1: You have failed miserably.  Rommel remains dominant in North Africa and Egypt is now sure to fall. Report for reassignment immediately!
column2: 你败得很惨。隆美尔(Rommel)仍主宰着北非(North Africa)，埃及(Egypt)如今必定陷落。立即报到接受改派！

column1: You have failed miserably.  Rommel remains dominant in North Africa and Egypt is now sure to fall. Report for reassignment immediately!
You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas.
column2: 你败得很惨。随着我们水面舰队的损失，英格兰在公海上仍占优势。

column1: You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas. Report for reassignment immediately!
column2: 你惨败了。随着我们水面舰队的损失，英格兰仍在公海上占据主导。立即报到接受重新安排！

column1: You have failed to beat off the Russian relieve attempt and now hundreds of thousands Bolsheviks have escaped. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 你未能击退俄国人的解围企图，如今数十万布尔什维克逃脱了。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: You have failed to do your duty...
You have failed to do your duty.....but we will give you another chance.
column2: 你未能尽到职责……但我们会再给你一次机会。

column1: You have failed to force allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军在突尼斯撤退，以我们手头这点部队，是无法守住突尼斯的。

column1: You have finished the hypothetical path. Try now to discover other scenarios in the game...
column2: 您已完成这条假设路线。现在不妨去探索游戏中的其他场景……

column1: You have finished the hypothetical path. Try now to discover other scenarios in the game...
column2: 您已完成这条假设路线。现在不妨去探索游戏中的其他场景……

column1: You have hurt the Axis badly, but they have managed to withdraw to Sicily.  Unfortunately, we do not have the resources to invade Sicily at this time.  The war in the Med will continue.  Commander, you are to return to England immediately.
column2: 你已重创轴心国，但他们还是撤到了西西里。遗憾的是，我们目前没有资源进攻西西里。地中海(Med)的战事仍将继续。指挥官，你须立即返回英格兰(England)。

column1: You have inflicted great tank losses on the 5GTA and you held on to Kharkov. However, Russian advances North and South of the city force us however to retreat to the Dniepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
column2: 你给近卫第5坦克集团军造成了巨大的坦克损失，并守住了哈尔科夫。但俄军在该城南北的推进仍迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整与整补。只有一支战斗群会留在东线，直到 1944 年春天。

column1: You have inflicted great tank losses on the 5GTA and you held on to Kharkov. However, Russian advances North and South of the city force us to retreat to the Dniepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
column2: 你给近卫第5坦克集团军造成了巨大的坦克损失，并守住了哈尔科夫。但俄军在该城南北的推进迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整与整补。只有一支战斗群会留在东线，直到 1944 年春天。

column1: You have inflicted great tank losses on the 5GTA and you held on to Kharkov. Russian advances North and South of the city force us however to retreat to the Dniepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
column2: 你给近卫第5坦克集团军造成了巨大的坦克损失，并守住了哈尔科夫。但俄军在该城南北的推进仍迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整与整补。只有一支战斗群会留在东线，直到 1944 年春天。

column1: You have managed to contain the Germans and repeal most of their attacks. In spite of several attempts German infantrymen could not take Vinkt.
column2: 你成功遏制了德军，击退了他们的大部分进攻。尽管多次尝试，德军步兵仍无法攻下芬克特。

column1: You have not chosen a sceneario, please try again (make a BV or V).
column2: 你没有选择场景，请再试一次（取得辉煌胜利或胜利）。

column1: You have not chosen any scenario. Please try again (make a BV or V).
column2: 你还没有选择任何场景。请再试一次（取得辉煌胜利或胜利）。

column1: You have once again defeated a numerically superior enemy with your elite SS units, even the British are impressed, on to France, Herr General!
column2: 你又一次以你的党卫军精锐部队击败了兵力占优的敌人，连英国人都为之折服，向法国进军，将军阁下！

column1: You have one mission; destroy the remnants of the capitalist forces.  Otherwise, they will receive more reinforcements and support from their stronghold at Pusan.  Quick drive them into the sea and Korea will become the unified Korean People's Republic.
column2: 你只有一个任务；消灭资本主义势力的残余。否则，他们将从其釜山据点获得更多增援和支持。迅速把他们赶下海，朝鲜将成为统一的朝鲜人民共和国。

column1: You have passed this first trial, now we are going to Massawa's Port to cut off any supply entry from the Indian Ocean.
column2: 您已通过了第一次考验，现在我们前往马萨瓦港，以切断来自印度洋的一切补给输入。

column1: You have proven to the world that you are the best.  A hero's welcome is being prepared for your return.  Hurry home.
column2: 你已向世界证明你是最优秀的。为你的归来，一场英雄式的欢迎正在筹备。快回家吧。

column1: You have pushed the British back, but they have managed to withdraw into their Tobruk fortress.  Unfortunately, we do not have the resources to capture Tobruk at this time.  The war in the desert will continue.  Herr General, you are to return to Germany immediately.
column2: 你击退了英军，但他们已设法撤入托布鲁克要塞。遗憾的是，我们眼下没有资源攻取托布鲁克。沙漠之战将继续。将军阁下，你必须立即返回德国。

column1: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area ahead of schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
column2: 你提前抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

column1: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area on schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
column2: 你按计划抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

column1: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area slightly behind schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
column2: 你略微落后于计划抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

column1: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area way behind schedule. Your troops will be thrown in action without much preparation.
column2: 你远远落后于计划才抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队将在几乎没有准备的情况下被投入战斗。

column1: You have recovered part of Lithuania, but failed to press your attacks
column2: 你收复了立陶宛(Lithuania)的一部分，但未能持续压迫你的进攻，

column1: You have selected the path to assault Egypt, in case of success the road to oil in the Middle East and the reconquest of former Italian colonies in South Afrika are at hand.
column2: 你已选择突击埃及的道路，一旦成功，通往中东石油的道路以及重新征服意大利在南部非洲的前殖民地的前景都近在眼前。

column1: You have selected the path to ensure the oil routes going through Syria, Irak and Persia.
column2: 你已选择了确保经由叙利亚(Syria)、伊拉克(Irak)与波斯(Persia)的石油通道的道路。

column1: You have selected the path towards North Afrika, you will have to resist to increasingly powerful Allies.
column2: 你已选择了通往北非的道路，你将不得不抵抗越来越强大的盟军。

column1: You have selected the path towards South Afrika, you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.
column2: 你已选择了通往南部非洲的道路，你必须收复意大利的殖民地。

column1: You have succeed in stopping the Germans after repealing all their attacks. In spite of several attempts German infantrymen could not take Vinkt.
column2: 你成功阻止了德军，击退了他们所有的进攻。尽管多次尝试，德军步兵仍无法攻下芬克特。

column1: You have succeeded in your mission where many others would have failed.  However, the Afrika Korps and its Italian Allies have been able to withdraw most of their troops where they will be a potent threat to future operations.
column2: 你在许多人都会失败的任务中取得了成功。然而，非洲军及其意大利盟军已撤走了大部分部队，他们将对未来的作战构成有力威胁。

column1: You have succeeded in your mission where many others would have failed.  However, the Western Allies have been able to evacuate a majority of their troops and sink most of our surface fleet.
column2: 你在许多人都做不到的地方完成了任务。然而，西线盟军得以撤走了大部分部队，还击沉了我们大部分水面舰艇。

column1: You have successfully beaten off the Russian relieve attempt. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 你成功击退了俄国人的解围企图。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: You have successfully crossed the Dniepr, but you have lost valuable time. All chances of encircling the Russian forces are gone.
column2: 你已成功渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)，但你失去了宝贵的时间。合围俄军的一切机会都没有了。

column1: You have to do better than this next time.
column2: 下次你必须打得比这更好。

column1: You have to move your air transport units where you want (and hope that AI has no AD or air units close), then where and when you want (you don't have to use your paratroops at the very 1st turn, you can wait) you deploy the paratroops.
column2: 你必须把你的空运单位移到你想要的位置（并祈祷AI附近没有防空或航空单位），然后在你想去的地点与时机（你不必在第1回合就投入伞兵，你可以等）投放伞兵。

column1: You have to move your air transport units where you want (and hope that AI has no AD units close), then where and when you want (you don't have to use your paratroops at the very 1st turn, you can wait) you deploy the paratroops (play by the rule, don't deploy other unit types).
column2: 你得把空中运输单位移动到你想去的地方（并指望 AI 附近没有防空单位），然后在你想去的地方、你想的时机——你不必在第 1 回合就使用伞兵，可以等——投放伞兵（按规则游玩，不要投放其他类型的单位）。

column1: You have to move your air transport units where you want (and hope that AI has no AD units close), then where and when you want (you don't have to use your paratroops at the very 1st turn, you can wait) you deploy the paratroops.
column2: 你得把空中运输单位移动到你想去的地方（并指望 AI 附近没有防空单位），然后在你想去的地方、你想的时机——你不必在第 1 回合就使用伞兵，可以等——投放伞兵。

column1: You have to resist sixteen turns in order to archieve victory. On the last turn for BV a unit will appear. Use this unit to take the goal next to it.
column2: 你必须坚守十六个回合才能取胜。在争取辉煌胜利的最后一回合会出现一支部队。用这支部队夺取它旁边的目标。

column1: You have turned the tide of war against the Allies, General, rest your army and make haste to Berlin, you must collect your Field Marshall's Baton!!!
column2: 将军，你已扭转了对盟军作战的局势，让你的集团军休整，并速往柏林，你必须去领取你的元帅权杖！！！

column1: You have turned the tide of war against the Allies, Herr General, rest your army and make haste to Berlin, you must collect your Field Marshall's Baton!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你已扭转了对盟军作战的局势，让你的集团军休整，并速往柏林，你必须去领取你的元帅权杖！！！

column1: You have won, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Unfortunately, the English continue to resist us even after the loss of their contemptible, little army. Good work.
column2: 你赢了，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。遗憾的是，即便失去了那支可怜的小军队，英国人仍继续抵抗。干得好。

column1: You haven't chosen any path, please try it again.
column2: 你还没有选择任何道路，请再试一次。

column1: You held the line longer than I thought you would
column2: 你守住防线的时间比我预想的更长

column1: You isolated the city and Monty was able to take Berlin.
column2: 你孤立了该城，蒙蒂(Monty)才得以夺取柏林。

column1: You jeopardized communism image of "people liberator" throughout the world and put Stalin in a nice mess towards Western powers.
column2: 你损害了共产主义在全世界「人民解放者」的形象，还让斯大林在面对西方列强时陷入了不小的麻烦。

column1: You jeopardized our diplomatic relations with Marshall Tito!!!
column2: 你危害了我们与铁托(Tito)元帅的外交关系！！！

column1: You know, Commander, if we're ever going to win this war, we need people who do more than just punch the clock.  You took St. Lo, yeah, but it cost us, not just time, but GIs.  It's been decided, we're going to give you another chance - in Caen.  Make your country proud, Commander.
column2: 你知道，指挥官，我们要想打赢这场战争，需要的是不只打卡混日子的人。你拿下了圣洛(St. Lo)，没错，但那让我们付出了代价——不只是时间，还有美国大兵。已经定了，我们再给你一次机会——在卡昂(Caen)。让你的国家为你骄傲吧，指挥官。

column1: You may purchase 1 new Paratrooper Mortar Team (or upgrade) and 1 new Paratrooper Bazooka Team.
column2: 你可以购买1个新的伞兵迫击炮组（或升级）和1个新的伞兵巴祖卡组。

column1: You must capture the cities of Ponte Dirillo and Ponte Olivo.
column2: 你必须夺取迪里洛桥(Ponte Dirillo)与奥利沃桥(Ponte Olivo)两座城镇。

column1: You must complete your mission prior to December 1st.
column2: 你必须在 12 月 1 日之前完成任务。

column1: you must cross the Liska and Don rivers then occupy the bridges near Kalach.
column2: 你必须渡过利斯卡河(Liska)与顿河，然后占领卡拉奇(Kalach)附近的桥梁。

column1: You must defend Le Cateau city and when possible you must attack at Beamont city the French supply depot and occupy it.
column2: 你必须守住勒卡托(Le Cateau)城，并在可能时进攻博蒙(Beamont)城的法军补给站并将其占领。

column1: You must defend the bridge near Osera city - medium strong republicans units -  and occupy Villanueva city and bridge on rio Gallego.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须防守奥塞拉城附近的桥梁（共和军部队中等强度），并攻占比利亚努埃瓦城及加列戈河上的桥梁。

column1: You must destroy airfields, other city defenses, RAF, land and navy units. Beware that islanders are defending their homes.
column2: 你必须摧毁机场、其他城市防御设施、皇家空军以及陆军和海军部队。要当心，岛民正在保卫他们的家园。

column1: You must find a landing area quickly before the Soviet naval forces break free of the mines.
column2: 你必须在苏军海军挣脱雷场束缚之前赶快找到一处登陆场。

column1: You must follow the next steps, comrade:
column2: 你必须遵循以下步骤，同志：

column1: you must hold all your positions until further notice.
column2: 你必须守住所有阵地，直至另行通知。

column1: You must hold Tobruk at all costs, there will be no withdrawal. The defense should be conducted with the utmost agression.
column2: 你必须不惜一切代价守住托布鲁克，不得撤退。防御作战应以最大的攻击性进行。

column1: You must hurry, so move quickly. Armored corps are on the way.
column2: 你必须抓紧，动作要快。装甲军正在赶来。

column1: You must move your forces as far forward as possible to meet and crush the attack. This is not exactly going to be a cakewalk Commander but if it was, we wouldn't be sending you. One more thing, G2 reports there may be a Russian airborne element on it's way. Be careful Commander and good luck!
column2: 你必须把部队尽可能前调，迎击并粉碎这场进攻。这可不是什么轻松差事，指挥官；若真轻松，我们就不会派你去了。还有一件事，G2 报告可能有一支俄国空降部队正在途中。小心点，指挥官，祝好运！

column1: You must now quickly take Khar'kov before the Russians can regain the initiative.
column2: 你现在必须迅速拿下哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)，抢在俄国人夺回主动权之前。

column1: You must provide support to the "Chasseurs Ardennais" defending Vinkt.
column2: 你必须为防守芬克特的“Chasseurs Ardennais”提供支援。

column1: You must reach Moscow and kill everyone at your advance.
column2: 你必须抵达莫斯科(Moscow)，并在推进中杀掉每一个人。

column1: You must secure the port and its installations to allow the arrival of the heavy machinery of the 4th Panzer Division coming from the continent.
column2: 你必须确保该港及其设施的安全，以便从欧洲大陆开来的第4装甲师的重型装备得以抵达。

column1: You must seize Antwerpen before they can react.
column2: 你必须抢在他们反应过来之前夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)。

column1: You need to clear out this road before the convoy arrives. And do not worry about Berlin. It is not heavily guarded from this direction.
column2: 你需要在运输队到达之前肃清这条道路。不必担心柏林(Berlin)。从这个方向看，它防守并不严密。

column1: You need to do better when we take Vladivostok.
column2: 我们夺取符拉迪沃斯托克时，你得打得更好。

column1: You penetrated the first Russian lines of defense, but the offensive is getting stuck in the mud. We need to retreat towards Vienna and regroup North of the NeusiedlerSee.
column2: 你突破了俄军第一道防线，但攻势陷入泥泞、寸步难行。我们需要向维也纳方向撤退，并在新锡德尔湖以北重整。

column1: You performed magnificantly, striking a blow so serious to the US forces, that they have
column2: 你干得极为出色，给美军的一击如此沉重，以致他们已

column2: 你表现出色，但从南面开来的美军各师已给
