column2: 你表现出色，但从南面开来的美军各师已给被围的

column1: You poor performance has not helped the situation at all, I am sorry to say you are being replaced.
column2: 你糟糕的表现对局势毫无帮助，很遗憾，你将被替换。

column1: You restored some semblance of order, but still further south the situation is disastrous, you will now withdraw along the Warta to Frankfurt a/d Oder as soon as possible. Maybe we can still stop the Soviets with our troops arriving from the west.
column2: 您恢复了一些秩序，但更南面的局势仍是灾难性的，您现在要沿瓦尔塔河尽快撤往奥得河畔法兰克福。也许我们还能靠从西面赶来的部队挡住苏军。

column1: You seem to be very talented in working with our allies. You will go to Bucharest and Rome to pick up some medals, your troops will go to Italy to assure us of Italian loyalty, and to prepare its defence.
column2: 您似乎很擅长与我们的盟友打交道。您将前往布加勒斯特和罗马领取几枚勋章，您的部队将开赴意大利，以确保意大利的忠诚并筹备其防务。

column1: You should be able to do better.
You stabilized the flank, but Ivan was able to withdraw a sizable number
column2: 你稳住了侧翼，但伊万(Ivan)得以撤走了相当数量的

column1: You succeeded in destroying the entrenched Soviet Bunker Artillery but allowed the remnants of the enemy army to escape to Tobruk which will contain the strongest defenses you have encountered yet.
column2: 你成功摧毁了据守工事的苏军碉堡炮兵，却让敌军残余逃往托布鲁克(Tobruk)——那里的防御将是你迄今遇到的最强的。

column1: You take command from Narvik to war's end.
column2: 你从纳尔维克(Narvik)一路指挥到战争结束。

column1: You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II - and beyond!
column2: 您将从西班牙内战一路指挥到二战初期那些“闪电”胜利——并走向更远！

column1: You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II and beyond.
column2: 你将从西班牙内战开始执掌指挥权，经历二战初期那些「闪电」式的胜利，直至更远。

column1: You take command of Elite German SS PanzerDivisions from the civil
column2: 你指挥德国党卫军的精锐装甲师，从西班牙(Spain)的

column1: You take command of Elite German SS PanzerDivisions from the civil war in Spain, to the blitzkrieg victories of early World War II, and then to the tough battles with the Allies later in the war.
column2: 你将指挥精锐的德国党卫军装甲师，从西班牙内战，到二战初期闪击战的胜利，再到战争后期与盟军的苦战。

column1: You take control of Axis forces trying to re-open the way to Stalingrad, and try to change history.
column2: 你掌控试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)之路的轴心国军队，试着改变历史。

column1: You valliantly kept your positions, but on the Weichsel and the Prut we were beaten, Soviet troops are streaming into Romania, and have attacked Bulgaria.
column2: 您英勇地守住了阵地，但在维斯瓦河和普鲁特河一线我们被打败了，苏军正涌入罗马尼亚，并已进攻保加利亚。

column1: You went through Ivan like shit through a goose.
column2: 你穿过伊万的防线，就像热刀切黄油一样顺。

column1: You were brilliant! It is time to celebrate: the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa. Now I want you and your men to get some badly needed rest. Soon we will meet again.
column2: 你太出色了！该庆祝了：轴心国在非洲已被彻底击败。现在我要你和你的部下好好休整一下。我们很快会再见。

column1: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in Finland.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
column2: 你在芬兰酿成惨败后还能逃脱被俘，算你走运。不过，你以往的表现值得再给一次机会。别再让我们失望了。

column1: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in Finland.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
column2: 喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains) (#13) - 1944 年 10 月 11 日

column1: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in North Africa.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
column2: 你在北非(North Africa)闯下那场大祸之后能逃脱被俘，算是运气。不过，你以往的表现值得再给你一次机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: You were given the chance to end this war with a glorious victory.  Instead, you dithered on the approaches to the fascist capital, and have allowed the sacrifices of your brave troops to go to waste.  It is fortunate for you, Comrade General, that we have won the war. You will report immediately to a site in the Urals to engage in self-criticism.
column2: 你曾有机会以一场光荣的胜利结束这场战争。可你却在法西斯首都的接近地上犹豫不决，让你英勇部队的牺牲白白浪费。将军同志，对你来说幸运的是，我们打赢了这场战争。你将立即前往乌拉尔(Urals)某地作自我批评。

column1: You were lucky 2nd Pz and 10th Pz divisions captured your targets. Vayzma and Gzhatsk are in our hands now. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. Partisan activity makes it increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
column2: 你运气不错，第2装甲师与第10装甲师夺取了你的目标。维亚济马(Vayzma)与格扎茨克(Gzhatsk)现在都在我们手中。又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的包围圈里。游击队活动使我们在靠近前线的机场起降越来越困难（这就是那些机场不提供补给的原因）。现在是向东推进的时候了。目标是莫斯科(Moscow)。但愿我们没有浪费太多时间。情报报告说，西伯利亚部队已经抵达前线。

column1: You were not able to penetrate the Russian lines of defense. Retreat towards Vienna and regroup North of the NeusiedlerSee.
column2: 你未能突破俄军防线。向维也纳方向撤退，并在新锡德尔湖以北重整。

column1: You were not as brilliant as we expected from you, but you did it at last. Now It is time to celebrate because the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa.
column2: 你并不像我们期望的那样出色，但你终究做到了。现在该庆祝了，因为轴心国在非洲已被彻底击败。

column1: You were slow to cutoff Berlin making Monty's job harder, but he got the
column2: 你切断柏林的动作太慢，让蒙蒂(Monty)的任务更难了，不过他还是把

column1: You will be assisted by Kriegsmarine units, OKW has decided to mine the Mediterranean sea in the sector of Medhia Harbor in order to submit the Royal Navy to a blockade before the arrival of a "Wolfpack" of submarines.
column2: 你将得到海军(Kriegsmarine)部队的协助，国防军最高统帅部(OKW)已决定在地中海马赫迪耶(Medhia)港海域布雷，以便在「狼群」潜艇到达之前对皇家海军实施封锁。

column1: You will be given another opportunity at Warszawa.  Make the most of it!
column2: 在华沙(Warszawa)你会得到另一次机会。好好把握！

column1: You will be supported by the 4th panzer division and the 20th motorized division that coming from the south which has the objectives to capture the cities of Dartford and Bexteyhead, outside London.
column2: 你将得到第4装甲师以及从南面开来的第20摩托化师的支援，后者的目标是夺取伦敦(London)城外的达特福德(Dartford)与贝克斯泰海德(Bexteyhead)。

column1: You will be transfered to the rear for administrative duties.
column2: 你将被调到后方担任行政职务。

column1: You will now hurry to Berlin to prepare the final battle
column2: 您现在要赶往柏林，准备最后一场战斗

column1: You will win if you resist the Allied offensive for 32 turns and defend the city of Occhiobello behind the Po river.
column2: 你若能顶住盟军攻势 32 个回合，并守住波河后面的奥基奥贝洛(Occhiobello)城，就能获胜。

column1: You'll be reinforced by the Italian division "Livorno"
column2: 你将得到意大利「利沃诺」师的增援

column1: You're not worth to be "comrade". Comrade Stalin ordered to assault, but you were so slow and clumsy, that Nazis could regroup and counterattack. So, you shall be courtmartialled.
column2: 你不配当「同志」。斯大林同志下令进攻，可你如此迟缓笨拙，让纳粹得以重整并反击。因此，你将受到军法审判。

column1: You're not worth to be "comrade". Comrade Stalin ordered to assault, but you were so slow and clumsy, that Nazis could regroup and counterattack. You should have been courtmartialled but at the last minute Comrade Stalin decided to grant you a last chance. This humble gesture won't happen twice.
column2: 你不配被称作「同志」。斯大林同志下令进攻，但你又慢又笨，让纳粹得以重整并反击。你本该被交付军事法庭审判，但斯大林同志在最后一刻决定给你最后一次机会。这种宽宏之举不会再有第二次。

column1: You've chosen the path of Dover - Margate, good luck!!
column2: 你选择了多佛(Dover) - 马盖特(Margate)这条路线，祝你好运！！

column1: You've chosen the path of Gothic Line - Austria - Eagle's nest, good luck!!!
column2: 你选择了哥特防线(Gothic Line) - 奥地利 - 鹰巢(Eagle's nest)这条路线，祝好运！！！

column1: You've chosen the path of Market Garden - The Battle of the Bulge - The Ruhr, good luck!!!
column2: 你选择了市场花园(Market Garden) - 突出部之战(The Battle of the Bulge) - 鲁尔这条路线，祝好运！！！

column1: You've chosen the path to Brighton - Portsmouth, good luck !!!
column2: 你选择了通往布赖顿(Brighton) - 朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)的路线，祝你好运 ！！！

column1: You've chosen the path to Lyme Regis, good luck!!!
column2: 你选择了通往莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)的路线，祝你好运！！！

column1: You've cut Ivan's supply line and withstood the best he could throw at
column2: 你切断了伊万的补给线，并顶住了他所能投入的

column1: You've driven deep into Ivan's flank and severely restricted his supplies to
column2: 你已深深突入伊万(Ivan)的侧翼，并严重限制了他通往

column1: You've got a tough nut to crack this time.
column2: 这次你要啃的可是块硬骨头。

column1: You've got nothing in front of you so drive like hell!
column2: 你面前什么都没有，拼命开进吧！

column1: You've got to delay Ivan for at least a few days or we'll have to swim to England.
column2: 你必须至少迟滞伊万几天，否则我们就得游回英格兰了。

column1: You've heard the casualty reports from Europe?
column2: 你听到来自欧洲(Europe)的伤亡报告了吗？

column1: You've heard the casualty reports from Europe?
column2: 朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth) - 怀特岛(Isle of Wight)

column1: You've isolated the majority of Ivan's forces in the east and we should be
column2: 你已把伊万(Ivan)的大部分兵力孤立在东部，我们应该很快

column1: You've seen the intelligence reports about the buildup our "friends" are
column2: 你已看过情报报告了吧，我们的「朋友们」正在

column1: You, the player, can determine which campaign you want to play by moving your unit either south to Gibraltar or southeast towards Tobruk. If you want to play the classical Blitzkrieg! scenario path you should choose Tobruk. If you want to play the campaign called Greater Europe (also originally by H. Craig Miller) you should capture Gibraltar.
column2: 您——玩家——可以通过将部队向南移动至直布罗陀或向东南移动至托布鲁克来决定游玩哪场战役。如果您想游玩经典的闪电战场景路线，应选择托布鲁克。如果您想游玩名为"大欧洲"的战役（同样原由 H. Craig Miller 设计），则应夺取直布罗陀。

column1: Your 22nd Pz has suceeded, but the 21st Pz has failed, the allies now have an uninterrupted bridgehead from Isigny to the Orne. It is quite clear they had hoped to have Cherbourg as a harbour, but your bold actions have prevented that. However, there is no chance whatsoever that we can drive hem back into the sea now.
column2: 您的第22装甲师成功了，但第21装甲师失败了，盟军如今拥有从伊西尼到奥恩河一线连绵不断的桥头堡。很明显他们本希望把瑟堡作为港口，但您的果敢行动使其未能得逞。然而，我们现在已毫无可能把他们赶下海去。

column1: Your advance bagged the rest of Ivan's forces in the East.
column2: 你的推进把伊万在东部的其余部队全都兜了进去。

column1: Your assignment will be to attack the industrial complex of Chicago and to prevent the Americans from using one of their main production centers.
column2: 你的任务将是进攻芝加哥(Chicago)的工业综合体，阻止美国人使用他们的一个主要生产中心。

column1: Your assignment will be to merge your units to that defense line and to destroy those bastards.\x00
column2: 你的任务将是把你的部队并入那道防线，并消灭那些混蛋。\x00

column1: Your assignment: Restore the defensive line and crush the Allied bridgeheads.
column2: 你的任务：恢复防线，粉碎盟军的桥头堡。

column1: Your attack hit the Allies hard, however they had time enough to strenghten their positions in the south. The Montgomery Army is closing in fast so it will be better to retreat to the north.
column2: 你的进攻狠狠打击了盟军，但他们有足够时间加强在南面的阵地。蒙哥马利(Montgomery)的集团军正在迅速逼近，所以最好向北撤退。

column1: Your Das Reich division is part of Guderian's 2nd Panzer Gruppe. Your troops have covered more than 700km in a bit over 2 weeks since Operation Barbarossa started but have not seen much action yet.
column2: 你的「帝国」师隶属古德里安的第2装甲集群。自「巴巴罗萨」行动开始以来，你的部队在两周多一点的时间里已推进700多公里，但尚未经历多少战斗。

column1: Your division has been transferred from Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe - South of us - to Hoepner's 4 Pz Gruppe for the final drive on Moscow. Our first task is to break through the Russian lines, following the 10Pz Div and move North to Vyazma to make contact with Hoth's 3rd Pz Gruppe North of us and encirle the Russian 16th, 19th and 20th Soviet Armies of the Western Front and the 24th and 32th Armies of the Reserve Front. The Russians made the mistake of putting their Reserve front in the first line of battle. Once we break through their lines we should be able to move on Vyazma and Gzatsk without too much resistance. Gzatsk is a city vital for or further drive on Moscow and also vital for the Russian defense of Moscow.
column2: 你的师已从我们以南古德里安的第2装甲集群转隶霍普纳的第4装甲集群，参加向莫斯科的最后推进。我们的首要任务是突破俄军防线，跟随第10装甲师北上维亚济马，与我们以北霍特的第3装甲集群建立联系，并合围西方面军的俄军第16、第19、第20集团军以及预备方面军的第24、第32集团军。俄国人犯了把预备方面军摆在第一线的错误。一旦我们突破其防线，就应能在阻力不大的情况下向维亚济马和格扎茨克推进。格扎茨克是继续向莫斯科推进的关键城市，对俄军防守莫斯科也同样关键。

column1: Your division has held it's objectives and fought off several counter-attacks, well done to you and your men.
column2: 你的师守住了目标，并击退了数次反击，你和你的部下干得好。

column1: Your division is one of the few Panzer divisions facing the Americans in Normandy. Send a KG to La-Haye-du-Puits in support of the 353th Division that is under heavy American attack. Send another KG to support 17SS Panzergrenadier Division "Goetz von Berlichingen" in its counterattack NW of St-Lo. The rest of your forces will be kept in reserve for now.
column2: 你的师是诺曼底为数不多面对美军的装甲师之一。派一个战斗群前往拉艾迪皮，支援正遭美军猛攻的第353师。再派一个战斗群，支援党卫军第17装甲掷弹兵师「格茨·冯·贝利欣根」在圣洛西北的反击。你其余的部队暂作预备队。

column1: Your division is ordered to move to the Eastern front to stop the new Russian winter offensive.
column2: 你的师奉命调往东线，去阻止俄军新的冬季攻势。

column1: Your Division will now be returned to England for some much needed R&R and refitting. Enjoy your break Bob because we will be calling on your veterans again soon I'm sure.
column2: 你的师现在将调回英格兰，进行急需的休整与整补。好好享受假期吧，鲍勃，因为我敢肯定，很快我们又会请你的老兵出马。

column1: Your effort was a success. Now our divisions can retreat to the Gothic Line.
column2: 你的努力取得了成功。现在我们的各师可以撤往哥特防线(Gothic Line)了。

column1: Your efforts have been very meritorious, but the Americans have broken the line in El Guettar, so we don't have another choice: the retreat.
column2: 你的努力十分可嘉，但美军已在盖塔尔(El Guettar)突破防线，我们别无选择：撤退。

column1: Your efforts have been very meritorious, but the Americans have broken the line in El Guettar, so we don't have another choice: the retreat.
Your failure in the invasion on Malta, will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where the prestige will be lacking.
column2: 你在马耳他(Malta)入侵中的失败，将把你引向阿拉曼(Alamein)地区那条更具历史意义的道路，在那里威望将会匮乏。

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have already have begun to counterattack.  You are now reassigned to duty as commander of our garrison in the Falkland Islands.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军各集团军已经开始反击。你现被改派为我们驻福克兰群岛(Falkland Islands)守备部队的指挥官。

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have escaped encirclement and already have begun to counterattack.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军各集团军已逃出合围，并且已经开始反击。

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have escaped encirclement and already have begun to counterattack.  The General Staff has no need for incompetent commanders.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军已逃出合围，并已开始反攻。总参谋部不需要无能的指挥官。

column1: Your failure is hard to stomach, Commander. I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 你的失败令人难以接受，指挥官。我跟你无话可说了。

column1: Your failure to follow the advice of your political advisors has cost the party dearly.  Only by bringing in reinforcements could the crossing of the Dnepr be forced.  It is clear the party must place a more dedicated communist in command.  Report to Stalingrad immediately to assist in rebuilding that city.
column2: 你未能听从政治顾问的建议，使党付出了沉重代价。只有投入增援，才能强渡第聂伯河(Dnepr)。显然，党必须任命一位更忠诚的共产党人来指挥。立即前往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)报到，协助重建该城。

column1: Your failure to follow the clear directives of the Party's Central Committee has resulted in a grievous defeat.  You are therefore to report to Yakutsk, to study further the writings of Marx, Lenin and the Great Stalin.
column2: 你未能遵循党中央委员会的明确指示，导致了一场惨痛的失败。因此，你须前往雅库茨克(Yakutsk)报到，进一步研读马克思(Marx)、列宁(Lenin)与伟大的斯大林的著作。

column1: Your failure will have implications for our winter counterattack.
column2: 你的失败将影响我们的冬季反击。

column1: Your first assignment as PLA's commander will be in the Jilin province, our base there is placed at Linjiang. The situation in Manchuria is complex. We need Manchuria for some reasons, first, it's border is close with the USSR and the support we are receiving from the Soviets, and second, Manchuria is the most industrialised area in the whole China, we need the resources from here, and we need to avoid the profits the Kuomingtang can get from here.
column2: 你作为解放军指挥员的第一项任务将在吉林省，我们在那里的基地设在临江。满洲的局势很复杂。我们需要满洲有几个原因：第一，它的边界靠近苏联，也靠近我们正从苏联获得的支援；第二，满洲是全中国工业化程度最高的地区，我们需要这里的资源，也需要防止国民党从中获利。

column1: your force was almost completely decimated.  Your men are rather unhappy at
column2: 你的部队却几乎被全歼。你的部下对你的表现

column1: Your forces are being transferred east where you cannot interfere with the war effort further.
column2: 你的部队正被调往东线，在那里你再也无法干扰战事了。

column1: Your forces are well under way to Budapest. The Bolsheviks are astounded by the success of your offensive against their over-extended forces. Stalin has indicated he wants to negotiate a peace settlement. This will allow us to direct forces to the west to fight the Western Allies.
column2: 你的部队正向布达佩斯(Budapest)顺利推进。布尔什维克对你打击其战线过长之敌所取得的胜利感到震惊。斯大林已表示愿意商谈和平解决方案。这将使我们得以把部队调往西线，与西方盟国作战。

column1: Your forces are well under way to Budapest. The Bolsheviks are astounded by the success of your offensive against their over-extended forces. Stalin has indicated he wants to negotiate a peace settlement. This will bring peace to Europe and will save our country. You performed wonderfully General.
column2: 你的部队正顺利向布达佩斯推进。布尔什维克对你进攻他们战线过长的部队所取得的成功感到震惊。斯大林已表示愿意谈判和平解决。这将为欧洲带来和平，也将拯救我们的国家。你干得非常出色，将军。

column1: Your forces arrived at The Hague too late to capture the Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina - they managed to escape to England. Fortunately the Dutch have capitulated after the center of Rotterdam was bombed into oblivion by the He-111s of Kampfgeschwader 4.
column2: 你的部队抵达海牙太晚，没能俘获荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王——他们成功逃往英格兰。所幸在第4轰炸航空团的 He-111 把鹿特丹市中心炸成废墟后，荷兰人投降了。

column1: Your forces have been stopped. Capturing Moscow before winter will become very difficult now.
column2: 你的部队已被挡住。如今要在入冬前拿下莫斯科将极为困难。

column1: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will allow us to direct forces to the west to fight the Western Allies.
column2: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将使我们能把兵力调往西线，与西方盟国作战。

column1: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will bring peace to Europe and will save our country. You performed wonderfully General.
column2: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将为欧洲带来和平，也将拯救我们的国家。你干得非常出色，将军。

column1: Your great victory hit the Allies hard, however they had time enough to strenghten their positions in the south. The Montgomery Army is closing in fast, so it will be better to retreat to the north.
column2: 你的重大胜利狠狠打击了盟军，但他们有足够时间加强在南面的阵地。蒙哥马利(Montgomery)的集团军正在迅速逼近，所以最好向北撤退。

column1: Your HQ at: Salas, Asturias, October 1936
column2: 你的司令部设于：阿斯图里亚斯，萨拉斯，1936年10月

column1: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have put back our weary troops all along the front.
column2: 你未能夺取莫斯科城内与周边的目标，已导致灾难。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，把我们战线过长、一度无敌的军队打得七零八落。这个冬天苏军的猛烈反击，把疲惫的我军全线逼退。

column1: Your indecisiveness showed poor coordination between combined arms, terrible usage of reconnaisance, and a very poor dispersal of units.  Your performance has left the units under your command in shambles.
column2: 你的优柔寡断暴露出诸兵种协同拙劣、侦察运用糟糕，以及部队部署极为不当。你的表现使你麾下的部队陷入一片混乱。

column1: Your job was to prevent Ivan from pulling his forces back along the
column2: 你的任务是阻止伊万(Ivan)沿

column1: Your lack of leadership under fire is simply not acceptable - we expected much more of you. I believe the stress is getting to you after all these years so I have recommended that you be sent home on an extended leave.
column2: 你在炮火下缺乏领导力，这绝对不可接受——我们对你的期望要高得多。我相信这么多年下来，压力已经影响到你了，所以我已建议让你回家长期休假。

column1: Your leadership has shattered the British forces.  Congratulations, Herr General.  Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk before the English can prepare an effective defense.
column2: 你的领导击垮了英军。恭喜，将军阁下。现在，我们必须在英国人组织起有效防御之前攻占托布鲁克港。

column1: Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness.   Some of the enemy has retreated into Romania.  The British and French have now declared war on Germany.  If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
column2: 你并不出彩的表现让人不得不重新评估你的价值。部分敌人已撤入罗马尼亚。英法现已对德宣战。若不是我们还需要每一个人去打仗，你的军旅生涯就该到此为止了！

column1: Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness. We have been forced to evacuate all our troops from the continent. If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
column2: 你并不出色的表现促使我们重新评估你的用处。我们被迫从大陆撤出全部部队。若不是我们还需要每一个人去战斗，你的军旅生涯就到此为止了！

column1: Your main task is to advance your troops to the center of Asturian and to give further assistance to Gijon and Oviedo.  You may recruit troops for a column under your command.
column2: 你的主要任务是率部推进到阿斯图里亚斯中部，向希洪和奥维耶多提供进一步支援。你可以招募部队，组成一支由你指挥的纵队。

column1: Your men shall be withdrawn to France for a deserved rest.
column2: 你的部下将撤往法国，获得他们应得的休整。

column1: Your mission is i) to stop the Germans in the river in order to permit the redeployment of the allied armies and ii) to safely retreat your troops, so do not engage them unnecessarily.
column2: 您的任务是：其一，把德军阻止在河中，以便盟军重新部署；其二，安全撤出您的部队，因此不要不必要地与敌交战。

column1: Your mission is to advance as fast as you can to avoid the lost of Gravesend and restore the front.
column2: 你的任务是以最快速度推进，以免失去格雷夫森德(Gravesend)并恢复战线。

column1: Your mission is to capture the important industrial city of Nancy and secure a springboard for our fall offensive into Germany itself. Without full control of this rail and shipping center, our advance will be impossible.  Commander, please be advised, that directly east of the city, Jerry has armored forces ready to counterattack any offensive against this stronghold.
column2: 你的任务是夺取重要的工业城市南锡(Nancy)，为我们秋季攻入德国本土取得一块跳板。没有对这座铁路与航运中心的完全控制，我们的推进就不可能实现。指挥官，请注意，在该城正东面，德国佬已备好装甲部队，准备反击任何针对这一据点的进攻。

column1: Your mission is to evacuate the greatest possible number of troops.
column2: 你的任务是撤出尽可能多的部队。

column1: Your mission is to reach the port of Hungnam while destroying all enemy forces along your way.  You must stop any UN evacuation as soon as possible.  A successful evacuation will be a victory for them.  The 2nd, 6th and 10th North Korean divisions (the 2nd Korean People's Army) will be under your direct command and the 20th PLA will arrive from the South as reinforcements.
column2: 你的任务是推进到兴南港，同时消灭沿途所有敌军。你必须尽快阻止联合国军任何撤离行动。撤离成功对他们来说就是一场胜利。朝鲜人民军第2、第6和第10师（朝鲜人民军第2军）将归你直接指挥，解放军第20军将从南面赶来作为增援。

column1: Your mission will be the destruction of this movement to protect our rearguard.
column2: 你的任务将是破坏这次调动，以保护我们的后卫。

column1: Your mission will be to prevent this attack and to locate the place where terrorists took radio contact with Yankees. You are allowed to deploy only two of your best units. Fly to Moscow at once! Once captured bring traitors to the Lubyanka for interrogation purposes. Failure is not an option. Dismissed comrade General!
column2: 你的任务将是阻止这次袭击，并查明恐怖分子与美国佬进行无线电联络的地点。你只被允许部署你最好的两个单位。立即飞往莫斯科(Moscow)！一旦抓获，就把叛徒带到卢比扬卡(Lubyanka)审讯。失败不是选项。解散，将军同志！

column1: Your mission won't be easy of course, you have to resist until our second attack wave arrive in Dover and you have to avoid British fleet to close the open line, no matter the cost.
column2: 你的任务当然不会轻松，你必须坚持到我们的第二波进攻抵达多佛(Dover)，还必须不惜一切代价阻止英国舰队封闭这条畅通的航线。

column1: Your mission: Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
column2: 你的任务：全速推进，夺取泰贝萨(Tebessa)。

column1: Your mission: Break through the British lines and force the B.E.F. to surrender. Beware of British counterattacks. Their armoured brigade has already brought Rommel's 7thPz division and the Totenkopf into problems a few days ago near Arras.
column2: 你的任务：突破英军防线，迫使英国远征军投降。提防英军反击。几天前在阿拉斯附近，他们的装甲旅已让隆美尔的第7装甲师和「骷髅」师陷入麻烦。

column1: Your mission: show the enemy that we are no defeated, advance quickly towards the inner Tunes to create a chaos within their armies.
column2: 你的任务：向敌人表明我们并未战败，迅速向突尼斯内陆推进，在他们的军队中制造混乱。

column1: Your mission: Show the enemy that we are not defeated, advance quickly towards the interior of Tunisia to create chaos within their armies.
column2: 您的任务：向敌人表明我们并未失败，迅速向突尼斯内陆推进，在他们的军队中制造混乱。

column1: Your mission: try to delay the Allied advance towards Rome to give us time to evacuate troops retreating from Cassino. Before the Allies cut the roads - you will counterattack with your HG panzer division that was appointed as OKW reserve north of Rome.
column2: 你的任务：设法迟滞盟军向罗马的推进，为我们争取时间撤出从卡西诺退下来的部队。在盟军切断道路之前——你将用你的赫尔曼·戈林装甲师发起反击，该师已被指定为罗马以北的国防军最高统帅部预备队。

column1: Your mission:- Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
column2: 你的任务：——全速推进并夺取泰贝萨。

column1: Your new base in Poland will desperately need supplies if it is to flank the Soviets and liberate Germany. A convoy is on route to your base, however the road is blocked by Soviet troops.
column2: 你在波兰(Poland)的新基地若要包抄苏军并解放德国，就急需补给。一支运输队正开往你的基地，但道路被苏军部队阻断。

column1: Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
column2: 你的下一个任务是前往满洲边境。你对我们的学说不理解得还不够透彻！！！

column1: Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!! Punishment could have been more severe.
column2: 你的下一个任务在满洲(Manchurian)边境。你对我们的学说理解得还不够透彻！！！惩罚本可以更严厉。

column1: Your next assignment will be enclose the Anglo-American armies that are in Bone.
column2: 您的下一项任务将是围歼位于博讷的英美军队。

column1: Your next assignment will be: try to enclose the Angloamerican armies which are currently in Bone.
column2: 你的下一个任务将是：设法包围目前位于博讷(Bone)的英美军队。

column1: Your next objective is Obojan.  It is likely heavily defended Smash them!
column2: 你的下一个目标是奥博扬(Obojan)。那里很可能防御坚固，粉碎他们！

column1: Your next operation will be to try and enclose the Anglo-American Armies in Bone.
column2: 你的下一次作战将是设法把英美军队合围于博讷。

column1: Your next operation will be: try to enclose the Angloamerican's Armies toward Bone.
column2: 你的下一次行动将是：设法把英美联军围向博讷(Bone)。

column1: Your objective is the City of Canterbury and the airstrip of Lympne, crucial communication center of the enemy. The resistance you will find will probably be the rest of 10th and 12th infantry.
column2: 你的目标是坎特伯雷(Canterbury)城与林普尼(Lympne)简易机场——敌人至关重要的通信中心。你将遭遇的抵抗很可能来自第10和第12步兵部队的残部。

column1: Your offensive was a complete disaster. We will have to wait for the infantry divisions to catch up before we can try another Dniepr crossing.
column2: 你的攻势彻底失败。我们得等步兵师赶上来，才能再尝试一次强渡第聂伯河。

column1: Your orders are to cross the Gargliano and establish a bridgehead in preparation for an offensive up the Liri Valley. Once the landings at Anzio go ahead we will be in position to quickly capture Rome.
column2: 你的命令是渡过加里利亚诺河、建立桥头堡，为向利里河谷发起攻势做准备。一旦安齐奥的登陆开始，我们就能处在迅速夺取罗马的位置上。

column1: Your orders are to cut off retreating route of German Army Group E.
column2: 你的命令是切断德军E集团军群的退路。

column1: Your orders are to give support to the 16th army controlling the cities to the outskirts of London, so that the 16th can keep moving to the North.
column2: 你的命令是支援第16集团军控制伦敦(London)郊外的各城市，以便第16集团军能继续向北推进。

column1: Your orders are to throw the landings on the southern Pelloponese back into the sea. However, a massive airlanding near Corinth threatens to cut of your supply lines. I secretly but urgently advise you to give up your positions in the South and to throw everything you have against these paratroopers. An escape to Attica is your best option.
column2: 您的命令是把伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部的登陆部队赶下海去。然而，一场在科林斯附近的大规模机降正威胁切断您的补给线。我私下但紧急地建议您放弃南部阵地，把您手头的一切都投向这些伞兵。撤往阿提卡是您最好的选择。

column1: Your PanzerKorps has been ordered to the rear to refit and prepare for future action.
column2: 你的装甲军已奉命撤往后方整补，为日后的行动做准备。

column1: Your part of the offensive, Operation Honker, is to break through the line and advance up the Liri valley until you reach the Hitler Line. Meanwhile, the Americans will break out of Anzio to meet you and trap the Germans between the 2 spearheads - or so we hope.
column2: 你在这次攻势中的部分——雁鸣行动(Operation Honker)——是突破防线，沿利里(Liri)河谷推进，直到抵达希特勒防线。与此同时，美国人将从安齐奥(Anzio)突围来与你会合，把德军困在两个矛头之间——我们希望如此。

column1: Your performance makes me wonder if you're the right guy for the job.
column2: 你的表现让我怀疑你是否适合这份差事。

column1: Your performance was barely adequate Commander. I expect more from you in the future.
column2: 你的表现只是勉强合格，指挥官。今后我对你有更高的期望。

column1: Your performance was pathetic and you cannot stay in charge in this campaign. The Allies have taken the Gustav Line and Rome is about to fall.
column2: 你的表现可悲，在这场战役中你不能再继续指挥。盟军已夺取古斯塔夫防线，罗马即将陷落。

column1: Your quick advance has created a salient in the enemy lines, like the one at the Chosin Reservoir.  This sector is protected by a North American division.  Your task is to make a surprise attack from two different directions and destroy the entire enemy division.  Be careful, our spies report that it's a crack division and they have air support from an improvised airstrip near the reservoir.  Air reinforcements are on the way.
column2: 你的快速推进在敌军战线上形成了一个突出部，就像长津湖这里的这个。这一地段由一个北美师掩护。你的任务是从两个不同方向发起奇袭，全歼该敌师。小心，我们的间谍报告说那是一个精锐师，而且他们从水库附近的一座临时机场获得空中支援。空中增援正在赶来。

column1: Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  Good work.
column2: 你在西梅托河谷的成功突破打开了通往墨西拿之路。整个地区都在我们控制之下。干得好。

column1: Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
column2: 你在西梅托河谷的成功突破打开了通往墨西拿(Messina)之路。整个地区都在我们控制之下。应当向你道贺。干得漂亮！

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  Good day, Herr General.
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。日安，将军阁下。

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。干得漂亮！

column1: Your targets are the big city of Gravesend and the minor cities of Dartford and Bexteyhead, which are in London's outskirts. Paratrooper groups are leading the attack to eliminate defensive positions and delay enemy's counterattacks.
column2: 你的目标是格雷夫森德(Gravesend)这座大城市，以及位于伦敦(London)郊外的达特福德(Dartford)与贝克斯泰海德(Bexteyhead)两座小城。伞兵部队正带头进攻，以消灭防御阵地并迟滞敌人的反击。

column1: Your task is ''easy'', stop the americans, and kick them out from the Tokyo sector. Our special air attack units (tokko), and our land attack units recruited from the population will attack in first wave... they are deployed in the beaches, and we are sure they will act like true samurais, then, use your units to counterattack... This is the last battle of the war, we must get the victory to save the Japanese Empire, or die.
column2: 您的任务很“轻松”：挡住美国人，把他们赶出东京地区。我们的特别航空攻击队（特攻）以及从民众中征募的陆上攻击队将作为第一波发起攻击……他们部署在海滩上，我们相信他们会像真正的武士那样作战，随后，用您的部队发起反击……这是战争的最后一战，我们必须取胜以拯救日本帝国，否则就只有死。

column1: Your task is to accomplish the codenamed "Operation Theseus". This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.
column2: 你的任务是完成代号「忒修斯」行动(Operation Theseus)。这次行动意味着以非洲军(DAK)最精锐的装甲部队突破比尔哈凯姆(Bir Hacheim)地区的敌军防线，并迅速向敌后推进，包围敌人。最后，你应当突击托布鲁克(Tobruk)要塞，并夺取所有其他任务目标。

column1: Your task is to accomplish the codenamed ,,Operation Theseus''. This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.

日托米尔(Zhitomir) - 1943 年 11 月 19 日

column1: Zhitomir was taken, and although it would soon have to be relinquished, Soviet supply routes between the city and Kiev were cut.  The Leibstandarte moved on Brusilov, where it met a strong concentration of 5th and 8th Guards Armoured Corps, and 1st Guard Cavalry Corps.  With the 1st and 9th Panzer Divisions attacking the northern and southern flanks, and Leibstandarte from the west, on 24th November the concentration was encircled and destroyed.  On 16th December amid biting cold and blinding snowstorms the division advanced east with the 1st and 7th Panzer divisions from Korosten, aiming at encircling the Soviet armies around Meleni.  This was achieved, but with so few troops that the positions could not be held and soon attack turned to retreat.
column2: 日托米尔(Zhitomir)被攻占，虽然很快又不得不放弃，但该城与基辅(Kiev)之间的苏军补给线被切断。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)向布鲁西洛夫(Brusilov)推进，在那里遭遇了第5与第8近卫装甲军以及第1近卫骑兵军的强大集群。在第1与第9装甲师进攻南北两翼、警卫旗队从西面进攻的情况下，11 月 24 日这个集群被合围并歼灭。12 月 16 日，在刺骨严寒与令人目盲的暴风雪中，该师与第1、第7装甲师一起从科罗斯坚(Korosten)向东推进，目标是合围梅列尼(Meleni)周边的苏军集团军。目标达成了，但兵力太少，阵地无法守住，攻势很快转为退却。
